j nhn jy wT ahy jn ty fDl kyw thy'y, nh nhn jy (wT) jn ty (tnhnjw) Dmr thyl ahy & nh gmrhn jy (wT).
lm
hyu ktb, jnhn +m kw shk kwnhy, unhn khd trsn khy sidhw rstw DykhryndR ahy,
jyky N Dtthy ty ymn aNynd ahn & nmz pRhnd ahn & khyn jyky rzq Dnwsyn tnhn mn khrchynd ahn.
& uhy (y pyGmbr) jykw (qran) tw Dnhn lthw wyw & jyky twkhn G (byn pyGmbrn ty) lthw wyw tnhn khy mnyynd ahn & uhy akhrt ty yqyn rkhnd ahn.
ihy y'y (nhya) sdhy wT ty ahn j sndn plNhr khn (Dsyl) ahy & ihy y'y cchwTkry wr ahn.
byshk jn nkr kyw tn ty (y pyGmbr!) tnhnjw khyn Dydyryn y nh Dydyryn (sw) hkjhRw ahy ihy ymn nh aNynd.
llh sndn dlyn ty & sndn knn ty muhr hny'y ahy, & sndn khyn ty cchawRu (chRhyl) ahy & unhn li wDw `dhb ahy.
& mNhn mn ky (hR) ahn jy chwnd ahn th llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyywsyn & Hqyqt +m uhy mw'mn nh ahn.
llh & mwmnn khy dlbw Dynd ahn, & Hlnk pN khn swi (by'y knhn khy) dlbw nh Dynd ahn & nh smjhnd ahn.
sndn dlyn +m (mnfqya jy) bymry ahy pwi llh sndyn bymry wdhy'y, & nhya kry jw (hw) kuwR Glhy'ynd ahn nhn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.
& jDhn khyn chy'bw ahy th mulk +m fsd nh wjhw, chwnd ahn th syn sdhryndR y'y ahywn.
khbrdr! ihy pN fsdy ahn pr nh smjhnd ahn.
& jDhn khyn chy'bw ahy th jhRy TrH byn mNhn ymn andw ahy (thRy TrH whyn bh) ymn aNyw (tDhn) chwnd ahn th jy'n by smjhn ymn andw ahy ty'n ymn aNywn cch? khbrdr, uhy y'y by smjh ahn pr nh dyNnd ahn.
& jDhn mw'mnn khy mlnd ahn (tDhn) chwnd ahn th sn ymn andw ahy, & jDhn pnhnjn shyTnn (srdrn) khy hyklw mlnd ahn (tDhn) chwnd ahn th syn (pr +m) whn sn ahywn syn (mw'mnn sn) rGw chthr kndR ahywn.
llh sNn chthr kndw ahy & nhn khy pnhnjy srkshy +m Dygh Dyndw ahy jw `ql j ndh ahn.
ihy uhy ahn jn hdyt jy bdrn gmrhy Gdhy, pwi sndn wpr khyn fy'dw nh Dnw & nky uhy hdyt wr thy.
sndn mthl nhya jy mthl jhRw ahy jnhn bh bry, pwi jnhn mhl bh pnhnjy as ps khy rwshn kyw (tnhn mhl) llh sndn swjhrw jhyw & khyn wndhya +m cchDy Dny'yn jw nh Dsn.
(uhy) bwR, gwng, ndh ahn pwi uhy nh mwTnd.
y (sndn mthl unhy) asmny brst (wrn) jhRw ahy jnhn +m wndhywn & gwR & wdy hjy, uhy pnhnjywn aNrywn pnhnjn knn +m, kRkn khn mwt jy bhaw kry wjhn, & llh kfrn khy ghyrw kndR ahy.

wdy sndn khyn (jy swjhry khy) umlk khsN ty hujy, jDhn nhn li chmky th mnjhs hln th, & jDhn mthn wndh kry tDhn byhy rhn th, & jykDhn llh ghry th sndn khywn & sndn kn Drwr wnyy'y cchDy, byshk llh sbh knhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
y mNhw' pnhnjy nhya plNhr jy `bdt kryw jnhn whn khy & jy whn khn G huy' tn khy pyd kywth mna whyn Ddyw.
jnhn whn li zmyn khy wcchNw bNyw & asmn khy ccht, & (mynhn jw) pNy asmn khn wsyy'yn pwi un sn (hr jns jy) mywn mnjhn whn li rwzy pyd kyy'yn, pwi whyn dyN hwndy llh sn knhn khy shryk nh kryw.
& pnhnjy bnhy ty jykw (qran) lthwswn tnhn khn jykDhn whyn shk +m ahywth jhRys ky'y suwr@ bNy'y aNyw, & llh khn swi pnhnj mddgr (bh) sDyw jykDhn sch ahyw.
pwi jykDhn nh kndw', & kry bh kDhn nh sghndw', th nhya bh khn Ddyw jnhn jw bl mNhw & phN ahn, uh nh mnyyndRn li tyr ky'y wy'y ahy.

& jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn khy hya khwshkhbry Dy th nhn li bhsht ahn jn jy hytthn whywn pywn whn, jDhn un mn kw bh myww khdy li Dnw pyw wyndn (tnhn mhl) py chwnd th hyu (myww) uhw ahy jw G sn khy Dnw wyw hw & uhw (shkl +m) hk jhRw (pyw) Dbn, & nhn li mnjhs pk zlwn ahn & uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.

llh mcchr & un khn wdhyk jy mthl DyN khn Hy y'y nh kndwahy, pwi jn ymn andw ahy sy (pk) dyNnd ahn th uhw sndn plNhr wTn (ayl) sch ahy, & jn nkr kyw sy chwnd ahn th hn mthl DyN +m llh jw cch mTlb ahy? (llh) n mthl (DyN) sbbn ghNn khy bhly'yndw ahy & n sbbn ghNn khy sdhw rstw Dykhryndw ahy, un sn hRn by dynn khnswi (by knhyn khy) nh bhly'yndw ahy.
jyky llh jw njm n jy pky krN khnpwi bhnynd ahn, & llh jn kmn jy GnddhN jw Hkm kyw ahy tn khy cchnnd ahn & mulk +m fsd wjhnd ahn, uhy y'y cchyy'y wr ahn.
whyn hn hwndy bh llh khy khRy TrH nh th mnyyw? jw by sh huyw' pwi whn khy jyy'rw kyy'yn, wry whn khy mryndw, wry whn khy jyryndw & wry Dnhs mwTy wyndw'.
uhw (llh) ahy jnhn twhn (jy fy'dy) li jyky mRyy'y (shywn) zmyn +m ahn sy pyd kywn, wry asmn Dnhn mtwjh thyw pwi unhn khy st asmn kry brbr byhryy'yn, & uhw (llh) sbhknhn shyi khy dyNndR ahy.

& (y pyGmbr) jDhn tnhnjy plNhr mly'kn khy chyw th aun zmyn +m hk ny'b muqrr krN wrw ahyn, (tDhn) chyy'wn th cch mnjhs hRy khy thw pyd kryn jw mnjhs fsd kndw & (nHq) rt hryndw, & syn tnhnjy srh sn (tnhnjy) pky'y wkhNywn th & twkhy pk kry mnyywn th, frmyy'yn th jyky aun dyNndw ahyn sw twhn nth dyNw.
& (llh) adm khy sbhny shyn j nl sykhry wry uhy shywn mly'kn jy aDw kyy'yn pwi frmyy'yn th jykDhn sch ahyw th hnn j nl Dsywm.
chyy'wn th twn pk ahyn jyky sn khy dyNyw thyy'y tnhn khnswi sn khy (by) k khbr nh ahy, byshk twn y'y dyNndR Hkmt wrw ahyn.

(llh) chyw th y adm nhn j nl khyn Ds, pwi jDhn khyn nhn j nl Dsyy'yn (tDhn llh) chyw th whn khy nh chyw hwm cch th aun asmnn & zmyn jw Gjh dyNndw ahyn & jyky pdhrw kyw th & jyky lkyw th sw bh dyNndw ahyn.
& jDhn mly'kn khy chywswn th adm khy sjdw kryw tDhn shyTn dhrn (byn) sjdw kyw, hn nkr kyw & htth kyy'yn & kfrn mn thyw.
& chywswn th y adm twn & tnhnjy zl bhsht +m Tkw & jtn wNywa ttn mzy sn khy'w, & hn wN khy wyjh nh wnyjw nh th Zlmn (jy shmr) mn thyndw'.

pwi shyTn uthwn nhn khy thyRyw pwi jnhn (mzy) +m hy' tnhn mn khyn (bhr) kddhyy'yn, & chywswn th (bhsht mn) nkry hytth thyw whyn hk by'y j wyry ahyw, & whn li knhn wqt ty'yn zmyn +m rhk jw hndh & (gdhrn jw) smn (tthhryl) ahy.
pwi adm pnhnjy plNhr wTn ky lfZ skhy pwi (llh) snds twbh qbwl ky'y, byshk uhw y'y twbh qbwlyndR mhrbn ahy.
chywsyn th mnjhny's sbh lhy hytth wnyw, pwi jDhn mwn wTn whn wT k hdyt chy tDhn jyky mnhnjy hdyt ty hlnd tn khy kw bhw' kwnhy & nky uhy Gmgyn rhnd.
& jn nh mnyyw & snjy aytn khy kuwRw dytw sy dwzkhy ahn, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.
y y`qwb jy wld uhw mnhnjw GN yd kryw jykw mwn twhn ty kyw & mnhnjw njm pRyw th aun (bh) whn jw njm pRyn & rGw mwn khn Dp rkhw.
& (y bny sry'yl) jykw whn wT ahy (y`ny twryt) tnhn khy schw kndR jykw (qran ty) lthm tnhnkhy mnyyw & n j phryn mnkr nh thyw, & mnhnjy aytn khy (dny jy) thwry mlh sn nh wkNw, & rGw mwn kh Ddyw.
& sch khy kwR sn nh mlyw & nky whyn dyN hwndy bh sch lkyw.
& nmz pRhw & zkw@ Dyw & rkw` kndRn sn gDjy rkw` kyw.
mNhn khy chNy'ya jw Hkm kryw th & pN khy wsryw th? hn hwndy bh jw twhyn ktb pRhw th, pwi cchw nh th smjhw?
& Sbr & nmz sn mdd wtthw, & uh nhn azy kndRn khnswi byn khy Drwr Dkhy (lGndy) ahy.
jyky pk bhy'ynd ahn th uhy pnhnjy plNhr khy mlN wr ahn & uhy Dnhs mwTN wr ahn.
y bny sry'ylw uhw mnhnjw GN yd kryw jykw mwn whn ty kyw & mwn whn khy jhn (wrn) ty sGwrw kyw.
& unhya Dynhn khn Ddyw jnhn +m kw (bh) knhyn khn kjh bh Try nh sghndw & nky khny's k prt qbwl kby & nky khny's kw `iwD wtthbw nky khyn mdd Dby.

& (hy GN bh yd kryw) th jDhn whn khy fr`wn jy mNhn khn cchDywswn jy whn khy Dddhw ydhu chkhy'ynd hy', jw whn j puT khnd hy' & whn jwn dhyy'rwn jyy'rywn cchDynd hy', & un +m whn jy plNhr khn whn li wDy prkh huy'y.
& (yd kryw th) jDhn whn li smnD khy chyrywswn pwi whn khy (bDN khn) bchywswn & fr`wn jy mNhn khy bwRywswn & whyn Dsnd rhyw'.
& (yd kryw th) jDhn mws~ khy chlyhn rtyn jw njm Dnwswn wry n (jy wnyN) khnpwi gby khy (khd kry) wrtw' & whyn Zlm kndR hyw'.
wry un khn pwi whn khn Trw kywswn th mn whyn shkrnw kryw.
& (yd kryw th) jDhn mws~ khy ktb & (sch & kwRjy wch +m) sndhw wjhndR Dnwsyn th mn whyn hdyt wr thyw.

& (yd kryw th) jDhn mws~ pnhnjy qwm khy chyw th y mnhnjy qwm whn gby khy khud kry wtthN sbbn pN ty Zlm kyw ahy tnhnkry pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn mwTw & pN khy kuhw, hw whn li twhn jy pyd kndR wT chNw ahy, pwi whn ty bjh kyy'yn, byshk uhw y'y m`fy DyndR mhrbn ahy.
& (yd kryw th) jDhn whn chyw th y mws~ jysty'yn llh chTw (nh) Dsndswn tysty'yn twkhy kDhn bh nh mnyyndswn pwi whn ty wdy chy kRky & whyn Dsnd rhyw'.
wry whn jy mrN khn pwi whn khy jyy'rw kywswn th mna whyn shkrnw kryw.
& whn ty kkr jy cchnwa ky'y swn & whn ty manW & slw~ lthswn, th jyky whn khy stthyn shyn mn rzq Dnwsyn sw khy'w, & sn ty (ky) Zlm nh kyy'wn pr pN ty Zlm knd hy'.

& jDhn chywswn th hin Gwtth +m ghiRw pwi mnjhny's jtn wNywa ttn mzy sn khy'w & drwzy khn sjdw kndR thy lnghw & chy'w th sn j Dwh bkhsh th whn jwn mdywn whn khy bkhshywn, & chNy'y kndRn khy sghw wdhy'yndswn.
pwi Zlmn jyky khyn chyw wyw tnhn Glh khy mTy'y byw chyw pwi unhn Zlmn ty sndn bcchRy hjN sbbn asmn khn `dhb lthwswn.

& (yd kr th) jDhn mws~ pnhnjy qwm li pNy ghryw tDhn chywswn th pnhnjy ltth phN khy hN, pwi mnjhny's brhn whywn phTy nktywn, sbhknhn mNhw byshk pnhnjw tR sunytw, (chywswn th) llh jy rzq mn khy'w pyw & zmyn +m fsdy thy bgyR nh wjhw.

& jDhn chywa th y mws~ hk T`m ty kDhn bh Sbr nh kndswn tnhnkry pnhnjy plNhr khn sn li (du`) ghr th zmyn jykw pnhnjw sG & pnhnj bdrng & pnhnjy kNk & pnhnjy muhry & pnhnj bSr dymy'yndy ahy sy sn li pyd kry, chyy'yn th jyky chNywn ahn sy sdyn sn cchw th mTyw? (jy nth rhw th) knhn shhr +m lhy wnyw & pwi jyky ghrw th sw sbh whn li (uty mwjwd) ahy, khwry & mHtjy mthn hny'y wy'y & llh jy Dmr hytth wry, hiyu hn kry ahy jw unhn llh jy Hkmn khy nh thy mnyyw & pyGmbrn khy nHq thy kutthy'wn, hw km by frmnya sbbn thy kyy'wn & Hd khn lnghndR hw.
mw'mnn & yhwdyn & nSrn & Sbyn mnjhn jn llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyyw & chN km ky tn li sndn plNhr wT sndn jr ahy, & khyn nky bhw' ahy & nky uhy Gmgyn rhnd.
& jDhn whn khn njm wrtwsyn & whn jy mthn (jbl) Twr khy khRw kywswn, (tDhn chywswn th) jykw (twryt) whnkhy Dnwswn swghw wtthw & jyky mnjhs ahy sw yd kryw mna whyn Ddyw.
wry un khnpwi whyn phryw', pwi jDhn whn ty llh jw fDl & snds bjh nh thy'y h th whyn Drwr cchyy'y wrn mn thyw h.
& nhn khy byshk dytw thw jy whn mn cchncchr bbt Hd khn lnghy pwi khyn chywsyn th khwr bhwlR thyw.
pwi un (qSWh) khy un Gwtth jy as ps wrn & unhn jy pwyn li `brt & khud trsn li nSyHt ky'y swn.
& jDhn mws~ pnhnjy qwm khy chyw th llh whn khy Gy'wn kuhN jw Hkm kry thw, (tDhn) chyy'wn th twn sn sn chthr krN lGyn thw cch? (mws~) chyw th aun llh khn jhln mn hjN jy pnh guhrn thw.

chyy'wn th sn li pnhnjy plNhr khn du` ghr th sn li chTy'y kry th uh (Gy'wn) khRy (qsm jy) ahy, (mws~) chyw th llh chwy thw th uh Gy'wn nky pwRhy & nky jwn ahy, inhy wch +m wchthry ahy, pwi jyky whn khy Hkm Dnw wyw sw kryw.
chyy'wn th pnhnjy plNhr khn sn li du` guhrth sn li chTy'y kry th n jw rng khRw ahy, (mws~) chyw th llh chwy thw th uh Gy'wn hyDy kkRy ahy snds rng GwRhw hyDw ahy DsndRn khy surhy'y Dyndy ahy.
chyy'wn th pnhnjy plNhr khn sn li du` ghr th sn li chTy'y kry th uh (Gy'wn) khRy (pryn) ahy cchwth Gy'wn sn wT (pN jhRyn +m) gDyl ahy, & jykDhn llh ghryw th syn Drwr lhndsyn.

(mws~) chyw th llh chwy thw th uh hRy Gy'wn ahy (jw) nky whw ahy jw hr khyRy & nky pwkh pyry, N wddh ahy mnjhs kw dbk kwnhy, chyy'wn th hNy tw pwrw pr andw, pwi un khy kutthy'wn & (nhy km) krN ty nh hw.
& jDhn hk shkhS khy kutthwa tDhn n (jy mryndR) bbt tkrr kywa, & jyky lky'ynd ahyw sw llh pdhrw kndR ahy.
pwi chywsyn th snds (gwsht jw) kujh bhNw un (my'l) khy hNw, hRy TrH llh my'ln khy jyryndw ahy & whn khy pnhnjywn nshnywn Dykhryndw ahy th mna whyn smjhw.

wry n khnpwi whn jwn dlywn Dddhywn thywn pwi phN wngr blk Dddhywn skht ahn, & phNn mn ky hR (bh) ahn jw mnjhy'n whywn phTy nkrndywn ahn, & mnjhy'n kw phTndw ahy pwi mnjhny's pNy nkrndw ahy, & mnjhy's kw llh jy bhw' khn krndw ahy, & jyky knd ahyw tnhn khn llh bykhbr nh ahy.
(y mslmnw'! whyn yhwdyn +m) pN li frmnbrdr hjN jw hin hwndy bh nyn asrw rkhw th cch? jw byshk mnjhy'n hk Twly ihRy ahy jw llh jw klm bdhnd ahn wry n jy smjhN khn pwi uhy dyN hwndy n khy mTy'ynd ahn.

& jDhn mw'mnn khy mlnd ahn tDhn chwnd ahn th mnyywsyn, & jDhn hk by'y khy hyklw mlnd ahn (tDhn pN +m) chwnd ahn th jyky llh whn ty khwlyw ahy tnhn jy Glh sNn cchw knd ahyw th in sbbn whn jy plNhr wT whn ty Hjt wtthnd rhn, whyn cchwnh smjhnd ahyw?
nh dyNnd ahn cch th jyky lky'ynd ahn & jyky pdhrw knd ahn sw llh dyNndw ahy.
& mnjhy'n ky N pRhy ahn jy kwRn khyln khnswi ktb khy nh dyNnd ahn & uhy rGw Tkl hlnd ahn.

pwi unhn li khrby ahy jyky pnhnjw hthrdhw ktb lkhnd ahn, mwTy (mNhn khy) chwnd ahn th hyu llh wTn (ayw) ahy hin li th n sn (dny jw) thwrw mlh wtthn, pwi jyky sndn hthn lkhyw tnhn sbbn nhn li khrby ahy & jyky kmy'ynd ahn tnhn sbbn (pN) nhn li khrby ahy.
& chwn th th bh GNyln Dynhn khn swi sn khy kDhn nh cchhndy. y (pyGmbrkhyn) chy'w th llh wTn hRw njm wrtw thwa cch? th llh pnhnjy njm khy kDhn nh phyryndw y llh ty N dytw (kwR) Glhy'ynd ahyw.
hy'w jn mdy'y kmy'y & sndn bcchRy'y khyn wyRhy wy'y sy dwzkhy ahn, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.
& jn ymn andw & chN km ky sy bhshty ahn, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.

& jDhn bny sry'yln khn njm wrtwsyn th llh khnswi by'y knhn jy `bdt nh kryw, & mu pyu & miTn & cchwrn (brn) & mskynn sn chNy'y kryw & mNhn sn mitthw Glhyw & nmz pRhw & zkw@ Dyw, wry whn mnjhn thwrn khnswi (sbh) phiry wyw' & whyn mnhn mwRynd hyw'.
& jDhn whn khn njm wrtwswn th pnhnj khwn nh kndw' & nky pnhnjy qwm khy pnhnjn dysn mn lDy'yndw' pwi bsywa & (n j) whyn gwh ahyw.

(tnhn khn) pwi whyn hR thy ahyw jw pnhnjy qwm khy kuhw th & pnhnjy qwm mn hk Twlya ty ydh & Dddh krN li (pN +m) hk by'y khy mdd Dy'y khyn sndn dys mn lDyw th, & jykDhn (ky) bndy thy whn wT ynd ahn th chaTy bhry khyn cchDy'ynd ahyw hn hwndy jw uhw sndn lwdhN whn ty Hrm thyl ahy, pwi cchkhwn ky (Hkm) ktb (twryt) j mnyynd ahyw & ky nh mnyynd ahyw? pwi whn mn jykw hRw km kry tnhn jy sz dny jy Hytya +m khwrya khnswi knh ahy, & qymt jy Dynhn skht `dhb Dnhn wry wynd, & jyky knd ahyw tnhn khn llh by khbr nh ahy.
ihy uhy ahn jn akhrt jy bdrn dny jy Hyty Gdhy, pwi khny'n `dhb hlkw nh kyw wyndw & nky khyn mdd Dby.

& byshk muws~ khy ktb (twryt) Dnwswn & un khn pwi (by) pyGmbr hk by'y ptthyn mwklyswn, & `ys~ pT mrym khy pdhr mu`jz Dnswn & khyn pk rwH sn mdd Dny swn, pwi jDhn bh knhn pyGmbr whn wT uhy Hukm and thy jn khy whn jy dlyn nthy ghryw tDhn whn (n jy mnyN khn) wDy'y ky'y, pwi (pyGmbrn jy) hk Twly khy kuwRw dytwa, & by'y khy kutthawa.
& chwn th th sn jwn dlywn ddhkyl ahn, (nh) blk llh sndn kfr sbbn mthn l`nt ky'y ahy pwi thwr ymn aNynd.

& jDhn llh wTn ktb (qran) nhy (twryt) jw schw kndR ayn jykw wTn ahy & (hn khn) G kfrn ty swbh jwn (d`y'wn) ghrnd hy', pwi jDhn wTn ayw jnhn khy snyty'wn tDhn n jw nkr kyy'wn, pwi kfrn ty llh jy l`nt ahy.

uhw bcchRw (swdw) ahy jnhn +m pN Dy'y jyky llh ( ty) lthw ahy tnhn jw nh mnyN hn (Glh) jy sR kry Gdhy'wn th llh pnhnjy bnhn mn jnhn ty ghrndw ahy tnhn ty pnhnjy bjh sn ktb lhyndw ahy, pwi (llh jy) Dmr ty Dmr hytth wry, & kfrn li khwry DyndR `dhb ahy.

& jDhn khyn chy'bw ahy th jykw (qran) llh lthw tnhn khy mnyyw tDhn chwn th th jykw (twryt) sn ty lthl ahy tnhn khy mnyynd ahywn & jyky n khnswi ahy tnhn khy nh mnyynd ahn, & (Hqyqt kry) hw (qran) schw ahy jykw (twryt) wTn ahy tnhnjw schw kndR (bh) ahy, (y pyGmbr) chw' th jykDhn (twryt j) mnyyndR ahyw th llh jy pyGmbrn khy cchw kutthwa.
byshk muws~ whn wT chT m`jz and wry khny's pwi gby khy (khd kry) wrtwa & whyn Zlm ahyw.

& jDhn whn khn njm wrtwswn & whn jy mthn Tuwr (jbl) khRw kywswn, (chywswn th) jykw whn khy Dnwswn (y`ny twryt) sw swghw wtthw & bdhw, tDhn chyy'wn th bdhwswn & nh mnyywswn, & nhn jy dlyn +m sndn kfr sbbn gby jy pryt wdhy wy'y, (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th whn jw ymn whn khy jnhn shyi jw Hkm kndw ahy s bcchRy ahy jykDhn whyn (twryt) j mnyyndR ahyw.

& jyky krtwt sndn hthn Gy mwkly ahn tn sbbn un (mwt) khy kDhn bh nh ghrnd, & llh Zlmn khy (chNy TrH) dyNndR ahy.

& (y pyGmbr) nhn (yhwdyn) khy jyy'N ty mNhn & mshrkn khn wdhyk HrS wrw lhndyn, mnjhy'n hr kw ghrndw ahy th jykr hzr wrhyh jyryw wnyy h, & hw (yDw jyy'N) khys `dhb khn pry krN wrw nh ahy, & jyky knd ahn tnhn khy llh DsndR ahy.

(y pyGmbrkhyn) chy'w th jykw jbry'yl jw wyry thyndw (sw llh jw wyry ahy) cchwth jbry'yl qran khy llh jy Hkm sn tnhnjy dl ty lthw ahy jyky khny's Gy ahy tnhn khy schw kndR ahy & mw'mnn li hdyt & khwshkhbry ahy.
jykw llh & snds mly'kn & snds pyGmbrn & jbry'yl & myky'yl jw wyry bNbw th byshk llh (bh hRn) kfrn jw wyry ahy.
& (y pyGmbr) by shk tw Dnhn Sf aytwn mwklywn swn, & by dynn khnswi kwbh un jw mnkr nh thyndw.
jDhn bh kw njm bdhy'wn thy th n khy cchw mnjhy'n hk Twlya bhGw thy, blk mnjhy'n ghN ymn nh aNynd ahn.
& jDhn pyGmbr (muHmWd) nhy (y`ny twryt) jw schw kndR jykw wTn ahy llh wTn ayn (tDhn) jn khy ktb (twryt) Dnw wyw tn mn hk Twlya llh jy ktb khy pnhnjn putthyn pwyn ucchlyw dyNk uhy dyNnd y'y nh ahn.

& uhy (yhwdy twryt jy pyrwy cchDy) hRn (bTl `lmn) jy ptthyn lG jyky slymn jy wry +m shyTn pRhnd hw, & slymn (jdw krN jw) kfr nh kyw pr shyTnn kfr kyw jw mNhn khy jdw sykhrynd hw, & pN (jdwa khy sm lhyh sN byj st`ml krN jy ptthyn py) jyky (sm lhyh j srr) bn mly'kn hrwt & mrwt ty bbl (shhr) +m nzl thy hy', & uhy by'y (nhn sGwrn `lmn mn) kjh bh ysyn knhn hkRy khy nh sykhrynd hw jysyn (hy) chwnd hy' th syn rGw prkhh ahywn tnhnkry (nkhy byj km +m aNy) kfr nh bNj (jw njy'z kmn li smi lhy km aNN kfr ahy) pwi khny'n uhw skhnd huy' jnhn sn mRs & snds zl jy wch +m phyTw wjhnd huy', & uhy un sn knhyn hkRy khy llh jy Hkm dhrn Dkhwy'yndR nh huy', jyk khyn Dkhwy'yndy & fy'dw nh Dyndy s skhnd huy', & byshk dyty'wn thy th jnhn uh Gdhy tnhn khy akhrt +m kw nSyb nh ahy, & jnhn sn pN khy wkyy'wn s Drwr bcchRy ahy, jykr dyNn h (th pN plyn h).
& jykDhn uhy (yhwdy) ymn aNyn h & prhyzgr bNjn h th llh wTn Drwr chNw bdlw (mlyn h), jykDhn dyNn h.
y ymn wrw' (pyGmbr khy `rD krN mhl) r`in (jw lfZ) nh chy'w & unZrn (jw lfZ) chy'w & (hw Hkm dl sn) bdhw, & kfrn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.
nky kw ktb wrn kfrn mn & nky kw mshrkn mn whn jy plNhr khn whn ty knhn chNy'ya jw lhN ghrndw ahy, & llh pnhnjy bjh sn jnhn khy wNys tnhn khy chwnDyndw ahy, & llh wDy fDl wrw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) jy k ayt mnswkh knd ahywn y (tnhnjy dl tn) uh wsry'ynd ahywn th nhy khn chNy y jhRys aNynd ahywn. nh dyNndw ahyn cch th llh sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy?
(y pyGmbr) nh dyNndw ahyn cch th asmnn & zmyn jy bdshhy llh jy ahy, & llh khnswi whn jw nkw snbhlyndR & nkw whrw ahy?
(y mslmnw') whyn pnhnjy pyGmbr khn yy'n swl krN cchw th ghrw jyy'n G (yhwdyn) mws~ khn pcchyw hw? & jykw ymn khy kfr sn mTy'yndw sw byshk sidhya wT khn bhulw.

ktb wrn mn ghN ghrnd ahn th jykr whn jy ymn aNN khn pwi bh whn khy sR sbbn jw sndyn dlyn +m ahy khyn jw Hq pdhrw thy chkw ahy n khnpwi bh mwTy'y kfr kn, pwi ysyn Try wnyw & muRy wnyw jysyn llh pnhnjw Hkm mwkly, cchw th llh sbh knhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
& (y mslmnw') nmz pRhw & zkwt Dyw, & jyk chNy'y pN li Gy mwklyndw' s llh wT lhndw' jyky whn knd ahyw tnhn khy llh DsndR ahy.
& (yhwdy & nSr~) chwn th th yhwdyn & nSrn khnswi bhsht +m kwy'y nh ghRndw. ihy sndn sdhwn ahn. (y pyGmbr khyn) chy'w th jykDhn sch ahyw th pnhnjw kw dlyl aNyw.
hy'w, jnhn pnhnjw munhn llh li nwRyw & uhw bhlrw hwndw tnhn li snds plNhr wT snds jr ahy, & nky khyn bhw' ahy & nky uhy Gmgyn rhnd.

& yhwdy chwn th th nSr~ knhn dyn ty nh ahn, & nSr~ chwn th th yhwdy knhn dyn ty nh ahn & (Hqyqt kry) uhy ktb (twryt & njyl) pRhnd ahn, hRy TrH jyky nh dyNnd ahn sy (bh) sndn chwN jhRw chwnd ahn. pr llh qymt jy Dynhn sndn wch +m jnhn (Glh) bbt jhGRw knd ahn tnhn jw nbyrw kndw.

& kyr un khn wdhyk Zlm ahy jnhn llh jy msjdyn khy mnjhs snds nly jy yd krN khn jhlyw & nhn (msjdyn) jy phTy'N +m kwshsh kyy'yn? hRn khy nhn (msjdyn) +m DdyndR thy ghRN dhrn (by'y TrH ghRN) nh jGy'yndw ahy, nhn li duny +m khwry ahy & nhn li akhrt +m wDw `dhb ahy.
& wbhr & wlh llh jw ahy, pwi jDy pnhnjy mhR khy phyryw tDy llh jy smhny'y ahy, cchw th llh (mhrbny +m) kshdgy wrw dyNndR ahy.
& (kfr) chwn th th llh pnhnjy li wld wrtw ahy. (nh) hw pk ahy, blk jyky asmnn & zmyn +m ahy sw snds (milk) ahy, mRyy'y snds frmnbrdr ahn.
asmnn & zmyn jw tthhyndR ahy, & jDhn kwy'y km kndw ahy tDhn rGw chwndw ahy th thy th thy pwndw ahy.

& jyky nh dyNnd ahn sy chwnd ahn th llh sn sn cchw nh Glhy'yndw ahy y k nshny sn wT cchw nh yndy ahy? hRy TrH jyky khny'n G huy' tn sndn chwN wngr chyw, sndn dlywn hk jhRywn ahn, byshk nhya qwm li nshnywn byn kywn thy'wn jyky wysh rkhnd ahn.
(y pyGmbr) byshk sn twkhy sch sn khwshkhbry DyndR & DydyryndR kry mwklyw & (twn) dwzkhyn bbt nh pcchbyn.

& (y pyGmbr) yhwdy ysyn twkhn kDhn rDy nh thynd & nky nSr~ jysyn twn sndn dyn jy tb`dry kryn, (khyn) chw' th llh jy hdyt h (slm) jy hdyt ahy, & (y pyGmbr) tw wT jw `lm ayw ahy tnhn khn pwi bh jykDhn (twn) sndn sadhn jy tb`dry kndyn th tw li llh wTn nkw snbhlyndR & nkw whrw thyndw.
jn khy ktb Dnwswn sy n khy hRy TrH pRhnd ahn jhRw snds pRhN jw Hq ahy, hy n khy mnyynd ahn, & jyky un khy nh mnyynd sy y'y cchyy'y wr ahn.
y bny sry'ylw' uhy munhnj GuN yd kryw jyky mwn whn ty ky & mwn jhn (wrn) ty whn khy sGwrw kyw.
& nhya Dynhn kh Ddyw jnhn +m kw jyu knhn jya khn kjh bh nh Try sghndw & nky khny's kw bdlw qbwl kbw & nky khys k prt nf`w Dyndy & nky khyn mdd Dby.

& jDhn brhym khy snds plNhr kn Glhyn sn prkhyw pwi uhy pwrywn kyy'yn, & (llh) frmyw th aun twkhy mNhn li mm muqrWr krN wrw ahyn, (tDhn brhym) chyw th mnhnjy wld mn bh (mm kndyn? llh) frmyw th Zlmn khy hw mnhnjw njm nh phchndw.

& jDhn byt llh khy mNhn jy mwTN jw mG & mn jw hndh mqrr kywswn, & (hn mt khy Hukm kywswn) th mqm brhym khy (bh) nmz pRhN jy ji kry wtthw, & brhym & sm`yl khy wSyWt ky'y swn th mnhnjy ghr khy Twf kndRn & `tkf wrn & rkw` (&) sjdy kndRn li pk rkhw.

& jDhn brhym chyw th y mnhnj plNhr hn shhr (mky) khy mn jw hndh kr & snds rhndRn mn nhn khy mywn jy rwzy Dy jyky mnjhy'n llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyyn, (tDhn llh) frmyw th jnhn nh mnyyw (tnhn khy bh) pwi un khy (Hytya j) thwrR Dynhn aswdw knds wry khys bh jy `dhb Dnhn byws knds, & uh bucchRy ji ahy.
& jDhn brhym & sm`yl byt (llh) j bnyd wsrynd huy' (tDhn chwnd huy' th) y sn j plNhr (hyu pwrhyw) sn khn qbwl kr, cchwth twn y'y bdhndR dyNndR ahyn.
& sn j plNhr sn khy pnhnjw frmnbrdr kr & sn jy wld mn (bh) hk Twlya khy pnhnjw frmnbrdr kr, & sn khy sn jy Hj j rkn sykhr & sn jwn (khTy'wn) m`f kr, cchw th twn y'y wDw m`f kndR mhrbn ahyn.
& y sn j plNhr mnjhny'n hk pyGmbr mnjhn mwkl jw tnhnjwn aytwn mthn pRhy & khyn ktb & Hkmt sykhry & khyn sdhry, cchw th twn y'y Glb Hkmt wrw ahyn.
& jnhn pN khy by smjh kyw tnhn khnswi (byw) kyr brhym jy dyn khn muRndw, & byshk khys dny +m chwnDyw swn, & uhw akhrt +m Drwr bhlrn mn ahy.
jDhn khys snds plNhr chyw th mnhnj Hkm mny (tDhn) chyy'yn th jhn jy plNhr j (sbh) Hkm mnyym.
& brhym & y`qwb pnhnjy pTn khy n Glh jy wSyt ky'y, th y snj wld (hn) dyn khy llh whn li chwnDyw ahy pwi whyn mslmn hjN khnswi nh mrjw.

(y ktb wrw') whyn tDhn HDr hyw' cch? jDhn y`qwb khy mwt wyjhw thyw jDhn pnhnjn pTn khy chyy'yn th mwn khn pwi knhn jy `bdt kndw'? (tDhn) chyy'wn th tnhnjy khud & tnhnjy pyu DDy brhym & sm`yl & sHq jy khd jy jw kylw khd ahy `bdt kndswn, & syn snds Hkm mnyyndR ahywn.
h Twly byshk gdhry wy'y, jyky nhn kmyw sw nhn li ahy & jyky whn kmyw sw whn li ahy & jyky (uhy) knd tnhn bbt whyn nh pcchbw'.
& (ktb wr mslmnn khy) chwn th th yhwdy y nSr~ thyw th hdyt wr thyndw'. (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th syn brhym Hnyf (hk Trfy) jy dyn j tb`dr ahywn, & uhw mshrkn mn nh hw.

(khyn) chy'w th llh khy mnyyw thy'wn & (pN) jykw (qran) sn Dnhn lthw wyw & jyky (SHyf) brhym & sm`yl & sHq & y`qwb & y`qwb jy wld Dnhn lth wy ahn & jyky mws~ & `ys~ khy Dnw wyw & jyky byn pyGmbrn khy sndn plNhr khn Dnw wyw, tnhn (sbh khy mnyywn th) mnjhy'n knhn hk jy wch +m withy nh th bhnywn, & syn un (hk llh) khy mnyyndR ahywn.
pwi jykDhn llh khy whn jy mnyN jhRw mnyyn th byshk hdyt wr thynd, & jykDhn phrnd th uhy phyTy +m y'y pwnd, pwi llh twkhy nhn (jy shr) khn kfy thyndw, & hw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
llh (pnhnjy dyn jy rng sn) sn khy rnNyw ahy, & rNN +m llh khn wdhyk chNw kyr ahy? & syn snds `bdt kndR ahywn.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th llh (jy dyn) bbt sn sn tkrr kryw th cch? & (Hqyqt kry) uhw snjw plNhr & whnjw plNhr ahy, & sn li snj km & whn li whn j krtwt ahn, & snds nil bnh ahywn.

y chy'w th th brhym & sm`yl & sHq & y`qwb & y`qwb jw wld yhwdy y nSr~ huy'. (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th whyn wdhyk dyNndR ahyw y llh (wdhyk dyNndR ahy)? & jykw hRy shhdy lky'y j llh wTn wTs hjy tnhn khn wdhyk Zlm kyr ahy? & jyky knd ahyw tnhn khn llh bykhbr nh ahy.
ih Twly byshk gdhry wy'y, jyky kmyy'wn sw nhn li ahy & jyky whn kmyw sw whn li ahy, & jyky uhy knd huy' tnhn bbt (whyn) nh pcchy wyndw'.

mNhn mnjhn ky by smjh sghw chwnd th unhn (y`ny mslmnn) khy sndn uhw qblw jnhn Dy (nmz pRhnd) hy' tnhn khn khRya Glh phyrywa? (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th wbhr & wlh llh jw ahy, jnhn khy ghrndw ahy tnhn khy sidhya wT Dnhn dG Dykhryndw ahy.

& (jhRy TrH whn jw qblw bhlw kywsyn) hRya TrH whn khy bhly Twly ky'y swn th mNhn ty shhd hjw & pyGmbr whn ty shhd hjy, & (y pyGmbr) jnhn (Trf) ty (Gy) hy'yn tnhn khy qblw mqrr nh kyw hw swn mgr hn li th jykw pyGmbr jy ptthyn lGy tnhn khy unhya khn nkhyRywn jykw pnhnjyn khRyn (bhr pwi) ty phry, & byshk (ihw) jn khy llh hdyt ky'y tn khn swi (byn) ty Drwr Dkhyw ahy, & llh jw shn hRw nh ahy jw whn jy ymn khy wnyy'y, cchw th llh mNhn sn Drwr shfqt kndR mhrbn ahy.

(y pyGmbr) asmn Dnhn tnhnjw mnhn (hrhr) phyry'N byshk Dswn th, pwi jnhn qbly khy psnd kryn thw (wDnhn) twkhy Drwr phyry'yndsyn, pwi (y pyGmbr) pnhnjy munhn khy t`Zym wrya msjd Dnhn phyri, & (y mslmnw') whyn jty hjw tty pnhnj mnhn wDnhn phyryw, & jn khy ktb Dnw wyw ahy sy Drwr dyNn th th ihw (phyry'N) sndn plNhr wTn blkl sch ahy, & jyky knd ahn tnhn khn llh by khbr nh ahy.

& (qsm ahy) th jn khy ktb Dnw wyw ahy tn wT jykDhn (twn) sbh dlyl aNyn th (bh) tnhnjy qbly jy tb`dry nh knd, & nky twn sndn qbly jy tb`dry kndR ahyn, & nky unhn mn ky kn jy qbly jy tb`dry kndR ahn, & (qsm ahy) th n khnpwi jw tw wT `lm ayw jykDhn sndn sadhn jy tb`dry kndyn th twn un mhl Zlmn mn ahyn.
jn khy ktb (twryt) Dnwswn sy un (qbly jy phyr) khy iy'yn snyNnd ahn jy'n pnhnjn pTn khy snyNnd ahn, & mnjhny'n k Twly dyN hwndy byshk sch khy lky'yndy ahy.
ihw tnhnjy plNhr wTn sch ahy tnhnkry twn shk wrn mn bnh nh thyu.
& sbh knhn li (kw) hkRw qblw ahy jnhn Dnhn uhw mhR kndw ahy pwi chNyn Dnhn Gry'y kryw, jty hwndw' (utn) llh uwhn khy gD kry aNyndw, cchwth llh sbh knhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
& (y pyGmbr) jtn (bh) nkryn th pnhnjw mnhn t`Zym wrya msjd Dnhn phyri, & byshk ihw (phyry'N) tnhnjy plNhr wTn blkl sch ahy, & jyky knd ahyw tnhn khn llh by khbr nh ahy.

& jtn (bh) nkryn th pnhnjw mnhn t`Zym wrya msjd Dnhn phyri, & jty hjw (tty) pnhnj mnhn n Dnhn phyryw (hn li) th mnjhny'n jn Zlm kyw tn khn swi byn mNhn khy whn ty k Hjt nh rhy, pwi khny'n nh Ddyw, & (hn li) th (aun) pnhnjy n`mt whn ty pwry kryn & mna whyn hdyt wr thyw.

jhRya TrH whn ty n`mt pwry ky'y swn (thRya TrH) whn mnjhn pyGmbr whn +m mwklywswn jw sn jwn aytwn whn ty pRhndR ahy & whn khy pk kndw ahy & whn khy ktb & Hkmt sykhryndw ahy & jyky nh dyNnd hyw' sw (pN) whn khy sykhryndw ahy.
tnhnkry mwn khy yd kryw th aun whn khy yd kryn & mnhn jw shkr kryw & mnhn jy by shkry nh kryw.
y mw'mnw' Sbr & nmz sn mdd wtthw, cchwth llh Sbrn sn ahy.
& jyky llh jy wT +m kusn tn khy my'l nh chy'w, blk (uhy) jyy'r ahn pr whyn nh th prwRyw.
& whn khy bhwa & bkh & mln jy & jndn jy & mywn jy ghTty'ya mn knhn shy sn Drwr prkhyndswn, & (y pyGmbr) unhn Sbrn khy khuwshkhbry Dy.
jn khy jDhn k wkhy'y phchy thy (tDhn) chwn th th syn llh j (bnh) ahywn & syn n Dnhn mwTndR ahywn.
unhn ty sndn plNhr wTn mhrbnywn & bjh ahy, & ihy y'y sdhya wT wr ahn.

Sf & mrwh (jbl) llh (jy `bdt) jy nshnyn mn ahn, pwi jykw byt llh jw Hj kry y `mrw bji aNy tnhn khy bnhy jy Twf krN +m gnh nh ahy, & jykw wdhyk chNy'y kndw (tnhn jy llh qbwl kndw) cchw th llh qbwl kndR dyNndR ahy.
jyky pdhrywn Glhywn & hdytwn lthywn thy'wn tn khy jyky (mNhw) un khnpwi jy unhn khy mNhn li ktb (twryt) +m Zhr kywswn, lky'ynd ahn tn ty llh l`nt kndw ahy & l`nt kndR (bh) nhn ty l`nt knd ahn.
pr jn twbh ky'y & (pN) sdhryy'wn & byn kyy'wn tn ty (bjh sn) mwTnds, & aun Dddhw bjh sn mwTndR mhrbn ahyn.
jn kfr kyw & uhy kfr thy muy' tn ty llh & mly'kn & mRny mNhn jy l`nt ahy.
un l`nt +m sdy'yn rhN wr ahn, khny'n `dhb hlkw nh kbw & nky khyn mhlt Dby.
& whn jw khd kylw khd ahy, n khnswi kwy'y `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, (uhw) bjhrw mhrbn ahy.

asmnn & zmyn jy bNy'N (+m), & rt & Dynhn jy phyrghyr (+m), & byRywn jy unhya (smn) sn jw mNhn khy nf`w Dyndw ahy drya +m trndywn ahn tn (+m), & jyky asmn khn (mynhn jw) pNy llh wsyw pwi un sn zmyn khy n jy wsmN khnpwi abd kyy'yn tnhn (+m), & un (zmyn) +m sbh jns j jnwr pkhyRyy'yn tnhn (+m), & hwy'n jy ghlN (+m), & asmnn & zmyn jy wch +m nwyln kkrn +m, smjh wrya qwm li Drwr nshnywn ahn.

& mNhn mn ky (hR) ahn jy llh khnswi (byn khy) llh jhRw kry wtthnd ahn llh jy pyr wngr pyrw rkhnd thn, & jn ymn andw sy llh jy dwstya +m Dddh zwr ahn, & jn Zlm kyw sy jykDhn (hn Glh khy hNy) smjhn th jnhn mhl (qymt jy Dynhn) `dhb Dsnd (& smjhnd) th smwry sgh llh khy ahy & llh skht `dhb krN wrw ahy (th jykr Dddh pshymn thyn).
jnhn mhl GwN ptthyn lGndRn khn byzr thynd & `dhb khy Dsnd & sndn (sbh) lGp cchdynd,

& (tnhn mhl) ptthya lGndR chwnd th jykr sn khy (wry dny +m) mwTNw hjy h th khny'n y'yn byzr thywn h jy'n sn khn byzr thy ahn, hRy TrH llh sndn krtwtn khy mthn pshymnywn bNy'y Dykhryndw, & uhy bh mn nkrN wr nh ahn.
y mNhw' jyky shywn zmyn +m ahn tn mn pk Hll khy'w, & shyTn jy wkhn ty nh hlw, cchwth uhw whn jw pdhrw wyry ahy.

& (whyn) hn hwndy ky'n kfr th thyw? jw llh jwn aytwn whn ty pRhjn thywn & snds pyGmbr whn +m ahy, & jykw llh (jy dyn) khy chnbRy ptthndw tnhn khy byshk sdhya wT Dnhn rstw Dykhryw wyndw.

& llh jy rsya (y`ny qran) khy sbhy'y chnbRy wtthw & dhrwdhr nh thyw, & pN ty llh jy n`mt khy yd kryw jw jDhn pN +m wyry hyw' pwi whn jy dlyn +m mylp wdhy'yn pwi snds fDl sn hk by'y j phry bhy'r thyw', & whyn dwzkh jy khD jy bhar ty hyw' pwi whn khy khny's cchDyy'yn, hRya TrH llh whn li pnhnjywn nshnywn byn kndw ahy th mna whyn hdyt lhw.
& whn +m hRy Twly hy'N ghrjy jy chNy'ya Dnhn sDyn & chNn kmn jw Hukm kn & madn kmn khn jhlyn, & hy y'y cchTl ahn.
& whyn unhn jhR nh thyw jy frqw frqw thy wy & wTn m`jz ay un khnpwi bhtkrr kyy'wn, & unhn li wDw `dhb ahy.
unhya Dynhn jw ky munhn cch thynd & ky munhn kr thynd, pwi jn j munhn kr thynd (chyw wyndn th) whyn pnhnjy iymn (aNN) khnpwi cchw kfr thyw'? pwi unhya sbbn jw whyn kfr thy hyw' `dhb (jw mzw) chkhw.
& jn j mnhn cch hwnd sy llh jy rHmt hytth rhnd, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr hwnd.
(y pyGmbr) ihy llh jwn aytwn ahn jy (syn) twty schya TrH pRhwn th, & llh jhnn li Zulm krN nh ghrndw ahy.
& jyky asmnn +m ahy & jyky zmyn +m ahy (sw khS) llh jw ahy, & (sbh) km llh Dnhn mwTy wynd.

whyn hRy bhaly umt mNhn li pyd thyl ahyw jw chNn kmn jw Hukm knd ahyw & mdn kmn khn jhlynd ahyw & llh khy mnyynd ahyw, & jykDhn ktb wr ymn aNyn h th Drwr khyn bhalw hujy h, mnjhny'n ky mw'mn ahn & mnjhny'n ghN by dyn ahn.
(ihy zbny) iydhu khnswi whn khy kDhn Dkhwy'y nh sghnd, & jykDhn whn sn wRhnd th whn khy putthy Dyy'y bhdynd, wry mdd nh Dbn.

llh jy dhmy & mNhn jy pnh khnswi jty ldh wynd uty mthn khwry hny'y wyy'y ahy & llh jy Dmr hytth wry wry & mthn mHtjy hny'y wyy'y ahy, ih (sz) hn sbbn ahy jw llh jy aytn khy nh thy mnyyy'wn & pyGmbrn khy nHq thy kutthy'wn, ihy (`dtwn) inhya sbb ahn jw by frmny kyy'wn & Hd khn lnghndR hy'.
ihy (sbh) hk jhR nh ahn, ktb wrn mn hkRy hRy sdhy Twly ahy jw llh jwn aytwn rt jy wqtn +m pRhnd ahn & uhy nmz (bh) pRhnd ahn.
llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyynd ahn & chNn kmn jw Hkm knd ahn & madn kmn khn jhlynd ahn & chNyn (y`ny dyn mnyN) +m Gry'y knd ahn, & ihy bhlrn mn ahn.
& jyk k bh chNy'y knd ahn tnhn jy by qdry pTya nh kby, & llh prhyzgrn khy dyNndR ahy.
jn inkr kyw tn khn nky sndn ml sndn wld llh jw kujh (`dhb) Try sghnd, & uhy dwzkhy ahn, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.

hn dny jy Hytya +m jyky (ryu li) khrchynd ahn tnhn jw mthl unhya wu jy mthl wngr ahy jnhn +m prw hjy jw un Twlya jy pwkhh khy phchy jn pN ty Zlm kyw pwi un (sndn pwkhh) khy ns kry, & llh sNn Zlm nh kyw ahy pr uhy pN ty Zlm kn th.

y iymn wrw' pnhnjn (mslmnn) khnswi byn (qwmn) khy Gjhw dwst kry nh mnyyw (jw) whn jy khrby krN +m k ghTty'y nh knd ahn, whn jy Dkhh khy dwst rkhyy'wn, byshk sndn wtn mn dshmny pdhry thy ahy, & jyky (Dd) sndn synn lkyw ahy sw tmm wDw ahy, byshk sn whn li nshnywn byn kywn ahn jykDhn smjhnd ahyw.

whyn uhy ahyw jw unhn khy dwst rkhnd ahyw & uhy whn khy dwst nh rkhnd ahn & whyn llh jy sdyy ktb khy mnyynd ahyw, & jDhn whn khy miln th (tDhn) chwn th th mnyywsyn, & jDhn hykl thyn th (tDhn) whn ty kwR khn aNryn khy chbyn th, (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th (whyn) pnhnjya kwR sbbn mrw, cchwth llh synn wrw (bhyd) dyNndw ahy.

(y mw'mnw') jykDhn whn khy k chNy'y phchndy ahy th khyn Dkhwy'yndy ahy, & jykDhn whn khy kw Dkhh phchndw ahy th un sbbn srh thynd ahn, & jykDhn whyn Sbr kryw & prhyzgry kryw th sndn mkr whn khy kjh bh nh Dkhwy'yndw, cchwth jyky knd ahn tnhn khy llh ghyrw kndR ahy.
(y pyGmbr yd kr) jnhn mhl (twn) pnhnjy ghr mn swyrw nktyn jw mw'mnn khy jng li mwrchn ty whryy'y thy, & llh bdhndR dyNndR ahy.

(y pyGmbr unhya mhl khy yd kr) jnhn mhl tw mw'mnn khy chyw thy th whn khy whn jy plNhr jy Tn hzrn mly'kn (asmn khn) lthln sn mdd krN kfy nh ahy cch?
hy'w jykDhn whyn Sbr kryw & prhyzgr bNjw & hkdm hy (kfr) whn ty chy kRkn th whn jw pNhr pnjn hzrn mly'kn nshn kyln sn whn khy mdd Dyndw.
& llh un (mdd) khy rGw whn jy khwshkhbrya li kyw ahy & hn li th whn jwn dlywn un sn (bhaly th) arm wtthn, & llh Glb Hkmt wry jy pr khnswi k mdd (mlNy) nh ahy.
(&) hn li th hkRw psw (y`ny bhNw) kfrn jw cchny cchDy y khyn hyNw kry cchDy th by nSyb thy phirn.

& jyky asmnn +m ahy & jyky zmyn +m ahy (sw khS) llh jw ahy, jnhn khy ghrndw ahy tnhn khy bkhshyndw ahy & jnhn khy ghrndw ahy tnhn khy `dhb kndw ahy, & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
y ymn wrw' (whyn) wyj byNw chw'Nw nh khy'w, & llh khn Ddyw mna whyn cchTw.

unhn jw ajr sndn plNhr wTn bkhshsh & bhsht ahn jn jy hytthn whywn whndywn ahn mnjhn sdy'yn rhN wr ahn, & kmy'yndRn jw ajr chaNw ahy.

jDhn whyn pry thy bhaGw' & knhn hk ty (kndh phyry) nh thy wjhywa & pyGmbr whn khy whn jy putthyn sDyndw rhyw pwi (khdi) whn khy Dkh ty Dkh jw bdlw Dnw (ihw) hn li th jyky whn khn thy wyw nky tnhn ty & jyky whn khy phtw nky tnhn ty Gmgyn thyw, & jyky whn knd ahyw tnhn jy llh khbr rkhndR ahy.

wry Dkh khnpwi whn ty arm (j) wjhrky (hy'y) lthy'yn jw whn mn hk Twlya khy ddhkyndy rhy & by Twly hy'y jnhn khy sndn nfsn Gmgyn kyw hw nHq jhlyt jw gmn llh ty bhnyy'wn thy, chyy'wn thy th sn li inhya km mn cch kjh (thyNw) ahy, (y pyGmbr) chw' th sbh khtyr llh jw y'y ahy, jyky twty pdhrw nh knd ahn sw pnhnjyn dlyn +m lky'ynd ahn, chwnd ahn th jykDhn sn jy ws +m kjh bh km hjy h th syn hiti nh kuswn h, (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th jykDhn whyn pnhnjn ghrn +m hjw h th jn kusN lkhyl hw sy Drwr pnhnjy kws jy jyn Dnhn nkrn h, & (hn li) th jyky whn jy synn +m ahy sw llh prkhy & jyky whn jy dlyn +m ahy sw khrw kry, & llh synn wrw (bhyd) dyNndR ahy.
whn mn jn unhya Dynhn munhn mwRyw jw bh Twlywn (hk by'y jy) smhwn thywn th unhn khy shyTn sndn kjh kiy'y jy shmt khn swi nh thyRyw, & byshk llh unhn khy m`fy Dny, cchwth llh bkhshNhr burdbr ahy.

y ymn wrw' unhn kfrn wngr nh thyw jy pnhnjn bhy'rn li jDhn uhy mlk +m msfry kn y lRy'y kndR hjn (tDhn) chwn th th jykDhn sn wT hjn h th nh mrn h & nky kusn h, th llh uhw armn sndn dlyn +m kry, & llh jyryndw & mryndw ahy, & jyky whyn knd ahyw sw llh DsndR ahy.
& jykDhn whyn llh jy wT +m kusy pyw' y mry pyw' th jyky gD knd ahn tnhn khn llh jy bkhshsh & bjh (blkl) bhly ahy.
& jykDhn (whyn) mry wnyw y kusy py'w th Drwr llh Dnhn gD ky wyndw'.

jykDhn llh whn khy mdd Dyndw th whn ty kw Glb (thyNw) nh ahy, & jykDhn whn khy mdd nh Dyndw th un khnpwi kyr whn khy mdd Dyndw? & mw'mnn khy jGy'y th llh ty bhrwsw kn.

jykw llh jy rDmndya jy ptthyn lGw sw un jhRw ahy cch? jykw llh jy kwR hytth phry ayw & snds ji dwzkh ahy, & (uhw) wrN jw hndh bucchRw ahy.

byshk llh mw'mnn ty wDw Hsn kyw ahy jDhn th nhn +m sndn qwm mn pyGmbr mwklyy'yn jw khyn snds aytwn pRhy bdhy'yndw ahy & khyn pk kndw ahy & khyn ktb & dny'y sykhryndw ahy, byshk hn khn G pdhrya bhl +m (bhlyl) hw'.

& jDhn whnkhy (jng uHd +m) Dkh phtw twNyk (pnhnjn dshmnn khy) un jw byNw (Dukh badr +m) phchyw hyw th bh chywa thy th hy (mSybt) kthn (phty) ahy, (y pyGmbr) chw' th uh whn khy pN wTn (phty) ahy, cchwth llh sbhknhn shy ty wswrw ahy.
& unhya Dynhn jw bh Twlywn pN +m smhwn thywn (tnhn Dynhn) jyky whnkhy phtw sw llh jy Hukm sn hw & hn li th mw'mnn khy nikhyRy.

& mnfqn khy bh nikhyRy, & khyn chyw wyw th chw llh jy wT +m wRhw y (kfrn khy) jwb kryw, chyy'wn th jykDhn sn khy knhn jng thyN jy khbr hjy h th Drwr whn sn hjwn h, uhy un Dynhn pN iymn khn kfr Dy blkl wyjhw hw', pnhnjn wtn sn uhy (Glhywn) chwnd ahn jyky sndyn dlyn +m nh ahn, & jyky lky'ynd ahn sw llh blkl dyNndR ahy.
(th) ihy uhy ahn jn pnhnjn bhy'rn khy chyw & wytth rhy th jykDhn (uhy) sn jw chyw mnyn h th nh kusn h, (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th jykDhn whyn sch ahyw th pN khn mwt khy Tryw.
& jyky llh jy wT +m kutth wy tn khy my'l pTya nh bhni, blk (uhy) jyy'r ahn (&) pnhnjy plNhr wT rwzy Dnl ahn.
jyky llh unhn khy pnhnjy fDl sn Dnw ahy tnhn (Hl) sn khwsh thyndR ahn & jyky sndn ptthyn ahn tn mn jyky sNn nh gDy ahn unhn li hn kry khwsh thynd ahn th khyn kw bhw' nh ahy & nky uhy Gmgyn rhnd.
llh jy n`mt & fDl sn khwsh thynd ahn & llh mw'mnn jw jr nh wnyy'yndw ahy.
jn pN khy phT phchN khn pwi bh llh & rswl jw Hukm qbwl kyw, nhn mn jn chNy'y ky'y & Dn tn li wDw jr ahy.
jn khy mNhn chyw th (kfrn) mNhn whn li lshkr gD kyw ahy tnhn kry khny'n Ddyw pwi (un chwN) hthwn unhn jw ymn wdhyw & chyy'wn th sn khy llh kfy ahy & (uhw) chNw wkyl (bhrjhlw) ahy.
pwi (uhy mslmn) llh jy n`mt & fDl sn mwTy khyn k skhty nh phty & llh jy rDpy ptthyn lG, & llh wDy fDl wrw ahy.

pwi sndn plNhr unhn jy d` qbwl ky'y th aun whn mn `ml kndR mRs y zl jw `ml nh wnyy'ynds, whn mn ky kn mn (pyd thyl) ahn (y`ny sbh hk jns ahyw) pwi jn wTn cchDyw & pnhnjn ghrn mn kddhy wy & munhnjy wT +m Dkhwy wy & wRhy & kutth wy tn khn sndn mdywn Drwr myTynds & unhn khy (bhsht jy hRn) bGn +m Drwr dkhl knds jn jy hytthn whywn whndywn ahn, (ihw) bdlw llh wTn ahy, & llh wT chNw bdlw ahy.

& ktb wrn mn ky uhy ahn jyky llh khy & jyky twDnhn (qran) lthw wyw tnhn khy & jyky (twryt) unhn Dnhn lthw wyw tnhn khy llh jy `jzy kndR thy mnyynd ahn llh jy aytn khy thwry mulh sn nh wkNnd ahn, ihy (uhy) ahn jn li sndn plNhr wT sndn jr ahy, cchwth llh sghw Hsb wtthndR ahy.

y mNhw' whyn unhya pnhnjy plNhr khn Ddyw jnhn whn khy hk jiya (adm) mn pyd kyw & mnjhny's snds zl pyd kyy'yn & unhn mn ghN mRs & zlwn pkhyRyy'yn, & unhya llh khn Ddyw jnhn (jy nly) sn (pN +m) hk by'y khn ghrnd ahyw & my'Ty (cchnN) khn (bh Ddyw), cchwth llh whn ty nghbn ahy.

& jykDhn Ddyw th ytymn cchwkryn (jy nkH krN) +m `dl nh kndw' th (byn) zln mn jyky whn khy wNn sy bh bh & Ty Ty & chr chr prNyw, pwi jykDhn Dtthw th th whn khn nSf thy nh sghndw th hk (prNyw) y whn j hth jnhn j mlk thy (s bnhy rkhw) ihw hn khy wyjhw ahy th Dddhy'y nh kryw.

& by smjhn khy pnhnj uhy ml nh Dyw jn khy llh whn li gdhrn jw sbb bNyw ahy & mnjhny's khyn khryw & khyn phryw & khyn chNy Glh chy'w.

& ysty'yn ytymn khy prkhw jysty'yn prNy (jy `mr) khy phchn, pwi jykDhn unhn +m k syNp lhw th sndn ml khyn wry'y Dyw, & uhy (ml) jyw & (sndn) wDy thyN jy bhw' khn tkR kry nh khy'w, & jykw (snbhlyndR) aswdw hjy tnhn khy ghrjy th psy rhy, & jykw mskyn hjy sw mnsb (khdmt) ahr khy'yndw rhy, pwi jDhn snds ml khyn wry'y Dyw tDhn mthn shhd kryw, & llh Hsb kndR bs ahy.
jykw (ml) mu pyu & mTn cchDyw tnhn mn mRsn li HSWw ahy, & jykw (ml) mu pyu & mTn cchDyw tnhn mn zln li (bh) HSw ahy hw cchDyl ml thwrw hjy y ghNw, HSW (llh j) mqrr kyl ahn.
& jDhn wrhNy mhl my'Tya wr & ytym & mskyn HDr thyn tDhn un (ml) mn unhn mNhn khy (kjh) Dyw & unhn khy mtthy Glh chy'w.
& unhn khy (llh khn) DdyN ghrjy jyky jykDhn pnhnjy ptthyn hyNw wld cchDyn th mthn Ddyn (th khRw Hl thyndn), pwi ghrjy th llh khn Ddyn & ghrjy th sdhy Glhh chwn.
jyky ytymn jw ml Dddh sn khy'ynd ahn sy pnhnjn pyTn +m rGw bh khy'ynd ahn, & dwzkh +m sghw ghiRnd.

llh whn jy wld bbt whn khy wSyt thw kry, th puT li (HSWw) bn dhyy'rn jy bhNy jytrw ahy, & jykDhn (fqT) dhyy'rwn bn khn wdhyk hjn th (muy'al) jyky cchDyw tnhn jwn bh Thywn unhn li ahn, & jykDhn (fqT) hk ahy th un li dh ahy, & my'l jyky cchDyw tnhn mn un jy mu pyu hr hk li cchhwn bhNw ahy (sw tDhn) jDhn un (my'l) khy wld hjy, & jykDhn un khy wld nh hujy & un j wrth mu pyu hjn th mNs li Tywn bhNw (& bqy pNs li) ahy, & jykDhn un (my'l) khy bhy'r hjn th mNs li cchhwn HSWw ahy (ihw wrhNw) wSyWt (jy dy'ya khn pwi) jnhn li uh wSyWt kyy'yn y qrD jy dy'ya khnpwi (krNw) ahy, whn j pyy'r & whn j puT, (whyn) nh dyNnd ahyw th unhn mn khRw whn li fy'dy jy kry wdhyk wyjhw ahy, (ihw wrhNw) llh jy (prkhn) frD kyl ahy, cchwth llh dyNndR Hkmt wrw ahy.

& jyky (ml) whn jy zln cchDyw tnhn jw adh whn li ahy jykDhn nhn khy kw wyu kwnh hjy, pr jykDhn unhn khy kw wyu hjy th jyky cchDyy'wn tnhn mn chwthwn bhNw wSyt (jy dy'ya khnpwi) jnhn li uh wSyt kyy'wn y qrD jy dy'ya khn pwi whn li ahy, & jyky (ml) whn cchDyw tnhn mn jykDhn whn khy kw wyu kwnhy th unhn (zln) li chwthwn bhNw ahy, & jykDhn whn khy wyu ahy th jyky (ml) whn cchDyw tnhn mn wSyt (jy dy'ya) jnhn li uh wSyt ky'y athawa y qrD jy dy'ya khnpwi unhn (zln) li tthwn bhNw ahy, & jykDhn kw (my'l) mRs y zl wrthw cchDy (& uhw) kllh hjy (y`ny jnhnkhy mu pyu & wyu nh hjy) & un khy (my'ytw) hk bhu y hk bhyN hjy th unhn mnjhn hr hk li cchhwn HSw ahy, & jykDhn inhn khn wdhyk hjy th uhy (sbh) j wSyt nqSn wry nh ky'y wyy'y hjy tnhn y qrD jy dy'ya khnpwi Thy'ya +m bhy'ywr ahn, uhw llh jw Hukm ahy, & llh dyNndR burdbr ahy.

llh khy rGw unhn jy twbh krN jGy'yndy ahy jyky by smjhy'ya sn gnh knd ahn wry jhT pT twbh knd ahn unhn ty llh (bjh sn) mwTndw ahy, & llh dyNndR Hkmt wrw ahy.

(y mslmnw') whn ty whn jwn my'r & whnjwn dhyy'r & whnjwn bhynr & whnjwn pphywn & whnjwn msywn & bhy'Tywn & bhNyjywn & uhy whn jwn my'r jn whn khy thny pyry & whn jwn rDy'y (thny gD pytl) bhynr & whn jy zln jwn my'r (y`ny saswn) & uhy whnjwn G dyywn jyky whnjy hnjn +m plywn (&) whn jy unhn zln mn hjn jn khy whyn wyjh wy ahyw pr jykDhn whyn unhn (sndn my'rn) khy wyjh nh wy ahyw th whn ty gnh nh ahy (ihy sbh) Hrm kywn wywn ahn, & whn jy unhn puTn jwn zlwn jyky (pT) whnjy ptthyn mn (pyd thyl) ahn & bn bhynrn jw gD prNN (Hrm kyw wyw ahy) pr jyky G gdhryw ahy (sw gdhryw) cchwth llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

& whn mn jykw ajyn mw'mnyNyn jy prNjN jy sgh nh rkhndw hjy sw unhn mw'mnyNyn bnhyn mn jn j mlk whn (mw'mnn) mn ahn (k prNjy th `r nh ahy), & llh whn jy ymn khy wdhyk dyNndR ahy, whnj hkR byn mn (pyd thyl) ahn (y`ny pN +m hk jns ahyw), pwi khyn sndn mlkn jy mwkl sn prNjw & sndn kbyn hly chlya wngr khyn Dyw (uhy) nkH badhlwn nh zn kndRywn & nky Gjhn yrn wtthN wrywn hjn, pwi jDhn nkH +m aywn tDhn jykDhn (uhy) kw by Hyy'ya jw km kn th jyk sz ajyn ty ahy tnhn jw dh mthn ahy, (ih bnhya khy prNjN jy jzt) whn mn nhya li ahy jykw zn (jy gnh +m pwN) khn Ddyy, & whn jw Sbr krN whn li bhlw ahy, & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
llh ghrndw ahy th whn li khwly byn kry & jyky whn khn G (gdhry) ahn tn jwn wTwn whn khy Dykhry & whn ty bjh sn mwTy, & llh dyNndR Hkmt wrw ahy.
& llh whn ty bjh sn mwTN ghrndw ahy, & jyky pnhnjy sadhn jy ptthyn lGnd ahn sy whn jw (sdhya wT khn) tmm pry thRy wnyN ghrnd ahn.
llh whn tn br hlkw krN ghrndw ahy, & mNhw (Sl) hyNw pyd kyw wyw ahy.

& jykw Hd khn bhr nkrN & Zlm sn yy'n kndw tnhn khy bh +m sghw wjhndsyn, & hw km llh ty shnjw ahy.

& mu pyu & my'Tn jyky (ml) cchDyw tnhn sbh li wrth muqrWr kyswn, & jn khy (my'Tya jhRy dwstya +m) whnjy qasmn badhw ahy tn khy sndn HSWw Dyw, cchwth llh sbhknhn shy ty HDr ahy.

(& nky unhn khy) jyky (pN) knjwsy knd ahn & mNhn khy bh knjwsy krN jw Hukm knd ahn & llh pnhnjy fDl sn khyn jyky Dnw ahy sw lky'ynd ahn, & hRn nh mnyyndRn li khwrya wrw `dhb tyr kyw thy'wn.
& (unhn li bh) jyky pnhnjn mln khy mNhn jy Dykhrya li khrchynd ahn & nky llh khy & nky qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyynd ahn, & jnhn jw sngty shyTn thyw th uhw sngty bcchRw ahy.
& mthn khRy (Dkhyy'y) hy'y jykDhn llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyyn h & llh jyky khyn Dnw ahy n mn khrchyn h, & llh nhn (jy Hl) khy (chNw) dyNndR ahy.
llh dhry jytrw bh Zlm nh kndw ahy, & jykDhn (k) chNy'y hwndy th n khy byNw kndw ahy & pN wTn wDw jr Dyndw ahy.
pwi (tDhn) ky'n (knd) jDhn sbhknhn Twlya mn (hk) shhd aNyndswn & (y pyGmbr) twkhy (bh) hn Twlya ty shhd kry aNyndswn.

& jyky asmnn +m ahy & jyky zmyn +m ahy sw (khS) llh jw ahy, & llh bhrjhlw bs ahy.

y mslmnw' llh khy & snds pyGmbr khy & jykw ktb pnhnjy pyGmbr ty lthy'yn & jykw khny's G lthy'yn tnhn khy (bh mnyyw), & jykw llh & snds mly'kn & snds ktbn & snds pyGmbrn & qymt jy Dynhn khy nh mnyyndw sw byshk wDya bhl +m bhlw.
jn ymn andw wry kfr kyy'wn wry ymn andy'wn wry kfr kyy'wn wry kfr +m wdhnd wy tn khy llh kDhn nh bkhshyndw & nky khyn k wT Dykhryndw.

hy (mnfq) whn jw ntZr kddhnd ahn, pwi jykDhn llh (jy prkhn) whn li k ftH ahy th chwn th th (syn) whn sn gD nh huy'swn cch? & jykDhn (swbh jw) bhNw kfrn jw ahy th kfrn khy chwn th th syn whn ty Glb nh ahywn cch? & mw'mnn khn whn khy nh bchywswn cch? pwi llh qymt jy Dynhn whnjy wch +m nbyrw kndw, & llh kfrn khy mw'mnn ty Glby jy (k) wT nh kndw.
mnfq (pnhnjy bhny'N +m) llh khy dlbw Dynd ahn & (Hqyqt kry) llh khyn dlbw DyndR ahy, & jDhn nmz Dnhn thnd ahn tDhn arsy thy uthnd ahn rGw mNhn khy Dykhrynd ahn & thwrRy khnswi llh khy yd nh knd ahn.
nh hin Twly Dnhn ahn & nky hun Twly Dnhn ahn nhya wch +m Hyrn ahn, & jnhn khy llh bhly'yndw tnhn li kDhn wT nh lhndyn.

byshk munfq bh jy hytthyn Tbqy +m hwnd, & nhn jw mddgr kwy'y nh lhndyn.
pr jn twbh ky'y & pN sdhryw & llh khy chnbRy wrtw & khlS llh j Hukm mnyy sy mw'mnn sn ahn, & llh mw'mnn khy wDw jr sghw Dyndw.

jykDhn whyn k chNy'y pdhry TrH knd ahyw y uh lky'y knd ahyw y mdy'y khn Trw knd ahyw th byshk llh m`fy DyndR ws wrw ahy.

byshk jyky llh & snds pyGmbrn khy nh mnyynd ahn & llh & snds pyGmbrn jy wch +m frq krN ghrnd ahn & chwnd ahn th kn pyGmbrn khy mnyywn th & kn (pyGmbrn) khy nh th mnyywn & unhya wch +m k by wT wtthN ghrnd ahn.
uhy shkhS sy pk kfr ahn, & kfrn li khwry DyndR `dhb tyr kyw thy'wn.
& jn llh & snds pyGmbrn khy mnyyw & mnjhny'n knhn hk jy wch +m frq nh kyw unhn khy llh sndn jr sghw Dyndw, & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

& khny'n njm wtthN li sndn mthn (jbl) Tuwr khRw kywswn & khyn chywswn th (shhr jy) drwzy khn sjdw kndR thy ghRw & khyn (hyu bh) frmywswn th cchncchr (jy Dynhn mcchy nh mrN jy Hkm kyl) +m Hd khn nh lnghw & khny'n pkw njm wrtwswn.

pwi sndn njm bhnyN & llh jy aytn khy sndn nh mnyN & pyGmbrn khy sndn nHq mrN (sbbn sz jwG thy) & sndn (nhya) chwN sbbn th sn jw dlywn ddhkyl ahn, (nh!) blk llh sndn kfr sbbn mthn muhr hny'y ahy tnhnkry thwrn khnswi ymn nh aNynd.
& sndn kfr sbbn & mrym ty sndn wDy buhtn chwN sbbn.

& sndn hn chwN sbbn th llh jy pyGmbr masiyH `ys~ pT mrym jy khy kutthw thy'wn, Hlnk nh khys kutthy'wn & nky khys swrya ty chRhyy'wn pr nhn khy shubh +m wdhw wyw, & byshk jn n bbt tkrr kyw sy khny's shk +m ahn, gmn khnswi khyn n jy k pky dyNp nh ahy, & pk sn nh kutthw thn.
blk llh khys pN Dnhn mthy khNy wrtw, & llh Glb Hkmt wrw ahy.
& ktb wrn mn kwy'y nh rhndw pr snds mwt khn G (sbhy'y) mths Drwr ymn aNynd, & qymt jy Dynhn (`ys~) mthn shhd hwndw.
pwi yhwdyn jy Zlm sbbn (ghNywn) stthywn shywn jy nhn li Hll kyl hywn sy mthn Hrm kywswn & (pN) ghNn mNhn khy llh jy wT khn sndn jhlN sbbn.
& pN sndn wyj wtthN sbbn Hlnk byshk khny's jhly (bh) wy hy' & (pN) mNhn jy mln khy sndn nHq khy'N sbbn (ghNywn Hll shywn mthn Hrm kywn wywn), & unhn mn kfrn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb tyr kyw thy'wn.

pr mnjhny'n `lm +m pk & mw'mn jyky twDnhn nzl kyw wyw tnhn khy & jyky twkhn G nzl kyw wyw tnhn khy mnyynd ahn & nmz pRhndR & zkw@ DyndR & llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyyndR ahn, sghwy'y nhn khy wDw jr Dyndswn.

sn twDnhn (hRya TrH) wHy kyw jhRy TrH nwH Dnhn & khny's pwi (byn) pyGmbrn Dnhn wHy kywhwswn, & brhym & sm`yl & sHq & y`qwb & y`qwb jy wld & `ys~ & ayWuwb & yuwns & hrwn & slymn Dnhn wHy kywswn, & dw'd khy zbwr Dnwswn.

dwzkh jy wT khnswi mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn, & hw llh ty shnjw ahy.

`ys~ llh jy bnhy hujN khn bnh `r nh kndw ahy & nky muqrWb maly'ik, & jykw snds bnhp khn `r kndw & wDy'y kndw tn sbhny khy sghwy'y (llh) pN wT gD kndw.
pwi jn ymn andw ahy & chN km ky ahn tn khy sndn jr puwrw Dyndw & (blk) pnhnjy fDl sn khyn wdhyk Dyndw, & jn (bnhy hjN khn) `r kyw & wDy'y ky'y tn khy Dkhwy'yndR `dhb jy sz Dyndw.

pwi jn llh khy mnyyw & khys chnbRy wrtw tn khy pnhnjy prn bjh & fDl hytth sghw dkhl kndw & pN Dnhn khyn sdhw rstw Dykhryndw.

(y pyGmbr jnhn khy wld & mu pyu nh hjy tnhnjy myrth bbt) twkhn pcchn th, chw' th llh kllh (jy myrth) bbt whn khy ftw~ thw Dy'y, jykDhn (kw hRw) mRs mry jnhnkhy wld nh ahy (& nh mu pyu) & khys hk bhyN ahy th jyky cchDyy'yn tnhnjw dh un li ahy, & (jykDhn hRy zl mry wnyy & bhu jyy'rw thn th) bhu snds wrth ahy sw tDhn jw khys wld nh hjy, pwi jykDhn bh bhynr hjn th jyky cchDyy'yn tnhn mn bnhy li bh Thywn ahn, & jykDhn (wrth) bhynrwn & bhy'r hjn th mRs (y`ny bhu) li bn zln (bhynrn) jy HSWy jytrw ahy, llh whn li byn kndw ahy th mtn (whyn) gmrh thyw, & llh sbhknhn shyi khy dyNndR ahy.

y ymn wrw' llh jy `bdt jy nshnyn jy by t`Zymy nh kryw & nky t`Zym wry mhyny +m & nky (k`bh Dnhn mwklyl) qrbnya (jy jnwr) jy & nky qly'd (llh li ndhr kyl jnwrn jy Gchyn +m bdhl Gnn) jy & nky t`Zym wry ghr (byt llh) Dnhn wyndRn jy jyky pnhnjy plNhr jw fDl & rDmndy ghrndR ahn, & jDhn whyn Hrm khwlyw tDhn (bhaly) shkr kryw, & whn khy nhn mNhn jy dshmny jn whn khy t`Zym wry msjd khn jhlyw hn Glh jw sbb nh thy'y jw (whyn) Hd khn lnghw, & chNy'y & prhyzgrya ty pN +m mdd Dyw, & gnh & Hd khn lnghN ty hk by'y khy mdd nh Dyw, & llh khn Ddyw, byshk llh skht `dhb krN wrw ahy.

whn ty Hrm kyw wyw ahy muy'l jnwr & (whndR) rt & suwy'r jw gwsht & jnhn shyi khy llh jy nly khnswi by'y jy nly sn sDyw wnyy (y`ny llh khn swi by'y jy nly mnyt kyl hjy) & ghuTw Dyy'y mryl & dhk sn muy'l & kirN sn muy'l & ddhwr jy ukhl sn muy'l (Hrm kyw wyw ahy) & jykw (jnwr) phRyndR khdhw (sw bh) pr jnhnkhy (mrN khn G) dhbH kywa (sw Hrm nh ahy) & jw (jnwr) astnn ty dhbH kjy (sw Hrm kyw wyw ahy) & whnjw tyrn sn wrhN (bh), ihy (mRy'y) gnh j km ahn, dy kfr whn jy dyn khn n myd thy tnhnkry khny'n nh Ddyw & mwn khn Ddyw, dy whn jw dyn whn li kml kym & whn ty pnhnjy n`mt pwry kym & whn li dyn slm psnd kym, pwi jykw gnh Dnhn nh lRw kndR thy bkh +m lchr thy'y (& mthywn Hrm shywn khy'y th rw ahy), pwi tHqyq llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

(y pyGmbr) twkhn pcchn th unhn li khRywn shywn Hll kywn wywn ahn, chw' th whn li (sbh) stthywn (shywn) Hll kywn wywn ahn & (uhw shkr bh Hll ahy) jyky shkry jnwrn khy shkr sykhryndR thy (whn) sykhryw ahy (y`ny) jyky llh (shkr krN jw dstwr) whn khy sykhryw tnhn mn nhn khy sykhryw hjy, th jykw (shkr uhy) whn li jhlyn tnhn mn khy'w & un (jnwr khy bcchN mhl) ty llh jw nlw (y`ny bismi llhi allhu akbru) chy'w & llh khn Ddyw, byshk llh skht Hsb wtthndR ahy.

dy whn li stthywn shywn Hll kywn wywn ahn, & ktb wrn jw T`m (bh) whn li Hll ahy, & whn jw T`m nhn li Hll ahy, & (pN) pkdmn mw'mnyNywn & jn khy whn khn G ktb Dnw wyw tn mn pkdmn (`wrtwn) jDhn prNw kndR nh zn kndR & nh Gjhy ashny'y rkhndR thy khyn sndn kbyn Dyw (th Hll kywn wywn), & jykw ymn (y`ny unhn Hukmn mnyN) jw nkr kndw tnhnjw kyw kmyw byshk ns thy wyw, & uhw akhrt +m cchyy'y wrn mn ahy.

y ymn wrw' jDhn whyn nmz li uthw tDhn pnhnjn munhn khy & pnhnjn hthn khy tthwntthyn ty'yn dhwy'w & pnhnjn mthn khy msH kryw & pnhnjn pyrn khy bhyDyn ty'yn (dhwy'w) & jykDhn whyn junby (y`ny mthy myr) hjw th pk thyw (y`ny tR kryw), & jykDhn bymr hjw y msfrya ty (hjw) y whn mn kwy'y py'khnh mn chy y whyn zln khy wyjh wy hjw pwi whyn pNy nh lhw th pk mTya sn tymm kryw pwi pnhnjn munhn khy & pnhnjn hthn khy mnjhny's masH kryw, & llh whn ty k tngy nh ghrndw ahy pr ghurndw ahy th whn khy pk kry & whn ty pnhnjy n`mt pwry kry mna whyn shkrnw kryw.
& llh jy n`mt j whn ty ahy s yd kryw & snds uhw anjm jykw whn sn pkya TrH kyy'yn tnhn khy (bh yd kryw) jDhn whn chyw th bdhwswn & mnyywswn, & llh khn Ddyw, cchwth llh synn wrw (bhyd) dyNndR ahy.

y ymn wrw' nSf sn shhdy DyndR thy llh lG byhk wtthndR hujw, & knhn qwm jy dshmny whn khy whn jy by nSfy jw sbb nh bNy, nSf kryw, uhw prhyzgry khy Dddhw wyjhw ahy, & llh khn Ddyw, cchwth jyky whyn knd ahyw tnhnjy llh khbr rkhndR ahy.
jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn sn llh w`dw kyw ahy th unhn li bkhshsh & wDw jr ahy.
& jn kfr kyw & sn jy aytn khy kuwRw bhnyw uhy dwzkhy ahn.

& llh bny sry'yln khn byshk njm wrtw, & mnjhn brhn srdr mqrr kyswn, & llh chyw th tHqyq aun whn sN ahyn, jykDhn nmz pRhyw & zkw@ Dnwa & munhnjn pyGmbrn khy mnyywa & khyn mdd kyw & llh khy chNw qrD Dnwa th lbt whn jwn mdywn whn khn Drwr myTynds & lbt whn khy hRn bGn +m Drwr dkhl knds jn jy hytthn whywn whndywn ahn, wry hn khn pwi whn mn jykw kfr thyndw sw sdhya wT khn byshk bhulw.

pwi sndn njm bhnyN sbbn mthn l`nt ky'y swn & sndyn dlyn khy skht kywswn, (uhy twryt +m) kn lfZn khy pnhnjn jyn khn bdly'yn th & jyk nSyHt ky'y wy'y tnhn mn HSw wsryy'wn, & mnjhy'n thwrRn khnswi nhn (sbhny) jy (hk nh by) khynt ty hmyshh wqf thyndw rhndyn tnhnkry khyn m`f kr & muRy wny, byshk llh bhlrn khy dwst rkhndw ahy.

nhya kry bny sry'yln ty lzm kywswn th jykw knhn jn jy `wD y zmyn +m fsd wjhN (wry) khnswi by'y knhn khy kuhndw tnhn dyNk mRny mNhn khy kutthw, & jnhn un khy bchyw tnhn dyNk mRny mNhn khy bchyw, & lbt byshk sn j (ghN) pyGmbr chTn mu`jzn sn wTn ay, wry byshk un khnpwi mnjhy'n ghN mulk +m Hd khn lnghndR thy.

jyky llh & snds pyGmbr sn wRhnd & mlk +m fsd (wjhN) li kwshsh knd tn jy sz hn khnswi (by k) nh ahy th kuhjyni y suwrya chRhjyni y sndn hth & sndn pyr ubtR sbtR wddhjn y dys nykly Djyni, duny +m unhn li ih khwry ahy & akhrt +m unhn li wDw `dhb ahy.

y ymn wrw' llh khn Ddyw & Dnhs wsylw Gwlyw (y`ny nyk `mln jy wsyly sn llh t`l~ Dy wyjh thyw) & snds wT +m kwshsh kryw mna whyn cchTw.
byshk jn kfr kyw tn khy jyky zmyn +m ahy sw mRy'y jykDhn hjy & un jytrw byw bh gD (hjyn) uhw qymt jy Dynhn jy `dhb khn (bcha) li `wD Dyn th khny'n qbwl nh kbw, & unhn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.

pwi jnhn pnhnjy kyl pnyN twbh ky'y & chN km ky tnhn ty llh bjh sn mwTndw, cchwth llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

y pyGmbr nhn jw Hl twkhy Gmgyn nh kry jyky hRn (mNhn) mn kfr +m khy pwnd ahn jw pnhnjn wtn sn chwnd ahn th ymn andwswn & sndn dlyn ymn nh andw ahy, & (pN) yhwdyn mn, jw Dddh kuwR bdhndR ahn bya qwm (kfrn) li jy ny tw wT nh ay ahn jsuwsy kndR ahn, kn (SHyH) Glhyn khy pnhnjn hndhn ty qy'm hjN khnpwi bdly'ynd ahn, (mNhn khy) chwnd ahn th jykDhn hyu (Hukm) Dnw wnyywa th hw qbwl kjw & jykDhn uhw nh Dnw wnyywa th pry thjw, & llh jnhn jy gmrh krN jw rdw kndw ahy tnhn li llh (jy pr) khn (hdyt krN jw) kujh khtyr nh thyy'y, uhy (hR) ahn jw nhn jy dlyn khy llh pk krN nh ghrndw ahy,, dny +m nhn li khwry ahy & akhrt +m nhn li wDw `dhb ahy.

bny sry'yln mn jyky kfr thy tn ty dw'd & `ys~ pT mrym jy zbn sn l`nt ky'y wyy'y ahy, uhw hn sbbn ahy jw by frmny kyy'wn & Hd khn lnghnd hy'.

pwi jyky chyy'wn tnhn sbbn llh khyn bhsht Dnw jnhn jy hytthn whywn whndywn ahn mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn, & ihw bhlrn jw bdlw ahy.
& jn kfr kyw & sn jy aytn khy kwRw bhnyw uhy dwzkhy ahn.
y ymn wrw' jyky pk shywn llh whn li Hll kywn ahn sy Hrm nh bNyw & nky Hd khn lnghw, byshk llh Hd khn lnghndRn khy dwst nh rkhndw ahy.
& jyky llh whn khy pk Hll rzq Dnw ahy tnhn mn khy'w, & un llh khn Ddyw jnhn khy mnyyndR ahyw.

llh whn jy jyn qsmn khNN +m whn khy nh pkRyndw pr jyky qsm whn pky nyt sn khny tnhn sbbn whnkhy watth kndw, pwi n jy kfrt wchthrw (khdhw) jyky pnhnjy `yl khy khry'ynd ahyw tnhn mn Dhn mskynn khy khdhw DyN ahy y khyn wys ddhky'N y bnhwn ajw krN (jGy'y), pwi jykw nh lhy th Ty Dynhn rwzw rkhN lzm ahy, jDhn whyn qsm khNw (& bhnyw tDhn) ih kfrt whn jy qsmn jy ahy, & pnhnjy qsmn khy (bhnyN khn) swghw rkhw, hRy TrH llh whn li pnhnj Hkm byn kndw ahy mna whyn shkrnw kryw.
y ymn wrw' shrb & jw' & pwdy astn & ddhr plytu shyTny kmn mn ahn tnhnkry whyn khny'n prhyz kryw th mna cchTw.
shyTn jw rdw shrb (pyrN) & jw' (khyDy'N) +m hn khnswi nh ahy th whn jy wch +m dshmny & bGD wjhy & llh jy yd krN khn & nmz khn whn khy jhly, pwi (hNy bh) whyn (nh) jhlbw' cch?
& llh jy frmnbrdry kryw & pyGmbr jy frmnbrdry kryw & Ddyw, pwi jykDhn whyn phrndw' th (pk) dyNw th sn jy pyGmbr ty rGw pdhrw pyGm phchy'N ahy.

jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn ty jyky (G) khdhy'wn tnhn +m gnh nh ahy jDhn prhyzgry kyy'wn & ymn andy'wn & chN km kyy'wn wry prhyzgry kyy'wn & ymn andy'wn wry prhyzgry kyy'wn & chNy'y kyy'wn, & llh bhlrn khy dwst rkhndw ahy.

y ymn wrw' llh knhn shkr (jy Hkm) sn jnhn khy whn j hth y whn j tyr phchn whn khy hn li Drwr prkhyndw th llh nkhyRy th kyr khny's prputth Ddyndw ahy, pwi jykw hn khnpwi Hd khn lnghndw tnhn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.

y ymn wrw' whyn Hrm (jy Hlt) +m shkr nh kryw, & whn mn jnhn dyNy wNy n khy mryw pwi jyky mryw ths tnhn jhRw jnwr jnhn li whn mn bh m`tbr Hukm kn sz lzm ahy h qrbny k`by wT phchNy ahy y (sz) mskynn jw khdhw kfrt ahy y n jy brbr rwz rkhy hn li th pnhnjy km jy sz chkhy, jyky Gy gdhryw sw allh m`f kyw, & jnhn mwTy kyw tnhn khn llh bdlw wtthndw, & llh Glb bdly wtthN wrw ahy.
drya jw shkr whn li Hll kyw wyw & n jw khy'N whn li & msfrn li nf`y wrw ahy, & jhng jw shkr jysty'yn whyn Hrm wr hjw tysty'yn whn ty Hrm kyw wyw, & un llh khn Ddyw jnhn Dnhn gD ky wyndw'.

llh t`Zym wry ghr k`bh t`Zym wry mhyny & (k`by Dnhn mwklyl) qrbny & qly'd khy mNhn li byhk jw sbb kyw, ihw (hn li) th whyn dyNw th jyky asmnn & jyky zmyn +m ahy sw byshk llh dyNndw ahy & llh sbhknhn shy khy dyNndR ahy.
dyNw th llh skht sz DyndR ahy & (hybh th) llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
pyGmbr ty rGw pyGm phchy'N ahy, & jyky pdhrw knd ahyw & jyky lky'ynd ahyw (sw sbh) llh dyNndw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th plyt & pk brbr nh ahn jytwNyk plyt jy ghNy'y twkhy zydh wNy, pwi y dhyn wrw' llh khn Ddyw th mna whyn cchTw.

y ymn wrw' nhn shyn bbt swl nh kryw jn jy Hqyqt jykDhn whn ty pdhry ky'y wnyy th whn khy Dkhy lGy, & jykDhn qran lhN mhl n bbt swl kryw th whn li pdhrw kyw wyndw, nhn (swln) khn llh whn khy m`fy Dny, & llh bkhshNhr brdbr ahy.
byshk hk qwm whn khn G hRyn (Glhyn) jw swl kyw hw (pr) smjhy'N ty wry un j phry munkr thy.
llh nky bHyrh & nky sy'bh & nky wSylh & nky Hm muqrWr kyw ahy pr kfr llh ty kwR bdhnd ahn, & mnjhny'n ghN nth smjhn.

& jDhn khyn chy'bw ahy th jyky llh lthw ahy tnhn Dnhn & pyGmbr Dnhn chw (tDhn) chwnd ahn th jnhn ty pnhnjn bn DDn khy (hlndw) Dtthwswn sw sn khy bs ahy, jytwNyk sndn b DD kjh nh dyNnd hy' & nky hdyt wr hy'.
y mw'mnw' whyn pnhnjn nfsn jy kryw, jDhn whyn hdyt wr thyw' tDhn uhw whn khy Drr nh rsy'yndw jykw bhulw, llh Dnhn whn mRny jw mwTN ahy pwi jyky whyn knd ahyw tnhnjy whn khy sudh Dyndw.

y ymn wrw' jDhn whn mn knhn khy mwt wyjhw thy'y th wSyWt krN mhl bh m`tbr wSWy kryw jy whn (mslmnn) mn hjn y whn khnswi by (y`ny Gyrqwm j) hjn (hy tDhn) jykDhn whyn mulk +m msfr hjw pwi whn khy mwt jw wq`w puhchy, jykDhn (whyn sndn gwhy DyN +m kw) shk rkhw th th (wchyna) nmz khnpwi whyn bnhy khy jhlyw pwi uhy (by'y) llh jw qsm khNy chwn th twNyk my'T hwnd th bh syn qsm jy `wD k bh nh wtthndswn & nky llh jy (Hkm wry) shhdy lky'yndswn (jy lky'y swn) th uty jw uty Drwr gnhgrn mn thyndswn.

pwi jykDhn m`lwm thy'y th uhy by'y gnhgr thy th jn jy ml ty by'y Hq rkhyw ahy tn jy wyjhy my'Ty wrn mn by bh dyN nhn jy bji khR thyn pwi llh jw qsm khNy chwn th bnhy jy shhdya khn sn jy shhdy Dddhy schy ahy & Hd khn nh lnghndswn, nh th ty jw ty Drwr Zlmn mn thyndswn.

ihw (Hukm hn Glh khy) wyjhw ahy th uhy (wSWy mNhw) schy Glhh jy shhdy DyN y pnhnjn qsmn khNN khnpwi qsm jy rd thyN khn Ddyn, & llh khn Ddyw & hy (Hukm dl sn) bdhw, & llh by dyn qwm khy sdhw rstw nh Dykhryndw ahy.
(yd kr) jnhn Dynhn llh sbhny pyGmbrn khy gD kndw (tnhn Dynhn) chwndw th whn khy cch jwb Dnw wyw, chwnd th sn khy (mNhn jy dlyn jy) khbr nh ahy, cchwth twn y'y Gjhn jw wDw dyNndR ahyn.

jDhn (un Dynhn) llh `ys~ pT mrym jy khy chwndw th pN ty & pnhnjy mu ty munhnjy n`mt yd kr, jDhn twkhy pk ruwH sn mdd Dnm, (jw) mNhn sn pynghy +m (khS TrH) & wDy whya +m Glhyuy'y thy, & jDhn twkhy ktb & dny'y & twryt & njyl sykhrym, & jDhn mnhnjy Hkm sn mTya mn pkhya jy shkl jhRw bNyy'y pwi mnjhs phwkyy'y th munhnjy Hkm sn pkhy thyw & munhnjy Hukm sn dywl ndhy & kwRhy khy cchTyy'y thy, & jDhn my'l khy mnhnjy Hukm sn (jyy'rw kry) kddhyy'y thy, & jDhn bny sry'yln (jy shr) khy twkhn jhlym jDhn wTm m`jzn sn ay'yn tDhn mnjhny'n kfrn chyw th hyu rGw pdhrw jdw ahy.
& jDhn Hwryn Dnhn lhm kym th mwn ty & munhnjy pyGmbr ty ymn aNyw, chyy'wn th ymn andwswn & (y `ys~) shhd hj th sn mslmn ahywn.
(yd kr) jDhn Hwryn chyw th y `ys~ puT mrym j tnhnjw plNhr sn ty asmn khn kw (T`m jw) khwnchw lhy sghndw cch? (`ys~) chyw th jykDhn mw'mn ahyw th llh khn Ddyw.
chyy'wn (syn hyu) ghrwn th th mnjhny's khy'wn & sn jwn dlywn arm wtthn & dyNwn th sn khy sch chyw thyy'y & mths shhd hjwn.
(tDhn) `ys~ pT mrym jy chyw th y sn j plNhr llh sn ty hk khwnchw asmn khn lh th sn jy Gyn & sn jy pwyn (sbhny) li `yd thy'y & tnhnjy nshny thy'y, & sn khy rwzy Dy & twn chNw rwzy DyndR ahyn.
llh chyw th aun whn ty (khwnchw) lhynds, pwi whn mn jykw hn khn pwi by frmny kndw tnhn khy aun hRw skht `dhb knds jw jhnn (jy rhndRn) mn knhn hk khy `dhb nh knds.

& (uhw wqt yd kr) jDhn llh chwndw th y `ys~ pT mrym j tw mNhn khy chyw hw cch? th llh khnswi mwnkhy & mnhnjy mu khy bh khd kry mnyyw, (`ys~) chwndw th twn pk ahyn jnhn chwN jw mwn khy kw Hq nh ahy sw chwN mwn khy ky'n jGy'yndw hw, jykDhn mwn hw chyw hwndw th byshk uhw twkhy m`lwm hwndw, jyky mnhnjy dl +m ahy sw (twn) dyNndw ahyn & jyky tnhnjy dl +m ahy sw (aun) nh dyNndw ahyn, byshk twn y'y Gujhn jw Dddhw dyNndR ahyn.

jnhn li mwn khy Hukm kyw thyy'y tnhn khnswi (byw ky) khyn nh chyw thm (y`ny) hy th llh jy `bdt kryw jw mnhnjw plNhr & whn jw plNhr ahy, jysyn mnjhn rhys th (aun) mthn nghbn rhys, pwi jnhn mhl tw mwnkhy khNy wrtw th twn y'y mthn nghbn rhyy'n, & twn sbhknhn shy ty khbrdr ahyn.
jykDhn khyn `dhb kryn th uhy tnhnj bnh ahn, jykDhn khyn bkhshyn th twn y'y Glb Hkmt wrw ahyn.

llh frmy'yndw th hy uhw Dynhn ahy jw schn khy sndyn schy'y fy'dw Dyndy, unhn li (uhy) bhsht ahn jn jy hytthn whywn whndywn ahn mnjhs Sly sdi rhN wr ahn, llh khny'n rDy ahy & uhy khny's rDy ahn, ih wDy mrd mNN ahy.
asmnn & zmyn jy & jyky mnjhn ahy tnhnjy bdshhy llh jy ahy, & uhw sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
sbh srh (khS) nhya llh khy jGy'y jnhn asmn & zmyn khy bNyw & wndh & swjhrw pyd kyw, wry (bh) kfr pnhnjy plNhr sn byn khy brbr knd ahn.
uhw (y'y llh) ahy jnhn whn khy mTya mn bNyw wry (whn jy jy'N & mwt jy) mudWt tthhryy'yn, & (hkRy by) mudWt wTs muqrWr thyl ahy wry (y kfrw' llh bbt) whyn shk knd ahyw.
& hwy'y llh asmnn & zmyn +m (sbhknhn jw m`bwd) ahy, whn jw Gjh & whn jw pdhrw dyNndw ahy & jyky knd ahyw swbh dyNndw ahy.
sndn plNhr jy aytn mn k ayt wTn nh yndy ahy pr khny's mnhn mwRynd ahn.
pwi byshk sch (y`ny qran) khy jnhn mhl wTn ayw (tnhn mhl) kwR bhnyy'wn, pwi jnhn (Glh) bbt chthr knd ahn tnhnjy (sz jwn) khbrwn wTn sghw phchndywn.

(kfr) nh Dsnd ahn cch? th khny'n Gy kytr Tbq ns kyswn jn khy zmyn +m hRy qdrt Dny hy'y swn jw whn khy bh nh Dny thy'wn & mthn asmnn mynhn sndh wsyswn, & sndn hytthn whywn whndR kywn swn pwi nhn khy sndn gnhn sbbn hlk kywswn & sndn pwy'tn byn qwmn khy pyd kywswn.
& jykDhn twty kGdhn +m (lkhyl) ktb (qran) nzl krywn h pwi uhy pnhnj hth khys ly'yn h th jyky kfr ahn sy Drwr chwn h th hyu rGw pdhrw jdw ahy.
& chwn th th mths malk cchwnh lthw wyw? & jykDhn syn malk nzl krywn h th Drwr km pwrw thy wnyy h (y`ny mry wnyn h) wry khyn muhlt (mwr) nh Djy h.
& jykDhn khys malk krywn h th Drwr khys mRs (jy shkl +m) bNywn h & jhRw shbh (hNy) knd ahn thRw shbh mthn qy'm rkhwn h.
& byshk twkhn G (byn) pyGmbrn sn (bh) chthr ky'y wyy'y (ahy) pwi mnjhny'n jn chthrwn kywn tn ty jnhn (Glh) ty chthr knd hy' tnhn (jy sz chy) ghyrw kyw.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th mlk +m ghmw wry Dsw th kwRn jy pcchRy kyy'n thy?

(y pyGmbr khny'n) pucch kr th jyky asmnn & zmyn +m ahy sw knhnjw ahy? chw' th llh jw ahy, jnhn (bnihn ty) bjhh (krN) pN ty lzm ky'y ahy, qymt jy Dynhn jnhn +m shk nh ahy Drwr whn khy gD kndw, jnhn pN khy cchyy'y +m wdhw sy kDhn ymn nh aNynd.
& jykw rt & Dynhn +m rhndw ahy, sw n jy milk ahy, & uhw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.

(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th asmnn & zmyn jy bNy'yndR llh khnswi by'y khy snbhlyndR kry cchw wtthn? & uhw (sbhny khy) rwzy Dyndw ahy & khys rwzy kwnh Dyndw ahy, chw' th mwn khy Hukm Dnw wyw th phrywn mslmn aun hjn & (frmyw wyw th) twn mshrkn mn muwr nh hj.
chw' th jykDhn pnhnjy plNhr jw chyw nh mnyyn th aun wDy Dynhn jy `dhb (phchN) khn Ddyn thw.
un Dynhn jnhn (mNhw) khn (`dhb) Tryw wyndw tnhn ty byshk llh bjh ky'y, & h pdhry mrd mNN ahy.
& jykDhn llh twkhy kw Dkh puhchy'y th un (llh) khnswi n jw kw lhyndR nh ahy, & jykDhn uhw twkhy sukh puhchy'y th uhw sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
& uhw bnhn ty Glb ahy, & uhw Hkmt wrw khbr rkhndR ahy.

pucch kr th shhdya +m kyr wDw ahy, chw' mnhnjy & whn jy wch +m llh y'y gwh ahy, & mwn Dnhn hyu qran hn li wHy kyw wyw ahy th un sn whn khy & jn jn khy (hyu qran) phchy (tn sbhny khy) Dydyryn, (hya Glh) whyn thbt kry sghndw' cch? th llh sN by (bh) `bdt j ly'q ahn, chw' th aun (hRy bTl km jy) shhdy nthw Dyn, (blk schy Glh jy thbtya li) chw' th hk llh khn swi kwy'y `bdt jw ly'q kwnhy & jnkhy whyn shryk bNy'ynd ahyw tn khn aun byzr ahyn.
jn khy ktb Dnwsyn sy un (pyGmbr) khy hRya TrH snyNnd ahn jhRya TrH pnhnjn pTn khy snyNnd ahn, jn pN khy cchyy'y +m wdhw sy ymn nh aNynd.
n khn wdhyk Zlm kyr ahy? jnhn llh ty kwRw tthh tthhyw y snds aytn khy kwRw dytw, kw shk nh ahy th Zlm nh cchTnd.
& (uhw wqt yd kr) jnhn Dynhn uhy mRy'y gD kndsyn wry mshrkn khy chwndsyn th whn j uhy shryk jn khy whyn (llh jw shryk) bhy'ynd hyw' kthy ahn?
wry sndn kwy'y `dhr hn chwN khn swi nh rhndw th pnhnjy plNhr llh jw qsm thy'wn th syn shryk kndR nh hy'swn.
(y pyGmbr) Ds th pN ty khRw kwR chyy'wn jyky tthh tthhynd ahn sy khny'n bhljy bhdyy wy.

& mnjhy'n kw hRw ahy jw tw Dnhn (qran bdhN li) kan Dyndw ahy, & sndyn dlyn ty n jy smjhN khn ddhk & sndn knn +m ghbry'y ky'y thy'wn, & jykDhn sbh mu`jz Dsnd th (bh) khyn nh mnyynd, tn jw jnhn mhl twsn jhGRw kndR thy tw wT ynd (tnhn mhl) kfr chwnd th hyu Gyn jy akhNyn khnswi byw kjh bh nh ahy.
& uhy un (jy bdhN) khn (byn khy) jhlynd ahn & (pN bh) khny'n pry bhdynd ahn, & pN khnswi (by'y knhn khy) hlk nh th kn & nh dyNnd ahn.
& jDhn (uhy) bh ty byhrb tDhn jykr khyn Dsyn (th `jb kryn) pwi chwnd sn khy rmn ahy (jykr dny +m) mwTy wnywn & pnhnjy plNhr jy aytn khy kwRw nh bhnywn & mw'mnn mn thywn.
(nh!) blk hn khn G jyky (kfr & gnh) lky'ynd hy' sy (dy) khyn pdhr nZr ay, & jykDhn (duny Dnhn) mwTy wnyn th jnhn (km) khn jhly wy swy'y wry krN lGnd & byshk uhy Drwr kwR ahn.
& chwn th th hn duny jy Hyty khnswi (byw kjh) nh ahy & syn (mrN khnpwi wry) uthN wr nh ahywn.

& jnhn mhl pnhnjy plNhr jy aDw byhrb (tnhn mhl) jykDhn khyn Dsyn (th `jb kryn, llh) chwndw th hy (wry jyy'rw thyN) sch nh ahy cch? chwnd hy'w snkhy pnhnjy plNhr jw qsm ahy (th sch ahy, llh) chwndw th jyky whyn kfr knd hyw' tnhn sbbn `dhb (jw mzw) chkhw.

jn llh jy mlN khy kwR bhnyw sy byshk cchyy'y wr thy, ytry qdr jDhn wchtw nhn ty qymt yndy (tDhn) chwN lGnd th sn un (qymt) bbt jyk kwthy ky'y tnhn ty sn khy fsws ahy & uhy pnhnjw br pnhnjy ptthyn ty khNnd, khbrdr jyky khNnd sw bcchRw ahy.
& duny jy Hyty rGw rnd & chrchw ahy, & jyky prhyzgr ahn tn li akhrt jy ji bhly ahy, pwi cchwnh th smjhw?
byshk dyNwn th th jyky (uhy) chwnd ahn sw twkhy Drwr Gmgyn kndw pwi uhy nh (rGw) twkhy kwRw chwnd ahn pr Zlm llh jy aytn jw nkr knd ahn.

& byshk twkhn G (ghN) pyGmbr kwR smjhy wy hy' pwi pnhnjy kwRy bhy'njN & pnhnjy Dkhwy'jN ty ysyn Sbr knd rhy jysyn khyn sn jy mdd puhty, & llh jy Glhyn (y`ny njmn) khy (kwbh) phyryndw nh ahy, & byshk tw wT pyGmbrn jy kujh khbr ay'y ahy.

& jykDhn sndn mnhn mwRN twkhy Dkhyw lGy thw th jykDhn zmyn +m k surng hNy sghyn y asmn ty k DkN tthhy sghyn y wTn kw m`jzw aNyn th aNy nhn khy Dykhr, & jykDhn llh ghry h th mRny khy hdyt ty gD kry h pwi N dyNn mn nh huj.
jyky (Hq TlbyndR thy Hq Glh khy) bdhnd ahn sy y'y (slm jy d`wt) qbwl knd ahn (unhn khy llh hdyt kndw ahy), & my'ln (y`ny kfrn) khy llh qymt jy Dynhn khRw kndw wry Dnhs mwTy wynd.
& chwn th th snds plNhr wTn un (pyGmbr) ty k nshny cchwnh lthy wy'y? (y pyGmbr) khyn chw' th llh nshny jy lhN ty ws wrw ahy pr mnjhny'n ghN (mNhw) nh dyNnd ahn.

& nkw zmyn +m kwy'y chrndR ahy & nkw pkhy ahy jw pnhnjyn khnbhRTyn sn uDmy thw pr whn jhRywn y'y Twlywn ahn, (sbh) k shy ktb (y`ny lawH maHfuwZ) +m lkhN khnswi nh cchDy swn wry pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn gD kywn wyndywn.
& jn sn jy aytn khy kuwRw dytw sy gwng & bwR wndhyn +m (pyl) ahn, llh jnhn khy ghury tnhn khy bhly'yndw ahy, & jnhn khy ghury tnhn khy sdhy wT ty byhk Dyndw ahy.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th (whyn) Dsw jykDhn llh jw `dhb whn khy puhchy y qymt whn wT chy th jykDhn whn sch ahyw th llh khnswi knhn khy sDyndw'?
(nh!) blk khS n khy sDynd pwi jykDhn ghry th jnhn (mSybt jy lhN) li whyn khys sDynd ahyw s lhy cchDy & jnhn khy llh sn shryk knd ahyw (sw nhya mhl) wsrynd ahyw.
& byshk twkhn G (ghNyn) umtn Dnhn (pyGmbr) mwklyswn pwi (unhn jy by frmnya sbb) khyn sn skhty & tklyf +m pkRyw th mna uhy zry kn.
pwi jnhn mhl sn jw `dhb wTn puhtw thy (tnhn mhl) cchwnh thy zry kyy'wn? pr sndn dlywn skht thy wywn hywn & jyky km knd hy' sy shyTn nhn li syngry.
pwi jyk nSyHt Dny wyn s jnhn mhl wsryy'wn (tnhn mhl) mthn hr shy j drwz khwlyswn, ytryqdr jw jyky Dnw wyn tnhn sn jDhn (chNy TrH) khwsh thy (th) khyn wchtw pkRywswn pwi uhy unhya mhl n umyd thy.
pwi Zlm qwm jy pR pTy wyy'y, & sbh srh llh jhnn jy plNhr khy jGy'y.

(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th Dsw th jykDhn llh whn j kn & whn jwn khywn khsy wtthy & whn jy dlyn ty muhr hNy th nhya llh khnswi kyr byw khud whn khy uhw Dyndw? Ds th khR dlyl byn krywn th wry bh uhy psw knd ahn.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th whyn khbr Dyw th jykDhn llh jw `dhb wchtw y pdhrw whn khy puhchy th Zlm qwm khnswi (byw kw) hlk thyndw cch?
& pyGmbrn khy khwshkhbry DyndR & DydyryndR y'y kry mwklywswn, pwi jn mnyyw & pN sdhryw tn khy kw bhw' nh ahy & nky uhy Gmgyn rhnd.
& jn sn jy aytn khy kwRw bhnyw tn khy nhya sbbn jw bdkry knd hy' `dhb phchndw.

& tnhnjy qwm un (qran) khy kwR bhnyw & (Hqyqt kry) uhw blkl sch ahy, (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th aun whn jw dhmy wr nh ahyn.

& jyky sn jy aytn bbt jyw bHth knd ahn tn khy jDhn Dsyn th khny'n munhn mwR jysty'yn un dhrn bya knhn Glhh +m bHth kn, & jykDhn shyTn twkhy wsry'y th yd chN khnpwi Zlm Twlya sn nh wyh.

& (y pyGmbr) jn pnhnjy dyn khy rnd & tmshw bNyw ahy & khyn duny jy Hytya tthGyw ahy tn khy cchDy Dy & qran sn nSyHt kr mtn (qymt jy Dynhn) kwy'y pnhnjy ky'y jy sbbn (hlkt +m) phsy, llh khnswi n jw nkw mddgr & nkw sfrsh kndR ahy, & jykDhn sbhk shy `wD Dyndw th khny's nh wrtw wyndw, ihy uhy ahn jw jyky kyy'wn tnhn sbbn (hlkt +m) phsy wy, unhn li ThkndR pNy mn pyN & Dkhwy'yndR `dhb nhya kry ahy jw kufr knd hw.

(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th llh khnswi hRy khy sDywn cch jykw sn khy nky sukh Dyndw ahy & nky Dukh Dyndw ahy & unhya khn pwi jw llh sn khy hdyt ky'y nhya wngr pnhnjyn khRyn (bhrpwi) ty mwTy wnywn cch jnhn khy shyTnn jhng +m bhly'y cchDyw hjy hw Hyrn pyw phry, snds kyy'y dwst hujn jy n khy sdhy rsty Dnhn py sDyn th sn Dnhn ch (& hw chy y'y nh, y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th llh jy Dsyl wT hy'y sdhy wT ahy, & sn khy Hkm Dnw wyw ahy th jhnn jy plNhr jy frmnbrdry krywn.
& (hyu bh Hkm Dnw wyw ahy) th nmz pRhw & khny's Ddyw, & uhw (llh) ahy jnhn Dnhn uthry wyndw'.

& uhw y'y ahy jnhn asmnn & zmyn khy rith sn bNyw ahy, & jnhn Dynhn (qymt li) chwndw th thyu th thy pwndy. snds Glh schy ahy, & jnhn Dynhn Swr +m phwkyw wyndw (tnhn Dynhn) rGw un jy bdshhy ahy, Gjh & Zhr jw dyNndR ahy, & uhw Hikmt wrw khbrdr ahy.
& (yd kr) jDhn brhym pnhnjy pyu azr khy chyw th butn khy khd kry cchwth wtthw? byshk aun twkhy & tnhnjy qwm khy pdhry gmrhya +m Dsn thw.
& hRy TrH brhym khy asmnn & zmyn jy bdshhy Dykhry swn thy (hin li) th (uhw) yqyn kndRn mn thyy'y.
pwi jnhn mhl rt mths wndhy ky'y (th asmn +m) hk trw Dtthy'yn, chyy'yn hy mnhnjw plNhr ahy, pwi jnhn mhl lthw (th) chyy'yn th lhndRn khy pyrw nh thw rkhn.
pwi jnhn mhl chnD khy chmkndR Dtthy'yn th chyy'yn hy mnhnjw plNhr ahy, pwi jnhn mhl lthw (th) chyy'yn th jykDhn mnhnjw plNhr mwn khy hdyt nh kndw th aun Drwr gmrh qwm mn thynds.
pwi jnhn mhl sj khy chmkndR Dtthy'yn (th) chyy'yn hy mnhnjw plNhr ahy (jw) hy wDw ahy, pwi jnhn mhl lthw (th) chyy'yn y mnhnjy qwm jn khy whyn khud sn shryk bNy'ynd ahyw tn khn aun byzr ahyn.
mwn (sbhny khn) hk Trfw thy pnhnjy mhR khy nhya llh Dnhn smhwn kyw ahy jnhn asmnn & zmyn khy bNyw ahy & aun mshrkn mn nh ahyn.

& snds qwm sNs tkrr kyw, chyy'yn th whyn llh bbt mwn sn hn Hlt +m cchwth tkrr kyw jw byshk mwnkhy sdhy rsty ltw ths jnhn khy sNs shryk kryw th tnhn khn kyn Ddynds pr mnhnjy plNhr jw kjh (krN) ghryw (sw thyNw ahy), sbhk shy mnhnjy plNhr jy `ilm +m smy'y ahy, pwi whyn cchwnh nSyHt mnyynd ahyw.

& jnhn khy llh sn shryk kryw th tnhn khn ky'n Ddynds & (whyn) hn khn nh th Ddyw whyn llh sN hw shryk knd ahyw jnhn jy whn wT k HujWt lthl nh ahy, jykDhn whyn dyNnd ahyw (th bdhyw th) bnhy Twlyn mn khRy mn jy wdhyk Hqdr ahy?
jn ymn andw & pnhnjy ymn khy kfr sn nh wchRyw unhn li mn ahy & uhy hdyt wr ahn.
& hy sn jw dlyl ahy jw brhym khy snds qwm ty (mqbly li) Dnwswn, jnhn khy ghrnd ahywn tnhnkhy drjn +m mthhwn knd ahywn, cchwth tnhnjw plNhr Hkmt wrw dyNndR ahy.

& brhym khy sHq & y`qwb `T kywswn, sbhny khy hdyt ky'y swn, & un khn G nuwH khy hdyt ky'y swn & snds wld mn dw'd khy & sulaymn & ayWuwb & yuwsf & muws~ & hruwn khy (hdyt ky'y swn), & hRy TrH syn bhlrn khy bdlw Dynd ahywn.
& dhkryW & yaHy~ & `ys~ & lys khy bh, jw hr hk bhlrn mn hw.
& sm`yl & yasa`a & yuwns & luwT khy bh, & sbhny khy jG (jy rhndRn) khn bhly'y Dny swn.
& sndn pyn DDn & sndn wld & sndn bhy'rn mn bh, & khyn chwnDywswn & khyn sdhy wT Dnhn hdyt ky'y swn.
h llh jy hdyt ahy pnhnjn bnhn mn jnhn li ghry tnhn khy n rsty ly'y, & jykDhn (hy mNhw) shrk kn h th jyky kmyy'wn sw khny'n Drwr ns thy'y h.
ihy uhy ahn jn khy ktb & Hikmt & pyGmbry Dny swn, pwi jykDhn hy mNhw (qran jy nhn) Glhyn khy nh mnyyn th byshk sn hk qwm khy mqrWr kyw ahy jy (qran jy nhn) Glhyn j nkr kndR nh thynd.
ihy uhy ahn jn khy llh hdyt ky'y ahy pwi twn bh sndn Tryqy jy pyrwy kr, chw' th whn khn un (pyGm puhchy'N) ty kw jwrw nthw ghurn, ihw qran khS jhnn li nSyHt ahy.

& unhn (yhwdyn) llh jw snds shn mTbq qdr nh kyw hn kry jw chyy'wn th llh knhn mNhwa ty kujh nh lthw ahy, (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th uhw ktb knhn lthw jykw mws~ andw hw? jw mNhn li nuwr & hdyt hw jnhn khy whyn jzwn jzwn kryw th un jy knhn bhNy khy pdhrw knd ahyw & ghNw lky'ynd ahyw, & jyky (Glhywn) nky whyn & nky whn j pyu DD dyNnd hy' sy whn khy sykhrywn wywn, chw' th llh (ktb lthw ahy) wry nhn khy sndn jy'y bHth +m rnd kndw cchDy Dy.

& un khn wdhyk Zlm kyr ahy jykw llh ty kwRw tthh tthhy y chwy th mwn Dnhn wHy kyw wyw ahy & Dnhns kujh bh wHy nh kyw wyw hjy y chwy th jy'n llh (ktb) nzl kyw ahy ty'n aun (bh) ktb nzl knds, & (y pyGmbr) jykDhn Dsyn (th jykr `jb lGyy'y) jDhn Zlm mwt jy skrtyn +m hwnd & mly'k pnhnjn hthn khy Dghw knd, (& chwnd th) pnhnjn shn khy bhr kddhw, dy whn khy khwry wry `dhb jy sz nhya sbbn Dny wyndy jw whyn llh ty nHq chwnd hyw' & snds aytn khn wDy'y knd hyw'.

& byshk sn wT (y'yn) hk hk thy ayw' jy'n whn khy phryn bhyry pyd kyw hwswn & jyky whn khy `T kyw hwswn sw whn pnhnjyn ptthyn pwi tn cchDy Dnw, & whn j sfrsh kndR whn sn nh th Dswn jn khy whyn pnhnjn (Htyjn pwry krN) +m (llh sn) shryk bhy'ynd hyw', byshk whn jw pN +m Gnddhpw cchnw & jn khy whyn bhy'ynd hyw' sy whn khn bhuljy wy.
llh bj & kkRya khy phTy'yndR ahy, muy'y mn jyy'rw kddhndw ahy & jyy'ry mn muy'w kddhndR ahy, uhw (y'y) llh ahy pwi whyn kyDnhn bhly wynd ahyw.
prh khy phTy'yndR ahy, & rt khy arm & sj & chnD khy (wqtn jy) Hsb li (pyd) kyy'yn, hw ndzw (llh) Glb dyNndR tthhyw ahy.
& uhw (llh) ahy jnhn trn khy whn li hn kry (pyd) kyw th pTn & dryy'n jy wndhyn +m wTwn lhw, byshk dyNndR qwm li nshnywn (khwly) byn kywn swn.
& uhw (llh) ahy jnhn whn khy hik jiya mn pyd kyw pwi (whn li) TkN jw hndh & snbhN jy ji kyy'yn, byshk smjhndR Twly li nshnywn (khwly) byn kywn swn.

& uhw (llh) ahy jnhn asmn mn pNy wsyw, pwi un sn hr shy j wbhR dymyswn pwi un mn swk khy kddhywswn pwi mnjhny's (sngn +m) gDyl dN kddhwn th, & khjya jy chpRn mn gwsh lRkyl & Dkhn j bG & zytwn & DRhwn hk by'y jhR & dhr dhr (pyd kyswn), jDhn phrjn th sndn phr & n jy pchN Dnhn nhryw, cchwth un +m mnyyndR Twly li Drwry nshnywn ahn.
& (kfrn) jnn khy llh sn shryk bNyw ahy hn hwndy jw khyn (llh) khlqyw ahy & un li by `lmya sn puT & dhyy'rwn tthhywn thn, hw pk ahy & jyky byn knd ahn tnhn khn mthhwn ahy.
asmnn & zmyn jw bNy'yndR ahy, nhya khy wld jw Htyj ky'n thyndw? & un khy zl (jw Htyj) nh ahy, & sbhk shy (pN) khlqyy'yn, & uhw sbhknhn shy khy dyNndR ahy.
hw whn jw plNhr ahy, un khnswi kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, sbhknhn shy khy pyd kndR ahy tnhnkry snds `bdt kryw, & uhw sbhknhn shy khy snbhlyndR ahy.
(dny +m) khywn khys Dsy nh sghndywn & uhw khyn khy Dsndw ahy, & uhw bryk byn khbr rkhndR ahy.
byshk whn jy plNhr khn whn wT nshn ay ahn, pwi jnhn Dtthw (y`ny smjhyw) tnhn pN li (nf`) kmyw, & jykw ndhw thyw tnhn ty n jw nqSn ahy, & (y pyGmbr chw' th) aun whn ty nghbn nh ahyn.
& hRy TrH TrHyn TrHyn dlyl byn krywn th & hn li mtn chwn th twn pRhyw ahyn & hn li th hn (dyn) khy unhya qwm li pdhrw krywn jy dyNn th.
(y pyGmbr) jyky tnhnjy plNhr wTn twDnhn wHy kyw wyw ahy tnhnjy tb`dry kr, un khnswi kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, & mushrkn khn munhn mwR.
& jykDhn llh guhry h th shrk nh kn h, & twkhy mthn nghbn nh kyw thy'wn, & nky twn mthn kw nZr kndR ahyn.

(y mslmnw') jn khy (mushrk) llh khnswi sDynd ahn tn khy grywn nh Dyw jy mtn (uhy) by smjhy'y jy kry dshmnya khn llh khy Glhy'yn, hRy TrH hr Twlya li sndn km syngryswn, wry sndn plNhr Dnhn sndn mwTN ahy pwi jyky knd ahn tnhn jy khyn sudh Dyndw.

& kfr pnhnjy skht sunhn sn llh jw qsm khNnd ahn th wTn jykDhn kw m`jzw chy th n khy Drwr mnyynd, chw' th mu`jz th (khS) llh wT ahn (y mslmnw') whn khy knhn smjhyw ahy th uhy mnyynd (sw m`jz wTn) jDhn ay th bh nh mnyynd?

& jykDhn nhn ty syn mly'k lhywn h & sNn muy' (bh) Glhy'yn h & hr shy sndn amhwn smhwn kry gD (bh) krywn h th bh llh jy ghur khnswi kDhn ymn nh aNyn h pr unhn mn ghN by smjhy'y kn th.

& (hn li wswsw wjhnd ahn) th jyky akhrt khy nh mnyynd ahn tn jwn dlywn Dnhs lRn & n khy psnd kn & (hn li) th uhy jyky km kndR ahn sy knd rhn.

& tnhnjy plNhr jw skhn schy'y & nSf +m pwrw ahy, snds skhnn khy kw mTy'yndR nh ahy, & uhw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
& jykDhn zmyn wrn (mNhn) mn ghNn (y`ny kfrn) jw chyw mnyyndyn th twkhy llh jy wT khn bhuly'ynd, (uhy) rGw gmn ty hlnd ahn & uhy rGw Tkl hNnd ahn.
byshk tnhnjw plNhr unhn khy (bh) chNw dyNndR ahy jyky snds wT khn bhul, & uhw hdyt wrn khy (bh) chNw dyNndR ahy.
pwi jykDhn whyn snds aytn khy mnyynd ahyw th jnhn ty llh jw nlw yd kjy tnhn mn khy'w.

& whn khy cch (thyw) ahy jw jnhn (shy) ty llh jw nlw yd kjy tnhn mn nh khy'ynd ahyw hn hwndy jw jyky (shywn) llh whn ty Hrm kywn ahn sy whn li byshk byn kywn ths? pr jnhn (Hrm jy khy'N) li whyn lchr thyw (sw bh rw ahy) & ghN N dyNy'ya sn pnhnjn sadhn sbbn Drwr bhly'yn th, cchwth tnhnjw plNhr Hd khn lnghndRn khy chNy TrH dyNndR ahy.
& Zhry gnh & bTny gnh (sbh TrH) cchDy Dyw, jyky gnh knd ahn sy jyky kn th tnhn sbbn sghw sz Dbyn.

& jnhn (shy) ty llh jw nlw yd nh kjy tnhn mn nh khy'w jw uhw (khy'N) Drwr gunh ahy, & shyTn pnhnjn yrn khy hn li wswsw wjhnd ahn th whn sn jhyRw kn, & jykDhn sndn chyw mnyyndw' th whyn (bh) Drwr mshrk thyndw'.

jykw my'l hw tnhn khy jyrywswn & un li swjhrw kywswn jnhn sn mNhn +m ghumy thw uhw un jy mthl jhRw ahy cch jykw wndhyn +m ahy mnjhny's nkrN wrw nh ahy, hRy TrH kfr jyky knd ahn sw nhn li syngryw wyw ahy.
& hRy TrH hr Gwtth +m unhy (Gwtth) j wDyr hn li bdkr kyswn th un (Gwtth) +m fsd wjhnd rhn, & (uhy) pN khnswi by'y knhn li fsd nh knd ahn & nh dyNnd ahn.

& jDhn wTn k ayt yndy ahy (th) chwnd ahn th jhRy (pyGmbry) llh jy pyGmbrn khy Dny wy'y ahy thRy jysty'yn sn khy (nh) Dny wyndy tysyn kDhn nh mnyyndswn, llh jnhn hndh pnhnjy pyGmbry khy mwkly (sw hndh) chNw dyNndR ahy, jn Dwh kyw tn khy llh wTn khwry & skht `dhb nhy kry sghw phchndw jw shrrtwn knd ahn.

pwi llh jnhn khy ghrndw ahy th hdyt kry tnhn jw synw slm li kshdw kndw ahy, & jnhn khy bhly'N ghrndw ahy tnhn jy syny khy hRw skht swRhw kndw ahy jw dyNk asmn ty chRhy thw, jyky nh mnyynd ahn tn ty llh hRy plyty rkhndw ahy.
& tnhnjy plNhr jy ih sidhy wT ahy, byshk sn nshnywn nhya qwm li khwly byn kywn ahn jy nSyHt mnyynd ahn.
