& jn ymn andw & chN km ky knhn mNhwa khy snds ws khn wdhyk tklyf Dynd y'y nh ahywn, uhy bhshty ahn, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.

& jykw Gyr sndyn dlyn +m hwndw sw kddhy cchDyndswn sndyn (mRyn jy) hytthn whywn pywn whndywn, & chwnd th sbh srh nhy khy jGy'y jnhn sn khy hn (bhsht) Dnhn rstw ltw, jykDhn llh sn khy hdyt nh kry h th kDhn syn hdyt nh lhwn h, byshk sn wT sn jy plNhr j pyGmbr sch wtthy ay, & sDyw wyndw th hy bhsht (whn khy Dnw wyw) un j unhya sbbn (whyn) wrth ahyw jw (chNy'y) knd hyw'.

& bhshty dwzkhyn khy sDynd (& chwnd) th sn jy plNhr sn sn jyky njm kyw hw sw byshk schw ldhwswn pwi whn jy plNhr whn sn jykw njm kyw hw sw schw (nh) ldhwa cch? chwnd th hy'w! pwi sDyndR sndn wch +m sDyndw th unhn Zlmn ty llh jy l`nt ahy.
jyky llh jy wT khn (mNhn khy) jhlynd rhy & n jy wT jy Dngy'y ghrnd rhy, & uhy akhrt khy nh mnyyndR hw.
& sndn wch +m prdw kyw wyndw, & a`rf +m hR mNhw hwnd jw sbhknhn khy sndyn pyshnyn mn snyNnd, & bhshtyn khy sDy alsWlamu `alaykum chwnd, (ny) un +m (pN) nh ghRy hwnd & uhy mydwr hwnd.
& jDhn sndn khywn dwzkhyn Dnhn phyrywn wyndywn (th) chwnd y sn j plNhr sn khy Zlm Twlya sn gD nh kr.
& a`rf wr jn muRsn khy sndyn pyshnyn mn snyNnd tn khy sDynd chwnd th whn jyky gD kyw hw sw & jyk wDy'y knd hyw' tnhn whn khn kjh bh nh Tryw.
hyu uhy (mNhw) ahn cch jn li whyn (dny +m) qsm khNnd hyw' th llh mthn bjh nh kndw, (khyn chy'bw th) bhsht +m ghRw whn khy kw bhw' nh ahy & nky whyn Gmgyn rhndw'.
& dwzkhy bhshtyn khy sDynd (chwnd) th kjh pNy sn ty plTyw y llh whn khy jyky rzq Dnw ahy tnhn mn (kjh Dyw), chwnd th uhy by'y kfrn ty llh Hrm ky ahn.
jn pnhnjy dyn khy khil & rnd kry wrtw & nhn khy duny jy Hyty tthGyw, pwi unhn khy dy yy'n wsrywswn jy'n (unhn) mnhnjy hn Dynhn jy mlN khy wsryw hw & (jy'n) sn jy aytn jw nkr knd hw.
& byshk nhn khy hk ktb Dnwswn jnhn khy dny'ya sn khwly byn kywswn (&) unhya qwm li hdyt & bjh ahy jy mnyynd ahn.

(kfr) hn khnswi ntZr nh knd ahn th un (jy w`dh) jy murd chy, jnhn Dynhn snds mrd yndy (tnhn Dynhn) jn n khy Gy wsryw sy chwnd th byshk sn jy plNhr j pyGmbr sch sn ay, pwi (dy) sn li ky sfrsh krN wr ahn? jw sn li prt kn y wry mwTy wnywn th jyky (`ml) kyswn tn khnswi by (chN) `ml krywn, byshk pN khy cchyy'w lty'wn & jykw tthh tthhynd hw sw khny'n bhljy wyw.

whn jw plNhr hw llh ahy jnhn asmnn & zmyn khy cchhn Dynhn +m bNyw wry `rsh Dy mtwjh thyw, rt khy Dynhn sn ddhkyndw ahy & sj & chnD & tr snds Hukm sn nwyl ahn, khbrdr pyd krN & Hukm krN un jw (km) ahy, jhnn jw plNhr wDy brkt wrw ahy.
pnhnjy plNhr khy zry kndR & Gjh thy sDyw, cchwth uhw Hd khn lnghndRn khy dwst nh rkhndw ahy.
& whyn mulk +m n jy sdhry khnpwi fsd nh wjhw & un (llh) khy (khny's) Ddyy & Tm` rkhy sDyw, byshk llh jy bjh bhlrn khy wyjhy ahy.

& uhw (llh) ahy jw hwy'n khy pnhnjy rHmt (wrya brst) jy Gyn khwshkhbry DyndR kry ghly'yndw ahy, ytry qdr jw jnhn mhl (uhy) Grn kkrn khy khNn thywn th nhn khy knhn Gyr abd thyl Dyh Dnhn rwnw krywn th pwi nhn (kkrn) mn pNy wsywn th pwi un sn hr jns j myw dymywn th, hRy TrH syn muy'n khy (qbrn mn) bhr kddhndswn th mna whyn nSyHt wtthw.

& (j) stthy zmyn (ahy tnhn) j sal snds plNhr jy Hukm sn dymnd ahn, & jyk adn~ ahy (tnhn j sala) khrb salan khn swi by nh dymnd ahn, hRy TrH jyk qwm shukrnw kndR ahy tnhn li nshnywn TrHyn TrHyn byn knd ahywn.
byshk nwH khy snds qwm Dnhn pyGmbr kry mwklywswn pwi chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm llh jy `bdt kryw un (llh) khnswi kw whn jw khd nh ahy, aun whn ty wDy Dynhn jy `dhb (chN) khn Ddyn thw.
snds qwm jy srdrn chyw th syn twkhy pdhrya gmrhya +m (pyl) Dswn th.
chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm mwn khy k gmrhy knh ahy pr aun jhnn jy plNhr jw pyGmbr ahyn.
whn khy pnhnjy plNhr jw pyGm phchy'yndw ahyn & whn khy nSyHt kndw ahyn & llh (jy pr) khn uhw dyNndw ahyn jyky whyn nh dyNnd ahyw.
whn khy (hn Glh jw) `jb lGw cch th whn jy plNhr khn hk smjhNy whn mn hk mRs jy hthn whn wT hin li ay'y th whn khy Dydyry & tn th whyn prhyzgr thyw & th whn ty bjh ky'y wnyy.
pwi khys kwRw bhnyy'wn pwi un khy & jyky sNs huy tn khy byRya +m bchywswn & sn jy aytn khy jn kuwR dytw tn khy bwRywswn, cchwth uh ndhy qwm huy'y.
& `d (qwm) Dnhn sndn bhu hwd (pyGmbr kry mwklywswn) chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm llh jy `bdt kryw un (llh) khnswi kw byw whn jw khud nh ahy, pwi cchwnh Ddynd ahyw?
snds qwm mn kfrn srdrn chyw th syn blshk twkhy by smjhya +m Dsnd ahywn & syn blshk twkhy kwRn mn bhy'ynd ahywn.
chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm mwnkhy kbh by smjhy kwnhy pr aun jhnn jy plNhr jw mwklyl ahyn.
whn khy pnhnjy plNhr jw pyGm phchyn aun whn li myn nSyHt kndR ahyn.

(hin Glh jw) `jb lGw cch jw whn jy plNhr khn whn mn hk mRs jy hthn smjhNy hn li whn wT ay'y th whn khy Dydyry? & (whyn uhw wqt bh) yd kryw jDhn whn khy nuwH jy qwm khn pwi (sndn) pyRhy ty whryy'yn & whn jy jusn +m sgh wdhyy'yn, tnhnkry llh jwn n`mtwn yd kryw th mna whyn cchTw.
chyy'wn th (twn) hn li sn wT ayw ahyn cch? th rGw hk llh jy `bdt krywn & snj b DD jn khy pwdyynd hy' tn khy cchDy Dywn? jykDhn twn schw ahyn th jnhn (`dhb) khn snkhy Dydyryn thw sw aN.

chyy'yn th byshk whn ty whn jy plNhr wTn `dhb +m Dmr lzm thy chkw ahy, whyn mwn sN rGw (nhn) nln +m cchw jhyRw knd ahyw jn ty whn & whn jy bn DDn cchRw nlw rkhyw ahy jn jy mnyN bbt llh kw dlyl nh lthw ahy? pwi ntZr kryw byshk aun (bh) whn sn gD ntZr kndR ahyn.
pwi n khy & jyky sNs hw tn khy pnhnjy bjh sn bchywsyn & jn sn jy aytn khy kwR dytw tn jy pR pTy cchDy swn & uhy mw'mn nh huy'.

& thmwdyn Dnhn sndn bhu SliH (pyGmbr kry mwklywswn), chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm llh jy `bdt kryw whn jw llh khnswi byw kw khud nh ahy, byshk whn wT whn jy plNhr khn hk mu`jzw ayw ahy, hya llh jy Dchy whn li nshny ahy tnhnkry unhya khy cchDy Dyw (th) llh jy zmyn +m charndy rhy & un khy kw ydhu nh puhchy'jw nh th whn khy Dkhwy'yndR `dhb wtthndw.

& jDhn whn khy `dyn khnpwi pyRhya ty whryy'yn (sw Hsn bh) yd kryw & whn khy mulk +m ji Dny'yn (&) un jy pTn mn mRywn bNy'ynd ahyw & Tkrn khy Tuky ghr bNy'ynd ahyw, tnhnkry llh jw n`mtwn yd kryw & (whyn) mulk +m fsdy thy bgyRw nh wjhw.

snds qwm mn wDy'y kndR srdrn nhn khy chyw jn mnjhy'n hyNn (mNhn) ymn andw hw th whyn dyNnd ahyw cch th SliH pnhnjy plNhr (jy Trf) khn mwklyl ahy, unhn chyw th jnhn (shry`t) sn unkhy mwklyw wyw ahy tnhn ty syn ymn aNyndR ahywn.
wDy'y kndRn chyw th jnhn ty whn ymn andw ahy tnhn j syn munkr ahywn.
pwi Dchya jwn khuchwn kpy cchDyy'wn & pnhnjy plNhr jy Hukm khn by frmn thy & (chthr kry) chyy'wn th y SliH jykDhn pyGmbrn mn ahyn th jnhn (`dhb) jw sn sn njm kyw thyy'y sw sn ty aN.
pwi zlzly (jy `dhb) wrtn pwi jnhn ghrn +m gwDn bhr krN wr thy.
pwi (SliH) khny'n munhn mwRyw & chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm byshk whn khy pnhnjy plNhr jw pyGm phchym & whn khy nSyHt kym pr whyn nSyHt kndRn khy dwst nh rkhnd ahyw.
& luwT khy (pyGmbr kry mwklywswn) jDhn pnhnjy qwm khy chyy'yn th whyn hRy by Hyy'y cchw knd ahyw j whn khn G sry jhn (jy mNhn) mn knhn hk bh nh ky'y ahy?
jw whyn zln khy cchDy mRsn Dnhn shhwt sn wynd ahyw, blk whyn Hd khn lnghndR qwm ahyw.
& snds qwm jy wrndy hn khnswi nh huy'y th unhn khy (luwT smyt) pnhnjn Gwtthn mn lwdhy cchDyw, cchwth uhy mNhw pk bNb ahn.
pwi sn luwT khy & snds ghr wrn khy snds zl khnswi bchywswn (uh) rhyln mn huy'y.
& mthn (phNn jw) mynhn wsywswn, pwi (y pyGmbr) Ds th Dwhryn jy pcchRy khRy (khrb) thy.

& madyn (wrn) Dnhn sndn bhu sh`yb khy (pyGmbr kry mwklywswn), chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm llh jy `bdt kryw whn jw llh khn swi byw kw khud kwnh ahy, byshk whn wT whn jy plNhr khn (chTywn) nshnywn aywn ahn tnhnkry mN & twr pwry Dyw wtthw & mNhn khy sndywn shywn ghT nh Dyw & mulk +m un jy sudhry khn pwi fsd nh wjhw, jykDhn whyn mw'mn ahyw th ihw whn li bhlw ahy.

& sbh knhn rsty ty hn li nh whw th jykw llh khy khy mnyy tnhn khy dhmkyw & llh jy wT khn jhlyw & un (wT) jy Dngy'y ghrw, & yd kryw jDhn whyn thwrR hyw' tDhn whn khy wdhyy'yn, & Dsw th fsd wjhndRn jy pcchRy khRy (bcchRy) thy.
& jykDhn whn mn hk Twlya nhn khy mnyyw ahy jnhn sn mwklyw wyw ahyn & by Twlya nh mnyyw ahy th (whn khy jGy'y th ysty'yn) Sbr kryw jysyn sn jy wch +m llh Hukm kry, & uhw chNw Hukm kndR ahy.

snds qwm mn htthyln srdrn chyw th y sh`yb twkhy & jn twkhy mnyyw auhy tn khy pnhnjy shhr mn Drwr lwdhynd swn y th whyn sn jy pr +m mwTy chw, (sh`yb) chyw th jytwNyk sn whnjy dyn khy bucchn bhy'yndR ahywn (th bh mwTndswn cch?)

jykDhn syn whn jy pr +m unhya khnpwi jw llh sn khy khny's cchDyw mwTy chwn th byshk llh ty kuwR chywswn, & sn jy plNhr llh jy ghur khn swi sn khy mnjhs mwTN nh jGy'yndw ahy, sn jy plNhr jy `lm sbhny shyy'n khy smyw ahy, syn llh ty bhrwsw krywn th, y snj plNhr sn jy & sn jy qwm jy wch +m nSf sn fySlw kr & twn chNw fySlw kndR ahyn.
& snds qwm mn kfrn jy Twlya (pnhnjy yrn khy) chyw th jykDhn whyn sh`yb jy tb`dry kndw' th whyn uty jw uty cchyy'y wr thyndw'.
pwi unhn khy zlzly (jy `dhb) wrtw pwi pnhnjy jyn +m gwDn bhr kry mry wy.
jn sh`yb khy kwRw bhnyw sy dyNk unhn (Gwtthn) +m rhy y'y nh hw, jn sh`yb khy kwRw bhnyw sy cchyy'y wr hw.
pwi khy'n munhn mwRyy'yn & chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm byshk whn khy pnhnjy plNhr j pyGm phchy thm & whnjy khyrkhwhy kym, tnhnkry (hNy) kfr qwm ty cchli Dkh kryn.
& knhn Gwtth +m pyGmbrn mn kwbh nh mwklywswn pr uty jy rhkn khy (pyGmbrn jy nfrmny sbb) skhty & mSybt +m pkRynd rhyswn th mna uhy `jzy kn.
wry (ysty'yn) Dkh jy bji sukh mTy'y Dnwswn jysty'yn aswd thy & chyy'wn th byshk sn jn bn DDn khy (yy'n) Dkh sukh phtw hw pwi wchtw y'y unhn khy sndn bykhbrya jy Hlt +m pkRywswn.
& jykDhn unhn Gwtthn wr ymn aNyn h & prhyzgr bNjn h th mthn asmnn & zmyn khn brktwn Drwr khwlywn h pr kwR bhnyy'wn tnhnkry nhn jyky kyw tnhn sbbn khyn pkRywswn.
Gwtthn wr jnhn Hl +m smhyl hjn tnhn mhl rtwwh pN ty snjy `dhb phchN khn cchw by prwh thy ahn?
y Gwtthn wr cchw by bhw thy ahn? jw sn jw `dhb Dynhn chRhy mhl wTn chy & uhy rnd +m mshGwl hjn?
llh jy rth khn cchw by bhw thy ahn? jw cchyy'y wrya qwm khnswi (byw) kw llh jy rth khn by bhy'w nh thyndw ahy.
jyky mulk jy rhndRn khnpwi wrth thyn th tn khy pdhrw nh thyw ahy cch th jykDhn ghrwn h th khyn sndn gnhn sbbn sz Dywn h, & sndyn dlyn ty muhr hy'yn n khn jnhnkry uhy nth budhn.

(y pyGmbr) uhy Gwtth ahn jn jwn khbrwn twkhy byn krywn th, & byshk wTn sndn pyGmbr pdhrn m`jzn sn ay, pwi unhya sbbn jw Gy kuwR bhnyy'wn uhy kDhn bh nh mnyynd hy', hRy TrH llh kfrn jy dlyn ty muhr hNndw ahy.
& mnjhy'n ghNn khy njm pRyndR nh Dtthwswn, & mnjhy'n ghNn khy by dyn Dtthwswn.
wry khy'n pwi muws~ khy fr`wn & snds srdrn Dnhn pnhnjn mu`jzn sn pyGmbr kry mwklywswn pwi unhn (nh mnyN sbbn) aytn ty Zlm kyw, (y pyGmbr) Ds th fsd kndRn jy pcchRy khRy TrH thy.
& mws~ (fr`wn khy) chyw th y fr`wn aun jhnn jy plNhr jw pyGmbr ahyn.
hn (Glh) ty qy'm ahyn th llh ty sch khnswi ky kyn chwn, byshk whn wT whn jy plNhr khn chTy mu`jzy sn ayw ahyn tnhnkry bny sry'yln khy mwn sn (hlN jy) mwkl Dy.
(fr`wn) chyw th jykDhn kw m`jzw andw thy'y th jykDhn schn mn ahyn th uhw aN.
pwi pnhnjy ltth ucchlyy'yn th ucchlN sn y'y uhw pdhrw wsyng (nng) thy pyy'y.
& pnhnjw hth bhr kddhyy'yn th uhw kddhN sn y'y DsndRn li rwshn thyw.
fr`wn jy qwm mn srdr mNhw chwN lG th hyu pkw dnu jdwgr ahy.
whn khy whn jy mulk mn kddhy cchDN ghry thw, tnhnkry whyn cch th SlH Dyw?
(fr`wn khy) chyy'wn th khys & bhNs khy trsi & kwtthyndR shhrn Dnhn mwkl.
th tw wT sbhy'y dn jdwgr aNyn.
& fr`wn wT jdwgr ay chwN lG th jykDhn syn Glb thywn th sn li Drwr (kw) n`m (hy'N) ghrjy.
fr`wn chyw th hy'w (n`m bh Dbw) & byshk mrtby wrn mn (bh) thyndw'.
chyy'wn th y mws~ twkhy (jdwa jy shy) cchlN ghrjy y (phryn) syn cchlyndR thywn.
(mws~) chyw th (whyn) ucchlyw, pwi jnhn mhl ucchlyy'wn (th) mNhn jwn khywn jdwa sn bnd kyy'wn & nhn khy Dydyryy'wn & wD jdw andy'wn.
& muws~ Dnhn wHy mwklywswn th pnhnjy ltth ucchl, pwi jykw jdw kyy'wn tnhnkhy uh unhya mhl y'y Ghnd wy'y.
pwi sch pdhrw thyw & jyky knd rhy sw kwRw thyw.
pwi (fr`wn wr) un hndh mGlwb thy & khwr thy mwTy.
& jdwgr sjdy +m kry py.
chyy'wn th jhnn jy plNhr ty ymn andwswn.
(jw) muws~ & hrwn jw plNhr (ahy).
fr`wn chyw th whn mnhnjy mwkl khn Gy y'y un ty ymn cchw andw ahy? hy (whn jw) fryb ahy (jw pN +m gDjy) hn kry (hn) shhr +m kyw thw th snds rhkn khy mnjhny's kddhy cchDyw, pwi sghw khy dyNndw.
whn j hth i whn j pyr ubtR sbtR Drwr wddhynds wry whn mRny khy Drwr swrya chRhynds.
chyy'wn th byshk sn pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn Drwr mwTndR ahywn.
& twn rGw hn kry sn sn wyr thw rkhyn th sn jy plNhr j Hukm jDhn sn wT ay (tDhn) sn mnyy ahn, y sn j plNhr sn ty Sbr plT & sn khy mslmn kry mr.

& fr`wn jy qwm jy srdrn (khys) chyw th mws~ & snds qwm khy hn li cchDy Dy'yn thw cch? th mulk +m fsd wjhn & twkhy & tnhnjy m`bwdn (jy `bdt) khy cchDy Dyn? chyy'yn th sndn pT sghwy'y khndswn & sndyn dhyy'rwn cchDy Dyndswn, & syn sndn mthn byshk zwr wr ahywn.
muws~ pnhnjy qwm khy (dlgyr Dsy) chyw th llh khn mdd ghrw & Sbr kryw, cchwth sry zmyn llh jy ahy, pnhnjy bnhn mn jnhn khy ghrndw ahy tnhnkhy un jw wrth bNy'yndw ahy, & (chNy) `qbt prhyzgrn li ahy.

chyy'wn th syn tnhnjy chN khn G (bh) & tnhnjy chN khn pwi (bh) ydhy wy ahywn, (muws~) chyn th umyd ahy th whnjw plNhr whn jy dshmn khy ns kry cchDyndw & mulk +m whn khy pyRhya ty whryndw pwi Dsndw' th (whyn) khRy TrH `ml th kryw.
& byshk fr`wn jy qwm khy Dkr & mywn jy ghTty'ya +m grftr kywswn th mna uhy nSyHt wtthn.

pwi jDhn unhn khy sukh phtw thy th chyy'wn thy th hy sn jw (ly'q) ahy, & jykDhn unhn khy kw Dkh phchndw hw th mws~ & snds sngt khy nbhGw bhy'ynd hw, khbrdr llh wT sndyn y'y nbhGy'y ahy pr mnjhy'n ghN nh th dyNn.
& chyy'wn th (y mws~) jDhn kDhn kbh nshny sn wT hn li aNyndyn th un sn sn ty jdw kryn th syn twkhy mnyN wr nh ahywn.
pwi mthn Twfn & mkR & jwn & DyDr & rt khlyl mu`jz mwklyswn, pwi wDy'y kyy'wn & (uh) Dwhry qwm hy'y.

& jDhn mthn sz phty th (tDhn) chyy'wn thy th y mws~ pnhnjy plNhr khn nhya w`dy sn jw twsn kyw ths sn li du` ghur, th jykDhn sn tn `dhb lthy'y th twty Drwr ymn aNyndswn & bny sry'yln khy (bh) Drwr twsn hlN jy mwkl Dyndswn.
pwi jnhn mhl `dhb jykw khyn tthhryl mdt twNy phchNw hw sw khny'n lthwswn thy (th) uty jw uty nhn anjm bhGw thy.
pwi sn khny'n pwrw wyr wrtw jw nhn khy smnD +m nhya kry bwRywswn jw unhn sn jy aytn khy kwR dytw & un khn by khbr hw.

& uh qwm jyk hyNy bhny'by hy'y tnhn khy unhya wbhr & wlh jy zmyn (y`ny shm & miSr) jw wrth kywswn jnhn +m brkt rkhy hy'y swn, & tnhnjy plNhr jw bny sry'yln sn chNw njm nhy sbbn pwrw thyw jw Sabr kyy'wn, & fr`wn & snds qwm jyky bNyw & jyk (Dwt) blnd ky'y hwy'wn s (sbh) ns kry cchDy swn.

& bny sry'yl khy smnD khn pr lnghywswn pwi uhy hkRy hRy qwm ty puht jw pnhnjy btn j mjwr hw, (mws~) khy chyy'wn th y mws~ sn li (bh) hkRw hRw khud bNi jhR hnn li khud ahn, (mws~) chyw th byshk whyn jhl qwm ahyw.
hy mNhw pN jnhn (mdhhb) +m pyl ahn sw rd ahy & jyky knd rhnd ahn sw GlT ahy.
muws~ chyw th llh khnswi whn li byw m`bwd cchw ghrn? jnhn whn khy jhnn jy mNhn khn bhlw kyw ahy.
& (yd kr) jDhn whn khy fr`wn jy mNhn khn cchDywsyn jn whn khy bcchRw `dhb chkhyw thy, jw whn j pT kuhnd hw & whn jw dhyy'r jyy'rywn cchDynd hw, & un +m whn jy plNhr khn whn li wDy prkh huy'y.

& muws~ khy Tyhn rtyn jw njm Dnwswn & nhy khy (byn) Dhn sn pwrw kywswn pwi snds plNhr jw njm chlyhn rtyn jw pwrw thyw, & muws~ pnhnjy bhu hrwn khy chyw th mnhnjy qwm & mnhnjy pwy'tn khlyfw thy & sdhrw kj & fsdyn jy wT ty nh hlj.

pwi khyn whn nh kutthw pr llh khyn ktthw ahy, & (y pyGmbr) jDhn tw (dhwR jy mutth) ucchly th (uh) tw nh ucchly pr llh cchly, & (hn li) th pN wTn mw'mnn khy (n`mt DyN sn) chNy TrH azmy'y, byshk llh bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
ihw (Hl) ahy & llh kfrn jy mkr khy sust kndR ahy.

& (y pyGmbr yd kr) jnhn mhl twli kfrn rth thy ky'y th twkhy bnd kn y twkhy shhyd kn y twkhy kddhy cchDyn, & (bcchRy) rth kyy'wn thy & llh (bh) rth ky'y thy, & llh chNw rth kndRn mn ahy.
& jDhn sn jwn aytwn khyn pRhy bdhy'jn thywn (th) chwnd ahn th bdhwswn jykDhn ghurwn th unhy jhRw (syn bh) chy'wn th hyu th rGw Gyn jwn akhNywn ahn.

& llh khy nh jGy'yndw ahy jw mnjhn tnhnjy hwndy khyn `dhb kry, & llh khy (hy bh) nh jGy'yndw ahy jw khyn hn hwndy `dhb kry jw uhy bkhshsh ghrnd hjn.

& khyn cch (thyw) ahy jw llh khyn (pyGmbr jy hjrt khnpwi) `dhb nh kry hn hwndy jw uhy t`Zym wrya msjd khn (mNhn khy) jhln th & un j mutwlWy nh ahn, prhyzgrn khnswi byw kw un jw mtwlWy nh ahy pr nhn mn ghN nh dyNnd ahn.
& sndyn nmz llh jy ghr wT syTyn & tRyn hNN khnswi (kujh) nh ahy, pwi nhya sbbn jw kfr knd ahyw `dhb chkhw.
(&) kfr pnhnj ml hn li khrchyn th th (mNhn khy) llh jy wT khn jhlyn, pwi hw sghw nhn (mln) khy khrch knd wry (hw khrchN) mthn rmn thyndw wry mGlwb ky wynd, & kfr dwzkh Dnhn gD ky wynd.
th llh plyt khy pk khn dhr kry & plyt khy hk by'y ty rkhy pwi hykndw ddhyr kry pwi un khy dwzkh +m wjhy, ihy y'y cchyy'y wr ahn.
(y pyGmbr) kfrn khy chw' th jykDhn whyn muRndw' th jw kujh gdhryw sw khyn bkhshbw, & jykDhn byhr wyRh knd th byshk Gyn jy (h) `dt thy gdhry ahy.
& (y mw'mnw') unhn sn (ysty'yn) lRy'y kryw jysyn (kfr jw) Glbw nh rhy & smwry Hkwmt rGw llh jy thy'y (y`ny qnwni lhy jw `ml hly), pwi jykDhn mRy wnyn th jyky knd ahn sw llh DsndR ahy.
& jykDhn munhn mwRyy'wn (& bz nh ay) th dyNw th llh whn jw snbhlyndR ahy, (& uhw) chNw snbhlyndR & chNw mddgr ahy.

& (hya Glh) dyNw th jykw ml (kfrn ty ftH lhN khnpwi) whn jy hth +m ayw tnhnjw pnjwn HSWw llh & pyGmbr & (pyGmbr jy) `zyzn & ytymn & mskynn & msfrn li ahy jykDhn whn llh khy mnyyw ahy & (pN) jykw pnhnjy bnhy ty fySly jy Dynhn jnhn Dynhn by'y Twlywn pN +m mqbl thywn nzl kywswn (tnhn ty yqyn rkhnd ahyw th un Hukm ty `ml kryw), & llh sbhknhn shy ty wswrw ahy.

(ihw uhw wqt hw) jnhn mhl whyn wryn bhr & hw pryna bhr hw & qflw whn khn hytthyn bhar (hlyw wyw), & jykDhn pN +m njm kryw h th Drwr njm +m brkhlf thyw h pr hin li th jykw km llh khy krNw hw sw pwrw kry (th Hq pdhrw thy'y, &) hn li th jykw hlk (gmrh) thy'y sw chTy'y khnpwi mrth hlk thy'y & jykw jyy'rw thy'y (y`ny Hq khy prwRy) sw chTy'y khnpwi mrth jyy'rw rhy, & byshk llh bdhndR dyNndR ahy.

(yd kr) jnhn mhl llh tnhnjy khwb +m twkhy uhy (kfr) thwr Dykhry, & jykDhn twkhy uhy ghN Dykhry h th Drwr by hmWt thyw h & Drwr (un) km +m hkby'y sn tkrr kryw h pr llh (un tkrr khn whn khy) bchyw, byshk uhw synn wrw (bhyd) dyNndR ahy.

& (yd kryw) jDhn whyn hkby'y jy smhwn thyw' tDhn (llh) whn jy khyn +m uhy thwrR kry Dykhry thy & nhn (kfrn) jy nghn +m whnkhy thwrR kry Dykhryy'yn thy hn li th llh hw pwrw kry jykw krNw hw, & llh Dnhn (sbh) km mwTy wynd.
y ymn wrw'! jDhn knhn (kfr) Twlya sn (jng +m) mqblw kryw tDhn thbt qdm rhw & llh khy ghNw yd kryw th mna whyn cchuTw.
& llh & snds pyGmbr jy frmnbrdry kryw & pN +m tkrr nh kryw nh th sst thyndw' & whn jy ((tfq jy) bwi hly wyndy & Sbr kryw, byshk llh Sbrn sn ahy.
& whyn unhn (bdr wrn kfrn) wngr nh thyw jyky pnhnjy dys mn tkbr sn & mNhn jy Dykhry li nkt & (mNhn khy) llh jy wT khn jhlN lG, & jyky knd ahn tnhn khy llh ghyrwkndR ahy.

& jDhn shyTn sndn krtwt unhn li syngry & (kfrn khy) khy chyy'yn th dy mNhn mn kwbh whn ty Glb (thyNw) nh ahy & byshk aun whn jw whrw ahyn, pwi jDhn by'y lshkr amhwn smhwn thy th (shyTn) pnhnjyn khRyn (bhrpwi) ty bhGw & chyy'yn th aun whn khn byzr ahyn tHqyq jyky mn Dsn thw sw whyn nth Dsw tHqyq aun llh khn Ddyn thw, & llh skht sz DyndR ahy.
(uhw wqt yd kryw) jnhn mhl mnfqn & jn jy dlyn +m bymry hy'y tn chyw th hnn (mslmnn) khy sndn dyn tthGyw ahy, & jykw llh ty bhrwsw kndw ahy th byshk llh Glb Hkmt wrw ahy.
(y DsndR) jykDhn (unhy mhl) Dsyn jnhn wqt mly'k kfrn jw sh kddhnd ahn (&) sndn munhn & ptthyn khy sTynd kTynd ahn (th `jb kryn) & (chwnd thn th hNy) sRyndR `dhb (jw mzw) chkhw.
ihw hn sbbn ahy jw jyky whn jy hthn Gy mwklyw ahy & byshk llh bnhn ty Zlm kndR nh ahy.
(nhn jw Hl) fr`wnyn & nhn jhRw ahy jyky khny'n G hw, (jw) llh jy aytn khy nh mnyyy'wn pwi llh sndn gnhn sbbn khyn pkRyw, byshk llh sghrw skht sz DyndR ahy.
hw hn sbbn ahy jw llh j n`mt knhn qwm khy `T kndw ahy tnhn khy (uhw) ysty'yn kDhn nh mTy'yndw ahy jysyn jyky sndn dlyn +m ahy sw (pN nh) mTy'ynd ahn & llh bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
(nhn jw Hl) fr`wnyn & pN jyky khny'n G hw tn jhRw ahy, (jw) pnhnjy plNhr jy aytn khy kwR dyty'wn tnhnkry nhn khy sndn gnhn sbbn hlk kywswn & fr`wnyn khy bwRywswn, mRy'y Zlm hw.
jndrn mn (sbh khn) bcchR llh wT kfr ahn pwi uhy ymn nh th aNyn.
nhn mn jn sn (SlH jw) njm kyw thyy'y pwi wry hr bhyry pnhnjw njm bhnyynd ahn & uhy nh Ddynd ahn.
pwi jykDhn lRy'ya +m khyn lhyn th (nhn khy hRy sz Dy jnhn jy kry) jyky sndn pwy'tn hjn tn khy bhdyi th mna hy yd kn.
& jykDhn knhn qwm jy (njm bhnyN jy) khynt khn Ddyyn th unhn Dnhn (sndn njm) pwry thyN mhl byzrya jw Tl` mwkl, cchwth llh khynt kndRn khy dwst nh rkhndw ahy.
& kfr (yy'n) nh bhy'yn th (kw) Gry'y kyy'wn, byshk uhy nh thky'ynd.

& nhn li (lRy'y jy hthyrn jy) sgh mn & ghwRn jy tyr rkhN mn jyky thy sghywa sw llh jy wyryn & pnhnjn wyryn khy dhsht DyN li tyr rkhw & nhy khnswi by qwm khy (bh) khyn nh dyNnd ahyw, unhn khy llh dyNndw ahy, & jyky knhn shy mn llh jy wT +m khrchyw sw whn khy pwrw Dbw & whn khy ghT nh Dbw.
& jykDhn SlH li lRw kn th (twn bh) un Dnhn lRw kr & llh ty bhrwsw kr, byshk uhw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
& jykDhn twkhy dwlb DyN jw rdw kn th th byshk tw li llh kfy ahy, (&) uhwy'y ahy jnhn twkhy & mw'mnn khy pnhnjy mdd sn sgh Dny.
& unhn (mw'mnn) jy dlyn +m mylp Dny'yn, jyky zmyn +m ahy sw mRy'y jykDhn twn khrchyn h th sndyn dlyn +m mylp Dy'y nh sghyn h pr llh sndn wch +m mylp Dnwn, byshk uhw Glb Hkmt wrw ahy.
y pyGmbr twkhy & pN mw'mnn mn jn tnhnjy tb`dry ky'y tn khy llh kfy ahy.

hNy llh whn tn br hlkw kyw & whn +m hyNy'y m`lwm kyy'yn, pwi jykDhn whn mn Sbr wr saw hwnd th bn swn ty Glb thynd, & jykDhn whn mn hzr hwnd th bn hzrn ty llh jy Hkm sn Glb thynd, & llh Sbrn sN ahy.
pyGmbr khy nh jGy'yndw ahy jw wTs qydy hjn (blk kutth wnyn) jysty'yn mulk +m (kfrn jy `m) khwnryzy nh kry, (whyn) dny jw smn ghrnd ahyw, & llh akhrt (jw thwb DyN) ghrndw ahy, & llh Glb Hikmt wrw ahy.
jykDhn khd jy tqdyr +m Gy lkhyl nh hjy h th whn jyky (fdyw) wrtw tnhn +m whn khy Drwr wDw `dhb phchy h.
pwi jyky whn ml Gnymt wrtw sw pk Hll (bhnyw &) khy'w, & llh khn Ddyw, byshk llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

& jykDhn twsn khynt krN ghrnd th byshk llh sn (bh) G khynt ky'y hwy'wn pwi (whn khy) nhn ty sghrw kyy'yn, & llh dyNndR Hkmt wrw ahy.

jn ymn andw & Hjrt ky'y & pnhnjn mln & pnhnjn jndn sn llh jy wT +m jhd kyw & jn ji Dny & mdd ky'y hy hk by'y j dwst ahn, & jn ymn andw & hjrt nh ky'y whn ty nhn jy dwstya jw kw Hq nh ahy jysyn hjrt kn, & jykDhn dyn (jy km) +m whn khn mdd ghurn th whn khy nhya qwm khnswi by qwm ty mdd DyN lzm ahy jn jw whnjy & hnn jy wch +m njm thyl hjy, & jyky knd ahyw sw llh DsndR ahy.
& jyky kfr ahn tn mn hkR byn j sngty ahn, pr (y mslmnw') jykDhn whyn (y'yn) nh kndw' th mulk +m ftnw & wDw fsd thyndw.
& jn ymn andw & hjrt ky'y & llh jy wT +m jhd kyw & jn ji Dny & mdd ky'y ihy y'y sch mw'mn ahn, unhn li bkhshsh & sGwry rwzy ahy.
& jn (nhn khn) pwi ymn andw & hijrt ky'y & whn sn gD jhd kyw sy bh whn mn ahn, & my'Tya wr llh jy Hukm mwjb (pN +m) hk by'y j wdhyk Hqdr ahn, cchwth llh sbhknhn shy khy dyNndR ahy.
jn mshrkn sn whn njm kyw tn Dnhn llh & snds pyGmbr jy prn (njm khn) byzry ahy.
(y mshrkw') mulk +m chr mhyn syr kryw & dyNw th whyn llh khy thaky'N wr nh ahyw & (dyNw) th llh kfrn khy khrb krN wrw ahy.

& wDy Haj jy Dynhn llh & snds pyGmbr jy Trfn mNhn Dnhn pRhw ahy th llh & snds pyGmbr mshrkn khn byzr ahy, pwi (y mshrkw') jykDhn (shrk khn) twbh kndw' th uh whn li bhly ahy, & jykDhn whyn munhn phyry'yndw' th dyNw th whyn llh khy thaky'N wr nh ahyw, & (y pyGmbr) kfrn khy Dkhwy'yndR `dhb jy khbr Dy.
pr mshrkn mn jn njm kyw hywa wry (nhn) whn sn (njm +m) kujh quSwr nh kyw & nky whn jy khlf knhn khy mdd Dny'wn tn jw njm sndyn mdt ty'yn sNn pwrw kryw, cchwth llh prhyzgrn khy dwst rkhndw ahy.

pwi (jn mhynn +m lRy'y) Hrm (ky'y wyy'y ahy sy) mhyn jDhn pwr thyn th (`rb jy) mshrkn khy jty lhw tty nhn khy mryw & nhn khy pkRyw & nhn khy bnd rkhw & sbhny ghaTn ty nhn li wyhw, pwi jykDhn twbh kn & nmz pRhn & zkw@ Dyn th sndn wT bnd nh kryw, cchwth llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
& jykDhn mshrkn mn kw hkRw twkhn mna ghury th khys mna Dy jysty'yn (hw) klm llh bdhy pwi khys snds mn jy hndh phchi, ihw hn kry ahy jw uh qwm hRy ahy jw nh dyNndy ahy.

llh wT & snds pyGmbr wT mshrkn li anjm ky'n thyndw swi nhn jy jn sn t`Zym wrya msjd wT njm kyw huywa, pwi uhy jysty'yn whn jy njm ty byhk kn th whyn nhn li byhk wtthw, byshk llh prhyzgrn khy dwst rkhndw ahy.
ky'n (sndn njm rhndw) & jykDhn whn ty Glb thyn th whn bbt nky my'Ty jw & nky njm jw khyl rkhn, whn khy pnhnjyn (mitthyn) zbnn sn rDy knd ahn & sndn dlywn nkry ahn, & mnjhny'n ghN by dyn ahn.
llh jy aytn khy thwry mulh ty wkyy'wn pwi (mNhn khy) snds wT khn jhlyy'wn, uhy jyky knd ahn sw bcchRw ahy.
knhn mw'mn bbt nky my'Ty & nky njm jw khyl rkhnd ahn, & hy y'y Hd khn lnghyl ahn.
pwi jykDhn (kfr khn) twbh kn & nmz pRhn & zkw@ Dyn th whn j dyn +m bhy'r ahn, & jyky mNhw dyNnd ahn tn li nshnywn khwly byn krywn th.
& jykDhn pnhnjn njmn badhN khnpwi pnhnj qsm bhnyn & whnjy dyn +m T`nw hNn th kfr jy srkrdn sn jng kryw cchw th unhn jw qsm (`tbr jwGw) nh ahy mn uhy jhljn.

hRy qwm sn cchwnh th wRhw jn pnhnjn qsmn khy bhGw & jy pyGmbr jy kddhy cchDN li snbry & mnddhy'wn whn sn (dshmny) wWl +m krN lG? khy'n cchw th Ddyw? jykDhn mw'mn ahyw th llh (hn li) wdhyk Hqdr ahy th khny's Ddyw.
nhn sn wRhw th llh whn jy hthn khyn sz Dyndw & khyn khwr kndw & whnkhy mthn swbh Dyndw & mw'mnn jy qwm jy synn khy shf bkhshyndw (tthryndw).
& sndyn dlyn jy kwR wnyy'yndw, & llh jnhn li ghrndw tnhn ty bjh sn mwTndw, & llh dyNndR Hikmt wrw ahy.

bhy'ynd ahyw cch th whn khy (jhd jy tklyf khn) cchDyw wyndw? Hqyqt kry whn mn jn jhd kyw & nky llh & nky pyGmbr & nky mw'mnn khnswi (byw) kw Gjhw dwst wrtw tn khy llh ny nh nkhyRyw ahy, & jyky knd ahyw tnhnjy llh khbr rkhndR ahy.
pN ty kfr jw qrry thy mshrkn khy llh jy msjdyn jw abd krN rw nh ahy, ihy uhy ahn jn j `ml chT thy wy, & uhy bh +m sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.
llh jy msjdyn khy abd krN rGw nhy khy jGy'yndw ahy jnhn llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyyw & nmz pRhy & zkw@ Dny & llh khnswi (by'y knhn khn) nh Dnw, pwi umyd ahy th uhy hdyt wrn mn ahn.

whn Hjyn khy pNy pyrN & t`Zym wry msjd khy abd rkhN un (jy `mln) jhRw kyw ahy cch jnhn llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyyw & llh jy wT +m jhd kyw, llh wT (hy & uhw) brbr nh ahn, llh Zlm qwm khy hdyt nh kndw ahy.
jn mnyyw & hjrt ky'y & llh jy wT +m pnhnjyn mln & pnhnjyn jnyn sn jhd kyw sy llh wT mrtby +m blkl wD ahn, & uhy murd mNN wr ahn.
nhn khy sndn plNhr pN wTn bjh & rDpy & nhn bGn jy khwshkhbry Dy'y thw jn +m nhn li sdy'yn n`mtwn ahn.
mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn, cchwth llh y'y wT wDw jr ahy.
y mw'mnw' pnhnjn py'rn & pnhnjn bhy'rn khy dwst nh wtthw jykDhn (uhy) kfr khy ymn khn pyrw rkhn (th), & jyky whn mn nhn sn dwsty knd sy y'y Zlm ahn.

(y pyGmbr) chw' th jykDhn whn j pyy'r & whn jw wld & whn j bhy'r & whn jwn zlwn & whn j my'T & uhy ml jy whn kmy ahn & wpr jnhn jy bnd thyN khn Ddyw th & jywn jn khy psnd kryw th sy whn khy llh & snds pyGmbr & snds wT +m jhd krN khn wdhyk pyr ahn th (ysyn) trsw jysyn llh pnhnjw `dhb aNy, & llh by dyn qwm khy (sdhw) rstw nh Dykhryndw ahy.

byshk llh whn khy ghNn hndhn +m swbh Dny & (pN jng) Hunyn jy Dynhn jw jDhn whn jy ghNy'y whnkhy `jb +m wdhw & whn khn whn jy ghNy'y kjh bh Try nh sghy & zmyn pnhnjy wykry'y hwndy (bh) whn ty swRhy thy wyy'y pwi whyn putthyr thy phryw'.
mwTy llh pnhnjy pr khn arm pnhnjy pyGmbr ty & mw'mnn ty lthw & (mly'kn jw) lshkr lthy'yn jn khy nh thy Dtthwa, & kfrn khy sz Dny'yn, & ih kfrn jy sz ahy.
mwTy un khnpwi llh jnhn li wNys tnhn ty bjh sn mwTndw, & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

chw' jyky llh ty kwRw tthh tthhynd ahn sy nh cchTnd.
dny +m thwrw aswdw gdhrn hwndn wry sn wT sndn mwTN ahy pwi khyn nhy sbbn skht `dhb chkhy'yndsyn jw kufr knd ahn.

& nuwH jw qSw khyn pRhy budhi, jDhn pnhnjy qwm khy chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm jykDhn mnhnjw rhN & llh jy aytn sn mnhnjy nSyHt DyN whn ty Gwry thy ahy th llh ty bhrwsw kym pwi pnhnjy km & pnhnjn shrykn jy mdd sn gDjy SlH kryw pwi whn jw km whn khn Gjhw rhjy nh wnyy th pwi mwn sn kry gdhrw & mwn khy ddhr nh Dyw.
pwi jykDhn (mnhnjy chwN khn) phryw' (th cch thyw) mwn whn khn kw jwrw nh ghryw hw, mnhnjw ujwrw llh khnswi by'y ty nh ahy & mwn khy Hukm kyw wyw ahy th muslmnn mn hjn.

pwi khys kwRw bhnyy'wn pwi khys & jyky byRy +m sNs hw tn khy bchywswn & khyn nhn (kfrn) jw jnshyn kywswn & jn sn jy aytn khy kwRw bhnyw tn khy bwRywswn, pwi Ds th jn khy Dydyryw wyw tn jy pcchRy khRy TrH thy.

pwi un (nwH) khnpwi (ghN) pyGmbr sndn qwm Dnhn mwklyswn pwi wTn pdhrn mu`jzn sn ay pwi hR nh hw jw jnhn shy khy phryy'yn kwR bhnyw hy'y'wn tnhn ty ymn aNyn, hRy TrH Hd khn lnghndRn jy dlyn ty mhr hNnd ahywn.
wry khy'n pwi muws~ & hrwn khy fr`wn & snds srdrn Dnhn pnhnjn mu`jzn smyt mwklywswn pwi wDy'y kyy'wn & DwhrN qwm huy'y.
pwi jnhn mhl wTn sn wTn schy Glh ay'y (tDhn) chyy'wn th byshk hy pdhrw jdw aGy.
muws~ chyw jDhn whn wT Hq ayw (th) un li cchw chwnd ahyw (th jdw ahy)? hy jdw ahy cch? & jdwgr nh cchTnd.
chyy'wn th sn wT hn li ayw ahyn cch th jnhn (mdhhb) ty sn pnhnj pyu DD Dtth tnhn khn sn khy rwkyn & mulk +m whn (bnhy) li wDy'y hjy? & syn whn khy mnyN wr nh ahywn.
& fr`wn chyw th sbhy'y hwshyr jdwgr mwn wT aNyw.
pwi jnhn mhl jdwgr ay (tnhn mhl) muws~ nhn khy chyw th jyky ucchly'Nw thw sw whyn cchlyw.
pwi jnhn mhl ucchlyy'wn (th) mws~ chyw th jyky andw thawa sw jdw ahy, byshk llh n khy sghwy'y bTl kndw, byshk llh fsdyn jw km nh tthhyndw ahy.
& llh Hq khy pnhnjy Hukm sn thbt kndw ahy jytwNyk Dwhry bcchn bhny'yn.
pwi mws~ ty snds qwm mn hk Twlya khnswi fr`wn & snds srdrn khn DdyN jy kry th mtn khyn ydhy'yn (knhn) ymn nh andw, & tHqyq fr`wn (un) mulk +m htthylw hw, & uhw Drwr Had khn lnghndRn mn hw.
& mws~ chyw th y mnhnjy qwm jykDhn whn llh ty iymn andw ahy th jy muslmn ahyw th mths bhrwsw kryw.
pwi chyy'wn th llh ty bhrwsw kywswn, y sn j plNhr sn khy Zlmn jy qwm jy prkh nh kr.
& kfrn jy qwm khn pnhnjy bjh sn sn khy bchi.
& mws~ & snds bhu Dnhn wHy kywswn th whyn pnhnjy qwm li miSr +m ghr bNyw & (unhn) pnhnjn ghrn khy qbly jy smhwn kryw & nmz pRhw, & mw'mnn khy khwshkhbry Dy.

& muws~ chyw th y sn j plNhr tw fr`wn & snds srdrn khy syngr & (ghNw) ml dny jy Hytya +m (hn li) Dnw ahy th y sn j plNhr tnhnjy wT khn mNhn khy bhuly'yn, y sn j plNhr sndn ml khy ns kr & sndyn dlyn muhr haN jw jysty'yn Dkhwy'yndR `dhb (nh) Dsn tysyn ymn nh aNyn.
(llh) chyw th byshk whn (bnhy) jy du` qbwl ky'y wy'y pwi by'y qy'm rhw & jyky nh dyNnd ahn tn jy wT jy tb`dry nh kryw.

& bny sry'yln khy smnD khn (pr) lnghywswn pwi sndn pwyn fr`wn & snds lshkr Zlm & srkshy krN li ytry qdr sndn putthyn py jysyn buD (fr`wn) chyw th ymn andm sch ahy th jnhn ty bny sry'yln ymn andw ahy tnhn khnswi kwy'y `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy & aun mslmnn mnjhn ahyn.
(chyw wyw th) hNy (thw ymn aNyn)? & byshk twkhn pwi chn tn li nshny hjyn, & ghN mNhw sn jy nshnyn khn Drwr bykhbr ahn.
pwi dy tnhnjy lshy khy hin li bchy'yndswn th jyky twkhn pwi chn tn li nshny hjyn, & ghN mNhw sn jy nshnyn khn Drwr bykhbr ahn.

& byshk bny sry'yln khy chNy hndh rhN jy ji Dny swn & khyn sutthyn shyn mn rwzy Dny swn, pwi (ysty'yn) khtlf nh kyy'wn jysyn wTn `lm (y`ny qran nh) ayw, byshk tnhnjw plNhr jnhn Glh bbt jhGRw knd ahn tnhn jw qymt jy Dynhn sndn wch +m fySlw kndw.
pwi jyky twDnhn nzl kywswn tnhn khn jykDhn shk +m ahyn th jyky twkhn G ktb pRhnd ahn tn khn pucch, byshk tnhnjy plNhr khn twDnhn Hq ayw ahy pwi twn shk kndRn mn nh huj.
& nky twn nhn mn hj jn llh jy aytn khy kuwR dytw th twn cchyy'y wrn mn thyndyn.
byshk jn ty pnhnjy plNhr (jy `dhb) jw Hukm lzm thy chkw ahy sy ymn nh aNynd.
jytwNyk wTn sbh dlyl chn jysty'yn th Dkhwy'yndR `dhb Dsn.

yuwnus jy qwm khnswi kn Gwtthn (wrn `dhb nzl thyN wqt) cchwnh ymn andw th sndn ymn khyn fy'dw Dy'y h, jnhn mhl (ywns jy qwm) ymn andw (th un wqt) khwrya wrw `dhb duny jy Hytya +m khny'n lthwswn & khyn kujh wqt asuwdw kywswn.
& jykDhn tnhnjw plNhr ghry h th jyky zmyn +m ahn sy sbh smwr Drwr ymn aNyn h, pwi twn mNhn khy zwr kndyn cch th mw'mn thyn?
& knhn mNhwa khy llh jy ghur khnswi mw'mn thyN jw khtyr nh ahy, & jyky nh dyNnd ahn tn ty (kfr jy) plyty rkhndw ahy.
chw' th nhryw th asmnn & zmyn +m khRywn (sndn qdrtwn) auhn? & nh mnyyndR qwm khy nshnywn & DydyrN fy'dw nh Dynd ahn.
pwi unhn jhRyn muSybtn khnswi ntZr nh knd ahn jyky khny'n G gdhry wywn, (khyn) chw' th ntZr kryw aun bh whn sn gD ntZr kndRn mn ahyn.
wry syn pyGmbrn khy & jn ymn andw tn khy bchy'ynd ahywn hRy TrH sn ty Hq ahy th mw'mnn khy bchywn.

chw' th y mNhw' jykDhn mnhnjy dyn khn shk +m ahyw th (budhw th) llh khnswi jn khy pwdyynd ahyw tn khy nh pwdyynds pr un llh khy pwdyynds jykw whn khy mryndw ahy, & muwn khy Hkm kyw wyw ahy th mw'mnn mn hjn.
& (hya) th pnhnjy mhR khy Hnyf dyn li byhk wtthi, & mushrkn mn nh huj.
& llh khnswi nhy jy `bdt nh kr jykw twkhy nky sukh puhchy'y & nky twkhy Dukh phchy'y, pwi jykDhn (y'yn) kndyn th unhy mhl twn Zlmn mn thyndyn.

& jykDhn llh twkhy kw Dkh phchy'y th un dhrn kw un jy lhN wrw kwnhy, & jykDhn twli chNy'y ghry th snds fDl kw hTy'N wrw nh ahy, pnhnjy bnhn mn jnhn khy wNys tnhn khy fDl puhchy'yndw ahy, & uhw bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
chw' th y mNhw' byshk whn wT whn jy plNhr khn Hq ayw ahy, pwi jykw hdyt wrw thyw sw pN li hdyt thw lhy, & jykw bhulw tnhn ty gmrhya hjN khnswi (byw ky) nh ahy, & aun whn jw dhmy wr nh ahyn.
& jyky twDnhn wHy kyw wnyy thw tnhnjy tb`dry kr & (ysty'yn) Sbr kr jysyn llh nbyrw kry, & uhw chNw nbyrw kndR ahy.
lr, (hy) ktb ahy jnhn jwn aytwn muHkm ahn wry Hikmt wry dn llh wTn byn kyl ahn.
th llh khnswi by'y knhn jy `bdt nh kryw, aun snds Trf khn whn khy DydyryndR & khwshkhbry DyndR ahyn.

& th pnhnjy plNhr khn bkhshsh ghrw wry Dnhs (twbh kry) mwTw th tthhryl mudWt ty'yn whn khy chNy nf`y sn fy'dw Dy'y & sbhknhn bhly'ya wry khy snds bhly'y jw `wD Dy'y, & jykDhn whyn phrndw' th byshk aun whn ty wDy Dynhn jy `dhb (phchN) khn Ddyn thw.
llh Dnhn whn jw mwTN ahy, & uhw sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.

khbrdr byshk uhy pnhnjn synn khy hn li wTynd ahn th khny's likn, khbrdr jnhn dm (uhiy) pnhnj kpR ddhkynd ahn (tnhn dm +m) jyky Gjhw knd ahn & jyky pdhr knd ahn sw (llh) dyNndw ahy, byshk uhw synn wrw (bhyd) dyNndR ahy.
& kw churndR zmyn +m ahy y'y nh pr snds rwzy llh ty ahy & snds rhN jw hndh & sndys snbhN jy ji (llh) dyNndw ahy, sbh pdhry ktbn +m lkhyl ahy.

& uhw (llh) ahy jnhn asmnn & zmyn khy cchhn Dynhn +m bNyw & snds `rsh pNy ty hw (hw bNy'N hn kry ahy) th whn khy prkhy th whn mn `mln jy kry kyr tmm chNw ahy, & jykDhn nhn khy chwyn th mwt khnpwi whyn jyry wyndw' th kfr Drwr chwnd th hy pdhrw jdw ahy.

& jykDhn knhn muqrWr mudWt ty'yn khy'n `dhb khNy hTywn th Drwr chwnd th un khy knhn jhlyw ahy? khbrdr jnhn Dynhn (uhw `dhb) wTn yndw (tnhn Dynhn) khy'n TrNw nh ahy & jnhn (shy) sn tthtthwlywn knd hw s khyn wkwRy wyndy.
& jykDhn mNhwa khy pN wTn k bjh chkhywn th (&) wry uh khny's khsywn th, th uhw nmyd by shkr (bNyw) ahy.
& jykDhn n khy Dkh phchN khnpwi sukh puhchywn th Drwr chwndw th mwn khn Dkh wy, hw pk srhw wDy'y kndR thyndw ahy.
pr jn Sbr kyw & chN km ky, tn li bkhshsh & wDw jr ahy.

pwi (y pyGmbr) jyky twDnhn wHy kjy thw tnhn mn mtn ky cchDy Dy'yn & (pN) mtn dl tng kryn kfrn jy hn chwN ty th mths khznw cchwnh lthw wyw y mly'k sNs cchwnh ayw, (nh cchD & nh dl tng kr) cchwth twn DydyryndR y'y ahyn & llh hr shy jw snbhlyndR ahy.
blk (y'yn) bh chwn th th uhw (qran) pN tthhyw ths, chw' th jykDhn sch ahyw th (whyn bh) un jhRywn Dh swrtwn pNwn tthhyl aNyw & llh khnswi (byn) jn khy sDy sghw tn khy sDyw.
pwi jykDhn whn jw (hw chwN) qbwl nh kn th dyNw th (uhw qran) rGw llh jy `lm sn lthw wyw ahy & (dyNw) th n khnswi byw kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, pwi whyn slm ty (muHkm) cchwnh rhndw'.
jykw dny jy Hyty & snds syngr ghrndw hjy tn khy dny +m (y'y) sndn `mln jw jwrw pwrw Dyndswn & nhn khy un +m ghT nh Dbw.
ihy uhy ahn jn li akhrt +m bh khnswi (byw ky) nh ahy, & jyky dny +m kyy'wn sw chT thyw & jyky kmy'ynd hw sw bTl thyw.

(uhw mNhw gmrhn jhRw nh ahy) jykw pnhnjy plNhr (jy Trf) khn pdhry Hjt ty hjy & llh khn un li shhd (y`ny qran pRhndw) hjy & un (qran) khn G mws~ jw ktb (twryt) mm & rHmt (bh gwh hjy), ihy (mNhw) un (qran) ty ymn aNyn th, (pwi nhn jy sbhny) Twlyn mn jykw un (qran) jw nkr kndw tnhn jy rhN jw hndh bh ahy, tnhnkry (twn) khny's shk +m nh huj, uhw tnhnjy plNhr jy pr khn Hq (lthw) ahy pr ghN mNhw ymn nh th aNyn.
& jykw llh ty kwRw tthh tthhy tnhn khn wdhyk Zlm kyr ahy, hy pnhnjy plNhr jy aDw ky wynd & shhd chwnd th hy ahn jn pnhnjy plNhr ty kwR chyw, khbrdr (nhn) Zlmn ty llh jy l`nt ahy.
jyky llh jy wT khn jhlynd ahn & n jy Dngy'y ghrnd ahn, & uhy y'y akhrt khy nh mnyynd ahn.
uhy mulk +m kDhn `jz krN wr nh ahn & llh khnswi (by ky) nhn j mddgr nh ahn, nhn khy byNw `dhb kyw wyndw, jw budhy nh thy sghy & nh thy Dtthy'wn.
ihy uhy ahn jn pN khy cchyy'w ltw & jykw tthh tthhynd hw sw khny'n bhljy wyw.
byshk ihy (mNhw) Drwr akhrt +m cchyy'y wr ahn.
byshk jn ymn andw & chN `ml ky & pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn nwy sy bhshty ahn, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.
nhn bn Twlyn jw mthl ndhy & bwRy & DsndR & bdhndR wngr ahy, (hy) mthl +m brbr ahn cch? pwi cchwnh th nSyHt wtthw.
& byshk sn nwH khy snds qwm Dnhn mwklyw (un chyw th) aun whn li pdhrw DydyrndR ahyn.
th llh khnswi (whyn by'y jy) `bdt nh kryw, byshk aun whn khy Dkhwy'yndR Dynhn jy `dhb (phchN) khn Ddyn thw.

pwi snds qwm mn kfr Twlya chyw th twkhy pN jhRy mNhw khnswi (byw) nth Dswn & sn mn by swch khsysn khn swi (byw) tnhnjw tb`dr nh th Dswn, & pN khn whn jy k zydty nh th Dswn blk whn khy kwR bhy'ynd ahywn.

(nwH) chyw th y mnhnjy qwm (mwn khy) Dsyw th shyn th jykDhn (aun) pnhnjy plNhr jy pky Hjt ty hjn & pN wTn mwn khy rHmt Dny hjys & (jnhn jy Hqyqt) whn khn lky'y wy'y hjy th un (jy mnyN) jw hn hwndy whn khy cchw zwr krywn jw whyn un khy bcchn bhy'ynd hjw?
& y mnhnjy qwm (aun) whn khn un bbt kw ml nthw ghrn, mnhnjw jwrw llh khnswi by'y ty nh ahy & aun mw'mnn khy tRN wrw nh ahyn, cchwth uhy pnhnjy plNhr khy mlN wr ahn pr aun whn khy jhl qwm Dsn thw.
& y mnhnjy qwm jykDhn khyn tRynds th mwn khy llh khn kyr cchDy'yndw, pwi cchwnh smjhnd ahyw?

& aun whn khy nthw chwn th mwn wT llh j khzn ahn & nky (kw) Gujh dyNndw ahyn & nky chwn thw th aun mly'k ahyn & jn khy whn jwn khywn hyNw Dsn thywn tn li nthw chwn th llh khyn k chNy'y nh Dyndw, jyky sndyn dlyn +m ahy sw llh chNw dyNndR ahy, (jy chwnds th) aun nhya mhl Zlmn mn thynds.
chyy'wn y nwH byshk tw sn sn jhGRw kyw pwi sn sn ghNw jhyRw kyy'y jykDhn schn mn ahyn th sn sn jykw njm kryn thw sw sn wT aN.
(nwH) chyw th uhw whn wT rGw llh aNyndw jykDhn un ghryw th & whyn (bhdyy) `jzy krN wr nh ahyw.
& jykDhn aun whn khy nSyHt DyN ghrn th jykDhn llh whn jw bhuly'N ghrndw th mnhnjy nSyHt whn khy kw nf`w nh Dyndy, uhw whn jw plNhr ahy, & Dnhs mwTy wyndw'.
blk (hyy'n bh) chwnd ahn th (hn pyGmbr) uhw pNwn tthhyw ahy, chy'w th jykDhn mwn un khy pN tthhyw ahy th mnhnjw Dwh mwn ty ahy & jyky whyn Dwh knd ahyw tnhn khn aun byzr ahyn.
& nuwH Dnhn wHy kyw wyw th jnhn ymn andw ahy tnhn khnswi tnhnjy qwm mn byw kwbh kDhn ymn nh aNyndw tnhnkry jyky knd ahn tnhn ty twn rnj nh thy.
& sn jy rwbrw & sn jy Hukm sn byRy jwR & Zlmn bbt mwn khy nh chy'j, cchwth uhy bwRy wynd.

& byRy bNy'N lGw, jDhn kDhn snds qwm mn k Twly wTny's lnghy thy (th) mths tthtthwlywn kyy'wn, (nwH) thy chyw th jykDhn whyn sn ty tthtthwlywn kryw th th syn (bh) hRywn tthtthwlywn whn ty kndswn jhRywn tthtthwlywn (whyn) kryw th.
pwi jnhn khy `dhb phchndw tnhn khy sghwy'y dyNndw' jw (uhw) n khy khwr kndw & mths sdy'yn `dhb (pyw) lhndw.

(nhya km +m hw) ytry ty'yn jw sn jw Hukm ayw & tnwr ubhmyw chywswn th sbhknhn jns (jy jnwrn) mn bh bh (nr & mdy) & jn bbt Hkm thy chkw ahy (th hlk kb) tn dhrn by pnhnjy ghr wr & jn ymn andw sy mnjhs chRh, & thwrn khnswi mths ymn nh andw hwy'wn.
& (nwH) chyw th mnjhs chRhw llh jy nly sn snds hlN & snds byhN ahy, cchwth mnhnjw plNhr Drwr bkhshyndR mhrbn ahy.
& uh jbln jhRyn lhryn +m khyn (khNy) hlN lGy, & nwH pnhnjy pT khy sDyw & uhw knry ty hw th y munhnj puT sn sn chRh & kfrn sn gD nh huj.

chyy'yn th (hRy) jbl ty pnh wtthnds jw mwn khy pNya khn bchy'yndw, (nwH) chyw th dy llh jy `dhb khn kw bchy'yndR kwnhy pr jnhn ty (pN) rHm kry (sw bchy sghndw), ytry +m bnhy jy wch +m lhr chy py'y & (uhw) bDln mn thyw.
& frmyw wyw th y zmyn (twn) pnhnjw pNy chuhy wny & y asmn (twn pnhnjw pNy) bnd kr & pNy sukyw wyw & km pwrw kyw wyw & (byRy jbl) jwdya ty bytthy & chyw wyw th (shl) Zlmn jy qwm ns thy'y.
& nwH pnhnjy plNhr khy sDyw & chyy'yn y mnhnj plNhr mnhnjw pT (bh) mnhnjy ghr wrn mnjhn ahy & byshk tnhnjw njm blkl schw ahy & tw Hkmn jw Hkm ahyn.
(llh) frmyw th y nwH uhw tnhnjy ghr wrn mn nh ahy, cchwth aN sdhryl kmn wrw ahy, tnhnkry jnhn jy twkhy k khbr nh ahy tnhn bbt mwn khn nh pucch, aun twkhy nSyHt kryn thw th mtn jhln mn thy'yn.
(nwH) chyw th y mnhnj plNhr jnhn (Glh jy Hqyqt) jy mwn khy khbr nh ahy tnhn bbt twkhn pcchN jy aun tw wTn pnh ghrn thw, & jy twn nh bkhshyndyn & rHm nh kndyn th cchyy'y wrn mn thynds.
chyw wyw th y nwH sn jy Trf khn slmty & brktn sn lh jy twty hjn & nhn Twlyn ty (bh) jyky twsN ahn, & (bywn ky) jm`twn hwndywn jn khy aswdw kndswn wry nhn (mn kfrn) khy sn wTn Dkhwy'yndR `dhb phchndw.
ihy (qS) Gujhyn khbrn mn ahn jy tw Dnhn wHy krywn th, hn khn G nky (n khy) twn dyNndw hy'yn & nk tnhnjy qwm dyNndy hy'y, pwi Sbr kryw, byshk pcchRy prhyzgrn li ahy.
& `dyn Dnhn sndn bhu hwd khy (mwklywswn), chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm llh jy `bdt kryw un (llh) khnswi whn jw kw m`bwd nh ahy, whyn rGw tthh tthhyndR ahyw.
y mnhnjy qwm whn khn (hn pyGm phchy'N ty) kw jwrw nthw ghrn, mnhnjw jwrw rGw nhy ty ahy jnhn mwn khy pyd kyw ahy, pwi whyn cchwnh th smjhw.
& y mnhnjy qwm pnhnjy plNhr khn bkhshsh ghrw wry snds Gyn twbh kryw th whn ty lGwlG wsndR kkr mwklyndw & whn jy sgh ty sgh wdhy'yndw & whyn Dwhy thy mnhn nh phyryw.
chyy'wn th y huwd sn wT kwy'y dlyl nh andw thy'y & syn tnhnjy chwN ty pnhnjn m`bwdn khy cchDN wr nh ahywn & nky twkhy mnyyndR ahywn.
syn twkhy rGw (hy Glh) chy'wn th th sn jy kin butn twkhy ky ydhyw ahy, (hwd) chyw byshk aun llh khy shhd kryn thw & whyn bh shhd hujw tHqyq aun nhn khn byzr ahyn jn khy (llh sn) shryk bNy'ynd ahyw.
un (llh) dhrn pwi mwn sn sbhy'y mdy'y kryw wry mwn khy muhlt nh Dyw.
tHqyq mwn pnhnjy plNhr & whn jy plNhr llh ty bhrwsw kyw ahy, kw (jndr) chrndR nh ahy jnhnjy pyshnya (jy chGh) un (llh) khnswi byw kw (hth +m) wtthndR hjy byshk mnhnjw plNhr sdhya wT ty ahy.

pwi jykDhn phrndw' th (mwn khy cch thyndw) byshk jnhn pyGm sn whn Dnhn mwklyw wyw ahyn sw whn khy phchym, & mnhnjw plNhr whn khnswi bya qwm khy whn jy ji ty whryndw, & whyn khys kujh dhrw nqSn phchy'y nh sghndw', byshk mnhnjw plNhr sbhny shyn ty nghbn ahy.
& jnhn mhl sn jw `dhb phtw (tnhn mhl) hwd khy & jn sNs ymn andw tn khy pnhnjy bjh sn bchywswn, & khyn skht `dhb khn cchDywswn.

& y mnhnjy qwm whn khy mwn sn dshmny krN hRy `dhb jw sbb nh bNjy jhRw `dhb nwH jy qwm y hwd jy qwm y SlH jy qwm khy puhtw, & luwT jy qwm whn khn k pry nh ahy.
& pnhnjy plNhr khn bkhshsh ghrw wry Gyns twbh kryw, tHqyq mnhnjw plNhr mhrbn (sbhknhn jw) sdyN ahy.
chyy'wn th y sh`yb jyky twn chwyn thw tnhn mn ghNw nth smjhwn & twkhy pN mn blkl hyNwn Dswn th, & jykDhn tnhnjw kRm nh hjy h th twkhy pthrn sn mrywn h, & twn sn ty kw srdr nh ahyn.
(sh`yb) chyw th y mnhnjy qwm whn wT mnhnjw kRm llh khn wdhyk pyrw ahy cch? & un (llh jy Hukm) khy pnhnjy ptthya pwyn ucchly cchDyw thwa, tHqyq jyky knd ahyw sw mnhnjy plNhr jy qbw +m ahy.

& y mnhnjy qwm whyn pnhnjy pr ty `ml kryw aun (bh) `ml kndR ahyn, sghwy'y dyNndw' th knhn khy `dhb phchy thw jw khys khwr kndw & jykw kwRw ahy tnhn khy bh, & ntZr kryw aun (bh) whn sn gD ntZr kndR ahyn.
& jnhn mhl sn jw `dhb ayw tnhn mhl sh`yb khy & jn sNs ymn andw hw tn khy pnhnjy bjh sn bchywswn, & Zlmn khy skht kRky (chy) pkRyw pwi pnhnjn ghrn +m gwDn bhr mry wy.
dyNk mnjhn rhy y'y nh hw, khbrdr mdyn wrn ty phiT hjy jhRy thmwd qwm ty l`nt thy.
& byshk mws~ khy pnhnjyn nshnyn & pdhry HujWt sn mwklywswn.
fr`wn & snds srdrn Dnhn pwi (sbh mNhw) fr`wn jy Hukm jy pwyn lG, & fr`wn jw Hukm sdhw nh hw.
qymt jy Dynhn (fr`wn) pnhnjy qwm jw GwN thyndw pwi khyn bh +m ghyRyndw, & jnhn ghT +m ghyRy wynd sw bcchRw ahy.
& hn (dny) +m (bh) l`nt nhn khy pwyn lGy'y wyy'y & qymt jy Dynhn (bh) jykw (l`nt jw) n`m mlyn sw bcchRw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) hy Gwtthn jwn khbrwn ahn jy twty byn krywn th nhn mn (ky) qy'm (ahn) & (ky) ns thyl.
& sn nhn ty Zlm nh kyw pr hnn pN ty (pNhyn) Zlm kyw pwi jnhn mhl tnhnjy plNhr jw Hukm phtw (th) sndn m`bwdn jn khy llh khn swi sDynd hw khy'n kujh bh nh Tryw, & hlky khnswi (byw ky) khyn nh wdhyy'wn.
& y'yn tnhnjy plNhr jw un mhl Gwtthn (wrn) khy un Hlt +m pkRN thyndw ahy jDhn uhy Zulm kndR thynd ahn, byshk snds pkR skht Dkhwy'yndR ahy.
byshk n (Glh) +m nhya li nshny ahy jw akhrt jy `dhb khn Dnw, ihw uhw Dynhn ahy jnhn +m mNhn khy myRbw & ihw uhw Dynhn ahy jnhn +m (sbh) HDr thynd.

& jyky nyk bkht ky wy sy bhsht +m (ghRnd) mgr jytrw wqt tnhnjy plNhr ghryw (n khnswi) asmnn & zmyn jy bq hjN ty'yn mnjhs sdy'yn rhnd, (ih) bkhshsh aN khT ahy.

& byshk mws~ khy ktb Dnwswn pwi mnjhs khtlf pyw, & jykDhn tnhnjy plNhr jw Hkm Gy nh thy chky h th sndn wch +m fySlw kyw wnyy h, & uhy khny's wDy shk +m pyl ahn.

pwi jy'n twkhy Hukm kyw wyw ahy ty'n twn muHkm rh & jn twsn twbh ky'y (sy bh mHkm rhn) & Hd khn nh lnghw, byshk jyky knd ahyw sw llh DsndR ahy.

& jykDhn tnhnjw plNhr ghry h th (sbhny) mNhn khy hk y'y mdhhb (ty) kry h & (uhy) sdy'yn mkhtlf (mdhhb ty) rhnd.

& (y pyGmbr) pyGmbrn jy khbrn mn tw wT ytrw byn krywn th jnhn sn tnhnjy dl khy mDbwT krywn, & unhn (khbrn) +m Hq & mw'mnn li nSyHt & smjhNy ay'y ahy.

& asmnn & zmyn jw Gujh rGw llh khy (m`lwm) ahy & sbh km Dnhs mwTyw wyndw ahy pwi snds `bdt kr & mths bhrwsw rkh, & jyky whyn knd ahyw tnhn khn tnhnjw plNhr by khbr nh ahy.
lr, hy pdhry ktb jwn aytwn ahn.

& hry TrH tnhnjw plNhr twkhy sGwrw kndw & twkhy khwbn jw t`byr sykhryndw & pnhnjy n`mt twty & y`qwb jy wld ty hRy TrH pwry kndw jhRy G tnhnjy pyu DDy brhym & sHq ty pwry kyy'yn, byshk tnhnjw plNhr dyNndR Hkmt wrw ahy.

mnjhy'n (hk) chwndR chyw th yuwsf khy nh mryw & jykDhn (ky) kndR ahyw th khwh jy try +m (khNy) ucchlyws th kw wThRw khys kddhy wyndw.

pwi jnhn mhl khys nyy'wn (th) un khy khwh jy try +m cchlN jy pk kyy'wn, & Dnhs wHy kywswn th sndn hn wq`y jy khyn Drwr sdh Dyndyn & uhy (twkhy) nh dyNnd.

& snds phrN ty kwRw rt ly'y andy'wn, (y`qwb) chyw th (y'yn nh ahy) blk whn jy nfsn whn li (un) tthh khy tthhyw ahy, tnhnkry (mwn khy) chNw Sbr krN ghrjy, & jyky whyn byn knd ahyw tnhn ty llh khn mdd ghry wnyy thy.
& (un khwh ty) qflw ayw pwi pnhnjy pNy bhryndR khy mwklyy'wn jnhn pnhnjw bwkw wdhw, chyy'wn wh wh! hy nyngr ahy, & khys hk (chNy) wth smjhy lkyy'wn, & jyky kyy'wn thy sw llh dyNndR ahy.

& jnhn mhl (yuwsf) pnhnjy jwnya khy phtw (th) Hikmt & `lm Dnwswn, & hRy TrH bhlrn khy bdlw Dynd ahywn.

pwi snds plNhr n jy du` qbwl ky'y & khny's unhn jw mkr Tryy'yn, cchwth uhw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
wry bh nshnyn jy DsN khn pwi khyn hya (Glh) nZr ay'y th kjh wqt ty'yn khys Drwr qyd wjhn.

& sNs bh jwn qyd +m ghRy, nhn mn hk chyw th mwn pN khy (nnD +m) Dtthw th shrb npwRyn thw, & by'y chyw th mwn pN khy mthy ty mny khNndw & mnjhny's pkhyn khy khy'yndw Dtthw, sn khy un jy t`byr jy khbr Dy, byshk syn twkhy bhlrn mn Dswn th.

(yuwsf) chyw th jykw T`m whyn khy'ynd ahyw sw whn wT yndw y'y nh pr whn wT n jy chN khn Gyy'y snds t`byr aun whn khy Dsynds, ihw (t`byr krN) nhn (Glhyn) mn ahy jy mnhnjy rb mwnkhy sykhrywn ahn, byshk mwn un qwm jy pr phTy ky'y ahy jyky llh khy nh mnyynd ahn & uhy akhrt j bh munkr ahn.
& pnhnjy pyu DDn brhym & sHq y`qwb jy dyn jy pyrwy ky'y thm, knhn shyi khy llh sn shryk krN sn khy nh jGy'yndw ahy, hw sn ty & byn mNhn ty llh jw fDl ahy pr ghN mNhw shkrnw nh knd ahn.
y mnhnj sngty qydy (hya Glh smjhnd ahyw th) dhrw dhr ghN rb chN ahn y kylw Glb llh (chNw ahy)?

llh khnswi jn jy whyn pwdy knd ahyw uhy rGw nl ahn jy whn & whn jy pyu DDn nl rkhy ahn nhn jy bbt llh k snda nzl nh ky'y ahy, llh khnswi by'y knhn jy Hkwmt nh ahy, Hukm kyy'yn th khS un (llh) khnswi knhn jy `bdt nh kryw, uhw dyn qy'm ahy pr ghN mNhw nh dyNnd ahn.
y mnhnj qydy sngty whn mn hkRw pnhnjy bdshh khy shrb pyryndw, & byw swrya chRhyw wyndw & snds mthy mn pkhy khy'ynd, jnhn bbt pcchw th sw km pwrw thy wyw.
& nhn bnhy mn jnhn li gmn hws th (nytth) cchTndw tnhn khy chyy'yn th pnhnjy bdshh wT mwn khy yd kj, pwi shyTn snds bdshh wT khny's ydgyry wsry'y cchDy tnhnkry (yuwsf) kytry'y wrhyh qyd +m rhyw.

& bdshh chyw th mwn (nnD) +m st thulhywn Gy'wn Dtthywn ahn jn khy stn Dbryn khdhw thy & (pN) st sw sng & by st suk (Dtth thm), y srdrw' jykDhn whyn khwb jw t`byr knd ahyw th mnhnjy khwb jw mwn khy t`byr bdhyw.
chyy'wn (hy) pryshn khwb ahn, & syn kwRn khwbn jw t`byr nh dyNnd ahywn.
& jykw bnhy mn cchuTw hw & ghNy dyr khnpwi yd ays tnhn chyw th n jy t`byr jy aun twkhy sudh Dynds pwi mwnkhy mwklyw.
(pwi bndy khny Dnhn wyw chyy'yn) y sch yuwsf stn thlhyn Gy'n bbt jn khy stn Dbryn khdhw & stn swn sngn & byn (stn) sukn bbt t`byr bdhi th aun mNhn Dnhn mwTn th mna uhy dyNn.
(ywsf) chyw th st wrhyh sndh pwkh knd rhw, pwi jykw fSl luNw tnhn mn jyky khy'w tnhn khnswi byw (sbh) sndn sangn +m (rkhy) cchDyw nhn thwrn khnswi jyky whyn khy'w.
wry un khnpwi st sl skhtya j ynd nhn li jyky (an) Gy rkhy cchDyw hwndwa sw jyky bchy'y rkhndw' tnhn mn thwrRy khnswi (byw sbh) khy'y wynd.
wry un khnpwi hRw wrh yndw jnhn +m mNhn ty mynhn wsyw wyndw & mnjhs (Dkh wGyrh) npwRynd.

& bdshh chyw th yuwsf khy mwn wT aNyw, jnhn mhl wTs qSd ayw (th n wqt yuwsf) chyw th pnhnjy bdshh Dnhn mwT pwi khny's pucch th nhn zln jw khRw Hl hw jn pnhnj hth wddhy, cchwth mnhnjw plNhr sndn mikr khy dyNndR ahy.

(bdshh `wrtn khn) pcchyw th whn jw cch Hl hw jDhn yuwsf khy snds nfs khn rNywa thy, chyy'wn th llh pk ahy k bucchRy'y mths nh dyty swn, `zyz jy zl chyw th hNy Hq pdhrw thyw, mwn khys snds nfs khn rNN ghryw hw & uhw byshk schn mn ahy.
(yuwsf chyw th) ihw hn li hw th (`zyz) dyNy th mwn prptth snds khynt nh ky'y hy'y & llh khynt kndRn jw fryb pwrw thyN nh Dyndw ahy.
& (aun) pnhnjy nfs khy pk nthw bhnyn, tHqyq nfs bcchRy'ya Dnhn cchkyndw ahy pr jnhn ty munhnjw rb rHm kry, byshk mnhnjw plNhr bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
& bdshh chyw th khys mwn wT aNyw th (aun) khys pN li mqrr kryn, pwi jnhn mhl sNs Glhyy'yn (tnhn mhl snds syNp smjhy) chyy'yn th twn dy sn wT wDy mrtby wrw mnt wrw ahyn.
(ywsf) chyw th mwn khy hn mulk (mSr) jy khznn ty mqrr kr, tHqyq aun nghbn (sbhny kmn jw) wdhyk dyNndR ahyn.
& hRy TrH yuwsf khy (nhy) mlk +m mrtby wrw kywswn, jty wNndw hws tity Tkndw hw, jnhn li wNndw thw'n tnhn ty bjh phchy'ynd ahywn & nykan jw jr nh wnyy'ynd ahywn.
& jn ymn andw & prhyzgry knd rhy tn li akhrt jw jr Drwrbhlw ahy.
& yuwsf j bhy'r ay pwi wTs wy th khyn snyty'yn & uhy khys nh snyNnd hw.
& jnhn mhl nhn li sndn smn tyr kyy'yn (tnhn mhl khyn) chyy'yn th pnhnjy pyy'yty bhu khy mwn wT aNyw, whyn nh th Dsw cch th aun pwrw mN Dyn thw & aun chNw mhmny kndR ahyn?
pwi jykDhn khys mwn wT nh aNyndw' th whn li mwn wT k my'p knhy & nky mwn khy wyjh thjw.
chyy'wn sghw n bbt (knhn bhny sn) snds pyu khy rNyndswn & Drwr syn (yy'n) krN wr thyndswn.
& (ywsf) pnhnjn mNhn khy chyw th sndyn mwRy sndyn mDyn +m wjhy cchDyw pwi jDhn pnhnjn ghrn Dnhn mwTy wnyn mna nhy khy snyNn mna uhy wry chn.
pwi jnhn mhl pnhnjy pyu wT (kn`n +m) mwTy ay (tnhn mhl) chyy'wn th y b (anWa) my'y DyN sn khn rwkyw wyw ahy tnhnkry sn mn sn jy bhu (bnymyn) khy mwkl (th) my'p wtthwn & syn snds Drwr nghbn ahywn.
(y`qwb khyn) chyw th hn jy nsbt whn ty hRw y'y `tbr thw kryn jhRw G snds bhu jy bh nsbt whn ty `tbr kyw hwm, pwi llh chNw nghbn ahy, & uhw bjhrn khn khn wDw bjhrw ahy.

pwi jnhn mhl pnhnjw smn khwlyy'wn (th un wqt) pnhnjy mwRy pN wT mwTyl Dtthy'wn, chyy'wn th y sn j b (byw) sn khy cch ghrjy, (jw) hy sn jy mwRy sn Dnhn wry mwTyl ahy (th mwTy wnywn), & pnhnjn ghr wrn li an aNywn & pnhnjy bhu jy nghbny kndswn & hk utth jw br wdhyk bh wtthndswn, ihw (jyky an andw thy'wn sw) mN thwrw ahy.

(y`qwb khyn) chyw th (aun) whn sn n khy (ysyn) kDhn nh mwklynds jysyn mwn wT njm kry llh jw sunhn (nh) khNndw' th whyn knhn wkhy'y pwN khnswi n khy mwn wT Drwr aNyndw', pwi jnhn mhl khys pnhnjw pkw njm Dny'wn (th y`qwb) chyw th jyky syn chy'wn th tnhn ty llh nghbn ahy.

& chyy'yn th y pTw' whyn hk drwzy khn nh ghiRjw & lG lG drwzn mn ghRjw, & aun whn khn llh jy tqdyr mn kbh shy Try nh thw sghn, llh khnswi (by'y) knhn jw Hukm nh ahy, mths bhrwsw kym, & sbhknhn bhrwsy kndR khy mths bhrwsw krN ghrjy.

& jhRy TrH sndn pyu khyn Hukm frmyw hw thRy TrH jnhn mhl (mSr jy drwzn khn) ghRy, (tnhn mhl jyk skhty phchyn h) th sndn pyu llh jy tqdyr mn khy'n kjh bh Try nh thy sghyw (hw Hukm krN) y`qwb jy dl +m rGw hk khyl hw jw un khy pwrw kyy'yn, & jyky khys sykhryw hwswn tnhn sbbn (uhw) `lm wrw hw pr ghN mNhw nh dyNnd ahn.
& jnhn mhl yuwsf wT wy tnhn mhl un pnhnjy (sGy) bhu khy pN wT ji Dny chyy'yn th sch pch aun tnhnjw bhu ahyn tnhnkry jyky kyw thn tnhn ty Dkh nh kr.
pwi jnhn mhl unhn li sndn smn snbryy'yn (tnhn mhl) pnhnjy (sGy) bhu jy mDya +m pylw lkyy'yn wry awz kndR awz kyw th y qfly wrw' whyn Drwr chwr hyw.
(qfly wrn bdhy) nhn Dnhn munhn kry chyw th cch wnyyw thw?
chyy'wn th bdshh jw pylw wnyyw thwn & jnhn uhw (lhy) andw tnhn li utth jw br (n`m) ahy & aun (n njm) jw dhmy wr ahyn.
chyy'wn th llh jw qsm ahy th whn khy khbr hwndy th syn hn li nh ay ahywn th mulk +m DphyR wjhwn & nky syn chwr ahywn.
(wry nwkrn) chyw th jykDhn kwR hujw th un (chwr) jy sz khRy ahy?
chyy'wn th un jy sz (hy) ahy th jnhnjy mDya mn uhw ldhw sw (pN) n jw bdlw ahy, hRy TrH syn Zlmn khy sz Dynd ahywn.

pwi (yuwsf) pnhnjy bhu jy bwry (GwlN) khn G nhn (byn) jwn bwrywn GwlN shrw` kywn wry uhw (pylw) pnhnjy bhu jy bwry mn kddhyy'yn, hRy TrH yuwsf khy tjwyz sykhry swn, jw bdshh jy qnwn mwjb pnhnjy bhu khy llh jy ghur khnswi wtthy nthy sghyw, jnhn khy ghrnd ahywn tnhn khy drjn +m mthhwn knd ahywn, & hr knhn syNy jy mthn syNw ahy.

chyy'wn th jykDhn (hn) chwry ky'y aGy th G snds bhu (bh) byshk chwry ky'y hy'y, pwi n (Glh) khy ywsf pnhnjy dl +m lkyw & khyn uh pdhry nh kyy'yn, (dl +m) chyy'yn th whyn bcchRy mn wr ahyw, & jyky byn kryw th sw llh chNw dyNndR ahy.
chyy'wn th y `zyz hn jw pyu pwRhw wDya dymr wrw ahy in kry sn mn hkRw snds bdrn wtth, syn twkhy nykn mn Dswn th.
chyy'yn llh pnh +m rkhy jnhn wT pnhnjw smn ldhwswn tnhn khnswi by'y knhn khy pkRywn (jykDhn wtthwn th) nhy mhl syn Zlm ahywn.

jnhn mhl khny's n myd thy (tnhn mhl) nwykl thy SlH kndR thy, sndn wDy (bhu) chyw th nh dyNnd ahyw cch? th whn jy pyu whn khn llh jw pkw njm qsm ty wrtw ahy & G whn ywsf jy nsbt +m kjh nh ghTyw hw, tnhnkry (jysyn) mnhnjw pyu mwn khy mwkl (nh) Dyndw y llh mwn li Hukm nh kndw tysyn aun hn mulk mn kDhn nh nkrnds, & uhw chNw Hukm DyN wrw ahy.
whyn pnhnjy pyu wT mwTy wnyw pwi chy'w th y b tnhnjy puT chwry ky'y, & jykw dytwswn n khnswi by'y (Glh) jy shhdy nh Dnyswn & Gujh (jy khbr) nh dyNnd hwswn.
& jnhn Gwtth +m hwswn nhy khn & jnhn qfly +m ayswn tnhn khn pucch kr, syn Drwr sch ahywn.
(y`qwb) chyw th (nh!) blk whn jy nfs whn li (k) Glh tthhy ahy, tnhnkry chNw Sbr krN (mnhnjw km) ahy, myd ahy th llh nhn sbhny khy mwn wT aNyndw, cchwth uhw dyNndR Hikmt wrw ahy.
& khny'n munhn mwRyy'yn & chyy'yn mwn khy yuwsf li fsws ahy & snds by'y khywn Dkh khn cchywn thywn pwi uhw Dkh bhryl hw.
(& snds ghrNy wrn) chyw th llh jw qsm ahy th twn sdy'yn ywsf khy sryndw ahyn jysyn bymr thy'yn y mry wnyyn.
chyy'yn th aun pnhnjw Dkh & byqrry llh jy jnb +m byn kndw ahyn & llh jy Trf khn hw dyNndw ahyn jw whyn nh dyNnd ahyw.
y mnhnj pTw' wnyw & yuwsf & snds bhu jy Gwl kryw & llh jy rHmt khn n myd nh thyw, cchwth llh jy bjh khn kfrn jy qwm khnswi (byw) kw (bh) n myd nh thyndw ahy.

pwi jnhn mhl ywsf wT ay (tnhn mhl) chyy'wn th y `zyz sn khy & sn jy ghr wrn khy Dkh phtw ahy & nkmw smn khNy ay ahywn pwi sn khy pwry my'p Dy & sn khy (kjh) khyrt (bh) Dy, cchwth llh khyrt kndRn khy chNw bdlw Dyndw ahy.
(yuwsf) khyn chyw th jDhn whyn by smjh hyw' th jyky whn yuwsf & snds bhu sn kyw sw dytw thwa?
chyy'wn th twn y'y pk yuwsf ahyn cch? chyy'yn (hy'w) aun yuwsf ahyn & hyu mnhnjw bhu ahy, byshk llh sn ty bjh kyw ahy, jykw prhyz gry kndw & Sbr kndw th llh bhlrn jw jr nh wnyy'yndw ahy.
chyy'wn th llh jw qsm ahy th byshk llh twkhy sn khn bhlw kyw ahy & byshk syn khT kndR hwswn.
(ywsf) chyw th dy whn ty k myr nh ahy, llh whn khy bkhshyndw, & uhw (sbhny) bjhrn khn blkl bjhrw ahy.
hy mnhnjw phrN nyw pwi uhw mnhnjy pyu jy munhn ty ghmyw th DsndR thyndw, & mRy'y pnhnjy ghr j admy mwn wT aNyw.
& jnhn mhl qflw (mSr mn) nktw (th) sndn pyu chyw th jykDhn (whyn) mwn khy bhwrRw nh dyNw th mwn khy yuwsf jy bwi chy thy.
chyy'wn th llh jw qsm th twn Gy'yn wysry +m ahyn.
jnhn mhl khwshkhbry DyndR ayw th snds munhn ty hw (phrN) ghmyy'yn th mwTy DsndR thyw, chyy'yn th whn khy nh chyw hwm cch, th aun llh jy pr khn hw dyNndw ahyn jw whyn nh dyNnd ahyw?
chyy'wn th y sn j b sn li sn jy gnhn jy bkhshsh ghur syn byshk gnhgr ahywn.
(y`qwb) chyw th aun sighw whn li pnhnjy plNhr khn bkhshsh ghrnds, cchwth uhw y'y bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
jnhn mhl yuwsf wT puht (th un wqt) pnhnjy mu pyu khy pN wT ji Dny'yn & chyy'yn jykDhn llh ghryw th mSr +m by bhw thy gihRw.

& pnhnjy mu pyu khy tkht ty whryy'yn & uhy Dnhs sjdw kndy kry, & (yuwsf) chyw th y mnhnj b hyu mnhnjy Gyn khwbn jw t`byr ahy, byshk mnhnjy plNhr n khy schw kyw, & (llh) mwn sn tDhn byshk Hsn kyw jDhn mwn khy qyd mn bhr kddhyy'yn & mnhnjy & mnhnjy bhy'rn jy wch +m shyTn jhyRw wdhw tnhn khnpwi whn khy bhrRya khn (shhr) +m andy'yn, cchwth mnhnjw plNhr jnhn li wNys tnhn ty Hsn kndR ahy, sch ahy th uhw dyNndR Hkmt wrw ahy.

(yuwsf chyw th) y mnhnj plNhr byshk mwn khy bdshhy Dny thy'y & mwn khy khwbn jw t`byr sykhryw thy'y, y asmnn & zmyn j bNy'yndR, twn duny & akhrt +m mnhnjw wrth ahyn, mwn khy mslmn kry mr & mwn khy SlHn sn shml kr.
(y pyGmbr) hw (qSw) Gujhyn khbrn mn ahy jw tw Dnhn wHy krywn th, nhn jDhn fryb kndR thy pnhnjy km jw pkw rdw kyy'wn tDhn twn wTn kwnh hy'yn.
& (y pyGmbr) jytwNyk HrS kryn th bh ghN mNhw ymn aNyndR nh ahn.
& (twn) un (qran jy puhchy'N) ty khny'n kw ujwrw nh ghrndw ahyn, uhw (qran) jhnn jy nSyHt khnswi (byw ky) nh ahy.
& kytrywn y'y nshnywn asmnn & zmyn +m ahn jn tn lnghnd ahn & uhy (Disy kry) unhn (ty dhyn DyN) khn munhn mwRynd ahn.
& mnjhny'n ghN llh ty ymn nh aNynd ahn pr uhy (llh sn) shryk bNy'yndR ahn.
(uhy) llh jy `dhb mn pN wT cchip chN khn y qymt jy wchty chN khn by bhawa thy ahn cch? jw uhy nh dyNnd hujn?
(y pyGmbr) chw' th hyu mnhnjy wT ahy pdhry HujWt sn llh Dnhn sDyn thw aun & mnhnj tb`dr bh (sDynd ahn), & llh pk ahy & mn mshrkn mn nh ahyn.

& (y pyGmbr) sn twkhn G shhr wrn mn mRsn khnswi byw kwnh mwklywswn jn Dnhn wHy kywswn, pwi cchwnh zmyn +m ghmy Dsnd ahn th jyky khny'n G hw tn jy pcchRy khRy TrH thy? & akhrt jw ghr nhn li bhlw ahy jyky Ddynd ahn, pwi cchwnh dyNnd ahyw?

(ysty'yn ddhr Dnyswn) jysty'yn pyGmbr (mdd phchN khn) n myd thyN lG & (sndyn qwm) bhnyw th nhn sn kwRw njm kyw wyw ahy wTn sn jy mdd phty pwi jnhn khy ghrywswn tnhn khy cchwTkrw Dnw wyw, & gnhgr qwm khn sn jw `dhb nh Tryw wyndw ahy.
byshk dhyn wrn li nhn (pyGmbrn) jy qiSWn +m `ibrt ahy, (hy qran) bNwty akhNy nh ahy pr jyky (ktb) khny's G ahn tn khy schw kndR ahy & sbhknhn shy li nkhyR ahy & ymn wry qwm li hdyt & bjh ahy.
lmWr, hyu ktb jwn aytwn ahn, & jyky twDnhn tnhnjy plNhr wTn nzl kyw wyw sw Hq ahy pr ghN mNhw nh mnyynd ahn.

llh uhw ahy jnhn asmnn khy rya thnbhn jy khRw kyw ahy nhn khy Dsw th wry `rsh Dy mtwjh thyw & sj & chnD khy frmnbrdr kyy'yn, jw sbhkw tthhryl mudWt ty'yn hlndw ahy, (uhw) sbhny kmn khy rthyndw ahy nshnywn chTy'ya sn byn kndw ahy th mna whyn pnhnjy plNhr jy milN jw yqyn kryw.
& uhw (llh) ahy jnhn zmyn khy pkhyRyw & mnjhs jbl & dry bNyy'yn, & mnjhs sbhknhn mywy mn bh bh qism bNyy'yn Dynhn khy rt sn ddhkyndw ahy, byshk un +m prwRyndR qwm li nshnywn ahn.

& zmyn +m (pNwn wN) Tkr lGwlG ahn & Dkhn j bG ahn & pwkhwn & khjywn ahn (nhn mn ky) juwh & (ky) hk thuR wrywn ahn unhn khy hk (y'y) pNy pyryw wyndw ahy, & syn mywn +m kn (jy mzy) khy kin khn wdhyk knd ahywn, byshk un +m smjhndR qwm li nshnywn ahn.

& (y pyGmbr) jykDhn twkhy (sndn nkr jw) `jb thyndw ahy th sndn (hn) chwN jw bh `jb (krNw) ahy (jw chwnd ahn th) jDhn mTy thyndswn th syn wry ny'yn bNwt +m bNy wyndswn cch? ihy uhy ahn jn pnhnjy plNhr jw nkr kyw, & ihy uhy ahn jn jy Gchyn +m GT hwnd, & uhy dwzkhy ahn, uhy mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.

& (y pyGmbr) chNy'y (jy phchN) khn Gy y'y twkhn mdy'y jld ghrnd ahn & byshk khny'n G (mNhn ty) `dhb thy chuk ahn, & tnhnjw plNhr mNhn khy sndn Dwhy hjN hwndy bh bkhshN wrw ahy, & tnhnjw plNhr Dddhy `dhb krN wrw (bh) ahy.
& kfr chwnd ahn th hn (pyGmbr) ty snds plNhr khn k (bh) nshny cchwnh nzl ky'y wy'y ahy? (y pyGmbr) twn rGw DydyryndR ahyn & sbhknhn qwm li hdyt krN wrw hwndw ahy.
sbhk mdy (pnhnjy pyT +m) jykw (Hml) khNndy ahy sw llh dyNndw ahy & GbhyrNywn jyky ghTy'yndywn ahn & jyky wdhy'yndywn ahn (sw bh dyNndw ahy), & sbhk shy wTs ndzy sn ahy.
Gjh & Zhr jw dyNndR wDw mthhwn ahy.
whn mn jykw Glh hwryn kry & jykwwDy sD Glhy'y & jykw rt jw liky & Dynhn jw pdhrw thy ghmy (sy snds `lm +m) hk jhR ahn.

un (mNhwa) li (mly'k phrydr) hk by'y ptthyn yndR snds pwyn (mqrr) ahn jw llh jy Hukm sn un jy nghbny knd ahn, byshk llh knhn qwm jy Hlt khy (ysty'yn) nh phyry'yndw ahy jysyn uhy jyky sndyn dlyn +m ahy sw (pN) nh phyry'yn, & jDhn llh knhn qwm jy mdy'ya jw rdw kndw ahy th un khy kw TarN kwnh ahy, & nky nhn jw llh khnswi kw mddgr ahy.
uhw (llh) ahy jykw whn khy bhw' & umyd li widy Dykhryndw ahy & Garn kkrn khy khNndw ahy.
& r`d & (sbh) mly'k snds bhw' khn snds srh sn pky'y wkhNynd ahn, & widywn mwklyndw ahy pwi uhy jnhn li ghrndw ahy tnhn ty kyry'yndw ahy & kfr llh bbt tkrr knd ahn, Hlnk uhw skht `dhb krN wrw ahy.
