& llh dhrn nhn jy `bdt knd ahn jyky asmnn & zmyn mn khyn rwzy DyN jw kjh khtyr nh rkhnd ahn & nky (kjh kry) sghnd ahn.
pwi llh li (bcchR) mthl byn nh kryw, cchwth llh dyNndR ahy & whyn nh dyNnd ahyw.

llh hk khryd thyl bnhy jw mthl byn kry thw jnhn jw knhn shyi ty ws nh hujy & (byw) uhw jnhn khy pN wTn chNy rwzy Dnyswn pwi uhw un sn (sn jy wT +m) Gjhw & pdhrw khrch kry, (hy by'y pN +m) brbr ahn cch? sbh srh llh khy jGy'y, pr nhn mn ghN nh dyNnd ahn.

& llh bn mRsn jw (byw) mthl byn kry thw jn bnhy mn hkRw gngw hjy knhn shy ty ws kwnh hjys & uhw pnhnjy mlk ty br hjy jyDnhn mwklys utn k bhaly'y nh aNy uhw unhya jy brbr ahy cch jykw nSf jw Hukm Dy'y & uhw sdhyi wT ty hujy.
& asmnn & zmyn jw Gujh llh khy (m`lwm) ahy, & qymt (aNN) jw km (snds Gyn) rGy kh cchnbh (jy dyr) jhRw ahy blk uhw nhya khn bh wdhyk nzdyk ahy, cchwth llh sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
& llh whn khy whn jy my'n jy pyTn mn kddhyw jw kujh nh dyNnd hyw' & whn j knW & khywn & dlywn bNyy'yn th mna whyn shkrnw kryw.
asmnn jy hw +m tb` kyl pkhyn Dnhn nh Dsnd ahn cch? nhn khy llh khnswi kwnh jhlyndw ahy, byshk un +m ymn wrya qwm li nshnywn ahn.

& llh whn jy ghrn mn whn li arm (jw hndh) bNyw & ddhwrn jy chmRn mn whn li ghr bNyy'yn jn khy whyn pnhnjy msfrya jy Dynhn & pnhnjy hk hndh rhN jy Dynhn +m hlkw dyNnd ahyw & sndyn unWn & sndyn mlsn & sndyn Dsn mn (ghr jw) sbb & fy'dy jw smn bNyw th (jwGch) mudWt ty'yn (km Dy'y thw).

& llh pnhnjyn khlqyl shyn mn whn li cchny'wn bNywn & jbln mn whn li churwn bNyy'yn & whn li kpR bNyy'yn jy whn khy grmya (& srdya) khn bchy'ynd ahn, hRy TrH whn ty pnhnjy n`mt pwry kndw ahy th mna whyn frmnbrdry kryw.
pwi jykDhn phrnd th (y pyGmbr) twty pdhry pyGm phchy'N khnswi (byw ky) nh ahy.
llh jy n`mt dyNnd ahn wry un khy nh mnyynd ahn & unhn mn ghN kfr ahn.
& jnhn Dynhn hr knhn Twlya mn (hk) shhd khRw kndswn unhy Dynhn kfrn khy (`udhr krN li) mwkl nh Dby & nky unhn j `udhr qbwl ky wynd.
& jDhn Zlm `dhb Dsnd tDhn khy'n (`dhb) nky hlkw kbw & nky unhn khy muhlt Dby.
& jDhn mshrk pnhnjn shrykn khy Dsnd (tDhn) chwnd th y sn j plNhr hy sn j uhy shryk ahn jn khy twkhnswi sDynd hwsyn, pwi uhy (but) nhn khy wrndy Dynd th whyn kuwR ahyw.
& nhya Dynhn llh jy aDw `jzy knd & jykw tthh tthhynd hw sw khy'n bhuljy wyndw.
jn nkr kyw & llh jy wT khn (mNhn khy) jhlyw tn khy `dhb jy mthn `dhb nhya sbbn wdhy'yndswn jw (hw) fsd knd hw.

& un Dynhn sbhknhn Twlya +m sndyn jns mn mthn shhd khR kndswn & (y pyGmbr) twkhy hnn (y`ny umWt) ty shhd aNyndswn, & hr shy jy pdhry'ya li & muslmnn jy hdyt & bjh & khwshkhbry DyN li twty ktb nzl kywswn.
byshk llh nSf & bhly'y (krN) & my'Ty wrn khy DyN jw Hukm kry thw & by Hyy'y & mdy'y & zbrdsty khn jhly thw, whn khy nSyHt Dy'y thw th mna whyn nSyHt wtthw.
& jDhn whyn (llh jw nlw wtthy) pN +m njm kryw (tDhn) llh jw njm pRyw & whyn qasmn khy sndn pky krN khnpwi nh bhnyw jw byshk llh khy pN ty nghbn kyw thwa, byshk jyky knd ahyw sw llh dyNndw ahy.

& un zl wngr nh thyw jnhn pnhnjw suT ktyl pky krN khnpwi cchny Tukr Tukr kry cchDyw, whyn qsmn khy hn li pN +m Hylw bNyw th th (hk) Twly by Twlya khn wdhyk thy'y, llh th whn khy rGw un sn prkhyndw ahy, & jnhn bbt whyn tkrr knd ahyw sw qymt jy Dynhn whn jy li Drwr byn kndw.
& jykDhn llh ghry h th whn khy hk Twly kry h pr jnhn li wNndw ths tnhn khy gmrh kndw ahy & jnhn li wNndw ths tnhn khy hdyt kndw ahy, & jyky knd ahyw tnhn bbt whyn Drwr pucchbw'.
& whyn pnhnjn qsmn khy pN +m tthGy nh bNyw nh th unhn jy pky krN khnpwi whn j pyra trknd & (mNhn khy) llh jy wT khn jhlN sbbn sz chkhndw', & whn khy wDw `dhb thyndw.
& llh jy njm khy thwry mulh sn nh wikNw, cchwth jykDhn whyn dyNnd ahyw th jyky llh wT ahy sw whn jy li chNw ahy.
jyky whn wT ahy sw khpy wyndw & jyky llh wT ahy sw hmyshh rhN wrw ahy, & jn Sbr kyw tn khy sndn `mln jw blkl chNy TrH bdlw Dyndswn.
jnhn chNw `ml kyw (pwi) uhw mRs hujy y zl & uhw mw'mn hwndw th Drwr khys chNy Hyty Dy'y jyy'rw kndswn, & jyky knd hw tnhnjw bdlw khyn tmm chNya TrH Dyndswn.
pwi (y pyGmbr) jDhn qran pRhyn tDhn tRyl shyTn (jy shr) khn llh jy sm pw'.
n khy ymn wrn ty & jy pnhnjy plNhr ty bhrwsw knd ahn tn ty kw Glbw nh ahy.
snds Glbw rGw unhn ty ahy jyky khys dwst rkhnd ahn & (nhn ty bh) jyky llh sn shryk (mqrWr) knd ahn.
& jDhn hkRy ayt jy ji ty by ayt mTy'y aNynd ahywn & llh jyky nzl kndw ahy sw chNy TrH dyNndR ahy (tDhn) chwnd ahn th twn rGw pNwn bNy'yndR ahyn, (nh!) blk unhn mn ghN nh dyNnd ahn.
(y pyGmbr) khyn chw' th uhw qran tnhnjy plNhr wTn jbry'yl sch sn hn li nzl kyw ahy th mw'mnn khy thbt rkhy & muslmnn li hdyt & khwshkhbry hjy.
& byshk dyNnd ahywn th uhy chwnd ahn th un (pyGmbr) khy kw mNhw sykhryndw ahy, jnhn Dnhn h nsbt knd ahn tnhn jy bwly `jmy ahy & hy (qran) pdhry `rby bwlya +m ahy.
byshk jyky llh jy aytn khy nh mnyynd ahn tn khy llh sdhw rstw nh Dykhryndw ahy & unhn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.
kwRw tthh nhn khn swi kwnh tthhyndw ahy jyky llh jy aytn khy nh mnyynd ahn, & uhy (pN) kuwR ahn.

jnhn khy (ymn khn phrN jw) zwr kyw wnyy (uhw zbn sn ky chwy) & snds dl ymn sn armyl hjy un khnswi jykw pnhnjy ymn aNN khnpwi llh jw nkr kry blk kufr sn synw wykrw kry (y`ny rDy thy'y) hRn ty llh jw Dmr ahy, & nhn ty wDw `dhb ahy.
hw hn kry ahy jw nhn dny jy Hytya khy akhrt khn zydh psnd kyw ahy & (nhya kry) th llh kfrn jy qwm khy hdyt nh kndw ahy.
ihy uhy ahn jw sndyn dlyn & sndn kann & sndn khyn ty llh muhr hny'y, & uhy by khbr ahn.
blshk uhy y'y akhrt +m cchyy'y wr ahn.
wry byshk tnhnjw plNhr nhn khy (bkhshy thw) jyky (kfr jy klmy chwN li kfrn jy hthn) ydhy wy pwi wTn cchDyy'wn wry jhd kyy'wn & Sbr kyy'wn byshk tnhnjw plNhr n khnpwi Drwr bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
nhya Dynhn sbhkw jyu pnhnjy Trfn jhyRw kndw yndw & sbhknhn nfs jyky kmyw tnhnjw khys pwrw bdlw Dbw & nhn sn Zlm nh kbw.

& llh hk Gwtth jw (hk) qiSw byn kyw jw by bhy'w armyl hw n khy snds rwzy sbhknhn hndhn swkhy'ya sn yndy hy'y pwi llh jy n`mtn jy by shkry'y kyy'wn pwi jyky knd hw tnhn sbbn llh khyn bukh & bhw' jy pwshk chkhy'y.
& byshk mnjhy'n (hk) pyGmbr wTn ayw pwi khys kuwRw bhnyy'wn tnhnkry khyn `dhb pkRyw & uhy Zlm hw.
pwi llh whn khy jyk Hll (&) sutthy rwzy kry Dny tnhn mn khy'w, & jykDhn uhyn khS llh jy `bdt knd ahyw th snds n`mtn jw shkrnw kryw.

my'l ddhwr & rt & swy'r jw ms & jnhn shy khy llh jy nly khnswi by'y jy nly sn sDyw wnyy tnhn khnswi byw (ky bh) whn ty Hrm nh kyy'yn, pwi jykw nfrmny kndR nh hjy & nky Hd khn lnghndR thy lchr thy'y (& khy'y) th byshk llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
& jn shyn khy whn jwn zbnwn kwR sn byn kndywn ahn tn li (hnkry) nh chy'w th hy Hll ahy & hyu Hrm ahy th llh ty kuwRw tthh tthhyw, byshk jyky llh ty kuwRw tthh tthhynd ahn sy (kDhn) nh cchTnd.
(& hyu Hyty) thwry wath ahy, & unhn li akhrt +m Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.
& jyky twty hn khn G byn kywswn sw yhwdyn ty Hrm kyw hwswn, & sn mthn Zlm nh kyw pr (hw) pN ty Zlm knd hw.
wry jn by smjhy'y sn bcchR km ky wry un khnpwi twbh kyy'wn & pN sdhryy'wn tn li tnhnjw plNhr un (twbh) khnpwi blkl bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
brhym hk Trfw thyl llh jy `bdt kndR mm hw, & mushrkn mn nh hw.
llh jy n`mtn jw shukr kndR hw, (llh) khys sGwrw kyw & sdhy wT Dnhn hdyt kyy'yns.
& dny +m khys chNy'y Dny swn, & byshk uhw akhrt +m bhlrn mn ahy.
(y pyGmbr un khn) pwi twDnhn wHy kywswn th hk muhRy dyn brhym jy tb`dry kr, & brhym mshrkn mn nh hw.
jn cchncchr bbt tkrr kyw tn khnswi byn ty un (jy t`Zym) jw Hukm lzm nh kyw wyw, & byshk tnhnjw plNhr qymt jy Dynhn sndn wch +m Drwr nbyrw kndw jnhn +m tkrr knd ahn.

(y pyGmbr) Hkmt & chNy nSyHt sn pnhnjy plNhr jy wT Dnhn (mNhn khy) sD & chNy TrH khyn lzm Dy, tHqyq jykw llh jy wT khn gmrh thyw tnhnkhy tnhnjw plNhr chNw dyNndR ahy & uhw hdyt wrn khy (bh) chNw dyNndR ahy.
& jykDhn (kfrn khn) bdlw wtthw th jytrw ydhy wy hjw wtrw nhn khy ydhyw, & jykDhn whyn Sbr kryw th uhw Sbrn li bhlw ahy.
& (y pyGmbr) Sbr kr & tnhnjw Sbr llh y'y jy twfyq sn ahy & jykw fryb knd ahn tnhn bbt nky mthn Dkh kr & nky khfy rh.
jyky prhyzgry kndR ahn & jyky bhlr ahn tn sn llh gD ahy.

hw (llh) pk ahy jnhn pnhnjy bnhy khy hkRy rt (jy ndr) t`Zym wry msjd mn unhy masjd aqS~ ty'yn jnhn jy chwdhry brkt rkhy swn hn li syr kryw th khys pnhnjywn nshnywn Dykhrywn, byshk uhw y'y bdhndR DsndR ahy.
& muws~ khy ktb (twryt) Dnwswn & n khy bny sry'yln li hdyt krN wrw kywswn (& chywswn) th mwn khn swi (byw) kw bhrjhlw nh wtthw.
y (n qwm jw) wld jn khy nwH sn gD (byRy +m) chRhywswn, byshk hw shkr bnhw hw.
& bny sry'yln Dnhn ktb +m (hyu Hukm) mwklywswn th whyn mulk +m bh bhyr fsd Drwr kndw' & whyn wDy wDy'y sn Drwr htthyly'y kndw'.
pwi jDhn bnhy mn phrywn njm (fsd jw) yndw (tDhn) whn ty pnhnj Dddh swrh bnhn khR kndswn jy shhrn jy wch +m khy pwnd, & hw njm (pwrw) thyNw ahy.
wry whn khy hk bhyrw mthn Glbw Dyndswn & ml & wld sn whn khy (lGwlG) wdhy'yndswn & whn khy lshkr kry ghN kndswn.

jykDhn whyn chNy'y kndw' th (uh chNy'y) pN li kndw', & jykDhn whyn bcchRy'y kndw' th pN li, pwi jDhn byw njm (fsd jw) phchndw th by whn j mnhn rh knd & hRy TrH msjd +m ghRnd jhRy TrH n +m phrywn bhyrw ghRy hw & jnhn ty Glb thynd tnhn khy chNy TrH jRynd.
(chyw wyw th) whn jw plNhr wyjhw y'y whn ty bjh kndw, & jykDhn whyn (wry) phrndw' th syn bh (sz DyN Dnhn) phrndswn, & kfrn li dwzkh khy bndy khnh mqrr kywswn.
hyu qran nhy (wT) Dnhn rstw Dykhryndw ahy jyk Dddhy sidhy ahy & nhn mw'mnn khy khwshkhbry Dyndw ahy jyky chN km knd ahn nhn li wDw jr ahy.
& jyky akhrt khy nh mnyynd ahn tn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb tyr kyw thwn.
& mNhw mdy'ya khy (hRw) ghrndw ahy jhRw chNy'ya khy snds ghrN hwndw ahy, & mNhw bhrw ahy.

& rt & Dynhn khy bh nshnywn kywn swn pwi rt jy nshny khy myTywswn & Dynhn jy nshny khy hn li rwshn kywswn th pnhnjy plNhr jw fDl Gwlyw & (pN hn li) th whyn wrhn jw GNyTw & Hsb dyNw, & sbh knhn shy jw khwly byn kywswn.
& sbh knhn mNhwa jy Gchya +m snds `ml nmw bdhwswn, & qymt jy Dynhn ktb nhya li kddhndswn jw n khy khlyl Dsndw'.
(chyw wyndw th) pnhnjw ktb pRh, dy tnhnjw jyu twty Hsb wtthndR bs ahy.
jnhn hdyt ldhy tnhn pN li y'y hdyt ldhy, & jykw bhulw sw rGw pN li bhulndw, & kw br khNndR by'y knhn jw br nh khNndw, & syn ysty'yn `dhb kndR nh ahywn jysty'yn knhn pyGmbr khy mwklywn.

& syn jDhn knhn Gwtth jw ns krN ghrnd ahywn (tDhn) nhn mn aswdn khy (pyGmbr jy m`rft pnhnjy `bdt jw) Hukm knd ahywn pwi mnjhs nfrmny knd ahn tnhnkry mthn `dhb lzm thyndw ahy pwi pR pTN TrH n jy pR pTynd ahywn.
& kytry'y jG nuwH khn pwi ns kyswn, & tnhnjw plNhr pnhnjn bnhn jy gnhn jy khbr rkhndR DsndR kfy ahy.
jykw dny (jy aswdgy) ghrndw ahy tnhn khy n hndh hy'y jld Dynd ahywn jyky ghrnd ahywn sw jnhn li ghrnd ahywn (tnhn khy Dynd ahywn) wry n li dwzkh mqrr kywswn, jnhn +m (hw) khwr (&) tRyl thy ghRndw.
& jnhn akhrt ghry & n li chNy kwshsh ky'y & uhw mw'mn (bh) hjy sy uhy ahn jn jy kwshsh qbwl thyl ahy.
hn Twlya jy & hn Twlya jy hr hk khy tnhnjy plNhr jy bkhshsh mn mdd krywn th, & tnhnjy plNhr jy Dt k Tkyl nh ahy.
Ds th nhn mn hkRn khy byn khn (dny +m rzq & mrtbh +m) ky'n bhlw kyw thwn, & akhrt th drjn kry blkl wDy & mna DyN kry blkl wdhyk ahy.
(y mNhw twn) llh sn byw kw m`bwd mqrWr nh kr nh th gilrw (&) khwr thy whndyn.

& tnhnjy plNhr Hukm kyw ahy th n khnswi by'y knhn jy `bdt nh kryw & mu pyu sn nyky kryw, jykDhn bnhyn mn kw hkRw tnhnjy aDw buddhy'ya khy phchy y bay'y th twn uf (bh) nh chy'j & nky khyn jhNkj & sNn chNy Glh (db wry) Glhy'j.
& nhn li `jzya jwn bnhwn bjh mn hytthhywn kj & chy'j th y mnhnj plNhr unhn ty (hRy TrH) bjh kr jhRy TrH mwn khy nnddhpN +m plyy'wn thy.
jyky whn jy dlyn +m ahy sw whn jw plNhr chNy TrH dyNndR ahy jykDhn whyn sdhryl hwndw' (th bkhshyndw) cchwth llh twbh kndRn khy bkhshNhr ahy.
& my'Ty wr & mskynn khy & musfrn khy sndn Hq Dy & ddhngy'ya sn jyw nh wnyi.
cchwth jyw wnyy'yndR shyTnn j bhy'r ahn, & shyTn pnhnjy plNhr jy nfrmny kndR ahy.
& jykDhn twn (rzq jy Nhwnd kry) nhn khn mnhn mwRyn jnhn rzq jy mlN jy pnhnjy plNhr khn myd rkhyn thw th (khyn jhNky nh mwTi &) sNn mtthy Glh Glhi.
& nky pnhnjy hth khy pnhnjy Gchya +m bnd kr & nky hw srw khwly cchD nh th mlmty & `jz thy wyhy rhndyn.
tnhnjw plNhr jnhn li ghrndw ahy tnhnjy rwzy kshdy kndw ahy & ghT bh kndw ahy, tHqyq hw pnhnjn bnhn jy khbr rkhndR DsndR ahy.
& pnhnjn brn khy sunyy'ya jy Dp khn nh kuhw, syn khyn & (khwd) whn khy rwzy Dynd ahywn, byshk nhn khy kuhN wDw Dwh ahy.
& zn khy wyjh nh wnyw cchwth h by Hyy'y ahy, & ih wT bucchRy ahy.
& hRy jya khy nh kuhw jnhn jw (shr`y) Hq khnswi kuhN llh Hrm kyw ahy, & jykw nHq mryw wnyy n jy wrth khy (qSS jw) khtyr Dnwswn pwi jGy'y th mrN +m zydty nh kry, cchwth hw mdd Dnl thyw ahy.
& nky knhn cchwry br jy ml khy chNy nyt khnswi wyjh wnyw jysty'yn hw blwGt khy phchy, & pnhnjw njm pRyw, tHqyq njm bbt blkl pcch thyndy.
& jDhn mN bhryw tDhn pwrw bhryw & sny'yn trzya sn twryw, h (pwry mp & twr) bhly & `qbt jy kry blkl chNy ahy.
& (y bnh) jnhn shy jy twkhy k sudh nh ahy un jy pwyn nh lG, cchwth kan & kh & dl nhn sbhny (`Dwn) khn n bbt blkl pcch thyndy.
& zmyn +m twn akR kry nh guhm, cchwth twn nky zmyn khy chyry sghndyn & nky Dygh +m jbl (jy chwTy) khy phchyn sghndyn.
unhn sbhny (`dtn) jy bcchRy'y tnhnjy plNhr wT npsnd ahy.
hy Hukm nhn mn ahn jyky tnhnjy plNhr twDnhn Hkmt mn wHy ky ahn, & llh sn byw kwbh m`buwd muqrWr nh kr nh th twn mlmty (&) tRyl thy dwzkh +m wdhw wyndyn.
(y mshrkw') whn jy plNhr whn khy puTn jy li chwnDyw & (pN) mly'kn khy (pnhnjywn) dhyy'r kry wrty'yn cch? byshk whyn hya wDy Glh knd ahyw.
& byshk hn qran +m hn li wry wry smjhywswn th nSyHt wtthn, & hw nhn bbt nfrt khnswi (byw ky) kyn thw wdhy'y.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th jykDhn sNs by m`bwd jhRy TrH hwnd ahn (thRy TrH) hjn h th hy nhy dm `rsh jy mlk Dnhn (jng jy) wT Tlbyn h.
hw pk ahy & jyky chwnd ahn tnhn khn wDw (&) mthhwn ahy.
st asmn & zmyn & jyky mnjhn ahy sy n jy pky'y byn knd ahn, & k (bh) shy snds srh sn gD pky'y byn krN khnswi nh ahy pr (whyn) snds tsbyH nh smjhnd ahyw, byshk uhw burdbr bkhshNhr ahy.
& jDhn (twn) qran pRhndw ahyn (tDhn) tnhnjy wch +m & jyky akhrt khy nh mnyynd ahn tn jy wch +m (syn) lkl prdw knd ahywn.
& n jy smjhN khn sndn dlyn +m prdw & sndn kann +m ghbry'y wjhnd ahywn, & jDhn pnhnjy hkRy plNhr khy qran +m yd kryn thw tDhn nfrt kry pnhnjyn putthyn (bhrpwi) ty mwTnd ahn.

(y pyGmbr) jnhn mhl twDnhn kn Dyy'y jnhn (tthtthwly krN jy rdy) sn (qran khy) bdhnd ahn & jnhn mhl Gjhywn SlHwn knd ahn jDhn Zlm chwnd ahn th (whyn) rGw jdw kyl mRs jy tb`dry kryw th (tnhn mhl sndyn nhn Glhyn khy) chNy TrH dyNnd ahywn.
Ds th twli khR mthl Dynd ahn pwi gmrh thy tnhnkry sdhy wT lhy nh sghnd ahn.
& chwnd ahn th jDhn syn (mry Gry) hD & dhr dhr thyndsyn (tDhn) syn wry nwn bNjy thndsyn cch?
chw' th phN thyw y lwh thyw.

y pnhnjyn dlyn +m jyk (by) wDy khlq bhy'ynd ahyw (s thyw th bh thndw'), pwi sghwy'y chwnd th kyr sn khy wry jyryndw? chw' th jnhn whn khy phrywn bhyrw pyd kyw (sw jyryndw), pwi twDnhn pnhnjw kndh lwDynd & chwnd th hw kDhn thyndw? chw' th myd ahy th sghw thyNw ahy.
jnhn Dynhn llh whn khy sDyndw (tnhn Dynhn) whyn snds srh kndy wrndy Dyndw' & bhy'yndw' th thwrwy'y wqt rhy ahywn.
& (y pyGmbr) mnhnjn bnhn khy chw' th (kfrn sn) blkl chNy (Glh) chwnd rhn, cchwth shyTn sndn wch +m jhyRw wjhndw ahy, cchwth shyTn mNhw jw pdhrw wyry ahy.
whn jw plNhr whn khy chNy TrH dyNndw ahy, jykDhn wNys th whn ty bjh kry & jykDhn wNys th whn khy `dhb kry, & sn twkhy mthn wkyl kry nh mwklyw ahy.
& jyky asmnn & zmyn +m ahy sw tnhnjw plNhr chNy TrH dyNndw ahy, & byshk hkRn nbyn khy byn khn wdhyk kywswn & dw'd khy zbwr Dnwswn.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th llh khnswi byn jn khy (llh jhRw) bhy'ynd ahyw tn khy sDyw pwi (hy) whn khn nky knhn hnj lhN jw & nky phyry'N jw khtyr rkhnd ahn.

hy (kfr khud khnswi) jn khy sDynd ahn sy pN pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn wsylw Gwlynd ahn th nhn mn kyr Dddhw wyjhw ahy? & snds bjh jy myd rkhnd ahn & snds `dhb khn Ddynd ahn, cchwth tnhnjy plNhr jw `dhb DdyN jhRy shy ahy.
& kwbh Gwtth nh ahy mgr (jnhn jy rhN wrn) khy (sndn bcchRn krtwtn sbb) qymt jy Dynhn khn G syn ns krN wr ahywn y n khy skht `dhb DyndR ahywn, ihw Hukm ktb +m lkhyl ahy.

& sn khy mu`jzn mwklN khn nhya Glh khnswi by'y knhn nh rwkyw jw Gyn (mNhn) nhn khy kwR dytw hw, & thmwd (jy qwm) khy Dchy mu`jzh la Dny swn th un khy nh mnyyy'wn, & syn rGw DydyrN li mu`jz mwklynd ahywn.

& (y pyGmbr yd kr) jnhn mhl twkhy chywswn th tnhnjy plNhr mNhn khy (pnhnjy qdrt sn) lpyTyw ahy, & sn jykw twkhy nZrw Dykhrywswn jw l`nt kyl wN qran +m byn kyw wyw ahy sw mNhn jy prkh khnswi nh ahy, & syn jw khyn Dydyrynd ahywn sw nhn bbt wDy shrrt khnswi (byw ky) nh wdhy'yndw ahy.
& jDhn mly'kn khy chywswn th adm khy sjdw kryw pwi blys khnswi (byn) sjdw kyw, (blys) chyw th jnhn khy mTya mn pyd kyy'y tnhn khy cchw sjdw kryn?
(wry blys) chyw th Ds hy shkhS jnhn khy tw mwn ty shrf Dnw, jykDhn mwn khy qymt jy Dynhn ty'yn muhlt Dyndyn th thwrRn khn swi snds (by'y) wld khy pRy'wn pTynds.
(llh) chyw th wny pwi mnjhny'n jn tnhnjy tb`dry ky'y tn whn sbhny jy sz dwzkh ahy (& h) blkl pwry sz ahy.
& mnjhny'n jnhn khy (bhuly'y) sghyn tnhn khy pnhnjy sD sn bhuli & pnhnjn pydn & swrn sn mthn chRhy'y kr & sndn ml & wld +m bhy'ywry kr & khyn njm Dy, & shyTn tthGya khnswi khyn kw dlsw nh Dyndw ahy.
byshk mnhnjn bnhn ty twkhy k sgh nh ahy, & tnhnjw plNhr nghbn bs ahy.
whn jw plNhr hw ahy jykw dryy'n +m byRywn hn li hly'yndw ahy th snds fDl Gwlyw, cchwth uhw whn ty bjhrw ahy.

& jDhn whn khy drya +m k wkhy'y phchndy ahy tDhn khS n (llh) khnswi byn jn khy whyn sDynd ahyw sy wsry wynd ahn, pwi jnhn mhl whn khy suky Dy bchy'yndw ahy (tnhn mhl) munhn mwRynd ahyw, & mNhw Dddhw by shkr ahy.
(whyn) pN khy skya +m ghy'N khn y pN ty (phNn jy) andhy chN khn by bhw thy ahyw cch? wry whyn pN li kw whrw nh lhndw'.
y by'y bhyry n (dry) +m mwTy'N khn by bhawa thy ahyw cch? pwi whn ty wu jw Twfn mwkly pwi whn khy whn jy nkr sbbn bwRy wry nhy (bwRN jy) kry pN li sn ty kw pycchy krN wrw nh lhndw'.
& byshk adm jy wld khy shrf Dnwswn & khyn paTn & dryy'n +m khnywswn & khyn stthyn shyn mn rwzy Dnyswn & jyky khlqyswn tn mn ghNn khn khyn zydh mna wrw kywswn.
hr knhn Twlya khy sndn GwN sn sDyndswn, pwi jnhn khy snds `mlnmwn snds sdyy hth +m Dnw wyndw sy pnhnjw `mlnmw pRhnd & tnd jytrw bh Zlm nh kbn.
& jykw hn dny +m ndhw thyw sw akhrt +m (bh) ndhw (hwndw) & wT khn binh bhulyl rhndw.
& jyky twDnhn (pnhnjn Hukmn jw) wHyu kywswn tnhn khnswi twkhy hn li dwkhy +m wjhN lG hw th twn n khnswi byw kw sn ty tthh tthhyn, & nhya mhl twkhy dwst bNy'yn.
& jykDhn syn twkhy (pnhnjy Glh ty) pkhtw nh rkhwn h th wyjhw hw jw byshk unhn Dnhn ky thwrwy'y lRy pwn h.
& ty jw ty Hyty jw byNw `dhb & mwt jw (bh) byNw `dhb twkhy chkhywn h wry pN li sn ty kw whrw nh lhyn h.
& (y pyGmbr mky jy) zmyn +m sghw y'y twkhy hn li byqrr knd th n mn twkhy lDy'yn & nhya mhl twkhn pwi (pN bh) thwrw wqt rhnd.
twkhn G jyky pnhnj pyGmbr mwklyswn tn jw dstwr mwfq (jw sndn qwm khyn lDyw th ns kyw wyn) & sn jy dstwr khy k phyrphr nh lhndyn.
sj lRy'y khn wtthy rt jy wndhya ty'yn nmz pRh & fjr jw qran prh, byshk fjr jw qran pRhN mhl mly'k HDr thyn th.
& kjh rt jw (qran) sn thjWd prh jw (h) twli zydh `bdt ahy, tnhnjw plNhr twkhy sghwy'y srhyl ji +m uthryndw.
& (y pyGmbr) chw' th y mnhnj plNhr mwn khy (mdyny +m) schy'ya sn dkhl kr & (mky mn) mwn khy schy'ya sn bhr kddh & pN wTn mwn li Dddhy sgh mdd DyndR kr.
& (y pyGmbr) chw' th sch ayw & kwR bhGw, byshk kwR bhdyndR ahy.
& syn qran khy nzl krywn th jw hw srw mw'mnn li shf & bjh ahy & Zlmn bbt nqSn khnswi (byw ky) nh wdhy'yndw ahy.
& jDhn nsn ty k n`mt nzl knd ahywn (tDhn) munhn mwRyndw ahy & khny's psyrw thyndw ahy, & jDhn khys mdy'y phchndy ahy th n myd thyndw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th sbhkw pnhnjy Dwl ty km kndw ahy, pwi jykw Dddhya sdhya wT ty ahy tnhn khy tnhnjw plNhr chNy TrH dyNndw ahy.
& (y pyGmbr) twkhn ruwH bbt pucchn th, chw' th ruwH mnhnjy plNhr jy mr mn ahy & whn khy ky thwrRy `lm khnswi nh Dnw wyw ahy.
& jykw (qran) twdhnhn wHy kywswn sw jykDhn ghrwn th wry'y wtthwn th pwi twn pN li sn ty kw bhrjhlw nh lhndyn.
pr tnhnjy plNhr jy bjh (n wry'y wtthN khy jhly rkhyw) ahy, cchwth snds fDl twty wDw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th jykDhn mNhw & jinW hn qran jhRy (by'y knhn ktb) aNN li gD thyn th jhRs kDhn nh aNy sghnd jytwNyk hk by'y khy mdd Dyn.
& byshk hn qran +m sbhkw mthl mNhn li byn kyw thy'wn, pr ghN mNhw by shkr thy nkr knd ahn.
& chwnd ahn th syn twkhy (ysty'yn) hrgz nh mnyyndswn jysty'yn zmyn & sn li kw chshmw why'yn.
y khjyn & Dkhn mn twli bG thy'y pwi snds wch +m twn whndR whywn why'yn.
y jhRy TrH tw bhnyw thRy TrH sn ty asmn Tukr Tukr kyry'yn y twn llh & mly'kn khy smhwn aNyn.

y twkhy kw swnwn ghr hujy y asmn ty chRhyn, & tnhnjy chRhN khy (ysty'yn) kDhn nh mnyyndswn jysty'yn sn ty (hRw lkhyl) ktb lhyn jnhn khy pRhwn, chw' th mnhnjw plNhr pk ahy aun rGw pyGm phchy'N wrw mNhw ahyn.
& jDhn mNhn wT hdyt ay'y (tDhn) khyn ymn aNN khn hn Drn knhn nh jhlyw ahy jw chwnd ahn th llh pyGmbrn khy cchw mNhw kry mwklyw.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th jykDhn mly'k (whn jn) zmyn +m TkndR thy ghmn phrn h th syn mthn Drwr asmn mn mly'k pyGmbr kry mwklywn h.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th llh whn & sn jy wch +m shhd bs ahy, byshk hw pnhnjy bnhn jy khbr rkhndR DsndR ahy.

& jnhn khy llh hdyt ky'y sw hdyt wrw ahy, & jyky gmrh thy tn li twn llh khnswi kwy'y dwst nh lhndyn, & khyn qymt jy Dynhn sndn munhn bhr ndh & gng & bwR kry gD kndswn, sndn ji dwzkh ahy, jnhn mhl ddhrw thyndw tnhn mhl nhn li dwzkh khy wdhyk tpy'yndswn.
h sndn sz hn sbbn ahy jw snjy nshnyn jw nkr kyy'wn & chyy'wn th jDhn syn hD & chuwrw thyndswn (tDhn) wry ny'yn sr pyd thy thry wyndswn cch?
nh Dsnd ahn cch th jnhn llh asmnn & zmyn khy bNyw sw sndn hRy bNy'N ty ws wrw ahy & nhn li h mudWt mqrr kyy'yn jnhn +m kw shk nh ahy, pwi Zlm nkr khnswi ky qbwl nh knd ahn.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th jykDhn whyn mnhnjy plNhr jy khznn j mlk hjw h th nhya mhl (sbh) khrch thy wnyN jy bhaw khn whyn Drwr bnd rkhw h, & mNhw pkw pych ahy.
& byshk muws~ khy nawa pdhrywn nshnywn Dnywswn pwi bny sry'yln khn pucch th jDhn (hw) wTn ayw tDhn khys fr`wn chyw th y muws~ byshk aun twkhy yqynan jdw thyl bhy'yndw ahyn.

(muws~) chyw th byshk tw dytw ahy th hy (nshnywn) asmnn & zmyn jy plNhr khnswi (by'y knhn) nh nzl kywn ahn (whn jy) smjhy'N li (th Dsy mwn mnyyw), & y fr`wn aun twkhy (nhn jy nkr sbbn) hlk thyl bhy'yndw ahyn.
pwi fr`wn mlk mn sndn lwdhN jw rdw kyw pwi fr`wn & snds sry sngt khy bwRywswn.
& khny's pwi bny sry'yln khy chywswn th mulk +m Tkw pwi jDhn akhrt jw w`dw ayw (tDhn) whn khy lpyTy wtthndswn.
& n (qran) khy sn sch sn nzl kyw ahy & hw sch sn nzl thyw ahy, & twkhy khwshkhbry DyndR & DydyryndR khnswi nh mwklywswn.
& n qran khy jud jud (suwrtwn & aytwn) hn li kywswn th hw mNhn khy ahsth ahsth pRhy bdhy'yn & n khy ahsth ahsth kry lthwswn.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th whyn n qran khy mnyw twRy nh mnyw, byshk jn khy hn khn G `lm Dnw wyw ahy tn wT jDhn (qran) pRhbw ahy (tDhn) sjdw kndR thy khDyn bhr kirnd ahn.
& chwnd ahn th sn jw plNhr pk ahy byshk sn jy plNhr jw njm Drwr (pwrw) thyNw ahy.
& rwy'ynd khDyn bhr kirnd ahn & (qran) mnjhn `jzy wdhy'yndw ahy.

(y pyGmbr) chw' th (llh khy) llh (jy nly sn) sDyw y rHmn (jy nly sn) sDyw, jnhn nly sn (whyn) sDyw nhy j (sbh) nl chN ahn, & pnhnjy nmz +m nky tmm Dddhyn pRh & nky tmm hwryn pRh n jy wch wry wT khtyr kr.
& chw' th sbh srh nhy llh khy jGy'y jnhn (pN li) kw wld nh wrtw ahy & nky snds mulk +m kw bhy'ywr ahy & nky knhn hyNy'y sbbn n jw kw mddgr ahy & hn jy ghNy qdr wDy'y byn kr.
sbh srh nhy llh khy jGy'y jnhn pnhnjy bnhy ty ktb lthw & n +m kw Ding nh rkhyy'yn.
hn li sdhw kyy'yn th llh wTn skht muSybt khn kfrn khy Dydyry & unhn mw'mnn khy khwshkhbry Dy jyky chN km knd ahn th unhn li chNw jr ahy.
mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.
& nhn khy Dydyry jyky chwn th th llh (pN li) puT wrtw ahy.
jnhn jw nky khyn & nky sndn pyu DDn khy kw `lm ahy, wDy (gnh jy) Glh ahy j sndn wtn nkry thy, hy kwR khnswi (byw ky) nh chwnd ahn.
jykDhn hy hn Glh khy nh mnyn th mtn twn rmn khn sndn pwyn pN khy hlk kryn.
jyky zmyn ty ahy sw sn n jy syngr li hn kry kyw th sndn azmy'sh wtthwn th nhn mn `mln +m Dddhw chNw kyr ahy.
& n zmyn ty jyk (swl) ahy s syn chTy pTy krN wr ahywn.
pr bhnyw thyy'y th Gr & rqym wr sn jy nshnyn mn `jyb ahn.
jDhn Gr +m kytrn jwnn ji wrty tDhn chyy'wn th y sn j plNhr pN wTn sn ty bjh `T kr & sn jy km +m sn li chNy'y kr.
pwi kytry'y wrhyh khyn Gr +m kann bhr smhrywswn.
wry khyn hn li thrywswn th Dykhrywn th j mdt rhy s bnhy Twlyn mn khRy khy yd ahy.
syn twkhy sndn schy khbr byn krywn th, byshk hy kytr jwn hw jw pnhnjy plNhr khy mnyyw hwy'wn & khyn wdhyk hdyt ky'y hy'y swn.
& sndn dlyn ty (schy'y) bdhy swn jDhn thy tDhn chyy'wn th sn jw plNhr asmnn & zmyn jw plNhr ahy n khnswi by'y knhn khy m`buwd kry nh sDyndswn (jy sDywswn th) Drwr byshk unhy mhl byhwdy Glh chy'y swn.
sn jy hn qwm llh khnswi by m`bwd wrt ahn, mthn cchwnh kw pdhrw dlyl aNynd ahn? pwi jykw llh ty kwR tthhy n khn wdhyk Zlm kyr ahy?
& jDhn nhn (mshrkn) khn & (hy) llh khnswi jn khy pwdyynd ahn tn khn psy thyw tDhn Gr Dnhn pnh wtthw th whn jw plNhr whn li bjh pkhyRyndw & whn jy km +m whn li swly'y mwjwd kndw.

& (y DsndR) jDhn sj bhry (tDhn) Dsndyn th (us) sndn Gr khn sdyy psy lRndy ahy & jDhn lhy tDhn sndn khby psy mRndy ahy & uhy n (Gr jy) wykry'y +m ahn, ih llh jy nshnyn mn ahy, jnhn khy llh hdyt kry sw hdyt wrw ahy, & jnhn khy bhuly'y n li kwbh dwst wT DykhrndR nh lhndyn.

& twn khyn jGndR bhy'yndyn pr uhy (nnD +m) smhyl ahn, & khyn sdyy psy ty & khby psy ty thly'ynd ahywn, & sndn ktw chy'tth ty Gywn Tngwn Dghyryw pyw ahy, jykDhn mthn byhy Dsyn th khny'n bhdyndR thy mnhn phyryn & khny'n dhsht khn bhrjy wnyyn.

& hRy TrH khyn hn li khRw kywswn th pN +m pcchn, mnjhny'n chwndR chyw th (whyn hty) kytrw Tkyw', chyy'wn th hk Dynhn y Dynhn khn ghT rhyswn, (kn) chyw th jyky whyn rhy ahyw sw whn jw plNhr chNw dyNndR ahy, pwi mn pN mn hk khy hin pnhnjy rpy'y sn shhr Dnhn mwklyw pwi bhly Dsy th un (Gwtth) jw khRw T`m stthw ahy pwi n mn kjh t`m whn wT aNy & jGy'y th nrmy kry & whn jw Hl knhn hkRy khy nh dyNy'y.
cchwth jykDhn hy whn ty Glb thynd th whn khy sngsr knd y pnhnjy mdhhb +m whn khy mwTy'ynd & un mhl whyn hrgz nh cchTndw'.

& hRy TrH (tDhn) mNhn khy hn li mthn khbrdr kywswn th dyNn th llh jw njm schw ahy & byshk qymt (thyNy) ahy n +m kw shk nh ahy, tDhn nhn jy Glh bbt pN +m jhGRw krN lG pwi chyy'wn th nhn jy (Gr) ty k Dwt Dyw, sndn plNhr khyn dyNndR ahy, jyky pnhnjy Glh +m Glb thy tn chyw th nhn (jy Gr) ty msjd Drwr bNy'yndswn.

(ky) chwnd th (uhy) Ty ahn chwthwn sndn ktw ahy, & (ky) chwnd th pnj ahn cchhwn sndn ktw ahy Gujh bbt Tkl hNnd ahn, & chwnd ahn th st ahn tthwn sndn ktw ahy, (y pyGmbr) chw' th sndn GNyTw mnhnjw plNhr wdhyk dyNndR ahy nhn khy rGw ky thwr dyNnd ahn, pwi nhn bbt srsry jhGRy krN khnswi jhGRw nh kr, & nky nhn bbt kfrn mn knhn hk khn pcch kr.
& knhn km li nshllh khnswi nh chw' th aun hy sbhNy knds.
& jDhn pnhnjy plNhr khy wsryn (tDhn twn un khy) yd kr & chw' th sghwy'y mnhnjw plNhr hn khn bh Dddhy wyjhy sdhy hdyt kndw.
& uhy pnhnjy Gr +m Tn swn wrhn khn wdhyk naw wrh rhy.

(jykDhn uhy nh mnyyn th) chy'w th jyky rhy sw llh wdhyk dyNndR ahy, un khy asmnn & zmyn jw Gjh (m`lwm) ahy, khRw `jyb DsndR & khRw `jyb bdhndR ahy, un khnswi kw nhn jw mddgr nh ahy, & pnhnjy Hukm +m knhn hk khy bhy'ywr nh kndw ahy.
& tnhnjy plNhr jy ktb mn jyky twDnhn wHy kyw wyw sw pRh, snds Hukm khy k phyr phr nh ahy, & un khnswi twn k wh nh lhndyn.

& pN khy nhn sn Sbr +m rkh jyky pnhnjy plNhr khy SubH & snjhya jw yd knd ahn (&) snds rD mndy ghrnd ahn & (ghrjy th) tnhnjwn khywn duny jy Hytya jy syngr jw rdw rkhy nhn (yd kndRn) khn (by'y psy) nh wjhy'yn, & nhya jy frmnbrdry nh kr jnhn jy dl sn pnhnjy yd krN khn Gfl ky'y & pnhnjy khwhsh jy ptthyn lGw & snds km Hd khn wdhyl ahy.

& chw' th (hw skhn) whn jy plNhr wTn (ayl) sch ahy, pwi jnhn khy wNy sw ymn aNy & jnhn khy wNy sw nh mnyy, sn Zlmn li bh tyr ky'y ahy (&) un j prd unhn khy wyRhynd, & jykDhn fryd knd th nhn jy fryd hRy pNya sn wry'y wyndy jw pghryl Tmy wngr hwndw sndn mnhn khy bhnyndw, uhw bcchRw pyN ahy, & bcchRw arm jw hndh ahy.
byshk jn ymn andw & chN km ky th jnhn chNw km kyw ahy tnhn jw jr syn nh wnyy'yndswn.

ihy (uhy) ahn jn li hmyshgya j bhsht (hwnd) jn jy hytthn whywn whndywn ahn mnjhs swnn kngNn j zywr nhn khy pry wynd & sanhy & thulhy pT jy sy'y pwshk ddhkynd (&) ty tkhtn ty tkyw ly'y whnd, ihw bdlw chNw ahy, & arm jy ji bh chNy ahy.
& (y pyGmbr) khyn bn mRsn jw qSw byn kr & nhn mn hkRy li Dkhn j bh bG pyd ky hy'swn & nhn jy chwdhry khjywn pyd kyw hywswn & nhn jy wch +m pwkh pyd ky'y hy'y swn.
bnhyn bGn pnhnj myw pchy & mnjhny'n kjh ghT nh kyy'wn & nhn jy wch +m whywn whywn swn.
& n khy (ghNw) phr mlyw, pwi pnhnjy sngtya sn Glhy'yndy n khy chyy'yn th aun twkhn ml +m wdhyk ahyn & mNhn jy kry (bh) wdhyk `izWt wrw ahyn.
& pnhnjy bG +m ghRyw & hw pN li Zlm hw, chyy'yn th mwn khy hn (bG) jy ns thyN jw kDhn bh gmn nh ahy.
& nky qymt jy qy'm thyN jw mwn khy kw gmn ahy & jykDhn pnhnjy plhNr Dnhn mwTys (th) hn khn (bh) bhly ji lhnds.
snds sngty sNs gftgw kndy khys chyw th jnhn twkhy mTya mn bNyw wry nTfy sn wry sny'yn lNyn mRs kyy'yn tnhn jw tw cchw nkr kyw?
(aun hy wysh rkhndw ahyn th) mnhnjw plNhr llh ahy & aun pnhnjy plNhr sn kwbh shryk nh knds.
& jDhn twn pnhnjy bG +m ghRyn tDhn cchwnh chyy'y th jyky llh ghryw (sw thyNw ahy) jw llh (jy mdd) khnswi k sgh nh ahy, jykDhn twn pN khn mwn khy ml & wld +m ghT Dsyn thw.
th umyd ahy jw mnhnjw plNhr tnhnjy bG khn chNw mwnkhy Dyndw & un (tnhnjy bG) ty asmn khn k aft mwkly pwi phry chiTy paTy thy pawy.
y snds pNy suky wnyy pwi n khy kDhn lhy nh sghyn.

& snds phr khy cchT kyw wyw pwi un (jy bNy'N) +m jyky khrchyw hwy'yn tnhn ty pnhnj hth malyndw rhyw & uhw (bG) pnhnjyn (bNyln) cchtyn smyt kryl hw & chyy'yn thy th fsws ahy pnhnjy plNhr sn knhn khy shryk muqrr nh kryn h (th chNw hw).
& nky n li k Twly hy'y jw llh khnswi khys mdd Dy'y & nky (pN) bdlw wtthN wrw hw.

& (y pyGmbr) jykDhn tnhnjy plNhr jw Hukm aGTw nh thy'y h & (pN) mdt mqrr thyl nh hjy h th Drwr (`dhb) lzm thy'y h.
pwi jyky chwnd ahn tnhn ty Sbr kr & sj ubhrN khn G & n jy lhN khn G pnhnjy plNhr jy pky'y srh sn gD byn kr, & rt jy (phryn) ghRyn +m & kjh ghRywn Dynhn jwn pky'y byn kr th mna twn rDy thy'yn.

& pnhnjy ghr wrn khy nmzjw Hkm kr & mths Sbr kr (y`ny qy'm rh) twkhn rzq nh ghrnd ahywn, syn twkhy rzq Dynd ahywn, & chNy `qbt prhyzgrn li ahy.
& chwn th th sn wT pnhnjy plNhr jy k nshny cchwnh aNyndw ahy? jyky phryn SHyfn +m ahy tnhn jy nshny wTn nh ay'y ahy cch?
& jykDhn syn khyn hn (pyGmbr mwklN) khn G `dhb sn ns krywn h th Drwr chwn h th y snj plNhr sn Dnhn pyGmbr cchwnh mwklyy'y th pnhnjy dhlyl thyN & khwr hjN khn G tnhnjy aytn jy tb`dry krywn h.

mNhn li sndn Hsb wyjhw thyw ahy & uhy Gflt +m (rhy khny's) mnhn mwRyndR ahn.
sndn plNhr wTn k ny'yn nSyHt wTn nh yndy ahy pr un khy (tthtthwlya wngr rnd) khyDndy bdhnd ahn.
sndn dlywn wy'Rywn ahn, & Zlm Gjhywn SlHwn knd ahn, th hy (pyGmbr) whn jhRw y'y mNhw ahy, & whyn Dsy wy'sy jdwa khy cchw wyjh wynd ahyw?
(pyGmbr) chyw th mnhnjw plNhr sbh Glh dyNndR ahy (j) asmn & zmyn +m (jty hujy), & uhw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
blk chyy'wn th (hw qran) jy khylt ahn blk un khy tthh tthhyw ths blk uhw sh`r ahy, pwi jGy'y th sn wT k nshny aNy jhRy TrH phryn (pyGmbr) mwkly wy hw.
(hy'w) kwbh Gwtth jnhn khy G ns kywswn tnhn (jy rhkn pnhnjn pyGmbrn ty) ymn nh andw hw, pwi hya ymn aNynd ahn cch?
& (y pyGmbr) twkhn G rG mrd mwklyswn jn Dnhn wHy kywhwswn (chw' th) jykDhn nh dyNnd ahyw th ktb wrn khn pcchw.
& unhn (pyGmbrn) jw jusw hRw nh bNywswn jw T`m nh khy'yn & nh sdy'yn rhN wr hw.
wry sNn (pnhnjy) njm khy schw kywswn pwi unhn khy & jnhn li ghrywswn tnhn khy bchywswn & Hd khn lnghndRn khy ns kywswn.
byshk whn Dnhn hk ktb nzl kywswn jnhn +m whn li nSyHt ahy, pwi cchwnh smjhnd ahyw?
& kytry'y Gwtth jw uhy Zlm hw wyrn kyswn & khny'n pwi byw qwmwn pyd kywn swn.
pwi jnhn dm sn jw `dhb shy kyy'wn (tnhn dm) umlk uthwn uthy bhG thy.
(chywswn th) nh bhdyw & jn (n`mtn) +m aswd huyw' unhn Dnhn & pnhnjn ghrn Dnhn mwTw th mna whn khn pcchyw wnyy.
chwnd rhy th sn li khrby ahy byshk syn Zlm hy'swn.
pwi sdy'yn sndn hw pkrN hw tnjw khyn lNyl (&) wsnyl kywswn.
& asmn & zmyn khy & jyky sndn wch +m ahy s k sn rnd nh bNy'y ahy.
jykDhn sn khy rnd bNy'N (y`ny brn bchn) jw kw rdw hjy h th Drwr unkhy pN wTn wtthwn h (y`ny pN jhR krywn h), jykDhn syn kndR hjwn h (pr syn y'yn kndR nh ahywn).
blk sch khy kuwR ty ucchlynd ahywn pwi uhw sndn mthw bhnyndw ahy pwi unhya mhl uhw (kwR) chT thyndR ahy & jyky (llh jwn) wSfwn whyn byn knd ahyw tnhn sbbn whn li khrby ahy.
& jyky asmnn & zmyn +m ahy sw llh jw ahy, & jyky wTs ahn sy snds `bdt khn wDy'y nh knd ahn & nky thkb ahn.
(uhy) rt jw & Dynhn jw pky'y byn knd ahn sust nh thynd ahn.
zmyn (jy shyn) mn hR m`bwd wrt thn cch jw uhy (my'y khnpwi khyn) khRw knd?
jykDhn asmn & zmyn +m llh khnswi (ghN) m`bwd hjn h th (asmn & zmyn) by'y ujRn h, pwi kfr jykw byn knd ahn tnhn (Glh) khn `rsh jw plNhr pk ahy.
(llh) jyky kndw ahy tnhn bbt (uhw) nh pcchbw & unhn khn pcch kby.

un khnswi (by) m`bwd cch wrty'wn? (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th pnhnjw dlyl aNyw, hy (qran) mnhnjy sngt jy nSyHt ahy & (hy) mwn khn G wrn jy nSyHt ahy (y`ny twryt & njyl nhn mn dlyl Dyw) blk nhn mn ghN Hq khy nh dyNnd ahn un kry uhy munhn mwRyndR ahn.
& twkhn G jykw (bh) pyGmbr mwklywswn tnhn Dnhn hy y'y wHy kywswn th mwn khnswi kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy tnhnkry mnhnjy `bdt kryw.
& chwn th th llh (pnhnjy li) wld wrtw ahy uhw pk ahy, blk (mly'k llh j) sGwr bnh ahn.
Glhy'N +m un khn aGTy'y nh knd ahn & snds Hukm mwjb km knd ahn.
jyky sndn Gtn & jyky sndn pwy'tn ahy sw (llh) dyNndw ahy & (llh) jnhn khn rDy thy'y tnhn khn swi by'y li sfrsh nh knd ahn & uhy snds bhawa khn DdyndR ahn.
& mnjhy'n jykw chwy th aun llh khn swi m`bwd ahyn tnhn khy dwzkh jy sz Dyndswn, Zlmn khy hRy y'y sz Dynd ahywn.
kfrn nh Dtthw ahy cch th asmn & zmyn bnd thyl hw? pwi nhn khy khwlywswn, & sbhknhn jyy'ry shy khy pNya mn pyd kywswn, pwi cchwnh ymn aNynd ahn?
& zmyn +m jbl pyd kyswn th mtn khyn dhwDy & mnjhs wykrywn wTwn bNywswn th mna uhy wT lhn.
& asmn khy muHkm ccht bNy'y swn, & uhy un jy nshnyn khn munhn mwRyndR ahn.
& (llh) uhw ahy jnhn rt & Dynhn & sj & chnD bNyw, sbhkw (trw pnhnjy) asmn +m trndw ahy.
& twkhn G knhn mNhwa khy sdy'yn rhN wrw nh kywswn, jykDhn twn muy'yn th uhy sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.
sbhkw jyu mwt (jw mzw) chkhN wrw ahy, & whn khy mdy'y & chNy'y sn jchN TrH prkhynd ahywn, & sn Dnhn mwTy'bw'.
& jDhn kfr twkhy Dsnd ahn tDhn twkhy rGw tthtthwly kry wtthnd ahn, (& chwnd ahn) th hyu uhw ahy cch jykw whn jy m`bwdn (jy `ybn) jw dhkr kndw ahy, & uhy llh yd krN khn nkr knd ahn.
mNhw ubhr mn bNyw wyw ahy, sghw pnhnjwn nshnywn whn khy Dykhrynds pwi mwn khn `dhb jld nh ghrw.
& chwn th th jykDhn whyn sch ahyw th uhw njm kDhn thyndw?
jykDhn kfr un wqt khy dyNn h jnhn mhl nky pnhnjn mnhn & nky pnhnjyn ptthyn khn bh khy jhly sghnd & nky khyn mdd Dby (th y'yn nh chwn h).
blk (h ghRy) wTn wchtw yndy pwi khyn Hyrn kndy pwi nky uh Try sghnd & nky khyn muhlt Dby.
& byshk twkhn G pyGmbrn sn tthtthwlywn kywn wywn pwi mnjhy'n jn tthtthwlywn kywn tn ty uhw `dhb ulTyw jnhn sn tthtthwlywn knd hw.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th rt & Dynhn +m bjhry (llh jy `dhb) khn kyr whn jy nghbny kndw ahy, blk uhy, pnhnjy plNhr jy yd krN khn mnhn mwRynd ahn.
sn khnswi (bchy'N wr) ky m`bwd ahn cch jw nhn khy bchy'ynd? uhy pN khy bh mdd Dyy'y nh sghnd ahn & nky uhy (hk by'y jy mdd sn) sn (jy `dhb) khn bchnd.
blk khyn & pyu DDn khy aswdw kywswn tn jw sndn dymr Dghy thy, pwi nh th Dsn cch th (kfrn jy) mulk khy un jy chwdhrywn (mslmnn jy Glby sn) ghTy'ynd ahywn? pwi uhy Glb thynd cch?
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th aun whn khy wHy sn y'y Dydyryndw ahyn, & jDhn (mNhw) Dydyry wynd ahn tDhn bwRw (DydyrN jw) sD nh bdhndw ahy.
& jykDhn tnhnjy plNhr jy `dhb mn thwrwy'y khyn phchy th Drwr chwn th hy rmn syn Zlm hwswn.
& qymt jy Dynhn `dl jy trzy rkhndswn pwi knhn jyu ty kjh Zlm nh kbw, & jykDhn `ml ahr jy dNy jy twr hwndw th bh un khy aNyndswn, & syn Hsb kndR bs ahywn.
& byshk muws~ & hrwn khy nbyryndR ktb & nhn prhyzgrn li swjhrw & nSyHt Dny swn.
jyky pnhnjy plNhr khn prptth Ddynd ahn & uhy qymt khn (pN) DdyndR ahn.
& hy (qran) hk brkt wry nSyHt ahy jnhn khy nzl kywswn, pwi bh whyn n j mnkr thynd ahyw cch?
& byshk brhym khy Gy snds hdyt Dny swn & khys dyNndR hwsyn.
jDhn pnhnjy pyu & pnhnjy qwm khy chyy'yn th hy khRywn mwrtwn ahn jn ty whyn wyhy `bdt th kryw.
chyy'yn th pnhnj b DD unhn j pwdyyndR Dtthswn.
(brhym) chyw th byshk whyn pN & whn j b DD pdhrya gmrhya +m ahyw.
chyy'wn sn wT sch andw thy'y y twn rnd kndRn mn ahyn?
(brhym) chyw th blk whn jw plNhr uhwy'y asmnn & zmyn jw plNhr ahy jnhn uhy bNy ahn, & aun un (Glh) ty shhdy DyndRn mn ahyn.
& llh jw qsm ahy th whn jy ptthyry thy phrN khnpwi whn jy btn jw Drwr kw Hylw knds.
pwi unhn khy sndn wDy khnswi Tukr Tukr kyy'yn th mna hy Dnhs mwTn.
chyy'wn th sn jy butn sn knhn hhRw Hl kyw? byshk uhw Zlmn mn ahy.
chyy'wn th hk jwn khn bdhwswn th sndyn gl thy kyy'yn un khy brhym sDynd ahn.
chyy'wn th khys mNhn jy khyn Gyn aNyw th mna uhy gwhy Dyn.
(jDhn andy'wn tDhn) chyy'wn th y brhym tw sn jy butn jw hy Hl kyw ahy cch?
(brhym) chyw th (nh)! blk hw sndn hn wDy kyw ahy jykDhn Glhy'n th th khny'n pcchw.
pwi pN Dnhn (swchyndR thy) mwTy pwi (hk by'y khy) chyy'wn th byshk whyn pN by nSf ahyw.
pwi pnhnj kndh uwndh kyy'wn, (chyy'wn) th byshk dyNndw ahyn th hy nh Glhy'ynd ahn.
(brhym) chyw th llh khnswi nhn khy pwdyynd ahyw cch jyky whn khy nky nf`w phchy'ynd ahn & nky whn khy nqSn phchy'ynd ahn.
whn khy & jnhn khy llh khnswi pwdyynd ahyw tnhn khy dhikr hujy, (whyn) nh dyNnd ahyw cch?
chyy'wn th un khy sRyw & jykDhn whyn ky krN ghrw th th pnhnjn butn jw bhalw wtthw.
(pwi bh +m wdhy'wns) chywswn th y bh brhym ty thdhy & slmty wry thy pw'.
& khys ydhy'N ghryy'wn tnhnkry khyn blkl cchyy'y wrw kywswn.
& khys & lwT khy hRy zmyn Dnhn bchy'y andwswn jnhn +m jhn wrn li brkt ky'y swn.
& brhym khy sHq bkhshywswn, & y`qwb (jw snds pwTw hw) wdhyk (bkhshywswn), & sbhny khy SlH kywswn.
& uhy hR mm kyswn jw sn jy Hukm mwjb sdhw rstw Dykhrynd hw & nhn Dnhn chNn kmn krN & nmz pRhN & zkw@ DyN jw Hukm kywswn, & sn jy `bdt kndR hw.
& luwT khy Hkmt & `lm Dnwswn & khys hRy Gwtth wrn khn bchywswn jw md km knd hw, cchwth uhy bcchRy nfrmn qwm hw.
& khys pnhnjy bjh hytth dkhl kywswn, byshk uhw SlHn mn hw.
& (y pyGmbr) nwH (jy qSy) khy (yd kr) jDhn (unhn pyGmbrn khn) G du` ghryy'yn tDhn snds du` qbwl ky'y swn pwi khys & snds ghr wrn khy wDy wkhy'ya khn bchyw swn.
& khys hRy qwm ty swbhrw kywswn jnhn sn jy aytn khy kwR bhnyw, byshk uhy bcchRy qwm hw tnhnkry nhn mRny khy bwRywswn.
& dy'wd & slymn (jy qSy) khy (yd kr) jDhn pwkh bbt fySlw kyy'wn jw hk qwm jy dhN rt jw mnjhs bhyl ky'y hy'y, & sndn Hukm krN wqt HDr hwswn.
tDhn uhw slymn khy smjhywswn, & hr hk khy Hkmt & `lm Dnwswn, & dy'wd khy jbl & pkhy tb` kry Dnswn jw (sNs) tsbyH chwnd hw, & (syn yy'n) krN wr hwswn.
& dy'wd khy whn li zrh bNy'N hn li sykhry swn th whn khy whn jy lRy'y (jy nqSn) khn bchy'y, pwi whyn ky shkr kndR ahyw cch?
& sulymn khy tikhw wu (tb` kry Dnwswn) jw snds Hukm sn hRy zmyn Dnhn hlndw hw jnhn +m brkt rkhy swn, & sbhknhn shy khy dyNndR ahywn.
& dywan mn ky hR (tb` kry Dnswn) jy un li Tbnd hw & un khnswi byw km (bh) knd hw, & sndn nghbn hwswn.
& (y pyGmbr) ywb (jy qSy) khy (yd kr) jDhn pnhnjy plNhr khy sDyy'yn th mwn khy Dukh phtw ahy & twn (sbhny) khn tmm bjhrw ahyn.
pwi snds du` qbwl ky'y swn pwi jykw khys Dkh phtw hw sw lthwswn & snds ghr wr khys (wry'y) Dnswn & unhn jhR sNn gD pnhnjy bjh wTn (Dnswn) & (th) `bdt kndRn li ydgyry hjy.
& sm`yl & drys & dhwlkfl khy (yd kr), hr hk Sbrn mn hw.
& khyn pnhnjy bjh +m dkhl kywswn, byshk uhy SlHn mn hw.

& mcchy wry (jy qSy) khy (yd kr) jDhn hw (pnhnjy qwm) ty kwRjy wyw pwi (dhwlnwn y'yn) bhnyw th sn jy mths kDhn pkR nh hlndy pwi wndhyn +m dnhwn kyy'yn th twkhn swi kw m`bwd nh ahy twn pk ahyn, aun gnhgrn mn ahyn.
pwi snds du` qbwl ky'y swn & khys Gm khn bchywswn, & hRy TrH mw'mnn khy bchy'ynd ahywn.
& zkry (jw qSWw yd kr) jDhn pnhnjy plNhr khy sDyy'yn th y mnhnj plNhr mwn khy hyklw nh cchD & twn chNw wrth ahyn.
pwi snds du` qbwl ky'y swn & khys yHy~ bkhshywswn & snds zl khy snds li chNw kywswn, uhy chNyn +m aGTy'y knd hw & sn khy umyd & bhw' kry sDynd hw, & sn khn DdyndR hw.
& (nhya zl jwqSWw yd kr) jnhn pnhnjy ughR bchy'y pwi mnjhs pnhnjw rwH phwkywswn & khys & snds pT khy sry jG li nshny ky'y swn.
byshk ihw whn jw dyn hk dyn ahy, & aun whn jw plNhr ahyn tnhnkry mnhnjy `bdt kryw.
& pnhnjy (dyn jy) kmn khy pN +m Tukr Tukr kyy'wn, sbhy'y mwn Dnhn mwTndR ahn.
pwi jykw chN km kndw & uhw mw'mn bh hwndw tnhnjy kwshsh jy by qdry nh kby, & syn un li lkhndR ahywn.
& jnhn Gwtth khy ns kywswn tnhn ty Hrm thyl ahy th wry mwTy ynd uhy.
tn jw jDhn yajuwj & majuwj khy khwlbw & uhy sbhknhn dRy khn DwRnd.
& (jDhn) schw w`dw phchndw tDhn wchtw y'y kfrn jw khywn TRy wyndywn, (chwnd th) hayi armn byshk hn (Hl) khn by khbrya +m hwswn blk syn y'y Zlm hwswn.
whyn & jn khy llh khnswi pwdyynd ahyw sy dwzkh jw brN ahyw, un +m whyn ghRndR ahyw.
jykDhn uhy (but) m`bwd hjn h th un (dwzkh) +m nh ghRn h, & mRyy'y mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn.
mnjhs nhn khy rRywn hwndywn & uhy mnjhs (ky) nh bdhnd.
jn li Gy y'y sn wT chNy'y (lkhyl) ahy uhy un (dwzkh) khn pry kb.
(uhy) un jy bhNk nh bdhnd, & jnhn (`ysh) +m sndn jyu (rhN) ghrndw tnhn +m uhy sdy'yn rhnd.
khyn tmm wDw khwf mlwl nh kndw & khyn maly'k gDb, (& chwndn th) hyu uhw Dynhn ahy jnhn jw whn khy w`dw Dnw wyndw hw.
jnhn Dynhn asmn khy kGdh jy wyRhya wngy wyRhyndswn, jy'n phrywn bNywswn (ty'n) n khy wry bNy'yndswn, hw njm sn ty lzm ahy, syn krN wr ahywn.
& byshk twryt khn pwi zbwr +m lkhywswn th mnhnj SlH bnhn zmyn j wrth thynd.
hn (qiSWy) +m `bdt kndR qwm li (mTlb jy) pwry'y ahy.
& (y pyGmbr) twkhy khS jhnn jy rHmt li mwklywswn.
chw' th mwn wT hn Hukm khnswi wHy nh thyndw ahy th hk llh khnswi whn jw kw m`bwd nh ahy, pwi whyn cchwnh Hukm mnyyndR ahyw?
pwi jykDhn phrn th chw' th whn sbhny khy (llh jy Hkm ty) hk jhRw khbrdr kym, & jykw whn khy njm Dnw wyw sw nh thw dyNn th wyjhw ahy y pry ahy.
byshk llh Zhry Glh (bh) dyNndw ahy & jyky whyn lky'ynd ahyw sw (bh) dyNndw ahy.
& aun nh dyNndw ahyn th mtn uh tthhryl (dyr) whn li prkh hjy & hk wqt ty'yn (whn li) nf`w hujy.
(pyGmbr) chyw th y mnhnj plNhr schw fySlw kr, & sn jw plNhr bjhrw ahy jyky whyn byn kndw ahy tnhn ty khny's mdd ghry wyndy ahy.
y mNhw' pnhnjy plNhr khn Ddyw, cchwth qymt wrw dhku wDy shy ahy.

jnhn Dynhn un khy Dsndw' (tnhn Dynhn) sbhk khyr pyryndR jnhn khy khyr pyryndy hwndy tnhn khy (dhsht khn) wsryndy & sbhk Gbh wry pnhnjy Gbh khy kyryndy & mNhn khy byhwsh Dsndyn Hlnk uhy byhwsh nh hwnd pr llh jw `dhb skht ahy.
& mNhn mn kw hRw ahy jw llh jy shn +m by smjhya sn tkrr kndw ahy & sbhknhn shyTn tRyl jy ptthyn lGndw ahy.
un (shyTn) ty lzm kyw wyw ahy th jykw khys dwst rkhndw tnhn khy byshk uhw gmrh kndw & n khy dwzkh jy `dhb Dnhn sdhw rstw Dykhryndw.

y mNhw' jykDhn wry jyy'ry thy'N khn whyn shk +m pyl ahyw th sn whn khy mTya mn bNyw wry nuTfy mn wry rt jy dG mn wry gwsht jy bwTya mn pwrw bNyl & dh gbrw bNyl hn li th whn khy khwly bdhywn, & jnhn khy ghrnd ahywn tnhn khy muqrr mudWt ty'yn GbhyrNyn +m tthhry'ynd ahywn wry br bNy'y whn khy bhr kddhnd ahywn wry npy'ynd ahywn th whyn pnhnjy jwny khy phchw, & whn mn kw Gy mrndw ahy & whn mn knhn khy (jhwry'y jy) nkmya dymr Dnhn hn li wryw wyndw ahy th dyNp khnpwi kjh nh dyNy, & zmyn khy Gyr abd Dsndw ahyn pwi jDhn mths pNy wsy'ynd ahywn tDhn tzy thyndy & ubhmndy ahy & sbhknhn jns mn chN wbhR dymy'yndy ahy.
ihw (byn) hn li ahy jw llh (jw y'y hjN) Hq ahy jw uhw muy'n khy jyryndw ahy & uhw sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
& th qymt chNy ahy mnjhs kw shk nh ahy & th jyky qbrn +m hwnd tn khy llh uthryndw.

(wDy'ya khn) kndh mwRyndR thy hn li th (mNhn khy) llh jy wT khn gmrh kry, n li dny +m khwry ahy & qymt jy Dynhn khys sRN jw `dhb chkhy'yndswn.

th jykr jyky (uty) cchDym th aun chN `ml kryn y'yn (kDhn thyNw) nh ahy, byshk ih Glh ahy j hw chwndR ahy, & sndn Gyn hk prdw (`lam qbr) nhya Dynhn ty'yn rhndw (jnhn Dynhn qymt +m) uthry wynd.
pwi jnhn mhl Swr +m phwkbw (tnhn mhl) un Dynhn sndn wch +m nh dhtywn rhndywn & nky pN +m pucch Gcch knd.

sndn munhn khy bh sRyndy & uhy mnjhs bd shkl thynd.

cchwth mnhnjn bnhn mn hk Twly hy'y j chwndy hy'y th y sn j plNhr sn ymn andw tnhnkry sn khy bkhsh & sn ty rHm kr & twn (sbh khn) chNw bjhrw ahyn.

(llh) frmy'yndw th zmyn +m (whyn) kytr wrh rhyw'?

zn kndR zl & zn kndR mRs sw bnhya mn hr hk khy sw' dur hNw, & jykDhn whyn llh & qymt jy Dynhn khy mnyynd ahyw th llh jy dyn +m whn khy nhy bnhy ty nrmy krN nh jGy'y, & mw'mnn mn hk Twlya khy nhn bnhy jy sz ty HDr thyN ghrjy.
zn kndR mrd zn kndR zl y mshrkyNya khnswi by nh prNbw, & zn kndR zl khys zn kndR mRs y mshrk khnswi byw nh prNbw, & ihw (zn kndR zl sn nkH krN) mw'mnn ty Hrm kyw wyw.
& jyky pkdmn `wrtn khy thmt ly'yn wry chr shhd nh aNyn th khyn sy dur hNw & nhn jy gwhy Sly qbwl nh kryw, & uhy by dyn ahn.
pr hn khn pwi jn twbh ky'y & pN sudhryw, th llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
& jyky pnhnjy zln khy tuhmt ly'yn & khyn pN khnswi ky shhd nh hjn th hRy hr hk jy (schy) shhdy chr bhyr (hyy'N DyN) ahy th llh jw qsm th byshk pN sch chwndRn mn ahy.
& pnjwn bhyrw chwy th jykDhn kwRn mn hwndw th mths llh jy l`nt hjy.
& un zl khn (hya Glh) sz Tryndy jw chr bhyr shhdy Dy'y th llh jw qsm th byshk uhw muRs kuwR chwndRn mn ahy.
& pnjwn bhyrw (hya shhdy Dy'y) th jykDhn uhw mRs schn mn ahy th un (zl) ty llh jw Dmr hujy.
& jykDhn whn ty llh jw fDl & snds bjh nh hjy h (th `dhb thy'ywa h) & byshk llh twbh qbwl kndR Hikmt wrw ahy.

byshk jn kuwRw buhtn andw sy whn mn hk Twlw ahn, (whyn) un (buhtn) khy nh bhnyw th whn li (kw) mdw ahy, blk uhw whn li bhlw ahy, mnjhy'n sbhknhn mNhwa gnhn mn jyky kmyw sw snds li ahy, & mnjhy'n jnhn bhtn jw wDw luR mchyw tnhn li wDw `dhb ahy.
jDhn uhw budhw tDhn mw'mnn mRsn & mw'mnyNn zln pnhnjn (mNhn) +m chNw gmn cchwnh kyw & cchwnh chyy'wn th hyu pdhrw buhtn ahy?

& jykDhn llh jw fDl & snds bjh dny & akhrt +m whn ty nh hjy h th jnhn (Glh) bbt chrchw mchywa (tnhn bbt) whn khy (tDhn y'y) wDw `dhb phchy h.

chyy'wn th syn zwr wr & Dddh jngy jwn ahywn, & (sbhkw) km twkhy (ws +m) ahy pwi nhr th cch thy Hukm kryn.
chyy'yn th byshk bdshh jnhn mhl knhn Gwtth +m ghRnd ahn (tnhn mhl) un khy ujRynd ahn & un jy mna wrn khy by mnw knd ahn, & (sbhy'y bdshh) y'yn y'y knd ahn.
& byshk aun unhn Dnhn k swkhRy mwklyn thy pwi Dsn th qSd cch sn mwTn th.

pwi jnhn mhl sulymn wT (qSd) ayw (tnhn mhl slymn) chyw th whyn mwnkhy ml sn mdd Dyw th cch? jw jyky mwnkhy llh Dnw ahy sw nhya khn bhlw ahy jyky whn khy Dnw ths, blk whyn pnhnjn swGtn sn khwsh thyw th.
(sndn swGtn smyt) nhn Dnhn mwTy wny (syn) byshk hR kTk wTn aNyndswn jn jy smhwn thyN jy nhn khy k mjl nh hwndy & un hndhn khyn blkl by mnw kry kddhndsyn & uhy khwr hwnd.
(slymn) chyw th y srdrw' whn mn kyr nhn jy mslmn thy mwn wT chN khn G mwn wT snds tkht aNyndw?
jnan mn hkRy wDy jn chyw th twn pnhnjy ji tn uthyn tnhn khn Gy aun hw tw wT aNynds, & byshk aun mths wDw sghrw m`tbr ahyn.

(byw) shkhS jnhn wT ktb mn `lm hw (tnhn) chyw th tnhnjy ngh jy twDnhn mwTN khn Gy aun hw (tkht) tw wT aNynds, pwi jnhn mhl (slymn) uhw pN wT rkhyl Dtthw (tnhn mhl) chyy'yn th hyu mnhnjy plNhr jy fDl mn ahy, (hn li) th mwnkhy prkhy th shkr kryn thw y by shkry kryn thw, & jykw shkr kndw sw rGw pnhnjy (nf`y) li shkr kndw, & jnhn by shkry ky'y th mnhnjw plNhr by prwh krm kndR ahy.
(sulymn) chyw th un jy tkht khy un (jy azmy'sh) li mTyw th Dswn th sunyNy thy y unhn mn thy'y thy jyky nh snyNn?
pwi jnhn mhl (blqys) ay'y (tnhn mhl) chyw wyw th tnhnjw tkht hhRw ahy cch? chyy'yn th hyu dyNk uhwy'y ahy, & hn khn G (slymn jy schy'y bbt) sn khy dyNp Dny wy'y hy'y & syn Hkm mnyyndR ahywn.
& llh khnswi jnhnjy pwdy kndy hy'y tnhn khn khys (slymn) jhlyw, byshk uh kfrn jy qwm mn hy'y.

un khy chyw wyw th mHlt +m ghiR pwi uh jnhn mhl Dtthy'yn (tnhn mhl) un khy pNya jw tlu bhnyy'yn & pnhnjn pnyn tn kpRw lthy'yn, (slymn) chyw th h mHlt shyshn sn jR thyl ahy, chyy'yn th y mnhnj plNhr mwn pN ty Zlm kyw & (hNy) jhnn jy plNhr llh khy sulymn smyt mnyym.
& byshk thmwd (qwm) Dnhn sndn bhu SlH mwklywswn th llh jy `bdt kryw pwi uhy un mhl bh Twlywn thy jhGRw kndywn rhywn.
(SlH) chyw th y mnhnjy qwm whyn chNy'ya khn G tkRw `dhb cchw ghrnd ahyw? llh khn bkhshsh cchwnh th ghrw th mna whn ty rHm kyw wnyy.
chyy'wn th twkhy & tnhnjy sngt khy nbhGw smjhywswn, (SlH) chyw th whn jw nbhG llh wT ahy blk whyn qwm prkhbw'.
& (un) shhr +m naw dyN hw jy mulk +m Dphyr wjhnd hw & sudhrw nh knd hw.
unhn llh jw qsm khNy pN +m khNy chyw th SlH & snds ghr wrn khy rthw hNy mrywn wry snds wrth khy Drwr chwndswn th (syn) snds ghr wrn jy hlk thyN mhl HDr nh hwswn & byshk syn sch ahywn.
& hnn hkRy qsm jw fryb kyw & sn (bh) hkRy qsm jy rth rthy & uhy by khbr hw.
pwi (y pyGmbr) nhr th sndn fryb jy pcchRy khRy TrH thy jw sn khyn & sndn sry qwm khy ns kyw.
pwi unhya sbbn jw Zlm kyy'wn uhy sndn ghr ujRyl ahn, dyNndR qwm li byshk hn +m (wDy) nshny ahy.
& jn ymn andw & prhyzgry ky'y tn khy bchywswn.
& luwT khy (mwklywswn) jDhn pnhnjy qwm khy chyy'yn th whyn by Hyy'y (jw km) knd ahyw cch? & whyn Dsnd (bh) ahyw.
cch whyn zln khy cchDy mrdn Dnhn shhwt sn wynd ahyw, blk whyn jhl qwm ahyw.
tDhn sndn qwm jy wrndy rGw hya hy'y th chyy'wn th pnhnjy Gwtth mn luwT jy ghr wrn khy tRyw, cchw th uhy mNhw pk hjN ghrnd ahn.
pwi khys & snds ghr wrn khy bchywswn swi snds zl jy, jnhn khy pwi ty rhyln mn tthhrywsyn.
& mthn mynhn wsywswn, pwi Dydyyln jw mynhn bcchRw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th sbh srh llh khy jGy'y & snds nhn bnhn ty slm hjy jn khy psnd kyy'yn, llh bhlw ahy y uhw jnhn khy (uhy llh jw) shryk bNy'ynd ahn?

(nh blk pcchwn th) uhw kyr ahy jnhn asmnn & zmyn khy bNyw & whn li asmn mn pNy wsyw? pwi n sn (hr TrH j) rwnq wr bG dymyswn, unhn (bGn) jy wNn jy dymy'N jy whn khy k sgh nh hy'y llh sn kw byw m`bwd ahy cch? blk uhy (hRy qwm ahn jy sdhy rsty khn) Dngw hlnd ahn.

(nh blk pcchwn th thh) zmyn khy Tka wrw knhn kyw & un jy wch +m nhrwn (knhn) pyd kywn & mths jbl (knhn) pyd ky & bn dryy'n jy wch +m (knhn) wT bNy'y? llh sn kw byw m`bwd ahy cch? blk unhn mn ghN nh dyNnd ahn.

(nh blk pucchwn th th) `jz jy du` kyr qbwl kndw ahy jDhn (hw) llh khy sDyndw ahy? & (kyr) Dkh lhyndw ahy? & whn khy zmyn +m (kyr Gyn jw) wrth kndw ahy, llh sn kw byw m`bwd ahy cch? whyn thwry nSyHt wtthnd ahyw.

(nh blk pcchwn th th) whn khy br & bHr jy wndhyn +m kyr (sdhw) rstw Dykhryndw ahy? & pnhnjy bjh (mynhn) khn G khwshkhbry DyndR wy'n khy kyr ghly'yndw ahy? llh khnswi kw byw m`bwd ahy cch? (kfr) jyky shryk mqrr knd ahn tn khn llh tmm mthhwn ahy.

bhl ny'yn sr mkhlwq kyr bNy'yndw ahy wry byhr un khy bNy'yndw? & whn khy asmn & zmyn mn kyr rwzy Dyndw ahy? llh sn kw byw m`bwd ahy cch? (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th jykDhn whyn sch ahyw th pnhnjy Hujt aNyw.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th asmnn & zmyn +m jyky bh ahn sy llh khnswi Gjh nh dyNnd ahn, & nky dyNnd ahn th kDhn wry uthrbn.
blk sndn dyNp akhrt (jy nsbt) +m `jz thy py'y ahy, blk uhy khny's shk +m ahn, (nh!) blk (n jy smjh) khn ndh ahn.
& kfr chwnd ahn th jDhn syn mTy thyndswn & sn j pyu DD (bh tDhn bh) syn wry qbrn mn kddhbswn cch?
byshk sn khy & sn jy pyu DDn khy hn khn G nhya Glh jw anjm Dnw wyw ahy hyu rGw Gyn jwn akhNywn ahn.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th zmyn +m guhmw & Dsw th ghnhgrn jy pcchRy khRy TrH thy hy'y.
& (y pyGmbr) mthn Dkh nh kr & sndn fryb krN khn khfgya +m nh rh.
& chwnd ahn th jykDhn whyn sch ahyw th hw njm kDhn thyndw.
(khyn) chw' th jyky tkRw ghrnd ahyw tnhn mn kjh mtn whn jy putthya pwyn (wyjhw) hjy.
& byshk tnhnjw plNhr mNhn ty fDl krN wrw ahy pr ghN mNhw shkr nh knd ahn.
& sndn syn jyky lky'ynd & jyky pdhrw knd ahn sw tnhnjw plNhr byshk dyNndw ahy.
& asmn & zmyn +m hRy k (shy) Gjhy nh ahy j pdhry ktb +m (lkhyl) nh ahy.
byshk hy qran bny sry'yln khy ghNywn Glhywn uhy Glhywn byn kndw ahy jn bbt uhy tkrr knd hw.
& byshk ihw muw'mn li hdyt & bjh ahy.
byshk tnhnjw plNhr pnhnjy Hukm sn sndn wch +m nbyrw kndw, & uhw Glb dyNndR ahy.
pwi (y pyGmbr twn) llh ty bhrwsw kr, byshk twn pdhry schy (dyn) ty ahyn.
byshk twn nky muy'n khy budhy'y sghndyn & nky bwRn khy sD bdhy'y sghndyn jDhn (hw) ptthy Dyy'y phrn.
& nky twn ndhn khy sndn gmrhya khn (mwTN li) sidhw rstw DykhryndR ahyn, (twn) ruGw nhya khy bdhy'yndyn jykw sn jy aytn ty ymn aNyndw pwi uhy frmnbrdr ahn.
& jDhn mthn (`dhb jw) njm lzm thyndw (tDhn) nhn li hk jnwr zmyn mn kddhndswn jw sNn Glhy'yndw nhya kry jw mNhw sn jy aytn ty yqyn nh rkhnd hw.
& unhy Dynhn jw sbhknhn umWt mn hRya Twlya khy khRw kndswn jnhn sn jy aytn khy kuwRw dytw thy pwi uhy (hkby'y jy phchN ty'yn) byhry wynd.
tn jw jDhn (sbh) ynd (tDhn llh) chwndw th whn mnhnjn aytn khy cchw kwR dytw hw & nhn khy whn smjhw bh nh huyw y (chw' th) whn khRw km kyw thy?
& sndn Zlm krN sbbn mthn (`dhb jw) njm lzm thy chukw pwi uhy (mNhw) Glhy'y nh sghnd.
nh Dtthw thn cch th sn rt khy (hn li) pyd kyw th mnjhs arm wtthn & Dynhn khy rwshn (bNywswn), byshk hn +m mnyyndR qwm li (mnhnjy qdrt jwn) nshnywn ahn.
& (yd kryw) jnhn Dynhn Suwr +m phwkbw (tnhn Dynhn) jyky asmnn +m ahn & jyky zmyn +m ahn sy sbhy'y ghbry'ynd pr jn li llh ghryw (sy nh ghbry'ynd), & sbhkw wTn khwr thyl yndw.
& twn jbln khy Dsyn thw nhn khy (zmyn) +m muHkm bhy'yn thw? Hlnk uhy kkrn jy hlN jn hlnd, ih (unhy) llh jy jwR ahy jnhn sbhknhn shy khy muHkm rkhyw, byshk jyky knd ahyw tnhnjy uhw khbr rkhndR ahy.
jykw nyky aNyndw tnhn li un khn bhlw (bdlw) ahy, & uhy un Dynhn ghbry'N khn mn wr hwnd.
& jykw mdy'y aNyndw pwi tn j mnhn bh +m wndh kry wjhb, (chyw wyndni) th jyky knd huyw' tnhn khnswi kw bdlw nh thw Djywa.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th mwn khy th (hyu) Hukm kyl ahy th hn shhr jy plNhr jy `bdt kryn jnhn un khy t`Zym wrw kyw & sbhk shy snds ahy & mwnkhy Hukm kyl ahy th muslmnn mn hujn.
& (hyu) qran pRhn, pwi jykw hdyt wrw thyw sw rGw pN li hdyt wrw thy'y thw, & jykw gmrh thyw th chw' th aun rGw DydyryndR ahyn.
& chw' th sbh srh llh khy jGy'y (uhw) whn khy pnhnjwn nshnywn sghw Dykhryndw pwi jnkhy whyn sunyNndw', & jyky knd ahyw tnhn khn whn jw plNhr by khbr nh ahy.
TsmW.
hy pdhry ktb jwn aytwn ahn.
(y pyGmbr) muws~ & fr`wn jw kujh Hwl mw'mn mNhn (jy bdhy'N) li twkhy schya TrH pRhy bdhywn th.

byshk fr`wn mulk +m wDy'y ky'y hy'y & n jy rhN wrn khy Twlywn Twlywn kry cchDyw hwy'yn mnjhy'n hk Twlya khy hyNw kyw hwy'yn jw sndn puT kuhndw hw & sndn dhyy'rwn jyy'rywn cchDyndw hw, byshk uhw fsdyn mn hw.
& ghurywswn th jn khy mulk +m hyNw kyw wyw tn ty iHsn krywn & khyn srdr bNywn & khyn wrth krywn.
& khyn mulk +m dbdbw Dywn & fr`wn & hmn & sndn lshkrn khy unhn (hyNn) khn uh (Glh) Dykhrywn jnhn khn Ddynd hw.
& muws~ jy mu Dnhn ilhm kywswn th un khy khiyr pyr, jDhn hn jy li Ddyyn tDhn khys drya +m ucchlj & nky Ddyj & nky Gmgyn thij, cchwth syn khys twDnhn wry'N wr ahywn & khys pyGmbrn mn krN wr ahywn.
pwi fr`wn jy ghrNy wrn un khy jhTyw th (nytth) unhn li wyry & Dkh jw sbb thy'y, cchwth fr`wn & hmn & sndn lshkr khT kndR hw.
& fr`wn jy zl chyw th (hyu cchwkr) mnhnjy li & tnhnjy li khyn jw tthr ahy, un khy nh kuhw, mna sn khy nf`w Dy'y y khys puT krywn & uhy (un jy Hl jy Hqyqt) nh dyNnd hw.
& muws~ jy mu jy dil by qrr thy, byshk n Glh khy stt y'y pdhrw kry h jykDhn snds dl ty syn bndsh nh krywn h hin li th wshndRn mn thy'y.
& muws~ jy bhyN khy chyy'yn th snds pyrw khN, pwi (uh) un khy pry khn Dsndy rhy & unhn nh thy dytw.
& (bhyNs jy phchN khn) G mths dy'yn jw khyr Hrm kywswn pwi bhyNs chyw th (aun) whn khy hRw ghrNw Dsyn jw (uhy) whn jy prn un jy snbhl kn? & uhy un j ghN ghr hjn.
pwi khys snds mu Dnhn wry phchywsyn th snds khywn tthrn & Gmgyn nh thy'y & (hy bh) dyNy th byshk llh jw njm schw ahy pr ghN mNhw nh dyNnd ahn.
& jnhn mhl pnhnjy jwnya khy phtw & pkhtw thyw (tnhn mhl) khys dny'y & `ilm Dnwswn, & hRy TrH bhlrn khy chNw bdlw Dynd ahywn.

& (mws~) shhr +m uty jy rhkn jy Gflt jy wqt dkhl thyw pwi ty bh mRs pN +m wRhndy Dtthy'yn, hy (hkRw) snds qwm mn hw & hy (byw) snds wyrya (fr`wn jy qwm) mn hw, pwi jykw snds qwm mn hw tnhn unhya ty hmrhy ghry jykw snds wyry (jy qwm) mn hw pwi muws~ n khy muk hny'y & un khy pwrw kyy'yn, chyy'yn th hy shyTn jy km mn ahy, byshk uhw pdhrw gmrh kndR wyry ahy.
chyy'yn th y mnhnj plNhr byshk mwn pN ty Zlm kyw tnhnkry mwn khy bkhsh pwi khys bkhshyy'yn, byshk uhw bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
chyy'yn th y mnhnj plNhr jykw mwn ty fDl kyw thy'y tnhn sbbn Dwhryn jw mddgr kDhn nh thynds.
pwi SubH ty'yn shhr +m DdyndR mntZr rhyw th wchtw jnhn khny's mdd ghry hy'y tnhn khny's (wry) mdd ghry, muws~ khys chyw th twn pdhrw by rhw ahyn.

pwi jykw bnhy jw wyry hw tnhn Dnhn (mws~) jnhn mhl hth DghyrN jw rdw kyw (tnhn mhl fryd kndR muws~ khy pN ty snbryl Dsy) chyw th y muws~ jy'n klh hkRy mNhwa khy kutthy'y ty'n mwn khy (bh) kuhN jw rdw kryn thw cch? mulk +m zbrdst thyN khnswi tnhnjw byw kw rdw nh ahy twn sudhryndRn mn hujN nh thw ghuryn.
& hk mRs shhr jy pryn psy khn DwRndw ayw, chyy'yn th y muws~ byshk (htwn j) srdr twli rth kn th th twkhy kuhn tnhnkry nykry wny byshk aun twli khyr ghrndRn mn ahyn.
pwi (muws~) Ddyndw ntZr kddhndw un (shhr) mn nktw, chyy'yn th y mnhnj plNhr Zlmn jy qwm khn mwnkhy bchi.
& jnhn mhl mdyn (shhr) jy Trf mnhn kyy'yn (tnhn mhl) chyy'yn th umyd thm th mnhnjw plNhr mwn khy sdhy wT Dykhryndw.

& jnhn mhl mdyn jy tR ty phtw (tnhn mhl) un mNhn jy hk Twly (jnwrn khy) pNy pyryndy Dtthy'yn, & unhn khnswi bh zlwn (bh pnhnjw dhN pNy pyN khn) jhlyndy Dtthy'yn, (muws~) chyw th whn jw khRw km ahy? chyy'wn th (syn) ysyn (pnhnjy dhN khy pNy) nh pyryndywn syn jysyn dhnr (pnhnj jnwr pyry nh) mwTy'yn, & sn jw pyu wDw bddhRw ahy.
pwi unhn (jy dhN) khy pNy pyryy'yn wry (rhN li) pcchy Dnhn phiryw pwi chyy'yn th y mnhnj plNhr byshk jyky mwn Dnhn chNy'ya mn mwklyi tnhn li aun muHtj ahyn.

pwi mnjhy'n hkRy ldy sn ghmndy wTs ay'y, chyy'yn th mnhnjw pyu twkhy hn li sDy thw th jykw sn (jy dhN) khy pNy pyryy'y tnhnjy mzwry twkhy Dy, pwi jnhn mhl wTs ayw & srw qSWw wTs byn kyy'yn (tnhn mhl sh`yb) chyw th nh Ddy, (hNy) Zlm qwm khn cchuTyn.
mnjhy'n hk chyw th y b hn khy mzwr kry rkh, cchwth bhlw (nwkr) jnhn khy mzwr kry rkhyn uhw ahy jw sghrw m`tbr hjy.

(sh`yb) chyw th mnhnjw rdw ahy th hnn pnhnjn bn dhyy'n mn hk hn shrT ty twkhy prNyn th atth sl mnhnjy mzwry kryn, & jykDh Dh (wrh) pwr kndyn th uhw tnhnjy pr khn (Hsn) ahy & aun twty (k) wkhy'y krN nh thw ghrn, jykDhn llh ghryw th mwn khy khyr ghrn mn Dsndyn.
(muws~) chyw th mnhnjy & tnhnjy wch +m hw (njm) ahy, nhn bnhy mdtn mn k pwry'y kryn th mwn ty kw zwr nh hwndw, & jyky chy'wn th tnhn ty llh shhd (bs) ahy.

pwi jnhn mhl muws~ (h) mudWt pwry ky'y & pnhnjy ghr wrn khy wtthy hlyw (tnhn mhl wch rsty +m kwh) Twr jy psy Dnhn bh Dtthy'yn, pnhnjy ghr wrn khy chyy'yn th trsw byshk mwn bh Dtthy ahy umyd thm th uthwn k khbr y kw bh jw TnDw whn wT aNynds th mna whyn pN sykyw.
pwi jDhn unhya (bh) wT ayw (tDhn) mydn jy sdyy bhr khn mubrk ji & wN mn sDyw wyw th y muws~ byshk aun jhnn jw plNhr ahyn.
& twn pnhnjy ltth ucchl, pwi jnhn mhl un khy chrndw Dtthy'yn dyNk uh nng ahy (tnhn mhl) ptthyrw thy mnhn mwRyy'yn & pwy'ty nh mwTyw, (chywswn th) y mws~ wry ch & nh Ddy, jw byshk twn mn wrn mn ahyn.

pnhnjw hth grybn +m ghyR th by `yb chmkndR thy nkry, & khwf khn (tslWy thyN li) pnhnjwn bnhwn pN Dnhn gD pwi uhy by'y HujWtwn fr`wn & snds lshkr Dnhn tnhnjy plNhr (jy Trf) khn ahn, byshk uhy bdkr mNhw hw.
chyy'yn th y mnhnj plNhr byshk mnjhy'n hk shkhS khy mwn mryw ahy tnhnkry aun pnhnjy mrjN khn Ddyn thw.
& mnhnjw bhu hrwn mwn khn zbn jy kry wdhyk chTw Glhy'yndR ahy tnhnkry un khy mwn sn mdd DyndR kry mwkl th mnhnjy tSdyq kry cchwth aun pnhnjy kwRy thyN khn Ddyn thw.
(llh) chyw th sighw tnhnj bzw tnhnjy bhu sn muHkm kndswn & whn khy Glbw Dyndswn pwi (uhy) whn Dnhn (ydha li) phchy nh sghnd, & snjy pdhrn m`jzn sbbn, whyn by'y & jyky whn jy putthyn lG sy Glb rhnd.
pwi jnhn mhl muws~ sn jy pdhrn m`jzn sn wTn ayw (tnhn mhl) chyy'wn th hy rGw tthhwkw jdw ahy & ih Glh pnhnjn phryn pyu DDn +m nh budhy swn.
& muws~ chyw th mnhnjw plNhr unhya khy wdhyk dyNndw ahy jnhn wTny's hdyt andy ahy & jnhn li (akhrt +m) mwchry `qbt jw ghr ahy, byshk Zlm nh cchuTnd.
& fir`wn chyw th y srdrw' mwn whn li pN khnswi kw byw m`bwd nh dytw ahy, pwi y hmn mwn li srn jw (khwrw) br pwi mwn li hk mRy bNi th mn mws~ jy m`buwd Dnhn chRhn & aun byshk khys kuwRn mn bhnyn thw.
& un (fr`wn) & snds lshkr nHq mulk +m wDy'y ky'y & bhnyy'wn th uhy sn Dnhn nh mwTy'b.
pwi khys & snds lshkrn khy pkRywswn & pwi khys smnD +m ucchlywswn, pwi Ds th Zlmn jy pcchRy khRy TrH thy.
& sn uhy (dwzkhyn j GwN) bNy jw (mNhn) khy bh Dnhn sDynd hw, & qymt jy Dynhn mdd nh Dbyn.
& hn dny +m l`nt sndn pwy'tn lthy swn, & qymt jy Dynhn uhy bucchRn mn hwnd.
& byshk muws~ khy ktb Dnwswn un khn pwi jw phryn juGn khy hlk kywswn jw (uhw) mNhn li chiTw dlyl & hdyt kndR & bjh hw th mna uhy nSyHt wtthn.
& (y pyGmbr twn tDhn) ulhndy psy khn nh hy'yn jDhn muws~ Dnhn waHy mwklywswn & nky (twn uty) HDrn mn huy'yn.
pr kytry'y juG (muws~ khnpwi) pyd kyswn pwi mthn mudt Dghy gdhry, & nky (twn) mdyn wrn +m rhndR hy'yn jw sn jwn khyn aytwn pRhy bdhyy'y thy pr syn (pyGmbrn) khy mwklynd rhyswn.
& nky (twn kwh) Twr jy psy huy'yn jDhn mws~ khy sDywswn pr tnhnjy plNhr jy bjh twty (hn li thyl) ahy th twn unhy qwm khy Dydyryn jn wT twkhn G kw DydyryndR nh ayw th mna uhy nSyHt wtthn.

& jykDhn y'yn nh hjy h th sndn hthn jyky Gy mwklyw ahy tnhnjy sbb unhn ty jDhn muSybt phchy tDhn (mtn) chwn th y sn j plNhr sn Dnhn kw pyGmbr cchwnh mwklyy'y th tnhnjn aytn j tb`dr bNjwn h & mw'mnn mn hjwn h (th twkhy nh mwklywn h).

pwi jnhn mhl sn wTn unhn wT schw (wHy) ayw (tnhn mhl) chwN lG th jhRw (m`jzw) muws~ khy Dnw wyw thRw hn pyGmbr khy cchwnh Dnw wyw ahy, jyky Gy muws~ khy Dnw wyw tnhn jw nkr nh kyw thn cch? (hNy) chwn th th (twryt & qran) by'y hk jhR jdw ahn, & chwn th th syn hr hk j munkr ahywn.
(khyn) chw' th jykDhn sch ahyw th llh wTn kw ktb aNyw jw nhn bnhy khn wdhyk sdhw rstw DykhryndR hjy th un jy tb`dry kryn.

pwi jykDhn tnhnjy Glh qbwl nh kn th dyN th uhy rGw pnhnjn sadhn ty hlnd ahn, & jykw llh jy rsty DykhrN khnswi pnhnjy sadh ty hly tnhn khn wdhyk gmrh kyr ahy, byshk llh Zlmn jy qwm khy sidhw rstw nh Dykhryndw ahy.
& byshk hn qran khy nhn li lGwlG mwklywswn th mna uhy nSyHt wtthn.
jn khy hn (qran) khn G ktn Dnw thwn sy un (qran) khy mnyynd ahn.
& jDhn khyn (hyu qran) pRhy bdhy'bw ahy (tDhn) chwnd ahn th un ty ymn andwswn byshk uhw sn jy plNhr wTn schw ahy byshk sn un (jy nzl thyN) khn Gyy'y muslmn hwswn.
ihy uhy ahn jn khy sndn ajr bh bhyr Dbw nhy kry jw Sbr kyy'wn & mdy'y khy chNy'y sn Trynd ahn & jyk khyn rwzy Dny thwn tnhn mn khrchynd ahn.
& jDhn k byhwdy Glh bdhnd ahn (tDhn) un khn munhn mwRynd ahn & chwnd ahn th sn j km sn li ahn & whn j km whn li ahn, whn ty slm hjy, syn jhln (jy sngt) khy nh th ghrwn.
(y pyGmbr) byshk twn jnhn khy ghryn tnhn khy hdyt kry nh thw sghyn pr llh jnhn khy ghrndw ahy tnhn khy hdyt kndw ahy, & uhw hdyt wrn khy chNy TrH dyNndR ahy.

& (ky) chwnd ahn th jykDhn twsN hdyt jy tb`dry kndswn th pnhnjy mulk mn tRjy wyndswn, khyn Hrm +m mn sn nh Tkyswn cch? jw un Dnhn sbhknhn jns jw myww pN wTn rwzya TrH phchy'bw ahy pr unhn mn ghN (mNhw) nh dyNnd ahn.
& Gwtthn mn kytry'y wyrn kyswn jy pnhnjy gdhrn +m Hd khn lnghy hw, pwi uhy sndyn rhN jwn jywn ahn unhn khnpwi kn thwrRn (wqtn) khnswi (uty) rhywy'y kwnh ahy, & akhr syn (y'y) wrth hwswn.

& (y pyGmbr) tnhnjw plNhr Gwtthn khy (ysyn) kDhn bh ns krN wrw nh ahy jysyn un jy knhn wDy shhr +m kw pyGmbr (nh) mwkly jw sn jwn aytwn khyn pRhy bdhy'y, & Gwtthn khy kDhn bh ns krN wr nh ahywn swi n Hlt jy jw sndn rhN wr Zlm hjn.
& hr hk jns mn jyky whn khy Dnw wyw ahy sw duny jy Hytya jw smn & n jw syngr ahy, & jyky llh wT ahy sw bhlw & sdy'yn rhN wrw ahy, pwi cchwnh smjh rkhnd ahyw?
bhl jnhn khy chNw n`m Dnwswn uhw hw lhN wrw ahy sw unhy jhRw ahy cch jnhn khy dny jy smn sn aswdw kywswn wry uhw qymt jy Dynhn (`dhb +m) HDr kyln mn hjy?
& jnhn Dynhn (llh) khyn sDy chwndw th munhnj uhy shryk kthy ahn jn khy whyn (mwn jahRw) bhy'ynd hyw'.

(n Dynhn) jn ty `dhb (jw Hukm) lzm thy chkw hwndw sy chwnd th y snj plNhr hy uhy ahn jn khy gmrh kywswn, jhRw pN gmrh thyswn thRw khyn (bh) gmrh kywswn, (hNy sbhny khn) tnhnjy aDw byzr thywn th, uhy sn khy nh pwdyynd hw.
& chyw wyndw th pnhnjn shrykn khy sDyw pwi khyn sDynd th uhy khyn wrndy nh Dynd & `dhb Dsnd, (tDhn sadh knd th) jykr dny +m hdyt wr hjwn h.
& jnhn Dynhn (llh) khyn sDyndw pwi chwndw th whn pyGmbrn khy khRy wrndy Dny.
pwi un Dynhn (sbh) Glhywn khyn bhuljy wyndywn pwi uhy pN +m (bh) nh pcchnd.
pwi jnhn twbh ky'y & ymn andw & chN km ky sw umyd ahy th cchTln mn thyndw.

& (y pyGmbr) tnhnjw plNhr jyky ghrndw ahy sw khlqyndw ahy (& jnhn khy ghrndw tnhn khy) psnd kndw ahy, nhn khy kw khtyr kwnhy, llh khy pky'y ahy & jnhn khy sNs shryk maqrWr knd ahn tnhn khn tmm mthhwn ahy.
& sndn siyn jyky lky'ynd ahn & jyky pN pdhrw knd ahn sw tnhnjw plNhr dyNndw ahy.
& uhw llh ahy un khnswi kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, duny & akhrt +m snds srh ahy, & snds y'y Hkwmt ahy & Dnhs whn khy mwTy'bw.
(khyn) chw' th Dsw th shyn jykDhn llh whn ty qymt jy Dynhn ty'yn hmyshh rt (qy'm) kry th llh khnswi (byw) khRw m`bwd ahy jw whn wT swjhrw aNyndw, pwi nh bdhnd ahyw cch?
chw' th Dsw th shyn th jykDhn llh whn ty qymt jy Dynhn twNy hmyshh Dynhn (qy'm) kry th llh khnswi (byw) khRw m`bwd ahy jw whn wT rt aNyndw jnhn +m whyn arm wtthw, pwi whyn nh th Dsw cch?
& pnhnjy bjh sn whn li rt & Dynhn bNyy'yn th whyn mnjhs arm wtthw & snds fDl mn (rwzy) Tlb kryw & th mna whyn shkrnw kryw.
& jnhn Dynhn (llh) khyn sDy chwndw th uhy mnhnj shryk kthy ahn jn khy whyn (mwn jhRw) bhy'ynd hyw'?
& hr hk Twlya mn shhd jud kndsyn & chwndsyn th pnhnjw dlyl pysh kryw pwi uhy dyNnd th byshk Hq llh jy psy ahy & jykw tthh tthhynd hw sw khny'n bhuly wyndw.

byshk qrwn muws~ jy qwm mn hw pwi mthn shrrt krN lGw, & khys khznn mn ytrw Dnw hwswn jw snds knjyn sgh wry Twlya khy thakyw thy, jDhn snds qwm khys chyw th (ml Dsy) nh marku cchwth llh marka kndRn khy dwst nh rkhndw ahy.

& llh twkhy jyky Dnw ahy tnhn sn akhrt jy ghr jy bhly'y Tlb kr & dny mn pnhnjw (nyk `ml krN jw) HSWw nh wsr & jhRy TrH llh twsn chNy'y ky'y ahy thRy TrH (twn snds khlq sn) chNy'y kr & zmyn +m fsd wjhN nh ghur, cchwth llh fsd krN wrn khy dwst nh rkhndw ahy.

(qrwn) chyw th uhw (ghNwml) th rGw hk hunr sn jw mwn wT ahy mwn khy mlyw ahy, nh dytw hwy'yn cch th byshk llh khny's G (uhy) kytry'y juG ns kry cchDy hw jyky khny's Dddhy sgh wr & ghNy jm`yWt wr hw, & Dwhryn khn sndn Dwhn bbt (`dhr) nh pcchbw.
pwi (hk Dynhn) pnhnjy qwm jy smhwn pnhnjy syngr sn nktw, jyky dny jy Hyty ghRnd hw tn chyw th hy rmn hRw (ml) jykr sn khy (bh) hjy h jhRw qrwn khy Dnw wyw ahy byshk uhw wDy nSyb wrw ahy.
& jn khy `lm Dnw wyw tn chyw th whn li khrby hujy llh jw thwb unhya mNhwa li bhalw ahy jnhn ymn andw & chN km ky, ih (Glh) Sbrn khnswi (by'y) knhnjy dl +m nh gihRndy ahy.
pwi khys & snds ghr khy zmyn +m Ghywswn, pwi llh khnswi k Twly un li knh hy'y j khys mdd Dy'y, & nky pN wyr wtthN wrn mn hw.

& jn klh snds mrtby jy sadh thy ky'y sy SbH jw chwN lG th `jb ahy th llh pnhnjn bnhn mn jnhn li ghrndw ahy (tnhnjy) rwzy kshdy kndw ahy & tng kndw ahy, jykDhn llh sn ty Hsn nh kry h th sn khy (bh zmyn +m) Ghy'y cchDy h, nh dytw thyy'y th kfrn khy cchwTkrw nh ahy.
ihw akhrt jw ghr ahy jnhn khy sn nhn li mqrr kyw ahy jyky mulk +m wDy'y nh knd ahn & nky fsd wjhN (ghrnd ahn), & (chNy) `qbt prhyzgrn li ahy.
jykw chNy'y aNyndw tnhn li un khn bhlw (bdlw) ahy, & jykw mdy'y aNyndw th mdy'yn krN wr rGw uh sz lhnd jyky kyy'wn thy.
byshk jnhn (llh) twty qran nzl kyw sw mwTN jy ji Dnhn twkhy Drwr mwTy'N wrw ahy, chw' th jnhn hdyt andy tnhn khy mnhnjw plNhr chNw dyNndR ahy & unhya khy bh jykw pdhrya gmrhy +m ahy.
& twkhy kw asrw nh hw th tw Dnhn (hyu) ktb lhbw pr tnhnjy plNhr jy bjh sn (lthw wyw) pwi kfrn jw mddgr hrgz nh thj.
& (y pyGmbr) twkhy llh jy aytn (jy phchy'N) khn un pnyN jw tw Dnhn mwklywn wywn (kfr) nh jhlyn & pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn (mNhn) khy sD, & mshrkn mn kDhn nh thyu.
& llh sn gD by'y knhn khy m`bwd (smjhy) nh sD, un khnswi kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, snds dht khnswi sbhk shy ns thyN wry ahy, sbhkw Hukm un jw y'y ahy & Dnhs mwTy wyndw'.
lmW.
mNhn bhnyw ahy cch th sndn (rGw ytry) chwN ty th ymn andwswn uhy cchDy Db & uhy nh azmy'b?
& jyky khny'n G hw tn khy byshk prkhywswn pwi jyky sch ahn tn khy llh Drwr dhr kndw & kuwRn khy (bh) Drwr dhr kndw.
jyky bcchRywn kn th tn bhnyw ahy cch th sn khwn Gty nkry wynd? jykw nbyrw kn th sw bcchRw ahy.
jykw llh jy mlN jy myd rkhndw ahy (sw smjhy) th byshk llh jy tthhryl mudt Drwr chNy ahy, & uhw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
& jykw (llh jy dyn li) kwshsh kry sw rGw pnhnjy li y'y kwshsh kry thw, cchwth llh jhnn khn by prwh ahy.
& jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn khn sndn mdywn Drwr myTynd swn & jyky knd hw tnhn jw khyn Dddhw chNw bdlw Dyndswn.

& mNhwa khy pnhnjy mu pyu sn chNy'y krN jw Hukm kywswn, & (y mNhw) jykDhn (uhy) mwn sn knhn khy shryk krN jy twkhy kwshsh kn jnhn (jy Hqyqt) jy twkhy k dyNp nh ahy th unhn jw chyw nh mny, whn jw mwn Dnhn mwTN ahy tnhnkry jyky knd hyw' tnhnjy whn khy sudh Dynds.
& jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn khy SlHn (jy Twlya) +m Drwr dkhl kndswn.

& mNhn mn ky (hR) ahn jy chwnd ahn th llh ty ymn andw thwn pwi jDhn llh (jy wT) +m un khy kw ydhu phchyw wyndw ahy (tDhn) mNhn jy ydhy'N khy llh jy `dhb wngr smjhndw ahy, & jykDhn tnhnjy plNhr wTn k mdd yndy ahy th chwnd ahn th byshk syn whn sN hwswn, jyky jhn (wrn) jy dlyn +m ahy sw llh chNy TrH dyNndR nh ahy cch?
& th jn ymn andw ahy tn khy llh dhr kndw ahy & mnfqn khy bh dhr kndw.
& kfr mw'mnn khy chwn th (whyn) sn jy wT jy tb`dry kryw & (syn) whn jwn mdywn khNndsyn, Hlnk uhy sndyn mdyn mn kjh bh khNN wr nh ahn, byshk uhy kuwR ahn.
& pnhnjn (gnhn jwn) GtthRywn & (bywn kyy'y) GtthRywn pnhnjn gnhn sn DrwrkhNnd, & jykw tthh tthhynd ahn tnhn bbt qymt jy Dynhn Drwr pcchy wynd.
& byshk nwH khy snds qwm Dnhn mwklywswn & pwi pnjh wrh ghT (hk) hzr sl mnjhn rhyw, pwi khyn Twfn pkRyw & uhy Zlm hw.
pwi khys & byRya wrn khy (bDN khn) bchywswn & un (byRya) khy jhn (wrn) li nshny kywswn.
& brhym khy (mwklywswn) jDhn pnhnjy qwm khy chyy'yn th llh jy `bdt kryw & khny's Ddyw, hw whn li bhlw ahy jykDhn whyn dyNnd ahyw.

whyn th llh khnswi butn khy pwdyynd ahyw & whyn (kwRw) tthh tthhynd ahyw, byshk llh khnswi jn khy pwdyynd ahyw sy th whn khy rwzy (DyN) jy (ky) mlk nh ahn tnhnkry llh wTn rzq Tlb kryw & snds `bdt kryw & snds shkrnw kryw, Dnhs mwTy wyndw'.
& jykDhn kwRw bhnyw th th (cch thyw) byshk whn khn G (kytryn) umtn (pnhnjn pyGmbrn khy) kwRw bhnyw hw, & pyGmbr ty pdhry pyGm phchy'N khnswi (byw ky rkhyl) nh ahy.
nh Dtthw thn cch th llh khlq khy khRy TrH ny'yn sir bny'yndw ahy? wry byhr un khy bNy'yndw, byshk ihw (km) llh ty asn ahy.
(khyn) chw' th mulk +m ghmw pwi nZr kryw th llh ky'n ny'yn sir khlq khy pyd kyw wry un pyd kyl khy llh byhr pyd kndw, cchwth llh sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
jnhn khy wNys tnhn khy `dhb kry & jnhn ty wNys rHm kry, & (whyn) Dnhs mwTy wyndw'.
& whyn nky zmyn +m & nky asmn +m `jz krN wr ahyw, & whn jw llh khnswi nkw sdyN & nkw mddgr ahy.
& jn llh jy aytn & snds mlN jw nkr kyw sy mnhnjy bjh khn n umyd thy ahn & unhn li y'y Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.
pwi brhym jy qwm jy wrndy hn chwN khnswi (by) knh hy'y th un khy kuhw y un khy sRyw pwi llh khys bh khn bchyw, byshk hn (Hwl) +m mnyyndR qwm li wDywn nshnywn ahn.

& (brhym) chyw th whn dny jy Hytya +m rGw pN +m dwstya jy kry llh khnswi btn khy khtyr kyw ahy, wry qymt jy Dynhn whyn hk by'y jw nkr kndw' & whn mn hkR byn ty l`nt knd, & whn jy ji dwzkh ahy & whn jw kwbh mddgr nh ahy.
pwi brhym ty luwT ymn andw, & (brhym) chyw th byshk aun pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn wTn cchDN wrw ahyn, byshk uhw Glb Hkmt wrw ahy.
& un khy sHq & y`qwb bkhshywswn & snds wld +m pyGmbry & ktb mqrr kywswn & khys dny +m snds jr Dnwswn, & byshk uhw akhrt +m (bh) SlHn mn ahy.
& luwT khy (pyGmbr kry mwklywswn) jDhn pnhnjy qwm khy chyy'yn th whyn uhw by Hyy'y jw km knd ahyw jw jhn wrn mn knhn hk (bh) hw whn khn G nh kyw ahy.
cch whyn mRsn Dnhn (shhwt sn) wynd ahyw & wT ty phur knd ahyw, & pnhnjn mjlsn +m bd km knd ahyw? pwi snds qwm jy wrndy hn chwN khn swi nh hy'y th jykDhn schn mn ahyn th llh jw `dhb sn wT aN.
(luwT) chyw th y mnhnj plNhr mwn khy fsdyn jy qwm ty mdd Dy.
& jnhn mhl sn jy qSdn brhym wT khwshkhbry andy (tnhn mhl) chyy'wn th syn hn Gwtth wrn khy ns krN wr ahywn, cchwth uty jy rhN wr Zlm (thy) ahn.
(brhym) chyw th byshk un +m luwT ahy, chyy'wn th jykw bh mnjhs ahy tnhn khy syn chNw dyNndR ahywn, khys & snds ghr jy bhtyn khy Drwr bchy'yndswn swi sndys zl jy j bqy rhyln mn thyndy.

& jnhn mhl sn j qSd luwT wT ay tnhn mhl nhn jy (chN) sbbn nrD thyw & unhn jy (chN) sbbn dl tng thyw & (unhn) chyw th nky Ddy & nky Gm khu, byshk syn twkhy & tnhnjy ghr jy bhtyn khy bchy'N wr ahywn swi tnhnjy zl jy j bqy rhyln mn thyndy.
byshk syn hn Gwtth wrn ty hk `dhb nhy sbbn asmn khn lhN wr ahywn jw bdkr thy ahn.
& byshk un Gwtth jy pdhry nshny smjhndR qwm li cchDy swn.
& mdyn (wrn) Dnhn sndn bhu sh`yb khy mwklywswn pwi chyy'yn th y mnhnjy qwm llh jy `bdt kryw & qymt jy Dynhn jy umyd rkhw & fsdy thy mulk +m nh phirw.
pwi un khy kwRw bhnyy'wn tnhnkry khyn zlzly chy wrtw pwi pnhnjn ghrn +m wndh thy (mry) py.
& `d & thmwd khy (chT kywswn) & byshk sndyn kn jyn mn whn khy pdhrw thy chkw ahy, & shyTn unhn li sndn `ml syngry hw pwi khyn sidhy wT khn jhlyy'yn & (uhy) smjh wr (bh) hw.
& qrwn & fr`wn & hmn khy (bh chT kywswn), & byshk muws~ pdhrn m`jzn sn wTn ayw pwi mulk +m wDy'y kyy'wn & (Gty) wdhy wyndR nh hw.

pwi sbhknhn khy snds gnh sbbn pkRywswn, pwi mnjhny'n kn ty skht andhy mwkly swn, & mnjhny'n kn khy kRky (chy) wrtw, & mnjhny'n kn khy zmyn +m Ghywswn, & mnjhny'n kn khy bwRywswn, & kDhn thyNw nh hw jw llh mthn Zlm kry pr hnn pnhnjw pN ty Zlm thy kyw.
jn llh khnswi by dwst wrt ahn tn jw mthl kwryy'Ry jy mthl wngr ahy, jnhn ghr tthhyw, & byshk sbhny ghrn +m wdhyk hyNw kwryy'Ry jw ghr ahy, jykDhn (h Glh) dyNn h (th y'yn nh kn h).
byshk jnhn shy khy llh khnswi pwdyynd ahn s jyk bh hjy tnhn khy llh dyNndw ahy, & uhw Glb Hkmt wrw ahy.
& hy mthl ahn jn khy mNhn li byn knd ahywn, & nhn khy dyNndRn khnswi kwnh smjhndw ahy.
llh asmnn & zmyn khy (chNy) rith sn khlqyw ahy, byshk in (km) +m mw'mnn li (wDy) nshny ahy.
(y pyGmbr) ktn mn jyky twDnhn wHy kyw wyw sw pRh & nmz pRh, byshk nmz by Hyy'y & mady km (krN) khn jhlyndy ahy, byshk llh jw yd krN sbh khn wDw ahy, & jyky knd ahyw sw llh dyNndw ahy.

& ktb wrn mn jn by nSfy ky'y tn khnswi byn sn Dddhy chNy Tryqy khnswi tkrr nh kryw & chy'w th jyky sn Dnhn nzl kyw wyw ahy & jyky whn Dnhn nzl kyw wyw ahy tnhn ty sn ymn andw ahy & sn jw m`bwd & whn jw m`buwd hk ahy & syn snds frmnbrdr ahywn.

& (jhRy TrH Gyn ktb nzl kyswn) hRy TrH sn twDnhn ktb nzl kyw, pwi jn khy ktb Dnwswn sy un (qran) khy mnyynd ahn, & nhn (`rbn) mn kw (hRw) ahy jw un ty ymn aNyndw ahy, & kfrn khnswi (byw) kw sn jy aytn jw nkr nh kndw ahy.
& unhya (qran jy lhN) khn G kw ktb nky twn pRhndw hy'yn & nky uhw pnhnjy sdyy hth sn lkhndw hy'yn (jykDhn lkhyn pRhyn h) th unhya mhl uhy kwR Drwr shk +m pwn h.
blk uhw (qran) pdhrywn aytwn (ahn) nhn jy synn +m (mHfwZ) ahy jn khy `ilm Dnw wyw ahy, & Zlmn khn swi (byw) kw sn jy aytn jw nkr nh kndw ahy.
& chwn th th snds plNhr khn mths mu`jz cchwnh nzl ky wy ahn? (khyn) chw' mu`jz (th rGw mnhnjy) llh wT ahn, & aun th rGw pdhrw DydyryndR ahyn.
sn twty ktb nzl kyw jw khyn pRhy bdhy'bw ahy sw khyn kfy nh ahy cch, byshk hn +m mw'mnn jy qwm li bjh & nSyHt ahy.
(khyn) chw' th llh mnhnjy & whn jy wch +m shhd bs ahy, jyky asmnn & zmyn +m ahy sw uhw dyNndw ahy, & jn kwR khy mnyyw & llh jw nkr kyw sy y'y cchyy'y wr ahn.
& twkhn `dhb tkRw ghrnd ahn, & jykDhn (un jy) mudWt muqrr thyl nh hjy h th khyn `dhb Drwr phchy h, & (hw) mthn pk wchtw yndw & uhy by khbr hwnd.
twkhn `dhb tkRw ghrnd ahn, byshk dwzkh kfrn khy (unhya Dynhn) wkwRyndR ahy.

llh uhw ahy jnhn asmnn & zmyn khy & jyky sndn wch +m ahy swcchhn Dynhn +m bNyw wry `rsh Dnhn mtwjh thyw, un khnswi whn li nky kw sdyN & nky kw prt kndR ahy, pwi nSyHt nh th wtthw cch?
asmn khn zmyn Dnhn km jw bndwbst kndw ahy, wry (uhw bndwbst) un Dynhn +m Dnhs mthhwn wyndw ahy jnhn Dynhn jw ndzw hzr wrh jytrw nhya lykhy mn ahy jw GNynd ahyw.
ihw ahy jw Gjh & Zhr jw dyNndR Glb mhrbn ahy.
jnhy jyk shy pyd ky'y s sbhk chNya TrH bNy'y & mNhwa jy pydy'sh khy mTya mn ny'wn shrw` kyy'yn.
wry snds wld by qdr pNya jy nchwRy mn bNyy'yn.
wry khys sy'yn lNyn kyy'yn & mnjhs pnhnjw rwH phwkyy'yn & whn li kn & khywn & dlywn bNyy'yn, whyn thwrw shkr knd ahyw.
& chwn th th jDhn zmyn +m rly mly wyswn (tDhn bh) syn wry ny'yn sr bNbsyn cch? (nh!) blk uhy pnhnjy plNhr jy mlN khn mnkr ahn.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th jykw mwt jw frshtw whn ty mqrWr kyl ahy sw whn jw rwH kddhndw wry pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn mwTy'bw'.

& (unhy mhl) jykDhn Dsyn jnhn mhl gnhgr pnhnjy plNhr jy smhwn pnhnj kndh wndh kndR hwnd (th `jb kryn), (& chwnd th) y snj plNhr Dtthwswn & bdhwswn hNy sn khy (duny +m) mwTi th chN km krywn byshk syn yqyn kndR ahywn.
& jykDhn ghurwn h th sbhknhn shkhS khy hdyt krywn h pr mwn wTn (hy) Hukm tthhry'jy chkw ahy th jinWn & mNhn (nhn y'y) mRny mn dwzkh Drwr bhrynds.
pwi hn Dynhn jy mlN khy jw wsryw hyw' tnhn sbbn `dhb chkhw, byshk sn (bh) whn khy wsryw & jyky knd hyw' tnhn sbbn hmyshgya jw `dhb chkhw.
sn jy aytn ty rGw uhy ymn aNynd jn khy unhn (aytn) sn jDhn nSyHt Dby ahy tDhn sjdw kndR thy kirnd ahn & pnhnjy plNhr jy srh pky'y sn byn knd ahn & uhy wDy'y nh knd ahn.
sndn ps smhN jy hndh khn lG thy pnhnjy plNhr khy khwf & umyd sn sDynd ahn, & jyk khyn rwzy Dny swn tnhn mn khrchynd ahn.
pwi jykw khyn jw tthr nhn li lkyw wyw ahy sw kw jy nh dyNndw ahy, uhw bdlw hnn jyky kmyw hw tnhn sbbn ahy.
jykw mw'mn ahy sw bdkr jy brbr ahy cch? (uhy by'y kDhn) brbr nh thynd.
jn ymn andw & chN km ky tin li bhsht (j bG) mhmny Twr rhN jw hndh ahy unhy sbbn jw (chN) km knd rhy.
pr jn bcchRy'y ky'y tn jy rhN jw hndh dwzkh ahy, jnhn mhl mnjhny's nkrN jw rdw knd (tnhn mhl) mnjhs wry'y (py wjhb) & khyn chy'bw th un bh jw `dhb chkhw jnhn khy whyn kwR bhy'ynd hy'w'.
& khyn wDy `dhb khnswi hlky sz (dny +m bh) Drwr chkhy'yndswn th mna uhy (sdhy wT Dnhn) wrn.
& un khn wdhyk Zlm kyr ahy jnhn khy snds plNhr jy aytn sn nSyHt Djy th wry un khn munhn mwRy, byshk syn Dwhryn khn bdlw wtthndR ahywn.
& byshk muws~ khy ktb Dnwswn pwi twn un (qran) jy mlN khn shk +m nh thj & un mws~ khy bny sry'yln li hdyt bNywswn.
mnjhny'n pyshw ky (hw) swn jy sn jy Hukm sn sdhw rstw Dykhrynd hw jDhn jw (uhy Dkhn ty) Sbr knd rhy, & uhy sn jy aytn ty yqyn rkhnd hw.
byshk tnhnjw plNhr y'y qymt jy Dynhn sndn wch +m nhya (Glh) jw nbyrw kndw jnhn bbt jhGRw knd hw.
khyn pdhrw nh thyw ahy cch th khny'n G kytr (y'y) juG ns kyswn jn jy ghrn +m (uhy) ghumnd ahn, byshk hn (Glh) +m wDywn nshnywn ahn, pwi nh bdhnd ahn p?
nh Dtthy'wn cch th syn ubRtth zmyn Dnhn pNy why'ynd ahywn pwi un sn pwkh dymy'ynd ahywn jnhn mn sndn ddhwr & uhy pN khy'ynd ahn, pwi nh Dsnd ahn cch?
& chwn th th jykDhn whyn sch ahyw th hw fySlw kDhn thyndw?
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th fySly jy Dynhn kfrn khy sndn ymn aNN fy'dw nh Dyndw & nky khyn muhlt Dby.
pwi khy'n munhn mwR & ntZr kddh byshk uhy (bh) ntZr kddhndR ahn.
