& jyky tnhnjy plNhr wTn twDnhn wHy kjy thw tnhnjy tb`dry kr, byshk jyky knd ahyw tnhnjy llh khbr rkhndR ahy.
& llh ty bhrwsw kr, & llh snbhlyndR bs ahy.

llh knhn mRs jy ndr +m bh dlywn (pyd) nh kywn ahn, & nky whn jy nhn zln khy jn khy whyn mu chy'y wytth ahyw sy whn jwn (Hqyqy) my'r kyy'yn, & nky whn jy puTyln khy whn j (Hqyqy) puT kyy'yn hw whn jw chwN whn jy wtn jw ahy, & llh sch chwndw ahy & uhwy'y (sdhw) rstw Dykhryndw ahy.

khyn sndn piyn j (pT kry) sDyw hw llh wT blkl nSf ahy, pwi jykDhn sndn pyy'r nh dyNnd hjw th whn j dyn +m bhy'r & whn j dwst ahn, & jnhn Glhy'N +m chwk ky'y hjywa tnhn +m whn ty kw gnh nh ahy pr whn jy dlyn jyky dyNy wNy kyw (tnhn +m gnh ahy), & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

pyGmbr mw'mnn ty sndn jndn khn wdhyk Hq rkhndw ahy & snds zlwn sndyn my'r ahn, & my'Ty wr hk by'y j pN +m llh jy ktb +m (byn) mw'mnn & hjrt kndRn khn wdhyk wyjh ahn pr pnhnjn dwstn sn Hsn kryw (th jy'z ahy), ihw (Hukm) ktb +m lkhyl ahy.
& (yd kr) jDhn pyGmbrn khn sndn njm wrtwswn & (pN) twkhn & nuwH & brhym & muws~ & `iys~ pT mrym jy khn bh, & (hn li) khny'n pkw njm wrtwswn.
th (llh) schn khn sndyn schy'y bbt pucchy, & kfrn li Dkhwy'yndR `dhb tyr kyw ths.

y ymn wrw' pN ty llh jw Hsn yd kryw jDhn (kfrn j) lshkr whn ty (chRhy'y kry) ay tDhn mthn wu khy mwklywswn & (whn jy mdd li mly'kn j) hR lshkr bh jn khy whn nh thy Dtthw (pwi kfrn khy bhdyy'y whn khy bchywswn) & jyky kryw th sw llh DsndR ahy.
jDhn (uhy) whn jy mthn & whn jy hytthn whn wT ay & unhya mhl khywn TiRy wywn & dlywn (dhsht khn) niR ghTn khy puhtywn & llh jy bh nsbt kyy'y gmn bhnywa thy.
uty muw'mnn khy prkhyw wyw & khyn tmm skht lwDyw wyw.
& unhya mhl mnfqn & jn jy dlyn +m bymry ahy tn chyw thy th llh & snds pyGmbr sn khy tthGya khnswi (byw) kw njm nh Dnw ahy.

& unhy mhl mnjhny'n hk Twlya chyw th y mdyny wrw' whn li (hty trsN jy) k ji knhy tnhnkry mwTw, & mnjhny'n hk Twlya pyGmbr khn mwklyw thy & chwN lG th sn j ghr hykl ahn, Hlnk uhy hykl nh hw, bhdyN khnswi (byw) kw rdw nh hwn.
& jykDhn un (mdyny) jy as ps khn mthn k (kfrn jy fwj) chy kRky h wry khny'n ghurw jng ghurN +m chy h th Drwr uh kn h & un li thwry (dyr) khn swi trsn y'y nh h.
& (hn khn) G llh sn njm kyw hwy'wn th (bhdyN li) ptthywn nh phyrynd, & llh jy njm jy (Drwr) pucch ky'y wyndy.
(khyn) chw' th jykDhn whyn mrN y mrjN khn bhdyndw' th bhdyN whn khy fy'dw nh Dyndw & unhya mhl blkl thwrw fy'dw Dnw wyndwa.

(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th whn khy llh (jy `dhb) khn kyr bchy'yndw jykDhn uhw whn khy k wkhy'y phchy'N ghry y whn khy k bjh phchy'N ghry (th uh kyr rwkyndw?), & llh khnswi pN li nkw dwst & nkw mddgr lhnd.
whn mn (jhd khn) jhlyndRn & pnhnjn bhy'rn khy (hy'n) chwndRn khy th sn Dnhn chw byshk llh dyNndw ahy, & thwrn khnswi (by) lRy'y +m nh th chn.

(hthwn) whn ty pbchy'y kndR ahn, pwi jnhn mhl bhawa (jw wqt) chy (tnhn mhl) khyn Dsyn th twDnhn nhrynd ahn jw sndn khywn un (mNhwa) wngr phirndywn ahn jnhn ty mwt (jy skrt) jy byhwshy phty hjy, pwi jnhn mhl (jng jw) bhw' lhndw ahy tnhn mhl (Gnymt jy) ml (wtthN) ty llchy thy whn khy tkhyn zbnn sn ydhy'ynd ahn, nhn ymn nh andw tnhnkry llh sndn `ml chaT ky, & hw km llh khy asn ahy.

(khwf jy kry) bhy'ynd ahn th (kfrn j) kTk nh wy ahn, & jykDhn (kfrn j) ky kTk chn h th (hya Glh) ghurn h th uhy jykr jhngln +m wytthl hjn h (&) whn jwn khbrwn (hrknhn khn) pcchnd rhn h, & jykDhn whn +m hjn th rGw thwrw (chy) jng +m wRhn.
byshk whn li llh jy pyGmbr jy Tryqy +m `mdy pyrwy unhya li ahy jykw llh (jy rD jy umyd) & qymt jy Dynhn (jy chN) jy myd rkhndw hjy & llh khy ghNw yd kndw hjy.

& jnhn mhl mw'mnn (kfrn jy) lshkrn khy Dtthw (tnhn mhl) chyy'wn th hy uhw njm ahy jykw llh & snds pyGmbr sn khy Dnw hw & llh & snds pyGmbr sch frmyw hw, & inhya (Hlt) unhn khy ymn & frmnbrdrya +m hykrw wdhyw.
mw'mnn mn ky hR mNhw ahn jw jykw llh sn njm kyw hwy'wn tnhn khy schw kyy'wn, pwi mnjhny'n kn pnhnjw dhmwn pwrw kyw & mnjhny'n kw ntZr kndw ahy, & (pnhnjy chwN khy) knhn TrH nh mTyy'wn.
(hw hn kry ahy) th llh schn khy sndn schy'y sbbn bdlw Dy'y & jykDhn ghry th mnfqn khy `dhb kry y (twbh jy twfyq Dy'N sn) mthn bjh sn mwTy, cchwth llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
& llh kfrn khy sndn Dmr smyt mwTyw jw k chNy'y nh ldhy'wn, & llh mw'mnn jy prn wyRh li kfy thyw, & llh sghrw Glb ahy.
& ktb wrn mn jn nhn (mshrkn) jy mdd ky'y hy'y tn khy (llh) sndn kwTn mn lthw & sndyn dlyn +m dhsht wdhy'yn (jw) hk Twlya khy kutthwa thy & bya Twlya khy qydy kywa thy.
& (nytth) whn khy sndyn zmyn & sndyn ghrn & sndn nhya zmyn jw wrth kyy'yn jnhn ty pyr (bh) nh ghumyw hywa, & llh sbhknhn shy ty ws wrw ahy.
y pyGmbr pnhnjy zln khy chw' th jykDhn whyn dny jy Hyty & un jw syngr ghrndywn hjw th chw th whn khy jwrw Dyn & chNy TrH cchDyn.
& jykDhn whyn llh & snds pyGmbr & akhrt jy ghr (y`ny bhsht) khy ghrw thywn th byshk whn mn nyk bkhtn li llh wDw jr tyr kyw ahy.

& whn mn jyk llh & snds pyGmbr jy tb`dry kndy & chN km kndy tnhn khy snds jr bh bhyr Dyndsyn & un li `zt wry rwzy tyr kndsyn.

y pyGmbr jwn zlwn whyn kn byn zln jhRywn nh ahyw jykDhn whyn (llh khn) Ddyndywn ahyw th (knhn dhry'y mNhwa sn) Glhy'N +m hytthhyn nh kryw cchwth jnhn jy dl +m bymry ahy sw (mtn) Tm` kry & chNw sukhn Glhyw.

& pnhnjn ghrn +m rhw & phryna jhlyt jy syngr wngr syngr nh kryw & nmz qy'm rkhw & zkw@ Dyw & llh & snds pyGmbr jy frmnbrdry kryw, y pyGmbr j ghr wrw' llh rGw hy ghrndw ahy th whn khn plyty dwr kry & th whn khy chNy TrH pk kry.
& whn jy ghrn +m jyky llh jy aytn & dny'ya jy Glhyn mn pRhyw wnyy thw sw yd kryw, byshk llh luTf kndR khbr rkhndR ahy.

byshk muslmn mrd & muslmn zlwn & mw'mn & mw'mnyNywn & frmnbrdr & frmnbrdrNywn & sch & schywn & Sbr wr & Sbr wrywn & (khd khn) DdyndR & (khd khn) DdyndRywn & khyrt krN wr & khyrt krN wrywn & rwzy rkhN wr & rwzy rkhN wrywn & pnhnjy ghRn khy ngh rkhN wr & ngh rkhN wrywn & llh khy ghNw yd kndR & yd kndRywn nhn (sbhny) li llh bkhshsh & wDw jr tyr kyw ahy.
& jDhn llh & snds pyGmbr knhn km bbt Hukm kry (tDhn) knhn mw'mn & knhn mw'mnyNya khy nhy pnhnjy km +m kw khtyr hjN nh jGy'y, & jykw llh & snds pyGmbr jy nfrmny kndw sw byshk pdhrya bhul +m bhulw.

& (y pyGmbr yd kr) jDhn tw unhya shkhS khy chyw thy jnhn ty llh fDl kyw ahy & tw (bh) mths Hsn kyw th pnhnjya zl khy jhl (& Tlq nh Dy) & llh khn Ddy & twn pnhnjy dl +m uh Glh lky'yn thw jnhn khy llh pdhrw kndw ahy & mNhn khn Dnyn thy, Hlnk llh (hn Glh jw) wdhyk Hqdr ahy jw un khn Ddyyn, pwi jnhn mhl zyd un (`wrt) khn pnhnjy Hjt pwry ky'y (y`ny Tlq Dny'yn tnhn mhl) un khy twsn prNywswn (hn li) th mw'mnn ty pnhnjy pTylyn jy zln prNjN +m k wkhy'y nh rhy jDhn (uhy) unhn khn pnhnjy Hjt pwry kn (y`ny Tlq Dyn), & llh jw (jykw) Hukm (ahy sw) thyNw ahy.
pyGmbr ty unhya +m k wkhy'y nh ahy jyky llh un (pyGmbr) li Hll kyw ahy, jyky G gdhry wy tn +m (bh) llh jw hw dstwr hw, & llh jw Hukm tthhryl (unhn li) muqrWr ahy.

whn jy mrdn mn knhn hk jw pyu nh ahy pr llh jw pyGmbr & sbhny pyGmbrn khn pcchRya +m chN wrw ahy, & llh hr shy khy dyNndR ahy.
y ymn wrw' llh khy tmm ghNw yd kryw.
& SbH & snjhya jw khys pky'ya sn wkhNyw.
hw uhw ahy jw whn ty rHmt mwkly thw & snds mly'k bh whn li rHmt jy du` ghrnd ahn th whn khy wndhyn mn swjhry Dnhn kddhy, & llh mw'mnn ty mhrbn ahy.
jnhn Dynhn llh khy mlnd (tnhn Dynhn) sndn khiykr slm ahy, & unhn li `zt wrw jr tyr kyw ths.

& llh Dnhn snds Hukm sn sDyndR & rwshn Dyy'w (kry mwklywswn).
& mw'mnn khy khwshkhbry Dy th nhn li llh jy pr khn wDw fDl ahy.
& kfrn & munfqn jw chyw nh mny & sndn ydhy'N (jy khyl) khy cchD & llh ty bhrwsw kr, & llh krsz bs ahy.
y ymn wrw' jDhn mw'mnyNyn khy prNjw (&) wry khyn hth ly'N khn G Tlq Dyw tDhn mthn k `idWt whn li knhy jnhn khy (whyn) GNyw, pwi khyn (cchRw) jwrw Dyw & chNya TrH sn khyn cchDyw.

y pyGmbr byshk sn twli uhy zlwn Hll kywn jn khy tw sndn kbyn Dnw & jyky bnhywn llh twty `nyt kywn tn mn jn ty tnhnjw hth mlk thyw sy & tnhnjy chchy jwn dhyy'r & tnhnjy pphyn jwn dhyy'r & & tnhnjy mmy jwn dhyy'r & tnhnjy msyn jwn dhyy'r jn twsn hjrt ky'y Hll kywswn, & uh mw'mnyNy zl bh (Hll ky'y swn) jyk pnhnjy jind pyGmbr khy (swi mhr wtthN jy) bkhshy bshrTyk pyGmbr khys prNjN jw rdw kry, (hw km) mw'mnn khnswi khlSw twli ahy, nhn (mw'mnn) ty sndn zln & sndn bnhyn bbt jn ty sndn hth mlk thy ahn jyky (kbyn & khrch DyN) frD kyw thwn sw byshk dytw thwn (hw) hn kry th twty k wkhy'y nh hjy, & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

mnjhny'n jnhn khy ghryn tnhn khy cchDy Dy'yn & jnhn khy ghryn tnhn khy pN wT ji Dy'yn, & jn khy tw psy kyw tn mn wry jnhn khy Tlb kryn th twty kw gnh nh ahy, ihw (khtyr) hn (Glh) khy tmm wyjhw ahy th sndn khywn tthrn & (uhy) Gmgyn nh thyn & jyky twn khyn Dy'yn tnhn khn uhy sbh khwsh thyn, & jyky whn jy dlyn +m ahy sw llh dyNndw ahy, & llh dyNndR burdbr ahy.

(y pyGmbr) nhn (bn qsmn) khnpwi twkhy bywn zlwn Hll nh ahn & nky nhn jy bdly (bywn) zlwn nkH kryn jytwNyk sndn swnhn twkhy psnd chy pr tnhnjw hth jnhn jw mlk thyw ahy (tnhn +m twkhy khtyr ahy), & llh sbhknhn shy ty nghbn ahy.

y mw'mnw pyGmbr jy ghrn +m unhya (wqt) khnswi ndr nh wnyw (jnhn wqt) whn khy knhn T`m (khy'N) li chN jy mwkl Dny wnyy & (hRy wqt wnyw jw) n jy tyr thyN jw ntZr kndR nh hjw pr jDhn whn khy sDyw wnyy tDhn ndr wnyw pwi jDhn khy'y rhw tDhn nkry wnyw & knhn Glh +m ryjhy wyhy nh rhw, cchwth nhya (km) pyGmbr khy ydhyw thy pwi (hn) whn khn ldy ky'y thy, & llh Hq (chwN) khn ldy nh kndw ahy, & jDhn nhn (pyGmbr jy bybyn) khn k shy ghrw tDhn prdy jy bhrn khny'n ghrw, hw (km) whn jy dlyn & nhn jy dlyn li Dddhw pk ahy, & whn khy nh jGy'yndw ahy th llh jy pyGmbr khy ydhyw & nky (jGy'yndw ahy) th un khnpwi snds zlwn whyn kDhn prNjw, cchwth uhw (km) llh wT wDw (gnh) ahy.
jykDhn knhn Glh khy pdhrw kryw y un khy lkyw th byshk llh hr shy khy dyNndR ahy.

zln ty nky pnhnjn pyn & nky pnhnjn pTn & nky pnhnjn bhy'rn & nky pnhnjn bhTyn & nky pnhnj bhNyjn & nky pN jhRyn zln & nky jn ty sndn hth mlk thy ahn tn jy Gyn (prdy nh krN +m) gnh ahy, & (y zlwn) llh khn Ddyw cchwth llh sbh knhn shy ty HDr ahy.
byshk llh & snds mly'k pyGmbr ty rHmt mwklynd ahn, y ymn wrw' whyn bh mths Slwt pRhw & pwry TrH slm chy'w.
byshk jyky llh & snds pyGmbr khy ydhy'ynd ahn tn llh dny & akhrt +m l`nt ky'y ahy & unhn li khwrya wrw `dhb tyr kyw ths.
& jyky (mNhw) mw'mnn & mw'mnyNyn khy hRy km (jy thmt) sn ydhy'ynd ahn jw unhn nh kyw hjy tn byshk kwRy tthh & pdhry gnh jw br khnyw.

y pyGmbr pnhnjyn zln & pnhnjyn dhyy'rn & mw'mnn jy zln khy chw' th (jykDhn bhr nkrn th) pN ty pnhnjwn chdrwn wjhn, ihw (hin Glh khy) tmm wyjhw ahy th uhy snytywn wnyn pwi khyn ydhu nh Dnw wnyy, & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
mnfq & jn jy dlyn +m bymry ahy sy & mdyny +m kwRyn Glhyn pkhyRN wr jykDhn (pnhnjy `dt khn) nh jhlb th mthn twkhy bcchyndswn wry thwrn (Dynhn) khnswi un (y`ny mdyny) +m tnhnj pRysry nh thynd.
l`nt kyl ahn, jty lbhnd tity pkRb & chNy TrH mrb.
jyky (hn khn) gdhry wy tn +m (bh) llh jw hw dstwr hw, & llh jy dstwr khy kDhn mt sT nh Dsndyn.
mNhw twkhn qymt bbt pcchn th, (khyn) chw' th un jy khbr rGw llh wT ahy, & khRya (Glh) twkhy dyNyw mtn qymt wyjhRw y'y thyndy hjy.
byshk llh kfrn ty l`nt ky'y ahy & nhn li sRyndR bh tyr ky'y ths.
mnjhs sdy'yn rhN wr ahn, nky kw sdyN & nky kw mddgr lhnd.
jnhn Dynhn sndn mnhn bh +m wndh kb (tnhn Dynhn) chwnd th sn li hya rmn (jykr) llh jy frmnbrdry krywn h & pyGmbr jy (bh) frmnbrdry krywn h (th chNw hw).
& chwnd th y sn j plNhr sn pnhnjn srdrn & pnhnjn wDn jy frmnbrdry ky'y th nhn sn khy wT khn bhulyw.
y snj plNhr khyn byNw `dhb kr & mthn tmm wDy l`nt kr.
y ymn wrw' (whyn) unhn wngr nh thyw jn muws~ khy ydhyw pwi jyky chyy'wn tnhn khn llh khys pk kyw, & (hw) llh wT mna wrn mn hw.
y ymn wrw' llh khn Ddyw & sdhy Glh chy'w.
(th) whn j `ml whn li sudhry & whn j gnh whn khy bkhshy, & jykw llh & snds pyGmbr jy frmnbrdry kndw tnhn byshk wDy mrd mNy.
byshk sn asmnn & zmyn & jbln khy mnt acchy th un jy khNN khn nkr kyy'wn & khny's Dn & un khy nsn khnyw, byshk uhw tmm Zlm jhl ahy.
(hya acch hn li ahy) th llh mnfqn & mnfqyNyn & mshrkn & mshrkyNyn khy `dhb kry & llh mw'mnn & mw'mnyNyn ty bjh sn mwTy, & llh bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
sbh srh unhya llh khy jGy'y jw jyky asmnn +m ahy & jyky zmyn +m ahy sw (sbh) snds ahy & un jy y'y srh akhrt +m ahy, & uhw y'y Hkmt wrw khbr rkhndR ahy.
jyky zmyn +m ghRndw ahy & jyky mnjhny's nkrndw ahy & jyky asmn mn lhndw ahy & jyky mnjhs chRhndw ahy sw (sbh uhw) dyNndw ahy, & hwy'y bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

& kfr chwnd ahn th sn ty qymt (kDhn) nh yndy, (khyn) chw' th hy'w mwn khy pnhnjy (unhya) plNhr Gujh dyNyndR jw qsm ahy th whn wT Drwr yndy, jnhn khn dhry jytrw nky asmnn & nky zmyn +m Gujhw rhy thw & un khn tmm nnddhy (k shy hRy) knhy & nky tmm wDy j pdhry ktb +m (lkhyl) nh ahy.
hn li th jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn khy bdlw Dy'y, nhn li y'y bkhshsh & sGwry rwzy ahy.
& jyky sn jy aytn +m mqblw kndR thy DwRy nhn li y'y Dkhwy'yndR `dhb jy sz ahy.
& jn khy `ilm Dnw wyw sy smjhnd ahn th jykw (qran) tnhnjy plNhr wTn twDnhn nzl kyw wyw ahy sw brHq ahy & Glb srhyl (llh) jy wT Dnhn rstw DykhryndR ahy.
& kfr (hk by'y) khy chwnd ahn th whn khy hRw mRs Dsywn cch jw whn khy bdhy'y thw th jDhn (whyn) tmm Gry dhr dhr thyndw' (tDhn) byshk whyn ny'yn sr bNy wyndw'.

jyky sndn Gyn & jyky sndn pwyn asmn & zmyn mn (bNyw wyw) ahy sw (Gwr kry) nh Dtthy'wn cch? jykDhn ghurwn th khyn zmyn +m Ghy'y cchDywn y asmn khn mthn Tukr kyrywn, byshk n +m sbhknhn (llh Dnhn) wrndR bnhy li (wDy) nshny ahy.
& byshk dw'd khy pN wTn bzrgy Dny swn, (& Hukm kywswn th) y jblw' sNs tsbyHwn chy'w & pkhyn khy (un jw frmnbrdr kywswn), & un li lwh khy nrm kywswn.
(Hkm Dnwswn) th wykrywn zrhwn bNi & ndzy sn kRywn tthh & (y dw'd jy ghrNy wrw') chN km kryw, cchwth jyky whn knd ahyw sw byshk aun DsndR ahyn.

& wu khy sulymn li (nwywswn) un jy GyRya jy mnzl mhyny jw pndh & pwyRya jy mnzl (bh) mhyny jw pndh hy'y & un li pghryl Tmy jw tlu wahywswn, & jnWn mn (bh kn khy frmnbrdr kywswn) jw snds plNhr jy Hkm sn snds Gyn kmy'ynd hw, & mnjhy'n jykw sn jy Hukm khn munhn mwRyndw tnhn khy bh jw `dhb chkhy'yndswn.
jyky ghrndw hw sw un li ky ql` & muwrtwn & HwD jyD pyl & wDywn dyGywn jy nh churndywn hywn sy bNy'ynd hw, (chywswn th) y dw'd j wld shukrnw kryw, & munhnjn bnhn mn thwr shukrnw kndR ahn.

pwi jnhn mhl mths mwt khy Hukm kywswn (tnhn mhl) snds mwt ty uDyhya khnswi (by'y knhn) unhn (jinWn) khy nh chtyw jw snds ltth khy thy khdhy'yn, pwi jnhn mhl kryw (tnhn mhl) jinWn m`lwm kyw th jykDhn Gjh dyNn h th khwrya wry `dhb +m nh rhn h.
byshk sb jy qwm li sndn Gwtth +m hk nshny huy'y, (y`ny) bh bG sdyy & khby psy khn hw, (chyw wyn th) pnhnjy plNhr jy rzq mn khy'w & snds shkrnw kryw, (whn li hy) shhr stthw ahy & plNhr bkhshNhr ahy.
pwi (shkr krN khn) mnhn mwRyy'wn tnhnkry (bnd bhnyy) skht cchara khy mthn whywsyn & sndn (unhn) bn bGn jy bdly khyn (by) bh bG ksrn mywn & lay'in wr & kjh thwryn byryn wr Dnswn.
sndn by shkrya sbbn khyn h sz Dny swn, & by shkr khnswi (by'y) knhn khy sz nh Dynd ahywn.
& sndn wch +m uhy Gwtth jn +m brkt rkhy swn tn jy wch +m pdhr Gwtth (lGwlG) kyswn & nhn +m ch wny jw pwrw bndwbst rkhywswn, (chywswn th) rtyn & Dynhn mnjhn by bhw' ghmnd rhw.

pwi chyy'wn th y sn j plNhr sn jy msfryn +m Dwry'y kr & pN ty Zlm kyy'wn tnhn kry nhn khy (byn jy li) akhNywn kywsyn & khyn tmm prz prz kry cchny phRy cchDywswn, byshk hn +m sbhknhn wDy Sbir shkr li nshnywn ahn.
& byshk blys nhn bh nsbt pnhnjy gmn khy schw ldhw jw mw'mnn jy hk Twlya khnswi byn un jy tb`dry ky'y.
& un jw mthn kw zwr nh hw pr (syn prkhwn) th jykw akhrt khy mnyyndw hjy tnhn khy unhya khn dhr krywn jykw un khn shk +m (pyl) hjy, & tnhnjw plNhr sbhknhn shy ty nghbn ahy.
(khyn) chw' th llh khnswi jn +m whyn gmn knd ahyw tn khy sDyw, uhy nky asmnn +m & nky zmyn +m dhry jytr (bh) mlk ahn & nky mnjhn k bhy'ywry ahy & nky mnjhy'n kw llh jw mddgr ahy.

& nky wTs (by'y knhn jy) sfrsh fy'dw Dyndy mgr jnhn li rkhSt Dny hwndy'yn (frshtn jw hy Hl ahy th jnhn mhl kw Hukm khd jw nzl thy'y thw th unhn jy Tby`t +m ghbrhT pyd thy'y thy) tnjw jnhn wqt hnn jy dlyn tn ghbrhT lhy thy (tnhn mhl) chwn th th whn jy plNhr cch chyw ahy (mthn mly'k hytthyn khy) chwnd th sch frmyw ths & uhw (sbh khn) mthhwn wDw ahy.
(khyn) chw' th whn khy asmnn & zmyn mn kyr rwzy Dyndw ahy, chw' th llh (Dyndw ahy) & byshk syn y whyn (y th) hdyt ty ahywn y pdhrya gumrhy +m.
chw' th jyky sn Dwh ky ahn tnhn bbt whyn pcchy nh wyndw' & jyky whyn knd ahyw tnhn bbt syn pucchy nh wyndswn.
chw' th sn jw plNhr sn (mRny) khy gD kndw wry sn & (whn) jy wch +m Hq sn fySlw kndw, & hwy'y (schw) fySlw kndR dyNndR ahy.
chw' th jn khy whn sNs shryk bNy'y mlyw ahy sy mwn khy Dykhryw (chw' th) y'yn nh ahy, blk uhw llh Glb Hikmt wrw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) twkhy th mRny mNhn li khwshkhbry DyndR & DydyryndR kry mwklywswn pr ghN mNhw nh dyNnd ahn.

chw' th whn li hRy Dynhn jw njm ahy jnhn khn hk ghRy nky dyr kndw' & nky Gy wyndw'.

& kfr chwn th th hn quran khy kDhn nh mnyyndswn & nky unhy khy jw khny's G ahy, & (y DsndR) jDhn Zlm pnhnjy plNhr Gyn byhrb (tDhn) jykDhn Dsyn th (`jb kryn), jw (pN +m) nhn mn hkR byn Dy Glh wry'ynd, jyky hyN ahn sy htthyln khy chwnd th jykDhn whn nh hjwh th syn mw'mn hjwn h.

& knhn Gwtth +m kw DydyryndR nh mwklywswn mgr un jy aswdn (mNhn) chyw th byshk jnhn shy sn whyn mwkly wy ahyw (tnhnkhy) syn nh mnyyndR ahywn.
& chyy'wn th syn ghNy ml & wld wr ahywn & sn khy `dhb thyNw nh ahy.
chw' th mnhnjw plNhr jnhn li ghry tnhnjy rwzy kshdy kndw ahy & (jnhn li ghry tnhn jy) tng kndw ahy pr ghN mNhw nh dyNnd ahn.
& nky whn j ml & nky whn j wld hRy shy ahn jw whn khy sn wT mrtby jy kry wyjhw kn pr (wyjh uhy ahn) jn ymn andw & chN km ky, tn jyky kmyw tnhn sbbn unhn li byNw bdlw ahy & uhy mRyn +m mn sn rhnd.
& jyky sn jy aytn (jy rd krN) +m mqblw kndR thy kwshsh knd ahn uhy `dhb +m HDr kb.

chw' th byshk mnhnjw plNhr pnhnjn bnhn mn jnhn li ghrndw ahy tnhnjy rwzy kshdy kndw ahy & (jnhn li ghrndw ahy tnhnjy) tng kndw ahy, & jyky whyn kujh khrchyndw' tnhn jw llh bdlw Dyndw, & uhw chNw rwzy DyndR ahy.

pwi dy whn mn kwbh hk by'y khy nky sukh puhchy'N jw nky Dkh phchy'N jw khtyr rkhy thw, & Zlmn khy chwndswn th un bh jy sz jw (jw mzw) chkhw jnhn khy whyn kuwR bhy'ynd hw.

& jDhn sn jwn pdhrywn aytwn khyn pRhy bdhy'bywn ahn tDhn (hk by'y khy) chwnd ahn th hyu rGw hk mNhw ahy jw jnhn khy whn j b DD pwdyynd hw tnhn khn whn khy jhlN ghrndw ahy, & chwnd ahn th hyu (qran) rGw kwR tthhyl ahy, & kfrn wT jDhn schy Glh ay'y (tDhn) un li chwnd ahn th hy rGw pdhrw jdw ahy.
Hlnk unhn (mshrkn) khy nkw kw ktb Dnwswn jnhn khy pRhn & nky twkhn G kw DydyryndR unhn Dnhn mwklywswn.
& khy'n Gyn bh kwR dytw hw Hlnk jyky nhnkhy Dnwhwswn tnhn jy Dhyn ptya khy (bh uhy mshrk) nh puht ahn pwi unhn sn jy pyGmbrn khy kwRw dytw, pwi mnhnjw `dhb ky'n hw.

(khyn) chw' th whn khy rGw hk Glh jy nSyHt kryn thw, th bh bh & hk hk thy llh (jy km) li khR thyw wry prwRyw, th whn jy sngtya khy kw swdu nh ahy, (blk) uhw th skht `dhb (jy phchN) khn G whn khy DydyryndR ahy.
(& khyn) chw' th whn khn jykw kw ujwrw ghryw hjym sw whn khy y'y hjy, mnhnjw ujwrw llh khnswi by'y knhn ty nh ahy, & uhw hr shy ty shhd ahy.
(khyn) chw' th byshk mnhnjw plNhr Hq khy mnhnjy dl +m wjhndw ahy, (hw) Gujhn jw dyNndR ahy.
(khyn) chw' th Hq ayw & kwRw m`bwd nky ny'y sr pyd kry thw nky bihr pyd kndw.
(khyn) chw' th jykDhn gmrh thys th rGw pN li gmrh thyn thw, & jykDhn hdyt wrw thys th (uh) unhya sbbn ahy jw mnhnjw plNhr mwn Dnhn wHy mwklyndw ahy, byshk uhw bdhndR wyjhw ahy.
& jnhn mhl pryshn thynd & (llh jy `dhb khn) cchwTkrw nh lhnd & wyjhy hndhn pkRb (tnhn mhl) jykDhn Dsyn (th `jb kryn).
& chwnd th (hNy) un (qran) ty ymn andwswn, & (uty duny jy) Dwryn hndh khn khyn (ymn) hth aNN kthn thyndw?
Hlnk Gy un qran khy nh mnyynd hw, & Dwryn hndh khn aN Dtthw (gumn j tyr) ucchlynd rhy.

sbh srh khS llh khy juGy'y jw asmnn & zmyn jw bNy'yndR ahy mly'kn khy qSd krN wrw ahy jw bn bn & Tn Tn & chay'n chay'n parn wr ahn, jyky ghry sw khlqt +m wdhy'y thw, byshk llh hr shy ty ws wrw ahy.
llh mNhn li (pnhnjya) bjh mn jyky khwlyndw tnhn khy kw bnd krN wrw nh ahy, & jyky bnd kndw tnhnkhy un (jy bnd krN) khnpwi kw khwlN wrw nh ahy, & uhw Glb Hkmt wrw ahy.
y mNhw' pN ty llh jwn n`mtwn yd kryw, llh khnswi kw bNy'yndR ahy cch? jw asmn & zmyn mn whn khy rwzy Dy'y thw, un (llh) khnswi kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy pwi kyDnhn phyry wynd ahyw.
& (y pyGmbr) jykDhn kwRw bhy'yn th byshk tw khn G (by kytry'y) pyGmbr kwR bhny wy, & sbh km llh Dnhn mwTy'jn th.
y mNhw' byshk llh jw anjm schWw ahy tnhnkry nky whn khy dny jy Hyty tthGy, & nky frybyndR (shyTn) llh bbt whn khy fryby.
byshk shyTn whn jw wyry ahy tnhnkry un khy wyry (kry) wtthw, (hw) pnhnjya Twlya khy rGw hn li sDyndw ahy th dwzkhyn mn thyn.
jn kufr kyw tn li skht `dhb ahy, & jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn li bkhshsh & wDw jr ahy.

jnhn li snds bcchRw km syngryw wyw pwi un khy hun chNw (kry) Dtthw (sw chNy km kndR jhRw hwndw) cch? pwi byshk llh jnhn khy ghrndw ahy tnhn khy gmrh kndw ahy & jnhn khy ghrndw ahy tnhn khy hdyt kndw ahy, tnhnkry mthn rmn krN sbbn mtn tnhnjw sh nkry, cchwth jyky knd ahn sw llh dyNndR ahy.
& llh uhw ahy jnhn wy'n khy mwklyw pwi unhn kkr khy khnyw pwi un (kkr) khy wyrn Gwtth Dnhn rwnw kywswn pwi un (jy pNya) sn zmyn khy snds wyrnya khnpwi jyrywswn, hRy TrH (qbrn mn) muy'n jw uthN ahy.

jykw mnu ghry (sw yd rkhy) th sbh mnu llh y'y khy ahy (un wTn `zt mlndy ahy), Dnhs pk sukhn chRhndw ahy & un (pk sukhn) khy chNw `ml mthy chRhyndw ahy, & jyky bcchRyn jy rth knd ahn tn li skht `dhb ahy, & uh tthGy unhn jy TTndy.

& llh whn khy mTya mn pyd kyw wry nTfy mn (bNyy'yn) wry whn khy jwRw jwRw (mRs & zl) kyy'yn, & mdyn mn kbh snds `lm khnswi nky ddhuky thyndy & nky dyNyndy ahy, & nky knhn wDy `mr wry khy dymr Dby ahy & nky snds dymr mn (kjh) ghTy'bw ahy mgr (uhw) ktb +m lkhyl ahy, byshk hw (km) llh khy asn ahy.

& bh drya hk jhR nh ahn (jn mn) hyu hk mitthw uny lhyndR ahy snds pNy wNndR ahy & uhw byw khrw kwRw ahy, & hr hk mn (mcchya jw) tzw gwsht khy'ynd ahyw & zywr (y`ny mwty mnjhy'n) kddhnd ahyw jy py'ynd ahyw, & mnjhs (pNy khy) chyryndR byRywn Dsndw ahyn (hn li) th snds fDl mn (rwzy) Tlb kryw & th mna whyn shkrnw kryw.

rt khy Dynhn +m ghyRyndw ahy & Dynhn khy rt +m ghyRyndw ahy & sj & chnD khy tb` kyy'yn, hr hk tthhryl mdt ty hlndw ahy, uhw llh whn jw plNhr ahy un jy bdshhy ahy, & jn khy llh khnswi sDynd ahyw sy khrk jy khkhRya jy cchlu (jytry dhry) j (bh) mlk nh ahn.
jykDhn khyn sDyw th whn jw sD nh bdhnd, & jykDhn (khNy) bdhn (bh) th bh whn khy wrndy nh Dynd, & qymt jy Dynhn whn jy shryk tthhry'N j mnkr thynd, & twkhy khbr rkhndR jhRy kwbh khbr nh Dyndw.
y mNhw whyn llh Dnhn muHtj ahyw, & llh uhw by prwh srhyl ahy.

& kwbh br khNndR by'y jw br nh khNndw, & jykDhn (gnhn jy) Gwry br wrw pnhnjy br khNN Dnhn knhn khy sDyndw twNyk my'Ty wrw hwndw th bh mnjhny's kjh bh nh khnyw wyndw, twn th nhn khy Dydyry sghndyn jyky pnhnjy plNhr khn prputth Ddynd ahn & nmz pRhnd ahn, & jykw pk thyw sw rGw pN li pk thy'y thw, & llh Dnhn mwTN ahy.
& ndhw & sdyw brbr nh ahn.
& nky wndhywn & nky swjhrw.
& nky cchnwa & nky us (pN +m hk jhR ahn).
& nky jyy'r & nky muy' brbr thyn th, byshk llh jnhn khy ghry tnhn khy bdhy'yndw ahy, & twn kw qbr wrn khy bdhy'yndR nh ahyn.
twn th rGw DydyryndR ahyn.
byshk sn twkhy schy dyn sn khwshkhbry DyndR & DydyryndR kry mwklyw, & hRy k Twly ahy y'y knh jnhn +m kw DydyryndR nh gdhryw ahy.
& jykDhn twkhy kwRw bhy'yn th th khy'n Gyn bh byshk kwRw bhnyw hw, jn wT sndn pyGmbr chiTn m`jzn & SHyfn sn & pdhrn ktbn sn ay hw.
wry kfrn khy pkRym & mnhnjy sz kyy'n hy'y.
nh Dtthw thy'y cch th llh asmnn khn pNy wsyw, pwi un sn myw pyd kyswn jn j rng qsmyn qsmyn ahn, & jbln mn Tukr ahn ky cch & ky GRh nhn j TrHyn TrHyn rng ahn & ky nhyt kr (bh) ahn.
& hRya TrH mNhn & chrndRn & ddhwrn mn (bh) jw nhn j rng TrH TrH j ahn (bNysyn), llh khn snds bnhn mn rGw smjh wr Ddynd ahn, byshk llh Glb bkhshNhr ahy.
byshk jyky (mNhw) llh jw ktb pRhnd ahn & nmz (pwrya TrH) pRhnd ahn & jyky khyn Dnwswn tnhn mn Gujhw & pdhrw khrchynd ahn sy hRya swdgry jy myd rkhnd ahn j kDhn nh brbd thyndy.
(hn li) th khud khyn sndn jr pwrw Dy'y & pnhnjy fDl sn khyn wdhyk bh Dy'y, cchwth hw bkhshNhr qdr dyNndR ahy.
& jyky twDnhn ktb mn wHy kywswn sw sch ahy jyky khny's G ahn tn khy bh schWw kndR ahy, byshk llh pnhnjn bnhn jy khbr rkhndR DsndR ahy.
wry nhn khy ktbn jw wrth kywswn jn khy pnhnjn bnhn mn chwnDywswn, pwi mnjhy'n ky pN li Zlm ahn, & mnjhy'n ky wchthr ahn, & mnjhy'n ky llh jy Hukm sn chNyn +m Gry'y kndR ahn, ihwy'y wDw fDl ahy.
(nhn li hmyshh wr bG ahn) jn +m (uhy) ghRnd mnjhn swn j kngN & mwty phry'bn, & nhn +m sndn lbs paT hwndw.
& chwnd th sbh srh nhy llh khy jGy'y jnhn sn khn (sbh) Dukh Try, byshk sn jw plNhr bkhshNhr qdr dyNndR ahy.
jnhn sn khy pnhnjy fDl sn sdy'yn rhN wry hndh lthw, nky sn khy mnjhs kw Dkh phchndw & nky sn khy mnjhs kw thak phchndw.
& jn kfr kyw tn li dwzkh jy bh ahy, nky mthn Hukm kbw th mrn & nky khy'n un jy `dhb mn ky hlkw kbw, sbhknhn by shukr khy hRy TrH sz Dynd ahywn.

chw' th jykDhn aun pnhnjy plNhr jy nfrmny kryn th byshk aun wDy Dynhn jy `dhb khn Ddyn thw.
chw' th pnhnjy `bdt llh li khlS kry fqT un jy `bdt kryn thw.

pwi llh khnswi jnhn khy (whyn) ghrw tnhn khy pwdyyw, (khyn) chw' th byshk cchyy'y wr uhy ahn jn gmrh thyN sbb pN khy & pnhnjy ghr wrn khy qymt jy Dynhn cchyy'y +m wdhw, khbrdr hwy'y pdhrw cchyy'w ahy.
sndn mthn bh jwn cchTywn & sndn hytthn bh (hR) wcchN hwnd, ihw (`dhb) ahy jnhn khn llh pnhnjn bnhn khy Dydyry thw, tnhnkry y mnhnj bnhw' mwn khn Ddyw.
& jn (mNhn) btn jy pwdy krN khn psw kyw & llh Dnhn wry tn li khwshkhbry ahy.
pwi (y pyGmbr) mnjhn unhn bnhn khy khwshkhbry Dy jyky Glh bdhnd ahn. pwi un mn tmm chNya ty hlnd ahn, ihy (uhy) ahn jn khy llh hdyt ky'y ahy & hy y'y dhyn wr ahn.
bhl jnhn ty `dhb jw Hukm thbt thyw (sw bchy sghndw cch?), twn bh +m pyl khy cchDy'y sghndyn cch?
pr jyky pnhnjy plNhr khn Dn tn li mRywn ahn unhn jy mthn (bywn) mRywn Dylywn ahn nhn jy hytthn whywn whndywn ahn, llh (ihw) njm kyw ahy, llh njm nh phyry'yndw ahy.

nh Dtthw thyy'y cch th llh asmn khn pNy wsyw pwi un khy zmyn jy chshmn +m whyy'yn wry un sn bhtyn bhtyn rng jy pwkh dymy'yndw ahy wry suky wyndy ahy pwi un khy zrd thyl Dsndw ahyn wry un khy dhr dhr kndw ahy, byshk un +m dhyn wrn li nSyHt ahy.

bhl jnhn jw synw (dyn) slm li llh khwlyw ahy & uhw pnhnjy plNhr jy (nuwr jy swjhry) ty hjy (sw skht dl wrn kfrn jhRw thyndw cch?), pwi unhn li wyl ahy jn jwn dlywn llh jy yd krN khn skht (thywn) ahn, ihy pdhrya gmrhy +m ahn.

llh tmm chNy Glh (y`ny) hRw ktb nzl kyw jw hk by'y jhR (snds mDmwn duhryl ahn un jy bdhN) khn unhn (mNhn) jwn khalwn knDrbywn ahn jyky pnhnjy plNhr khn Ddynd ahn, wry sndyn khalwn & sndyn dlywn llh jy yd krN ty kny'rywn thyndywn ahn, ih llh jy hdyt ahy jnhn khy ghry (tnhn khy) un sn wT Dykhry thw, & jnhn khy llh gmrh kry tnhn khy kw hdyt kndR kwnhy.
bhl jykw qymt jy Dynhn pnhnjy munhn sn bcchRy `dhb khy rwky thw (sw cchTl jy brbr thyndw cch?), & Zlmn khy chy'bw th jyky knd hyw' (tnhnjy sz) chNw.
jyky khny'n G hw tn bh kwR bhnyw (hw) pwi wTn utn `dhb phtw jtn dyNnd y'y nh hw.
pwi llh khyn dny jy Hytya +m khwry chkhy'y, & byshk akhrt jw `dhb (th) tmm wDw ahy, jykDhn (h Glh) dyNn h (th pN khy `dhb khn bchy'yn h).
& byshk mNhn li hn qran +m hr qsm j mthl byn kyswn th mna uhy nSyHt wtthn.
qran `rby (bwlya +m) by `yb (nzl kywswn) th mna uhy Ddyn.

llh mthl byn thw kry hk bnhw jnhn +m (ghN) bd mzj (mlk) bhy'ywr ahn & (byw) bnhw khlSw hkRy mNhwa jy mlkyt ahy mthl +m hy by'y (bnh) brbr thynd cch? sbh srh llh khy y'y juGy'y, pr nhn mn ghN nh dyNnd ahn.
(y pyGmbr) byshk twn (bh) mrndyn & byshk uhy (bh) mrnd.
wry byshk whyn qymt jy Dynhn pnhnjy plNhr wT pN +m jhGRw kndw'.
pwi un khn wdhyk Zlm kyr ahy jnhn llh ty kwR tthhyw & jDhn schw dyn wTs ayw (tDhn) un khy kwR dyty'yn, kfrn jy ji dwzkh +m nh ahy cch?
& jnhn schw dyn andw & (jnhn) khys sachw dytw ihy y'y prhyzgr ahn.
jyky ghrnd sw nhn li sndn plNhr wT ahy, bhlrn jw bdlw ihw ahy.
th jyky bcchR km kyy'wn sy llh khny'n myTy & jyky chN km knd hw tn bbt sndn (chNw) ujwrw khyn bdly +m Dy'y.
llh pnhnjy bnhy khy kfy nh ahy cch? & llh khnswi jyky (by) ahn tn khn twkhy Dydyrynd ahn, & jnhn khy llh bhuly'y tnhn khy kw hdyt krN wrw nh ahy.
& jnhn khy llh hdyt kry tnhn khy kw bhly'N wrw nh ahy, llh Glb bdly wtthN wrw nh ahy cch?

(y pyGmbr) jykDhn khny'n pucchyn th asmnn & zmyn khy knhn bNyw ahy? th Drwr chwnd th llh, (pwi khyn) chw' th llh khnswi jn khy sDynd ahyw tn khy Dsw (th shy) jykDhn llh mwn khy k skhty (phchy'N) ghry th ihy un jy (phchyl) skhtya jy lhN wr ahn cch? y mwn khy kw sukh (phchy'N) ghry th ihy (but) snds (phchyl) sukh jy bnd krN wr ahn cch? (twn khyn) chw' th mwn khy llh kfy ahy, bhrwsy kndR mths (y'y) bhrwsw knd ahn.
(khyn) chw' th y mnhnjy qwm whyn pnhnjy ji `ml kryw byshk aun (bh pnhnjy ji) `ml kndR ahyn, pwi sighwy'y dyNndw'.
th knhn ty (uhw) `dhb chy thw jw khys khwr kndw & mths hmyshh jw `dhb lhy thw.
byshk sn twty ktb mNhn li sch sn lthw, pwi jykw hdyt wrw thyw sw khS pnhnjy (fy'dy) li, & jykw gumrh thyw sw rGw pnhnjy (nqSn) li gumrh thy'y thw, & twn mthn kw dhmy wr nh ahyn.

llh mNhn j ruwH sndn mrN jy mhl kddhndw ahy & jykw nh muy'w ahy (tnhn jw rwH) snds nnD (jy Hlt) +m (kddhndw ahy), pwi jnhn ty mwt jw Hukm kyw ths tnhn khy jhlyndw ahy & un by'y khy hk muqrr mudWt ty'yn cchDyndw ahy, byshk hn +m mNhn li nshnywn ahn jyky dhyn knd ahn.
llh khnswi by shf`t krN wr wrt thn cch? (khyn) chw' th jytwNyk uhy nky kjh khtyr rkhnd hjn & nky smjhnd hjn (th bh shf`t knd cch?).
(khyn) chw' th sbh shf`t llh jy ws ahy, asmnn & zmyn jy bdshhy n jy ahy, (whyn) wry Dnhs mwTy'bw'.
& jDhn kyly llh (jy nly) khy yd kbw ahy (tDhn) jyky akhrt khy nh mnyynd ahn tn jwn dlywn Thndywn ahn, jDhn llh khnswi byn khy yd kbw ahy tDhn unhya y'y mhl uhy sarh thynd ahn.
(y pyGmbr) chw' th y llh asmnn & zmyn j pyd kndR Gjh & Zhr dyNndR twn y'y pnhnjn bnhn jy wch +m jnhn (Glh) bbt (uhy) jhGRw knd rhy (tnhn bbt) nbyrw kndyn.

& jyky zmyn +m sbhy'y ml ahy sw & un jytrw byw sNs jykDhn Zlmn khy hjy th jykr uhw qymt jy Dynhn bcchRy `dhb khn (bchN li) bdlw Dy'y chkn, & llh jy Trf khn hRw (m`mlw) nhn khy pdhrw thyndw jnhnjw gumn (y'y) nh rkhnd hw.
& jyky bcchRywn kmywn hwy'wn sy nhn khy pdhrywn thyndywn & jnhn (sz) jwn tthtthwlywn knd hw s khyn wyRhy wyndy.

pwi jDhn mNhwa khy k wkhy'y phchndy ahy (tDhn) sn khy sDyndw ahy, wry jDhn un khy pN wTn k n`mt Dynd ahywn (tDhn) chwndw ahy th uh rGw pnhnjy smjh sn (j mwn +m ahy) mwn khy Dny wy'y ahy, (yy'n nh ahy) blk uh (n`mt) prkh ahy pr unhn mn ghN nh dyNnd ahn.
byshk khny'n Gyn (bh) ih (Glh) chy'y hy'y pwi jyky (krtwt) kyy'wn thy tn khny'n kjh bh (muSybt) nh Try.
pwi jyky kmyy'wn tnhnjwn bcchRywn khyn phtywn, & hnn mn (bh) jyky Zlm ahn tn jyky kmyy'wn tnhnjwn bcchRywn khyn sighwy'y phchndywn & uhy `jz krN wr nh ahn.
nh dytw thn cch th llh jnhn li ghrndw ahy (tanhnjw) rzq kushdw kndw ahy & (jnhn li ghrndw ahy tanhnjw) ghT kndw ahy, byshk hn (km) +m unhn mNhn li nshnywn ahn jyky ymn aNynd ahn.
(mnhnjy Trfn unhn khy) chw' th y mnhnj uhy bnhw' jn pN ty Zlm kyw (whyn) llh jy bjh khn n umyd nh thyw, cchwth llh sbh gnh bkhshyndw ahy, byshk uhwy'y bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.
& pnhnjy plNhr Dnh wrw & un khn Gy snds frmnbrdr thyw jw whn wT `dhb chy (&) wry mdd nh Dn wyndw'.
& whn jy plNhr khn whn Dnhn jyk blkl chNy shy nzl ky'y wy'y ahy tnhn jy unhya khn G tb`dry kryw jw whn wT wchtw `dhb chy & whyn by khbr hjw.
(nhya kry khudi Dnhn mhR kryw & qran jy tb`dry kryw) th mtn pwi kwbh jyu chwy th hya rmn jw llh jy dyn +m susty kym & byshk (aun th) tthtthwlywn krN wrn mn hws.
y chwy th jykDhn llh mwn khy hdyt kry h th Drwr prhyzgrn mn thyn h.
y jDhn `dhb Dsy (tDhn) chwy th jy mnhnjw byw bhyrw (dny +m wnyN) thy'y th jykr bhlrn mn thyn.
(chy'bs th) hy'w! byshk tw wT mnhnjwn nshnywn aywn hywn pwi unhn khy kuwRw dyty'y & wDy'y kyy'y & kfrn mn thyy'n.
& qymt jy Dynhn twn nhn khy Dsndyn jn llh ty kwR badhw th sndn munhn kr thyl hwnd, wDy'y kndRn jy ji dwzkh +m nh ahy cch?
& jn prhyzgry ky'y tn khy llh sndn cchwTkry jy hndh +m (dwzkh khn) bchy'y phchy'yndw, nky khyn k mdy'y phchndy & nky uhy Gmgyn rhnd.
llh (y'y) sbhknhn shy jw khlqyndR ahy, & uhw sbhknhn shy jy snbhl kndR ahy.
asmnn & zmyn jwn kunjywn nhy y'y wT ahn, & jn llh jy nshnyn jw nkr kyw uhy y'y cchyy'y wr ahn.
chw' th y by `qlw' mwn khy (hy) Dsynd ahyw cch th llh khnswi by'y knhn jy `bdt kryn.
& (y pyGmbr) byshk twDnhn wHy kyw wyw & jyky twkhn G (by pyGmbr) hw tn (hr hk) Dnhn (bh) th jykDhn (llh sn kw) shryk mqrr kndyn th tnhnj `ml Drwr ns thynd & Drwr cchyy'y wrn mn thyndyn.
(nh!) blk rGw llh jy `bdt kr & shukr krN wrn mn huj.

& (unhn) llh khy jy'yn snds dyNN jw Hq ahy (ty'yn) nh snytw, & qymt jy Dynhn sry zmyn snds mutth +m hwndy & asmn snds sdyy hth +m wyRhyl hwnd, uhw pk ahy & unhya khn mthhwn ahy jyky sNs shryk tthhry'ynd ahn.
& (phrywn bhyrw) Suwr +m phwkyw wyndw pwi jyky asmnn +m ahy & jykw zmyn +m ahy sw (sbhkw) mrndw pr jnhn li llh ghryw (sw nh), wry un +m byw bhyrw phwkbw th umlk khR thy (py) Dsnd.
& zmyn pnhnjy plNhr jy nuwr sn rwshn thyndy & (`mln jw) ktb rkhbw & pyGmbrn & shhdn khy aNbw & sndn wch +m Hq sn nbyrw kbw & unhn ty Zlm nh kbw.
sbhknhn mNhwa jyky kmyw tnhnjw pwrw bdlw khys Dbw & jyky knd ahn tnhn khy llh dyNndw ahy.

& kfrn khy Twlywn Twlywn kry dwzkh Dnhn hklbw, tn jw jDhn un wT phchnd (tDhn) un j drwz khwlb & un j drwG khyn chwnd th whn mn whn wT ky pyGmbr nh ay hw cch? jw whn khy whn jy plNhr jwn aytwn pRhy bdhy'yn & whn khy hn Dynhn jy pysh chN khn Dydyryn, chwnd th hy'w (ay hw Dydyryw bh hwy'wn) pr kfrn ty `dhb jw Hukm thbt thyw.
(pwi nhn khy) chy'bw th dwzkh jy drwzn mn ghRw mnjhs sdy'yn rhndR ahyw, pwi wDy'y kndRn jy ji bcchRy ahy.
& jyky pnhnjy plNhr khn Dn sy Twlywn Twlywn bhsht Dnhn rwn kb, tnjw jDhn un wqt ynd & un j drwz khwlb & un j dwrwG khyn chwnd th whn ty slm hjy whyn (hNy) khwsh rhw pwi mnjhs hmyshh rhN li ghRw.
& chwnd th sbh srh nhya llh khy juGy'y jnhn pnhnjw njm sn sn schw kyw & sn khy (hn) zmyn jw wrth kyy'yn bhsht mn jty wNndw thwn uty jGh wtthwn th, pwi `ml kndRn jw ajr (khRwnh) chNw ahy.
& mly'kn khy `rsh jy chwdhry wkwRyndR Dsndyn pnhnjy plNhr jy srh sn gD pky'y byn knd ahn, & unhn jy wch +m nSf jw Hukm kbw & (akhr +m) chyw wyndw th sbh srh jhnn jy plNhr llh khy juGy'y.
Hm.
(hn) ktb jw hytth lhN llh Glb dyNndR wTn ahy.
jw gnh bkhshyndR & twbh qbwl kndR skht sz DyndR sgh wrw ahy, un khnswi (byw) kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, Dnhs wrNw ahy.
kfrn khnswi llh jy aytn bbt (byw) kwbh tkrr nh kndw ahy pwi shhrn +m (wpr li) sndn ch wny twkhy nh tthGy.

khny'n G nuwH jy qwm & nhn pdyN byn (kytryn y'y) Twlyn kuwR dytw, & sbhknhn Twlya pnhnjn pyGmbr jw qSd kyw th khys pkRyn & jyn (Glhyn) sn jhyRw knd rhy th un sn schya Glh khy ns kn pwi khyn wrtm, pwi mnhnjy sz (DyN) kyy'n hy'y.
& hRy TrH tnhnjy plNhr jw Hukm kfrn ty thbt thyw ahy th uhy dwzkhy ahn.

jyky (mly'k) `rsh khy khNnd ahn & jyky un jy chwdhry ahn sy pnhnjy plNhr jy pky'y srh sn gD byn knd ahn & mths ymn aNynd ahn & mw'mn li bkhshsh ghrnd ahn, (chwnd ahn th) y sn j plNhr sbhknhn shy khy pnhnjy bjh & `lm +m wkwRyw thyy'y tnhnkry jn twbh ky'y & tnhnjy wT jy tb`dry ky'y tn khy bkhsh & khyn dwzkh jy `dhb khn bchi.

y sn j plNhr khyn un hmyshh rhN wrn bGn +m dkhl kr jn jw sNn w`dw kyw thyy'y & jyky sndn pyn DDn & sndn zln & sndn wld mn sdhryl hjy tnhn khy bh (unhn bGn +m dkhl kr), byshk twn y'y Glb Hkmt wrw ahyn.
& khyn skhtyn khn bchi, & jnhn khy un Dynhn +m skhtyn khn bchyy'y tnhn ty byshk rHm kyy'y, & ihw (bchy'N) wDy murd mNN ahy.
byshk jn kufr kyw tn khy sDbw (& chy'bw) th llh jw (whn ty) DmrjN whn jy pN ty (dy jy) DmrjN khn tmm wDw ahy jDhn jw whn khy (dny +m) ymn Dnhn sDbw hw & nh mnyynd hy'w.
chwnd th y snj plNhr sn khy bh bhyr mryy'y & sn khy bh bhyr jyryy'y tnhnkry (hNy) pnhnjn gnhn khy (pN) mnyywswn pwi (hNy) nkrN jy k wh (kthy) ahy?

(chy'bn) ihw (`dhb whn khy) nhya kry ahy jw jDhn (khS) kyly llh khy sDbw hw (tDhn) whyn nkr knd hy'w, & jykDhn sNs shryk tthhryw wyndw hw th (n Glh khy) mnyynd hy'w, pwi (dy) tmm mthhyn wDy llh jw Hkm ahy.
(llh) uhw ahy jykw whn khy pnhnjwn nshnywn Dykhryndw ahy & asmn mn whn li rwzy nzl kndw ahy, & nSyHt rGw uhw wtthndw jykw (khd Dnhn) mwTndw.
pwi llh li pnhnjy `bdt khy khlS kry un khy sDyw jytwNyk kfr bcchn bhny'yn.
(uhw) mrtbn khy wDy krN wrw & `rsh jw SHb ahy, pnhnjn bnhn mn jnhn ty ghrndw ahy (tnhn ty) pnhnjy Hkm sn wHy mwklyndw ahy th (uhw bnhw mNhn khy llh jy) mlN jy Dynhn khn Dydyry.
jnhn Dynhn uhy (qbrn mn) bhr nkrnd, nhn jy kbh shy llh khn Gujhy nh rhndy, (llh frmy'yndw th) dy knhn jy bdshhy ahy, (wry pN chwndw) khS kyly Glb llh jy (bdshhy) ahy.
dy sbhknhn jiya khy unhy jw bdlw Dbw jykw kmyw ths, dy kw Zlm kwnhy, byshk llh jld Hsb wtthN wrw ahy.
& (y pyGmbr) khyn qymt jy Dynhn (jy unhya mhl) khn Dydyr jnhn mhl dlywn niR ghTn khy wyjhw thyndywn (uhy) Dkh bhryl hwnd, (un Dynhn) Zlmn jw kw dwst & nh kw prt kndR hwndw jnhn jy Glh mnyjy.
khyn jy khynt (wry ngh) & jyky syn lky'ynd ahn sw (llh) dyNndw ahy.
& llh nSf sn Hukm kndw ahy, & (mnkr) llh khnswi jn khy sDynd ahn sy kjh bh Hukm nh knd ahn, byshk llh y'y bdhndR DsndR ahy.

mulk +m nh ghmy ahn cch? th (nhry) Dsn th nhn jy pcchRy khRy TrH thy jyky khny'n G hw, uhy khy'n sgh +m zmyn ty nshnyn (y`ny mHltn jwRN) +m tmm Dddh hw pwi llh sndn gnhn sbbn khyn pkRyw, & llh (jy `dhb) khn unhn khy kw bchy'yndR nh hw.
ih (sz) hn kry hyn jw sndn pyGmbr (pdhrn) mu`jzn sn wTn ay thy pwi nkr kyy'wn tnhnkry llh khyn pkRyw, byshk uhw sghrw skht sz DyN wrw ahy.
& byshk mws~ khy pnhnjn mu`jzn & pdhrya HujWt sn mwklywswn.
fr`wn & hmn & qrwn Dnhn pwi chyy'wn th kuwRw jdwgr ahy.
pwi jnhn mhl sn wTn hnn wT schy (pyGm) sn ayw (tnhn mhl) chyy'wn th jn mths ymn andw ahy tn j puT kuhw & sndn dhyy'rwn jyy'rwn cchDyw, & kfrn jw fryb th rGw GlTya +m ahy.
& fr`wn (drbr wrn khy) chyw th mwn khy cchDyw th mws~ khy kuhn & bhly th pnhnjy plNhr khy sDy, byshk aun Ddyn thw th mtn whn jw dyn mTy'y y mulk +m fsd pyd kry.
& mws~ chyw th byshk mwn sbhknhn htthyly (jy lchy'ya) khn jw Hsb jy Dynhn khy nh mnyyndw ahy pnhnjy plNhr & whn jy plNhr jy pnh wrty.

& fr`wn jy my'Tn mn hk mw'mn mRs jw pnhnjw ymn lky'yndw hw (tnhn) chyw th hRy mRs khy khw th cch jw chwy thw th mnhnjw plNhr llh ahy & byshk whn wT whn jy plNhr khn (chT) mu`jz and ths, jykDhn khNy kwRw hjy th snds kwR (jw wbl) mths ahy, & jykDhn schw hwndw th jykw w`dw whn sn kry thw tnhn mn kjh whn khy Drwr phchndw, cchwth jykw Hd khn lnghndR kwRw hwndw tnhn khy llh sdhw rstw nh Dykhryndw ahy.

y mnhnjy qwm dy whn jy bdshhy ahy mulk +m (whyn) Glb ahyw, jykDhn (`dhb) sn wT chy th llh jy `dhb khn (bchN li) sn khy kyr whr Dyndw? fr`wn chyw th jyk (chNy mSlHt) Dsn thw tnhn khnswi (by) whn khy nh thw Dykhryn & whn khy sdhy rsty khnswi (byw rstw) nh thw Dykhryn.
& jnhn ymn andw hw tnhn chyw th y mnhnjy qwm byshk aun whn ty Gyn Twlyn jhRy (`dhb jy) Dynhn (chN) khn Ddyn thw.
jhRw Hl nwH jy qwm & `d & thmwd & jyky khy'n pwi hw tn jw (thyw hw thRw mtn thy'y), & llh bnhn ty Zlm krN nh ghrndw ahy.
& y mnhnjy qwm byshk aun whn ty hk by'y khy sDN jy (nhya) Dynhn (chN) khn Ddyn thw.
jnhn Dynhn whyn ptthyr thy bhdyndw', llh khnswi (byw) whn khy kw bchy'N wrw nh hwndw, & jnhn khy llh bhuly'y cchDy tnhn khy kw sidhw rstw DykhrN wrw kwnhy.

& byshk hn khn G whn wT ywsf mu`jzn sn ayw hw pwi jyky whn wT andy'yn tnhn khn (whyn) hmyshh shk +m huy'w', tn jw jDhn muy'w (tDhn) chywa th un khn pwi (byw) kw pyGmbr llh nh mwklyndw, hRy TrH jykw Hd khn lnghndR shk kndR ahy tnhn khy llh bhuly'yndw ahy.

unhn khy (bhuly'yndw ahy) jyky llh jy nshnyn bbt hRya HujWt dhrn j wTn ay'y hjy jhGRw knd ahn, (hw sndn jhGRw krN) llh wT & muw'mnn wT wDy GDb jhRy Glh ahy, hRy TrH llh sbhknhn wDy'y kndR htthyly jy dl ty muhr hNndw ahy.
& fr`wn chyw th y hmn mwn li hk mRy bNi th mna (nhn) wTn sn phchn.

asmnn jy wTn khy th muws~ jy m`buwd jy sdh lhn & byshk aun khys kwRw bhy'yndw ahyn, & hRya TrH fr`wn khy snds bcchRw km chNw kry Dykhryw wyw & sdhya wT khn jhlyw wyw, & fr`wn jw mkr ruGw khrbya +m hw.
& jnhn ymn andw hw tnhn chyw th y mnhnjy qwm mnhnjy tb`dry kryw th (aun) whn khy sdhy rsty lyn.
y mnhnjy qwm hya dny jy Hyty (thwry) wth khnswi (byw) ky nh ahy, & byshk akhrt y'y sdy'yn rhN jw hndh ahy.
jnhn bd km kyw tnhn khy rGw uhRw bdlw Dbw, & jnhn chNw km kyw khwh mRs hjy khwh zl & uhw mw'mn bh hjy th uhy bhsht +m ghRnd mnjhs N GNy rwzy Dbyn.
y mnhnjy qwm mwn khy cch (thyw) ahy jw (aun) whn khy cchwTkry Dnhn sDyn thw & (whyn) mwn khy bh Dnhn sDyw th.
(whyn) mwn khy sDyw th th llh jw nkr kryn & sNs hRy shy shryk tthhryn jnhn (jy Hqyqt) jy mwn khy dyNp nh ahy, & aun whn khy Glb bkhshNhr Dnhn sDyn thw.
blshk whyn mwn khy unhya Dnhn sDyw th jnhn khy dny & akhrt +m sDN jw kw Hq nh ahy & byshk sn jw mwTN llh Dnhn ahy & byshk Hd khn lnghndR y'y dwzkhy ahn.
pwi jyky whn khy chwn thw sw sghw yd kndw', & (aun) pnhnjw km llh khy swnpyn thw, cchw th llh bnhn (jy Hl) khy DsndR ahy.
pwi jyky phnd sTyy'wn tn jy bcchRy'ya khn llh khys bchyw & fr`wn jy mNhn khy bcchRy `dhb ghyryw.
j bh ahy jnhn ty SbH & snjhya jw khyn HDr kbw ahy, & jnhn Dynhn qymt qy'm thyndy, (tnhn Dynhn Hukm kbw th) fr`wnyn khy skht `dhb +m ghyRyw.
& (yd kr) jDhn bh +m hk by'y sn jhGRw knd (tDhn) hyN htthyln khy chwnd th byshk syn whn j tb`dr hwswn tnhnkry bh (jy `dhb) mn kw HSWw whyn sn khn TrN wr ahyw (y nh)?
htthyl chwnd th byshk syn (pN) sbh mnjhs (pyl) ahywn byshk llh bnhn jy wch +m nbyrw kry chkw ahy.
& dwzkhy dwzkh jy drwGn khy chwnd th whyn pnhnjy plNhr khy `rD kryw th sn khn hkRw Dynhn kjh `dhb hlkw kry.
(drwG) chwnd th whn j pyGmbr (pdhrn) m`jzn sn whn wT nh ynd hw cch? chwnd th hy'w (ynd hw), (drwG) chwnd th pwi (whyn) pN pkryw, & kfrn jw pkrN rGw gmrhy +m ahy.
byshk syn pnhnjn pyGmbrn jy & mw'mnn jy dny jy Hytya +m Drwr mdd kndswn & jnhn Dynhn shhd khR thynd (tnhn Dynhn bh mdd kndswn).
jnhn Dynhn Zlmn khy sndn bhnw nf`w nh Dyndw & khyn l`nt ahy & nhn li (uty) bucchRy ji ahy.
& byshk muws~ khy hdyt Dny swn & bny sry'yln khy ktb jw wrth kywswn.
jw dhyn wrn jy smjhy'N & nSyHt DyN li ahy.
pwi (y pyGmbr) Sbr kr cchwth llh jw w`dw schWw ahy & pnhnjy gnh jy bkhshsh ghr & SbH snjhya jw pnhnjy plNhr jy srh sn gD pky'y byn kr.

byshk jyky llh jy aytn bbt (unhya) HujWt dhrn j wTn ay'y hjy jhGRw knd ahn tn jy synn +m wDy'y (jy rdy) khnswi (byw) ky nh ahy jnhn khy uhy puhchN wr nh ahn, pwi llh jy pnh ghr, byshk uhw bdhndR DsndR ahy.
byshk asmnn & zmyn jy bNwt mNhn jy bNwt khn tmm wDy ahy pr ghN mNhw nh dyNnd ahn.
& ndhw & sdyw (pN +m) brbr nh ahy, & (nky) jn ymn andw & chN km ky (sy) nky mdy'y krN wrw (brbr ahn), whyn thwry nSyHt wtthnd ahyw.
byshk qymt Drwr chNy ahy mnjhs kw shk nh ahy, pr ghN mNhw wysh nh rkhnd ahn.
& whn jw plNhr frmy'y thw th whyn mwn khn du` ghrw th whn jy du` qbwl kryn, byshk jyky mnhnjy `bdt khn wDy'y knd ahn sy khwr thy dwzkh +m sghwy'y ghRnd.
llh uhw ahy jnhn whn li rt khy pyd kyw th mnjhs arm wtthw & Dynhn khy whn jy (hk by'y khy) DsN li (pyd kyw) byshk llh mNhn ty fDl (krN) wrw ahy pr ghN mNhw shkr nh knd ahn.
hw llh whn jw plNhr hr shy khy khlqyndR ahy, un khnswi (byw) kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy, pwi whyn kyDnhn phyry wynd ahyw.
hRy TrH uhy (sy'yn wT khn) bhuly'b ahn jn llh jy aytn jw nkr thy kyw.

llh uhw ahy jnhn whn li zmyn khy arm jw hndh & asmn khy ccht bNyw & whn jy shkl tthhyy'yn pwi whn jwn shklywn tmm chNywn bNyy'yn & whn khy stthyn stthyn shyn mn rwzy Dny'yn, hw llh whn jw plNhr ahy, pwi jhnn jw plNhr wDy brkt wrw ahy.
uhw (sdy'yn) jyy'rw ahy un khnswi kw `bdt jw ly'q nh ahy tnhnkry un li (pnhnjy) `bdt khy khlS kry khys sDyw, sbh srh jhnn jy plNhr llh khy jGy'y.

(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th llh khnswi jn khy (whyn) sDynd ahyw tn jy pwdyN khn jDhn mnhnjy plNhr wTn mwn wT (Sf) nshnywn aywn (tDhn unhya wqt) byshk aun jhlyw wyw ahyn & mwn khy Hkm kyw wyw ahy th jhnn jy plNhr jw frmnbrdr hjn.

(llh) uhw ahy jnhn whn khy mTya mn bNyw wry nuTfy mn wry rt jy dG mn wry whn khy br kry kddhy thw wry (cchDy thw) th (whyn) pnhnjy pwrya sgh khy puhchw wry (cchDy thw) th buddhR thyw, & whn mn knhn khy (in khn) G mrbw ahy & (cchDy thw) th muqrWr mdt khy phchw & mna whyn smjhw.
(llh) uhw ahy jykw jyryndw ahy & mryndw ahy, pwi jDhn knhn km jw Hukm kndw ahy tDhn un khy rGw chwndw ahy th thyu th thy pwndw ahy.
(y pyGmbr) nhn Dnhn nh Dtthw thyy'y cch jyky llh jy aytn bbt jhGRw knd ahn? (uhy) kyDnhn phyry wynd ahn.
jn ktb khy kuwR dytw & jnhn (shy) sn pnhnjn pyGmbrn khy mwklywswn tnhn khy (bh) sghwy'y dyNnd.
jDhn sndn Gichyn +m GaT & znjyr (hwnd), uhy gihlb.
ThkndR pNya +m, wry bh +m Tchky wynd.
wry khyn chy'bw th jyky whyn shryk tthhry'ynd hyw' sy kithy ahn?
llh dhrn (by) (uhy) chwnd th sn (jy nZr) khn gum thy wy blk knhn shy khy Gy nh pwdyynd hwswn, hRya TrH llh kfrn khy gumrh kndw ahy.
ih (sz) inhya sbbn ahy jw whyn zmyn +m nHq khwshya (sbb akR) knd hy'w & hn sbbn (bh) jw whyn lD knd hy'w.
(hNy) dwzkh jy drwzn mn ghRw mnjhs sdy'yn rhndR (ahyw), pwi (Dsw th dwzkh) htthyln jy ji bcchRy ahy.
pwi (y pyGmbr twn) Sbr kr byshk llh jw w`dw schw ahy, tnhnkry jykDhn khyn jykw njm Dywn th tnhn mn kjh twkhy (duny +m) Dykhrywn y (`dhb jy Zhr thyN khn G) twkhy mrywn th (nytth) sn Dnhn mwTy'b.

& byshk twkhn G kytry'y pyGmbr mwklyswn mnjhy'n knhn jw Hwl twkhy byn kywswn & mnjhy'n knhn jw Hwl twkhy byn nh kywswn, & knhn bh pyGmbr khy llh jy Hukm khnswi kw (bh) mu`jzw aNNw nh hw, pwi jDhn llh jw Hukm ayw tDhn nSf sn nbyrw kyw wyndw & uty kwuRn cchyy'w ptw.
llh uhw ahy jnhn whn li ddhwr pyd ky th unhn mn kn ty chRhw & mnjhy'n ky khy'ynd ahyw.
& mnjhn whn li (ghN) fy'd ahn & th mthn chRhy unhy mTlb khy phchw jw whn jy dlyn +m ahy & mthn & byRyn ty whn khy chRhbw ahy.
& (llh) whn khy pnhnjwn nshnywn Dykhryndw ahy, pwi llh jy khRyn (khRyn) nshnyn khn nkr kndw'.

pwi zmyn +m nh ghmy ahn cch? jw nhryn th jyky khy'n G hw tn jy pcchRy kyy'n thy, (jw) khy'n ghN hw & sgh +m & zmyn ty nshnyn kry (jy cchDy wy) tmm Dddh hw pwi jyky (krtwt) kmyy'wn tn khy'n kjh bh nh Tryw.
pwi jnhn mhl sndn pyGmbr mu`jzn sn wTn ay (tnhn mhl) jykw (dny hly'N jw) `ilm wTn hw tnhn sbbn khwsh thy & jnhn (Glh) ty tthtthwlywn knd hw tnhn (jy bcchRy'y) khyn wyRhyw.
pwi jnhn mhl sn jw `dhb Dtthy'wn (tnhn mhl) chyy'wn th kyly llh ty ymn andwswn & jnhn shy khy (sNs) shryk mqrr knd hwswn tnhnj mnkr thyswn.
pwi jDhn sn jw `dhb Dtthy'wn (tDhn) sndn ymn aNN khyn fy'dw kDhn nh Dnw, (hw) llh jw dstwr ahy jw snds bnhn +m hlyw yndw ahy, un hndh kfr TwTy wr thy.
Hm.
(hn ktb jw llh) bjhry mhrbn wTn nzl thyN ahy.

jw khwshkhbry DyndR DydyryndR ahy, pwi ghNn (mNhn) munhn mwRyw tnhnkry uhy (un khy) bdhndy'y nh ahn.

& chwnd ahn th jnhn Dnhn sn khy sDyndw ahyn tnhn khn sn jwn dlywn prdy +m ahn & sn jy kann +m ghbry'y ahy & sn jy & whn jy wch +m wT ahy tnhnkry (twn pnhnjya TrH) km kr byshk syn (pnhnjya TrH) km krN wr ahywn.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th aun (bh) whn y'y jhRw mNhw ahyn mgr mwn Dnhn wHy kyw wyndw ahy th whn jw m`buwd hk khd ahy tnhnkry Dnhs sdh mtwjh thyw & khny's bkhshsh ghrw, & (unhn) mshrkn li wyl ahy.
jyky zkw@ nh Dynd ahn & uhy akhrt khy (bh) nh mnyynd ahn.
byshk jn ymn andw & chN km ky tn li aN khuT ajr ahy.

& un (zmyn) +m mthny's Gr jbl bNyy'yn & mnjhs brkt rkhyy'yn & chy'n Dynhn +m mnjhs un (jy rhkn) j quwt muqrWr kyy'yn, pcchndRn li brbr (khwly byn kyw wyw) ahy.

pwi jykDhn (uhy) munhn mwRyn th chw' th whn khy hRy `dhb khn Dydyrym jhRw `d & thamuwd jw `dhb (hw).

jDhn pyGmbr sndn Gyn & sndn pwyn nhn wT ay (pyGmbrn chyw) th llh khnswi (by'y) knhn jy `bdt nh kryw, chyy'wn th jykDhn sn jw plNhr ghry h th Drwr mly'kn khy mwkly h tnhnkry (whyn) jnhn sn mwkly wy ahyw tnhnkhy syn mnyN wr nh ahywn.
pwi `d (wrn) zmyn +m nHq wDy'y ky'y & chyy'wn th sgh +m sn khn wdhyk Dddhw kyr ahy? nh Dtthw thn cch th hw llh jnhn khyn pyd kyw s khy'n sgh +m wdhyk Dddhw ahy, & (uhy) sn jy nshnyn jw nkr knd rhy.
tnhnkry nHs (y`ny muSybt jy) Dynhn +m mthn skht wu mwklywswn th khyn duny jy Hytya +m khwrya wrw `dhb chkhywn, & byshk akhrt jw `dhb th wdhyk khrb kndR ahy & unhn khy (k) mdd nh Dby.

tnjw jDhn (uhy mRyy'y) un (dwzkh) wT ynd (tnhn mhl) sndn kan & sndn khywn & sndn khalwn jyky uhy (dny +m) knd hw tnhnjy mthn shhdy Dyndywn.

& whyn pnhnjn kanWn & pnhnjyn khyn & pnhnjyn khalun jy pN ty shhdy DyN khn prdw nh knd hy'w' pr whn y'y bhnyw hw th jyky knd hy'w tnhn mn ghNw (Hwl) llh nh dyNndw ahy.
& whn jw uhw gmn jykw pnhnjy plNhr jy Hq +m (GlTya sn) bhnyw huy'w tnhn (hNy) whn khy hlk kyw tnhnkry (dy) cchyy'y wrn mn thyw'.
pwi jykDhn Sbr knd th (bh) unhn jy ji bh ahy, jykDhn m`fy ghrnd th (bh) unhn khy m`fy nh mlndy.

& nhn li (shyTn) sngty muqrWr kyswn pwi jyky sndn Gyn & jyky sndn pwyn ahy tnhnkhy unhn li (sndn sngtyn) syngryw & (nhya kry unhn Twlyn +m gDjy) mthn sz thbt thy jyky khy'n G jinWn & mNhn mn gdhry wy ahn, byshk uhy (sbh) TwTy wr hw.
& kfrn (hk by'y khy) chyw th hn qaran khy nh budhw & un (jy pRhN jy wch +m) luR mchyw th mna whyn Glb thyw.
pwi kfrn khy Drwr skht sz jw mzw chkhy'yndswn & jyky tmm bcchRw (km) knd hw tnhn jw bdlw Drwr khyn Dyndswn.
llh jy wyryn jy sz ih (y'y) bh ahy, unhn li uty hmyshh jw ghr hwndw, nhya kry sz (hwndyn) jw sn jy aytn jw nkr knd hw.
& kfr chwnd th y sn j plNhr jinWn & mNhn mn jn sn khy gumrh kyw sy sn khy Dykhr th pnhnjn pyrn jy hytthn kry ltRywn th bhly th (sbh khn) hytthhn hjn.

byshk jn chyw th sn jw plNhr llh ahy wry (n Glh ty) byhk wrty'wn tn ty (mwt wqt rHmt j) mly'k lhnd ahn (chwnd athn) th nh Ddyw & nky GNty kryw & unhya bhsht (jy khwshkhbrya) sn khwsh thyw jnhn jw whn khy w`dw Dnw wyndw hw.
syn duny jy Hytya +m whn j dwst hwswn & akhrt +m bh (whn j dwst ahywn), & jyky whn jw jyu khwhsh kndw sw whn li mnjhs ahy & jyky whyn ghrndw' sw (pN) whn li mnjhs ahy.
(h) mhmny bkhshNhr mhrbn (khd) wTn ahy.
& nhya khn wdhyk chNw Glh +m kyr ahy jnhn llh Dnhn sDyw & (pN +m) chN km kyy'yn & chyw th byshk aun muslmnn mn ahyn?
& nyky & bdy pN +m brbr nh ahn, (& nyky) j Dddhy chNy ahy tnhn sn (mdy'y khy) Tryw, jw unhya jy & tnhnjy wch +m dshmny ahy sw dyNk dwst my'Ty wrw thyndw.
& ih (Glh) Sbrn khnswi by'y khy HSl nh thyndy ahy, & nky wDy nSyb wry khnswi (by'y khy) ih HSl thyndy ahy.
& jykDhn twkhy shyTn khn (dl +m) k chwk chy th llh jy pnh ghur, cchwth uhw bdhndR dyNndR ahy.
& snds (qdrt jy) nshnyn mn rt & Dynhn & sj & chnD ahy, nky sj khy & nky chnD khy sjdw kryw & nhya llh khy sjdw kryw jnhn nhn khy khlqyw jykDhn khS sndys `bdt knd ahyw.
pwi jykDhn wDy'y kn th (cch thyw) jyky tnhnjy plNhr wT ahn sy rt & Dynhn snds tsbyHwn chwnd ahn & uhy nh thkb ahn.

& snds (qdrt jy) nshnyn mn hyu bh ahy jw zmyn khy wsNl Dsndw ahyn pwi jDhn mths (mynhn jw) pNy wsyw swn (tDhn) chry & ubhmy, byshk jnhn unhy (zmyn) khy jyryw ahy sw Drwr muy'n khy (bh) jyrN wrw ahy, byshk uhw sbhknhn shya ty ws wrw ahy.
byshk jyky sn jy aytn +m Dngy'y knd ahn sy sn khn Gujh nh ahn, bhl jykw bh +m wjhbw sw bhlw ahy y jykw qymt jy Dynhn amn wrw thy yndw? jyky wNywa sw kryw byshk jyky knd ahyw sw khud DsndR ahy.

jw nky un jy Gyn & nky un jy pwyn kuwR dkhl thyndw ahy, Hkmt wry srhyl (llh jy pr) khn lthl ahy.
(y pyGmbr) twkhy unhya khnswi (byw) ky nh chy'bw ahy jyky twkhn G (byn) pyGmbrn khy chyw wyw hw, byshk tnhnjw plNhr bkhshsh wrw (bh) ahy & Dkhwy'yndR sz DyN wrw (bh) ahy.

& byshk muws~ khy ktb Dnwswn pwi mnjhs khtlf kyw wyw, & jykDhn tnhnjy plNhr khn Hukm aGTw nh thy'y h th sndn wch +m Drwr nbyrw kyw wnyy h, & byshk uhy khny's wDy shk +m (pyl) ahn.
jykw chN km kndw sw pN li (kndw) tnhn ty (y'y un jw nqSn) ahy, & tnhnjw plNhr bnhn ty Zlm krN wrw ahy.

qymt (chN) jy khbr llh (y'y) jy Hwly ahy, & snds dyNp dhrn ky myw pnhnjn Gbhyn mn nh nkrnd ahn & (snds dyNp dhrn) kbh mdy nky ddhuky thyndy ahy & nky dyNyndy ahy, & un Dynhn (llh) khyn sDyndw th mnhnj shryk (jy whyn muqrWr knd hy'w sy) kthy ahn chwnd th twkhy khbr Dny swn th sn sn kwbh (unhn jw) shhd kwnhy.
& jn khy (hn khn) G (dny +m) pwdyynd hw sy khy'n bhuljy wynd & bhny'ynd th khyn kw cchwTkrw kwnhy.
mNhw chNy'ya jy sDN (du` ghrN) khn nh thkbw ahy, & jykDhn khys (k) mdy'y phchndy ahy th pwi asrw cchiny n umyd thyndw ahy.

& jykDhn khys wkhy'y phchN khn pwi pN wTn k bjh chkhy'ynd ahywn th Drwr chwndw ahy th hya mwn (y'y) li ahy & nh thw bhnyn th qymt qy'm thyNy ahy & jykDhn (aun) pnhnjy plNhr Dnhn (khNy) mwTy'bs th byshk mwn li wTs (bh) Drwr chNy Hlt hwndy, pwi kfrn jyky kyw ahy tnhn bbt khyn Drwr khbrdr kndswn, & khyn skht `dhb Drwr chkhy'yndswn.
& jDhn mNhwa ty fDl knd ahywn (tDhn) munhn phyry'yndw ahy & pnhnjw psw mwRyndw ahy, & jDhn khys k wkhy'y phchndy ahy tDhn wDywn d`y'wn ghurndw ahy.
(y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th whyn Dsw th jykDhn (qran) llh wTn hjy wry snds nkr kryw th jykw wDy DidW +m pyl hjy tnhn khn wdhyk gumrh kyr ahy?
pnhnjywn nshnywn mulkn +m sndn wjwdn +m khyn sghwy'y Dykhrynd swn tn jw khyn pdhrw thyndw byshk ihw (qran) schw ahy, tnhnjw plNhr kfy nh ahy cch jykw sbhknhn shy ty HDr ahy?
khbrdr byshk uhy pnhnjy plNhr jy mlN khn shk +m (pyl) ahn, khbrdr uhw hr knhn shy khy wkwRyndR ahy.
Hm.
`sq.
Glb Hkmt wrw llh hRya TrH twDnhn wHy mwkly thw & unhn Dnhn (bh) jyky twkhn G hw (mwklyndw) rhyw.
jyky asmnn +m ahy & jyky zmyn +m ahy sw (sbh) snds ahy, & uhw (sbh khn) mthhwn (&) wDw ahy.
(khud jy dhsht khn) asmn pnhnjy mthn stt y'y phTnd & mly'k pnhnjy plNhr jy srh sn gD pky'y byn knd ahn & jyky zmyn +m ahn tn li bkhshsh ghrnd ahn, khbrdr byshk llh y'y bkhshNhr mhrbn ahy.

& hRya TrH twDnhn `rbya (bwlya) +m qran wHy kywswn th mkWy wrn & snds as ps wrn khy Dydyryn & qymt jw Dynhn jnhn +m kw shk nh ahy tnhn khn (pN) Dydyryn, hk Twly bhsht +m & by Twly dwzkh +m hwndy.
& jykDhn llh ghury h th unhn sbhny khy hk Twly kry h pr jnhn khy ghry tnhn khy pnhnjy bjh +m dkhl kndw ahy, & Zlmn jw nky kw dwst & nky kw mddgr ahy.

& jnhn (Glh) bbt tkrr kyw thwa sw kjh bh hjy th unhya jw nbyrw llh Dnhn (Hwly kyl) ahy, mnhnjw plNhr hw llh ahy mthy bhrwsw kym, & Dnhs mwTn thw.
asmn & zmyn jw bNy'yndR ahy, whn jy jns mn whn li zlwn pyd kyy'yn & ddhwrn (jy jns) mn kytry'y y'y qism (bNyy'yn), nhy TrH sn whn khy pkhyRy thw, un jhRy k (bh) shya nh ahy, & uhw bdhndR DsndR ahy.
asmnn & zmyn jwn knjywn khys ahn, jnhn li guhry (tnhn li) rwzy kshdy kndw ahy & (jnhn li ghury tnhn li) tng kndw ahy, byshk uhw hr shy khy dyNndR ahy.

whn li hw dyn muqrWr kyy'yn jnhn (jy qy'm krN) jw nuwH khy Hukm kyw hwy'yn & jykw twDnhn bh wHy kywsyn & uhw jnhn (jy qy'm krN) jw brhym & muws~ & `ys~ khy Hukm kywswn th dyn khy qy'm kryw & mnjhs dhr dhr nh thyw, mushrkn khy uh (Glh) Dkhy lGy jnhn Dnhn khyn sDyndw ahyn, llh jnhn khy ghury (tnhn khy) pN Dnhn chwnDyndw ahy & jykw (Dnhs) wrndw ahy tnhn khy pN Dnhn hdyt kndw ahy.

pwi (twn) nhya (dyn) Dnhn sD, & jy'n twkhy Hukm kyw wyw ahy (tyy'n) byhk wtth, & sndn sadhn jy tb`dry nh kr, & chw' th jykw bh ktb llh lthw tnhn khy mnyym, & mwn khy Hukm thyl ahy th whn jy wch +m nSf kryn, llh sn jw plNhr & whn jw plNhr ahy, sn li sn j `ml & whn li whn j `ml ahn, sn jy & whn jy wch +m kw tkrr kwnhy, llh sn sbhny khy (qymt jy) Dynhn gD kndw, & Dnhs mwTN ahy.
& llh (jy dyn) bbt snds frmn qbwl thyN khnpwi jykw jhGRw knd ahn tn jy Hujt sndn plNhr wT kwRy (thyN wry) ahy & mthn (llh jw) Dmr ahy & unhn li skht `dhb ahy.

jyky qymt khy nh mnyynd ahn sy un khy tkRw ghrnd ahn, & jn ymn andw ahy sy un khn Ddynd ahn & dyNnd ahn th byshk uh sch (chNy) ahy, khbrdr byshk jyky qymt bbt jhGRw knd ahn sy byshk wDya gumrhya +m ahn.

unhn (y`ny kfrn) j ky hR shryk ahn cch jn unhn li dyn mn (uhw) ny'wn rstw bNyw ahy jnhn jw llh Hukm nh Dnw ahy, & jykDhn fySly krN jw w`dw (thyl) nh hjy h th Drwr (hNy y'y) sndn wch +m nbyrw kjy h, & byshk Zlmn li y'y Dkhwy'yndR `dhb ahy.

ihw (thwb) uhw ahy jnhn jy llh pnhnjn unhn bnhn khy khwshkhbry Dyndw ahy jn ymn andw ahy & chN km ky ahn, (y pyGmbr khyn) chw' th aun whn khn un (pyGm phchy'N) ty kw ujwrw nh thw ghurn pr (jGy'y th) my'Tn (jy wch) +m mHbt (rkhw), & jykw chNy'y kmy'yndw tnhn li un +m chNy'y wdhy'yndswn, cchwth llh bkhshNhr qdr dyNN wrw ahy.

chwnd ahn cch th (pyGmbr pN) llh ty kwR tthhyw ahy, pwi jykDhn llh ghry th tnhnjya dl ty muhr hNy, & llh kuwR khy ns kndw ahy & pnhnjn sukhnn sn schy dyn khy thbt kndw ahy, byshk uhw synn wrw (Gjh) dyNndR ahy.
& uhw ahy jw pnhnjn bnhn jy twbh qbwl kndw ahy & mdyn khn Trw kndw ahy & jyky knd ahyw sw dyNndw ahy.
& jn ymn andw ahy & chN km ky ahn tn jy du` qbwl kndw ahy & pnhnjy fDl sn khyn wdhyk (bh) Dyndw ahy, & kfrn li y'y skht sz ahy.
& jykDhn llh pnhnjn bnhn jy rwzy kshdy kry h th mulk +m Drwr bgyRw wjhn h pr jytrw (pN) ghrndw ahy (wtrw) nzl kndw ahy, cchwth uhw pnhnjn bnhn khy dyNndR DsndR ahy.
& (llh) uhw ahy jw (mNhn jy) n myd thyN khn pwi mynhn hytth mwklyndw ahy & pnhnjy rHmt pkhyRyndw ahy, uhw (y'y) krsz srhyl ahy.
& asmnn & zmyn jw bNy'N & jyky sndn wch +m chrndR pkhyRyy'yn tn jw (bNy'N) sndys nshnyn mn ahy, & uhw jDhn ghrndw (tDhn) sndn gD krN ty ws wrw ahy.

& Dsndyn twn unhn khy jw pysh ky wynd bh ty `jzy kndR khwrya khn kh Dby kywn py Dsnd, & mw'mn chwnd th byshk cchyy'y wr uhy ahn jn pN khy & pnhnjn ghr wrn khy qymt jy Dynhn cchyy'w ltw, khbrdr byshk Zlm hmyshh jy `dhb +m hwnd.

pnhnjy plNhr jw Hukm un Dynhn (jy chN) khn G qbwl kryw jnhn khy llh (jy pr) khn TarNw nh ahy, un Dynhn nk whn khy wh ahy & nh hwndw whn li kw nkr.

& mly'kn khy (llh jwn) dhyy'rwn muqrWr kywn thn jy (pN) llh j bnh ahn, (hy) sndn pyd thyN wqt HDr hw cch? sndyn (h) shhdy sighw lkhby & (huw qymt +m) pucchy wynd.

& byshk muws~ khy pnhnjyn nshnyn sn fr`wn & snds srdrn Dnhn mwklywswn pwi chyy'yn th byshk aun jhnn jy plNhr jw mwklyl ahyn.
pwi jnhn mhl wTn sn jy nshnyn sn ayw (tnhn mhl) wchtw uhy unhn (m`jzn) khn khlnd rhy.

pwi mths swn j kngN cchwnh lth wy y sNs gD thy mly'k cchwnh ay?

pwi khyn (kfrn jw) GwN & pwyn li akhNy kywswn.
& jDhn mrym jy puT jw qSWw byn kyw wyw (tDhn) umlk un (qiSWy) khn tnhnjy qwm luR mchy'yndy ahy.

& jnhn mhl `ys~ chTn m`jzn sn ayw (tnhn mhl) chyy'yn th whn wT Hkmt andy thm & (ayw ahyn) th jn Glhyn +m khtlf knd ahyw tn mn ky whn li byn kryn, pwi llh khn Ddyw & mnhnjw chyw mnyyw.
byshk llh y'y mnhnjw plNhr & whn jw plNhr ahy tnhnkry sndys `bdt kryw, ih sidhy wT ahy.
pwi Twlyn pN +m khtlf kyw, tnhnkry Dkhwy'yndR Dynhn jy `dhb khn Zlmn li khrby ahy.

& rt & Dynhn jy phyrghyr +m & jyky llh asmn khn rwzy nzl ky'y pwi un sbbn zmyn khy snds Gyrabdya khnpwi abd kyy'yn tnhn +m & wy'n jy hly'N +m unhn mNhn li nshnywn ahn jyky smjh rkhnd ahn.

& mw'mn chwnd ahn th k suwr@ cchwnh nzl ky'y wy'y, pwi jDhn pdhry m`n~ wry suwr@ nzl ky'y wnyy & un +m jhd jw dhkr kyw wnyy th jn jy dlyn +m bymry ahy tn khy Dsndyn th tw Dnhn unhya (mNhw) jy nhrN wngr Dsnd ahn jnhn khy mwt (jy skrt) khn byhwshy puhty hjy, pwi unhn li khrby ahy.

& jykDhn ghrwn h th uhy twkhy Dykhrywn h pwi sndn chhrn mn khyn snyNyn h, & Drwr khyn Glhy'N jy ddhng mn m`lwm kndyn, & llh whn j krtwt dyNndw ahy.
